#### 6.2.2 System Primitive Relations

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SystemState
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.system-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, process, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines system primitive state record and state access/update helpers.
-->

SysState = ⟨env, exit_code_opt⟩
Env(⟨env, exit_code_opt⟩) = env
ExitCode(⟨env, exit_code_opt⟩) = exit_code_opt
SetExitCode(⟨env, _⟩, code) = ⟨env, code⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SystemPrimitiveJudgments
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.system-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, process, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines state-elided and explicit-state system primitive judgements.
-->

SystemJudg = {SystemGetEnv(key) ⇓ r, SystemExit(code) ⇓ ok, SystemRun(command) ⇓ code}
SystemJudg_sys = {SystemGetEnv(key, sys) ⇓ (r, sys'), SystemExit(code, sys) ⇓ sys', SystemRun(command, sys) ⇓ (code, sys')}

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SystemPrimitiveStateElidedEquivalences

phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.system-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, process, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines state-elided system primitive judgements as existential wrappers over explicit-state judgements.
-->

SystemGetEnv(key) ⇓ r ⇔ ∃ sys, sys'. SystemGetEnv(key, sys) ⇓ (r, sys')
SystemExit(code) ⇓ ok ⇔ ∃ sys, sys'. SystemExit(code, sys) ⇓ sys'
SystemRun(command) ⇓ code ⇔ ∃ sys, sys'. SystemRun(command, sys) ⇓ (code, sys')

applies-to: runtime, capabilities, process, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage

EmptyStringVal = v ⇔ ∃ lit. lit.kind = StringLiteral ∧ StringBytes(lit) = [] ∧ LiteralValue(lit, TypeString(`@View`)) = v

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: System-GetEnv-Ok
kind: formal-rule

Env(sys)[key] = v

SystemGetEnv(key, sys) ⇓ (v, sys)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: System-GetEnv-None
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.system-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, process, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage

key ∉ dom(Env(sys))

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: System-Exit
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime

owner: runtime.system-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, process, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates SystemExit by setting the system exit code.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: System-Run

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TimePrimitiveValueConstructors
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.time-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, clock, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines value constructors used by time primitive semantics.
labels: DurationVal, MonotonicInstantVal, UtcInstantVal, TimeErrorVal, TimeOk, TimeErr
-->

DurationVal(n) = RecordValue(TypePath(["Duration"]), [⟨`nanoseconds`, IntVal("u128", n)⟩])
MonotonicInstantVal(domain, ticks) = RecordValue(TypePath(["MonotonicInstant"]), [⟨`domain`, IntVal("usize", domain)⟩, ⟨`ticks`, IntVal("u128", ticks)⟩])
UtcInstantVal(n) = RecordValue(TypePath(["UtcInstant"]), [⟨`unix_nanoseconds`, IntVal("i128", n)⟩])
TimeErrorVal(name) = EnumValue(["TimeError", name], ⊥)
TimeOk(T, v) = `Outcome<T, TimeError>@Value`{`value`: v}
TimeErr(T, name) = `Outcome<T, TimeError>@Error`{`error`: TimeErrorVal(name)}

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.TimePrimitiveAttenuationSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.time-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, clock, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires Time-derived and coarsened clock capabilities to be attenuation relations that grant no authority outside their sources.
labels: TimeMonotonic, TimeWall, MonotonicTimeCoarsen, WallTimeCoarsen, attenuation
-->

`TimeMonotonic` and `TimeWall` are attenuation relations from the process time root. `MonotonicTimeCoarsen` and `WallTimeCoarsen` are attenuation relations from an existing clock capability.

A conforming implementation MUST satisfy all of the following:
1. `TimeMonotonic(v_time) ⇓ v_mono` implies `v_mono` denotes a monotonic-clock capability whose authority is a subset of `v_time`.
2. `TimeWall(v_time) ⇓ v_wall` implies `v_wall` denotes a wall-clock capability whose authority is a subset of `v_time`.
3. Coarsened clock capabilities MUST NOT invalidate the source capability, mutate unrelated capability state, or introduce authority outside the source capability.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.MonotonicTimePrimitiveSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.time-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, clock, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires monotonic time primitives to provide ordered monotonic reads, resolution, elapsed-duration calculation, and precision attenuation.
labels: MonotonicTimeNow, MonotonicTimeResolution, MonotonicTimeElapsed, MonotonicTimeCoarsen
-->

A conforming implementation MUST satisfy all of the following:
1. `MonotonicTimeNow(v_mono) ⇓ MonotonicInstantVal(domain, ticks)` MUST read a monotonic clock. For two successful reads through capabilities in the same clock domain, if read A happens-before read B, then `ticks_A <= ticks_B`.
2. `MonotonicTimeResolution(v_mono) ⇓ DurationVal(n)` MUST return the advertised monotonic-clock resolution for `v_mono`, with `n > 0`.
3. `MonotonicTimeElapsed(v_mono, start, end) ⇓ TimeOk(TypePath(["Duration"]), DurationVal(n))` only if `start` and `end` are monotonic instants from the clock domain authorized by `v_mono`, `end` does not precede `start`, and the elapsed duration is representable in nanoseconds. Otherwise it MUST return `TimeErr(TypePath(["Duration"]), ClockMismatch)` or `TimeErr(TypePath(["Duration"]), OutOfRange)` without reading wall-clock time.
4. `MonotonicTimeCoarsen(v_mono, resolution) ⇓ TimeOk(TypeDynamic(`MonotonicTime`), v_mono')` only if `resolution` denotes `DurationVal(n)` with `n > 0`; the resulting capability MUST NOT expose timing precision finer than `max(n, resolution(v_mono))`. If `resolution` is zero or not a valid duration value, it MUST return `TimeErr(TypeDynamic(`MonotonicTime`), InvalidResolution)`.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.WallTimePrimitiveSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.time-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, clock, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires wall-clock time primitives to provide UTC wall-clock reads, resolution reporting, failure reporting, and precision attenuation.
labels: WallTimeNowUtc, WallTimeResolution, WallTimeCoarsen
-->

A conforming implementation MUST satisfy all of the following:
1. `WallTimeNowUtc(v_wall) ⇓ TimeOk(TypePath(["UtcInstant"]), UtcInstantVal(n))` MUST read the host wall clock as UTC nanoseconds relative to the Unix epoch. If the host wall clock is unavailable or the value is not representable, it MUST return `TimeErr(TypePath(["UtcInstant"]), ClockUnavailable)` or `TimeErr(TypePath(["UtcInstant"]), OutOfRange)`.
2. `WallTimeResolution(v_wall) ⇓ TimeOk(TypePath(["Duration"]), DurationVal(n))` MUST return the advertised wall-clock resolution for `v_wall`, with `n > 0`, or a `TimeErr(TypePath(["Duration"]), ClockUnavailable)` value when the host cannot report a wall-clock resolution.
3. `WallTimeCoarsen(v_wall, resolution) ⇓ TimeOk(TypeDynamic(`WallTime`), v_wall')` only if `resolution` denotes `DurationVal(n)` with `n > 0`; the resulting capability MUST NOT expose timing precision finer than `max(n, resolution(v_wall))`. If `resolution` is zero or not a valid duration value, it MUST return `TimeErr(TypeDynamic(`WallTime`), InvalidResolution)`.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

NetworkJudg = {NetRestrictHost(v_net, host) ⇓ v_net'}

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.NetRestrictHostRequiredSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.network-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, network, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires NetRestrictHost to be a runtime host-primitive relation with required semantics.
-->

`NetRestrictHost` is a runtime host-primitive relation with required semantics.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.NetRestrictHostSubsetAuthority
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.network-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, network, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires a restricted network capability to grant only a subset of the source capability authority.
-->

A conforming implementation MUST satisfy all of the following:
1. `NetRestrictHost(v_net, host) ⇓ v_net'` implies `v_net'` denotes a capability whose network authority is a subset of `v_net`.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.NetRestrictHostEqualityEnforcement
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.network-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, network, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires operations through a host-restricted network capability to be rejected unless their effective host equals the restriction host.
-->

2. Any connection, bind, or name-resolution operation performed through `v_net'` MUST be rejected unless its effective host equals `host`.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.NetRestrictRejectBeforeObservableEffect
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.network-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, network, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires rejection by host-restricted network capabilities to happen before externally observable network effects.
-->

3. Rejection under rule 2 MUST occur before any externally observable network effect is performed.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.NetRestrictNoUnrelatedMutation
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.network-primitives
applies-to: runtime, capabilities, network, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires NetRestrictHost not to invalidate its source capability or mutate unrelated capability state.
-->

4. `NetRestrictHost` MUST NOT invalidate `v_net` and MUST NOT mutate unrelated capability state.

owner: runtime.primitive-method-application

summary: Defines method name extraction and method owner resolution for primitive method application.
-->

MethodName(MethodDecl(_, _, _, name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _)) = name
MethodName(ClassMethodDecl(_, _, name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _)) = name
MethodName(StateMethodDecl(_, _, name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _)) = name
MethodName(TransitionDecl(_, _, name, _, _, _, _, _)) = name
MethodOwner(m) = owner ⇔ ∃ T. MethodByName(T, MethodName(m)) = m ∧ owner = T
MethodOwner(m) = ModalStateRef(modal_ref, S) ⇔ ModalDeclOf(modal_ref) = M ∧ (m ∈ Methods(M, S) ∨ m ∈ Transitions(M, S))

### 6.3 Binding and Permission Runtime State

#### 6.3.1 Binding State

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingStateDomain
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding movement state variants.
-->

BindingState ::= Valid | Moved | PartiallyMoved(F)    (F ⊆ Name)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindInfo
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines movability, responsibility, mutability, and binding info records.
-->

Movability ::= mov | immov
Responsibility ::= resp | alias
Mutability = {`let`, `var`}
BindInfo ::= ⟨state, mov, mut, resp⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingEnvironment
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding scopes and binding environment stacks.
-->

BindScope = Map(Identifier, BindInfo)
𝔅 = [BindScope]

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingScopeStackOps
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding environment push and pop operations.
-->

PushScope_B(𝔅) = [∅] ++ 𝔅
PopScope_B([_] ++ 𝔅) = 𝔅

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingLookup
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lexical binding lookup across binding environment scopes.
-->

Lookup_B([σ] ++ 𝔅', x) =
  { σ[x]                if x ∈ dom(σ)
    Lookup_B(𝔅', x)     otherwise }
Lookup_B([], x) = ⊥

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingUpdate
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lexical binding update across binding environment scopes.
-->

Update_B([σ] ++ 𝔅', x, info) =
  { [σ[x ↦ info]] ++ 𝔅'            if x ∈ dom(σ)
    [σ] ++ Update_B(𝔅', x, info)   otherwise }
Update_B([], x, info) = ⊥

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingIntro
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding introduction into the top binding scope.
-->

Intro_B([σ] ++ 𝔅', x, info) = [σ[x ↦ info]] ++ 𝔅'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 6.3.2 Permission Activity State

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionOfType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permission extraction from type syntax with const defaulting.
-->

PermOf(TypePerm(p, T)) = p
PermOf(T) = `const`    if T ≠ TypePerm(_, _)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionActivityDomain
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines active and inactive permission activity states.
-->

ActiveState ::= Active | Inactive

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionEnvironment
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permission keys, permission scopes, and permission environment stacks.
-->

PermKey = Identifier × FieldPath
PermScope = Map(PermKey, ActiveState)
Π = [PermScope]

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionScopeStackOps
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permission environment push and pop operations.
-->

PushScope_Π(Π) = [∅] ++ Π
PopScope_Π([_] ++ Π) = Π

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionLookup
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permission activity lookup with active default.
-->

Lookup_Π([σ] ++ Π', k) =
  { Inactive             if k ∈ dom(σ) ∧ σ[k] = Inactive
    Lookup_Π(Π', k)      otherwise }
Lookup_Π([], k) = Active

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionUpdate
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permission activity update in the top permission scope.
-->

Update_Π([σ] ++ Π', k, s) = [σ[k ↦ s]] ++ Π'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 6.3.3 Join and Transition Operations

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingStateJoin
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, control-flow-join, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding-state joins across control-flow branches.
-->

JoinState(Moved, s) = Moved
JoinState(s, Moved) = Moved
JoinState(PartiallyMoved(F_1), PartiallyMoved(F_2)) = PartiallyMoved(F_1 ∪ F_2)
JoinState(Valid, PartiallyMoved(F)) = PartiallyMoved(F)
JoinState(PartiallyMoved(F), Valid) = PartiallyMoved(F)
JoinState(Valid, Valid) = Valid

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the possible binding-state transitions.
-->

StateTransition = Valid → Moved | Valid → PartiallyMoved(F) | PartiallyMoved(F) → PartiallyMoved(F ∪ {f}) | PartiallyMoved(F) → Moved

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

summary: Defines binding info joins across control-flow branches.

JoinBindInfo(⟨s_1, mv_1, mut_1, resp_1⟩, ⟨s_2, mv_2, mut_2, resp_2⟩) =
  { ⟨JoinState(s_1, s_2), mv_1, mut_1, resp_1⟩   if mv_1 = mv_2 ∧ mut_1 = mut_2 ∧ resp_1 = resp_2
    ⊥                                            otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingScopeJoin
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, control-flow-join, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding scope joins across control-flow branches.
-->

JoinScope_B(B_1, B_2) =
  { { x ↦ JoinBindInfo(B_1[x], B_2[x]) | x ∈ dom(B_1) }    if dom(B_1) = dom(B_2) ∧ ∀ x ∈ dom(B_1). JoinBindInfo(B_1[x], B_2[x]) ≠ ⊥
    ⊥                                                      otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingEnvironmentJoin
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, control-flow-join, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding environment joins across control-flow branches.
-->

Join_B([], []) = []
Join_B(B_1 :: 𝔅_1, B_2 :: 𝔅_2) =
  { JoinScope_B(B_1, B_2) :: Join_B(𝔅_1, 𝔅_2)    if JoinScope_B(B_1, B_2) ≠ ⊥ ∧ Join_B(𝔅_1, 𝔅_2) ≠ ⊥
    ⊥                                           otherwise }
Join_B(𝔅_1, 𝔅_2) = ⊥    if |𝔅_1| ≠ |𝔅_2|

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionStateJoin

summary: Defines permission activity state joins.

JoinPermState(Active, Active) = Active
JoinPermState(_, _) = Inactive    otherwise

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionAtScope

PermAt(B, x) =
  { B[x]     if x ∈ dom(B)
    Active   otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionScopeJoin
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required

summary: Defines permission scope joins across control-flow branches.
-->

JoinScope_Π(B_1, B_2) = { x ↦ JoinPermState(PermAt(B_1, x), PermAt(B_2, x)) | x ∈ dom(B_1) ∪ dom(B_2) }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PermissionEnvironmentJoin

summary: Defines permission environment joins across control-flow branches.
-->

JoinPerm([], []) = []
JoinPerm(B_1 :: Π_1, B_2 :: Π_2) =
  { JoinScope_Π(B_1, B_2) :: JoinPerm(Π_1, Π_2)    if JoinScope_Π(B_1, B_2) ≠ ⊥ ∧ JoinPerm(Π_1, Π_2) ≠ ⊥
    ⊥                                             otherwise }
JoinPerm(Π_1, Π_2) = ⊥    if |Π_1| ≠ |Π_2|

#### 6.3.4 Access and Binding Introduction Helpers

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FieldHead
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, permissions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the first field component of a place access path.
-->

FieldHead(Identifier(x)) = ⊥
FieldHead(FieldAccess(p, f)) =
  { f                if FieldHead(p) = ⊥
    FieldHead(p)     otherwise }
FieldHead(TupleAccess(p, _)) = FieldHead(p)
FieldHead(IndexAccess(p, _)) = FieldHead(p)
FieldHead(Deref(p)) = ⊥

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FieldPathOf
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, permissions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines field-path extraction from place access syntax.
-->

FieldPath = [Name]
FieldPathOf(Identifier(x)) = []
FieldPathOf(FieldAccess(p, f)) = FieldPathOf(p) ++ [f]
FieldPathOf(TupleAccess(p, _)) = FieldPathOf(p)
FieldPathOf(IndexAccess(p, _)) = FieldPathOf(p)
FieldPathOf(Deref(p)) = []

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PlacePath
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, permissions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines root and field-path decomposition for places.
-->

PlacePath(p) =
  { (PlaceRoot(p), [])               if p = Identifier(x)
    (PlaceRoot(p), FieldPathOf(p))   otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AccessPathPrefixes
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines field-path prefixes and ancestor permission paths for a place.
-->

Prefixes([]) = [[]]
Prefixes([f] ++ io) = [[]] ∪ { [f] ++ p | p ∈ Prefixes(io) }
AncPaths(p) = { (PlaceRoot(p), fp) | fp ∈ Prefixes(FieldPathOf(p)) }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AccessPathOk
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permission-path accessibility as all ancestor paths active.
-->

AccessPathOk(Π, p) ⇔ ∀ k ∈ AncPaths(p). Lookup_Π(Π, k) = Active

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SuspendUniquePath
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines temporary suspension of unique access for non-move place argument paths.
-->

SuspendUniquePath(Π, mode, p) =
  { SetTop(Π, InactivateScope(Top(Π), AncPaths(p)))    if mode = ⊥ ∧ IsPlace(p) ∧ PermOf(ExprType(p)) = `unique`
    Π                                                 otherwise }
SuspendUnique(Π, mode, e) =
  { SuspendUniquePath(Π, mode, e)    if IsPlace(e)
    Π                               otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ReactivatePermissionKeys
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.permission-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, permissions, unique-access, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines removing suspended permission keys and reactivating permission state.
-->

RemoveKeys(σ, D) = { k ↦ σ[k] | k ∈ dom(σ) ∧ k ∉ D }
Reactivate([σ] ++ Π', D) = [RemoveKeys(σ, D)] ++ Π'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ArgumentPassExpression
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, permissions, temporaries, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines argument expression wrapping for move and reference parameter passing.
-->

ArgPassKind = {`ref`, `move`, `copy`}
ArgPassExpr(mode, pass, e) =
  { MoveArgExpr(e)          if mode = `move` ∧ pass = `move`
    CopyArgExpr(e)          if pass = `copy`
    MoveArgExpr(CallTemp(e)) if mode = `move` ∧ pass = `ref` ∧ ¬ HasSourceProvenance(e)
    RefArgExpr(e)           if mode = ⊥ ∧ pass = `ref`
    e                       otherwise }

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AccessStateOk

owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, permissions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines access-state validity for valid, partially moved, and moved bindings.
-->

AccessStateOk(Valid, p) = true
AccessStateOk(PartiallyMoved(F), p) = (FieldHead(p) = f ∧ f ∉ F)
AccessStateOk(Moved, p) = false

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PartialMoveStateUpdate

PM(Valid, f) = PartiallyMoved({f})
PM(PartiallyMoved(F), f) = PartiallyMoved(F ∪ {f})
PM(Moved, f) = ⊥

ExprType(e) = T ⇔ Γ; R; L ⊢ e : T
ExprType(p) = T ⇔ IsPlace(p) ∧ Γ; R; L ⊢ p :place T

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AccessOk
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, permissions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binding, permission, and combined access checks.
-->

AccessOk_B(𝔅, p) ⇔ x = PlaceRoot(p) ∧ Lookup_B(𝔅, x) = ⟨s, _, _, _⟩ ∧ AccessStateOk(s, p)
AccessOk_Π(Π, p) ⇔ (PermOf(ExprType(p)) ≠ `unique`) ∨ AccessPathOk(Π, p)
AccessOk(𝔅, Π, p) ⇔ AccessOk_B(𝔅, p) ∧ AccessOk_Π(Π, p)

**Temporary Lifetime.**

id: def.BindingInitializerScope

BindInitScope(e) = BindScope(s) ⇔

    StmtScope(EnclosingStmt(e)) otherwise }

id: def.TemporaryValuePredicate

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TemporaryEvaluationOrder

owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, temporaries, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines left-to-right temporary evaluation order for expression lists and expressions.
-->

TempOrderList([]) = []
TempOrderList([e] ++ es) = TempOrder(e) ++ TempOrderList(es)

TempOrder(e) =
  { TempOrderList(Children_LTR(e)) ++ [e]    if TempValue(e)
    TempOrderList(Children_LTR(e))           otherwise }

TempOrderStmt(s) = TempOrderList(StmtExprs(s))

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ControlStatementExpression
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis

owner: checker.binding-state

summary: Defines control-transfer expressions excluded from ordinary statement temporary drop lists.
-->

ControlExpr(ReturnStmt(e)) = e
ControlExpr(BreakStmt(e)) = e
ControlExpr(s) = ⊥    if s ∉ {ReturnStmt(_), BreakStmt(_)}

id: def.TemporaryDropOrder

-->

TempStmtList(s) = [ e ∈ TempOrderStmt(s) | TempScope(e) = StmtScope(s) ∧ e ≠ ControlExpr(s) ]
TempDropOrder(s) = Rev(TempStmtList(s))

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.StatementExpressions
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, temporaries, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines expression collection for statement forms.
-->

StmtExprs(LetStmt(⟨_, _, _, init, _⟩)) = [init]
StmtExprs(VarStmt(⟨_, _, _, init, _⟩)) = [init]
StmtExprs(UsingLocalStmt(_, _, _)) = []
StmtExprs(AssignStmt(p, e)) = [e, p]
StmtExprs(CompoundAssignStmt(p, _, e)) = [p, e]
StmtExprs(ExprStmt(e)) = [e]
StmtExprs(ReturnStmt(e_opt)) = OptList(e_opt)
StmtExprs(BreakStmt(e_opt)) = OptList(e_opt)
StmtExprs(ContinueStmt) = []
StmtExprs(DeferStmt(_)) = []
StmtExprs(UnsafeBlockStmt(b)) = [b]
StmtExprs(RegionStmt(opts_opt, _, b)) = [RegionOptsExpr(opts_opt), b]
StmtExprs(FrameStmt(_, b)) = [b]
StmtExprs(ErrorStmt(_)) = []

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.StatementAndBindingScopes
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, ownership, movement, temporaries, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines statement scopes, binding scopes, enclosing statement lookup, and statement block lookup.
-->

StmtScope(s) = s
BindScope(s) = BlockOfStmt(s)
EnclosingStmt(e) = s ⇔ e ∈ SubExprs(s) ∧ ∀ s' ∈ SubStmts(s). e ∉ SubExprs(s')
BlockOfStmt(s) = b ⇔ s ∈ BlockStmts(b) ∧ ∀ b' ∈ SubBlocks(b). s ∉ BlockStmts(b')

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.StatementBlocks
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.binding-state
applies-to: semantic-analysis, temporaries, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines child block extraction from statement forms.
-->

StmtBlocks(UnsafeBlockStmt(b)) = [b]
StmtBlocks(DeferStmt(b)) = [b]
StmtBlocks(RegionStmt(_, _, b)) = [b]
StmtBlocks(FrameStmt(_, b)) = [b]
StmtBlocks(s) = []    if s ∉ {UnsafeBlockStmt(_), DeferStmt(_), RegionStmt(_, _, _), FrameStmt(_, _)}

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.StatementSubExpressions

owner: checker.binding-state

summary: Defines recursive subexpression collection for statements.
-->

SubExprs(s) = SubExprsList(StmtExprs(s))
SubExprsList([]) = ∅
SubExprsList([e] ++ es) = {e} ∪ SubExprsList(Children_LTR(e)) ∪ SubExprsList(es)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.StatementSubStatements
kind: formal-definition

strength: required

applies-to: semantic-analysis, temporaries, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines recursive nested statement collection for statements.
-->

SubStmts(s) = SubStmtsList(StmtBlocks(s))
SubStmtsList([]) = ∅
SubStmtsList([b] ++ bs) = BlockStmts(b) ∪ SubStmtsSeq(BlockStmts(b)) ∪ SubStmtsList(bs)
SubStmtsSeq([]) = ∅
SubStmtsSeq([s] ++ ss) = SubStmts(s) ∪ SubStmtsSeq(ss)

id: def.SubBlocks

SubBlocks(b) = SubBlocksSeq(BlockStmts(b))
SubBlocksSeq([]) = ∅
SubBlocksSeq([s] ++ ss) = StmtBlocks(s) ∪ (⋃_{b' ∈ StmtBlocks(s)} SubBlocks(b')) ∪ SubBlocksSeq(ss)

### 6.4 Regions, Frames, and Provenance

#### 6.4.1 Built-In Region Options and Region Helpers

RegionOptionsFields = [
  ⟨⊥, `public`, false, `stack_size`, TypePrim("usize"), Literal(IntLiteral(0)), ⊥, ⊥⟩,
  ⟨⊥, `public`, false, `name`, TypeString(⊥), Literal(StringLiteral("\"")), ⊥, ⊥⟩
]

-->

RegionOptionsDecl = RecordDecl(⊥, `public`, `RegionOptions`, ⊥, ⊥, [], RegionOptionsFields, ⊥, ⊥, ⊥)
Σ.Types[`RegionOptions`] = RegionOptionsDecl

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

RegionActiveType(T) ⇔ StripPerm(T) = TypeModalState([`Region`], `Active`)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.regions
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, regions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region binding introduction for explicit aliases or fresh region names.
-->

RegionBind(Γ, alias_opt) = Γ_r ⇔ r =
  { alias_opt           if alias_opt ≠ ⊥
    FreshRegion(Γ)      otherwise } ∧ IntroAll(Γ, [⟨r, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState([`Region`], `Active`))⟩]) ⇓ Γ_r

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.regions
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lookup of the innermost active region in an environment stack.
-->

InnermostActiveRegion([]) = ⊥
InnermostActiveRegion([σ] ++ Γ') =
  { r                          if ∃ r. r ∈ dom(σ) ∧ RegionActiveType(σ[r])
    InnermostActiveRegion(Γ')  otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FrameBind
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.regions
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, regions, frames, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines frame binding introduction for implicit or explicit target regions.
-->

FrameBind(Γ, target_opt) = Γ_f ⇔ r =
  { InnermostActiveRegion(Γ)    if target_opt = ⊥
    target_opt                  if target_opt ≠ ⊥ ∧ Γ; R; L ⊢ Identifier(target_opt) : T_r ∧ RegionActiveType(T_r) } ∧ F = FreshRegion(Γ) ∧ IntroAll(Γ, [⟨F, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState([`Region`], `Active`))⟩]) ⇓ Γ_f

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

If `alias_opt = ⊥`, the identifier introduced by `RegionBindName(Γ, alias_opt)` MUST be treated as synthetic. It MUST NOT be introduced by name resolution and MUST NOT be referenced by user code.

#### 6.4.2 Provenance Tags and Lifetime Order

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ProvenanceTags
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines provenance tag variants.

π ::= π_Global | π_Stack(S) | π_Heap | π_Region(r) | ⊥

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionNesting
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region nesting from environment scope order.
-->

RegionNesting(r_inner, r_outer) ⇔ ∃ Γ_1, σ_inner, Γ_2, σ_outer, Γ_3. Γ = Γ_1 ++ [σ_inner] ++ Γ_2 ++ [σ_outer] ++ Γ_3 ∧ r_inner ∈ dom(σ_inner) ∧ r_outer ∈ dom(σ_outer)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.StrictProvenanceLifetimeOrder
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines strict provenance lifetime order.
-->

π_1 < π_2 ⇔ (π_1 = π_Region(r_inner) ∧ π_2 = π_Region(r_outer) ∧ RegionNesting(r_inner, r_outer)) ∨ (π_1 = π_Region(r) ∧ π_2 = π_Stack(S)) ∨ (π_1 = π_Stack(S) ∧ π_2 = π_Heap) ∨ (π_1 = π_Heap ∧ π_2 = π_Global) ∨ (π_1 = π_Global ∧ π_2 = ⊥)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ProvenanceLifetimeOrder
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines reflexive-transitive provenance lifetime order.
-->

π_1 ≤ π_2 ⇔ π_1 = π_2 ∨ (π_1 < π_2) ∨ ∃ π. (π_1 < π ∧ π ≤ π_2)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FrameTarget
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines frame target region resolution for implicit and explicit frame targets.
-->

FrameTarget(Γ, ⊥) = r ⇔ InnermostActiveRegion(Γ) = r
FrameTarget(Γ, r) = r ⇔ Γ; R; L ⊢ Identifier(r) : T_r ∧ RegionActiveType(T_r)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FrameTargetProvenanceOrder
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines frame target relation and ordering of frame regions beneath target regions.
-->

FrameTargetRel(F, r) ⇔ FrameTarget(Γ, F) = r
FrameTargetRel(F, r) ⇒ π_Region(F) < π_Region(r)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ProvenanceJoin
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.provenance
applies-to: semantic-analysis, regions, frames, lifetimes, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines pairwise provenance joins.
-->

JoinProv(π_1, π_2) =
  { π_1    if π_1 ≤ π_2
    π_2    if π_2 ≤ π_1
    ⊥      otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: Defines n-way provenance joins.

JoinAllProv([]) = ⊥
JoinAllProv([π]) = π
JoinAllProv([π_1, π_2] ++ ps) = JoinAllProv([JoinProv(π_1, π_2)] ++ ps)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

ResolveEntry_π([⟨tag_i, target_i⟩] ++ RS, tag) =

    ResolveEntry_π(RS, tag)  otherwise }

kind: formal-definition

strength: required
owner: checker.provenance

ClosureLocalSharedCaptures(C, Γ) = [x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ (∃ S ∈ LocalScopes(Γ). x ∈ dom(S)) ∧ (∃ T. BindOf(Γ, x) = ⟨_, shared T⟩)]

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ClosureEscapeCheck
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required

summary: Defines closure escape validity for capture provenance and escaping local shared captures.
-->

ClosureEscapeCheck(C, Ω) ⇔
  (∀ π_x ∈ ClosureCaptureProv(C, Ω). ¬(π_x < ClosureTargetProv(C, Ω))) ∧
  (¬IsEscaping(C) ∨ ClosureLocalSharedCaptures(C, Γ) = ∅)

Γ; Ω ⊢ C ⇓ π_Global

-->

ClosureCaptureProv(C, Ω) = [π_1, …, π_n]    JoinAllProv([π_1, …, π_n]) = π_cap    Γ; Ω ⊢ body ⇓ π_body

### 6.5 Dynamic Scope Stack, Bindings, and Region Runtime

#### 6.5.1 Dynamic Scope Stack and Binding Store

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ScopeEntry
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.binding-store
applies-to: runtime, scopes, bindings, cleanup, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines dynamic scope entries and accessors.
-->

ScopeEntry = ⟨scope_id, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩
ScopeId(⟨sid, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩) = sid
ScopeCleanup(⟨sid, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩) = cleanup
ScopeNames(⟨sid, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩) = names
ScopeVals(⟨sid, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩) = vals
ScopeStates(⟨sid, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩) = states

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.DynamicScopeStack
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.binding-store
applies-to: runtime, scopes, bindings, cleanup, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines dynamic scope stack, current scope, empty scopes, and fresh scope identifiers.
-->

ScopeStack(σ) ∈ [ScopeEntry]
CurrentScope(σ) = scope ⇔ ScopeStack(σ) = scope :: ss
CurrentScopeId(σ) = ScopeId(CurrentScope(σ))
ScopeEmpty(sid) = ⟨sid, [], ∅, ∅, ∅⟩
FreshScopeId(σ) = sid ⇒ ∀ s ∈ ScopeStack(σ). ScopeId(s) ≠ sid

summary: Defines dynamic scope stack replacement preserving address tags, region state, and poisoned module state.

UpdateScopeStack(σ, ss) = σ' ⇔ ScopeStack(σ') = ss ∧ AddrTags(σ') = AddrTags(σ) ∧ RegionStack(σ') = RegionStack(σ) ∧ RegionArena(σ') = RegionArena(σ) ∧ PoisonedModules(σ') = PoisonedModules(σ)

phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines removing a region arena while preserving other runtime state components.
-->

ArenaRemove(σ, r) ⇓ σ' ⇔ RegionArena(σ') = RegionArena(σ) \ {r} ∧ ScopeStack(σ') = ScopeStack(σ) ∧ AddrTags(σ') = AddrTags(σ) ∧ RegionStack(σ') = RegionStack(σ) ∧ PoisonedModules(σ') = PoisonedModules(σ)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionValue
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime Region modal-state values and handle extraction.
-->

RegionValue(S, h) = RecordValue(ModalStateRef([`Region`], S), [⟨`handle`, IntVal("usize", h)⟩])
RegionHandleOf(v) = h ⇔ v = RecordValue(ModalStateRef([`Region`], S), io) ∧ ⟨`handle`, IntVal("usize", h)⟩ ∈ io

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ResolveRuntimeRegionEntry
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime region stack entry resolution by region target.
-->

ResolveEntry([], r) = ⊥
ResolveEntry(e :: es, r) =
  e                     if RegionTargetOf(e) = r
  ResolveEntry(es, r)   otherwise

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ActiveRuntimeRegion
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the active runtime region entry and target.
-->

ActiveEntry(σ) = e ⇔ RegionStack(σ) = e :: es
ActiveTarget(σ) = target ⇔ ActiveEntry(σ) = e ∧ RegionTargetOf(e) = target

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ResolveRuntimeRegionTargetAndTag
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime region target and tag resolution from region stack entries.
-->

ResolveTarget(σ, r) = target ⇔ ResolveEntry(RegionStack(σ), r) = e ∧ RegionTargetOf(e) = target
ResolveTag(σ, r) = tag ⇔ ResolveEntry(RegionStack(σ), r) = e ∧ RegionTagOf(e) = tag

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FreshRuntimeRegionTagAndArena
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines fresh region tags and arena identifiers.
-->

FreshTag(σ) = tag ⇒ ∀ e ∈ RegionStack(σ). RegionTagOf(e) ≠ tag
FreshArena(σ) = r ⇒ ∀ e ∈ RegionStack(σ). RegionTargetOf(e) ≠ r

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UpdateRegionStack
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region stack replacement preserving scope stack, address tags, region arena, and poisoned module state.
-->

UpdateRegionStack(σ, rs) = σ' ⇔ RegionStack(σ') = rs ∧ ScopeStack(σ') = ScopeStack(σ) ∧ AddrTags(σ') = AddrTags(σ) ∧ RegionArena(σ') = RegionArena(σ) ∧ PoisonedModules(σ') = PoisonedModules(σ)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionNew
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime creation of a scoped region with a new scope and arena.
-->

RegionNew(σ, opts) ⇓ (σ', r, scope) ⇔ PushScope_σ(σ) ⇓ (σ_1, scope) ∧ FreshArena(σ) = r ∧ ArenaNew(σ_1, r) ⇓ σ_2 ∧ UpdateRegionStack(σ_2, ⟨r, r, scope, ⊥⟩ :: RegionStack(σ_2)) = σ'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionOpen
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime opening of a region in the current scope.
-->

RegionOpen(σ, opts) ⇓ (σ', r) ⇔ FreshArena(σ) = r ∧ ArenaNew(σ, r) ⇓ σ_1 ∧ UpdateRegionStack(σ_1, ⟨r, r, CurrentScopeId(σ), ⊥⟩ :: RegionStack(σ_1)) = σ'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FrameEnter
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime frame entry with a new scope, fresh tag, and arena mark.
-->

FrameEnter(σ, r) ⇓ (σ', F, scope, mark) ⇔ PushScope_σ(σ) ⇓ (σ_1, scope) ∧ F = FreshTag(σ) ∧ mark = FrameMark(σ_1, r) ∧ UpdateRegionStack(σ_1, ⟨F, r, scope, mark⟩ :: RegionStack(σ_1)) = σ'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.BindRegionAlias
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines optional runtime binding of a region alias.
-->

BindRegionAlias(σ, ⊥, r) ⇓ σ
BindRegionAlias(σ, x, r) ⇓ σ' ⇔ BindVal(σ, x, RegionValue(`@Active`, r)) ⇓ (σ', b)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TagAddr
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines assigning a runtime tag to an address.
-->

TagAddr(σ, addr, tag) ⇓ σ' ⇔ AddrTags(σ') = AddrTags(σ)[addr ↦ tag] ∧ ScopeStack(σ') = ScopeStack(σ) ∧ RegionStack(σ') = RegionStack(σ) ∧ RegionArena(σ') = RegionArena(σ) ∧ PoisonedModules(σ') = PoisonedModules(σ)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TagAddrFrom
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines propagating an address tag from a base address to a new address.
-->

TagAddrFrom(σ, base, addr) ⇓ σ' ⇔ (AddrTag(σ, base) = tag ∧ TagAddr(σ, addr, tag) ⇓ σ') ∨ (AddrTag(σ, base) = ⊥ ∧ σ' = σ)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionAlloc
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region allocation, memory write, arena append, address tagging, and allocated value readback.
-->

RegionAlloc(σ, r, v) ⇓ (σ', v') ⇔ ResolveTag(σ, r) = tag ∧ FreshAddr(σ) = addr ∧ WriteAddr(σ, addr, v) ⇓ σ_1 ∧ ArenaAppend(σ_1, r, addr) ⇓ σ_2 ∧ TagAddr(σ_2, addr, RegionTag(tag)) ⇓ σ' ∧ ReadAddr(σ', addr) = v'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.FreshRuntimeRegionTags
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines freshness of a list of runtime region tags.
-->

FreshTags(σ, tags) ⇔ Distinct(tags) ∧ ∀ tag ∈ Set(tags). ∀ e ∈ RegionStack(σ). RegionTagOf(e) ≠ tag

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RetagRegions
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines retagging runtime region stack entries for a target region.
-->

RetagRegions([], r, tags) = [] ⇔ tags = []
RetagRegions(e :: es, r, tags) =
  e' :: RetagRegions(es, r, tags')    if RegionTargetOf(e) = r ∧ tags = tag :: tags' ∧ e' = ⟨tag, RegionTargetOf(e), RegionScopeOf(e), RegionMarkOf(e)⟩
  e :: RetagRegions(es, r, tags)      otherwise

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionReset
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region reset by clearing arena allocations and retagging region stack entries.
-->

RegionReset(σ, r) ⇓ σ' ⇔ ArenaClear(σ, r) ⇓ σ_1 ∧ FreshTags(σ_1, tags) ∧ RetagRegions(RegionStack(σ_1), r, tags) = rs' ∧ UpdateRegionStack(σ_1, rs') = σ'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PopRegions
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines removal of all region stack entries for a target region.
-->

PopRegions([], r) = []
PopRegions(e :: es, r) =
  PopRegions(es, r)    if RegionTargetOf(e) = r
  e :: PopRegions(es, r)    otherwise

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RegionFree
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, scoped-allocation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region free by removing the arena and region stack entries for a target region.

RegionFree(σ, r) ⇓ σ' ⇔ ArenaRemove(σ, r) ⇓ σ_1 ∧ PopRegions(RegionStack(σ_1), r) = rs' ∧ UpdateRegionStack(σ_1, rs') = σ'

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ReleaseArena

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ResetArena

#### 6.5.3 Runtime Value, Block, and Address Helpers

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.RegionReleaseCleanupBeforeArenaReclaim
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, cleanup, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires region release and frame reset to execute CleanupScope before resetting or removing arena storage.
-->

**Region Deallocation Order.**
`RegionRelease` and `FrameReset` MUST execute `CleanupScope` before any `ArenaResetTo` or `ArenaRemove`.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.ArenaReclaimNoDrop
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.regions
applies-to: runtime, regions, frames, scoped-allocation, cleanup, oracle.behavior, oracle.coverage
summary: Forbids arena reset, clear, and remove operations from invoking Drop.
-->

`ArenaResetTo`, `ArenaClear`, and `ArenaRemove` MUST NOT invoke `Drop`; they only reclaim arena storage.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ScalarRuntimeValues
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, values, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines scalar runtime values and scalar value accessors.
-->

BoolVal(b) = b ⇔ b ∈ {true, false}
CharVal(u) = u ⇔ u ∈ UnicodeScalar
UnitVal = ()
IntVal(t, x) defined ⇔ t ∈ IntTypes ∧ InRange(x, t)
IntValType(IntVal(t, x)) = t
IntValValue(IntVal(t, x)) = x
FloatVal(t, v) defined ⇔ t ∈ FloatTypes ∧ v ∈ FloatValueSet(t)
FloatValType(FloatVal(t, v)) = t
FloatValValue(FloatVal(t, v)) = v

-->

PtrVal(s, addr) defined ⇔ s ∈ PtrStateSet

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AggregateRuntimeValues
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, values, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines tuple, array, function, closure, range, modal, record, enum, and slice runtime values.
-->

TupleVal = {(v_1, …, v_n) | n ≥ 0}
ArrayVal = {[v_1, …, v_n] | n ≥ 0}
FuncVal(sym) defined ⇔ sym ∈ Symbol
ClosureVal(env_ptr, code_ptr) defined ⇔ (env_ptr = null ∨ env_ptr ∈ Addr) ∧ code_ptr ∈ Symbol
RangeVal = {RangeVal(k, lo_opt, hi_opt) | k ∈ RangeKind}
ModalVal(S, v) = ⟨S, v⟩
RecordValue(tr, io) defined
EnumPayloadVal = {⊥, TuplePayload(vec_v), RecordPayload(vec_f)}
EnumValue(path, payload) defined ⇔ payload ∈ EnumPayloadVal
SliceValue(v, r) defined ⇔ SliceBounds(r, Len(v)) defined

owner: runtime.value-model

-->

Value = {BoolVal(b) | b ∈ {true, false}} ∪ {CharVal(u) | u ∈ UnicodeScalar} ∪ {UnitVal} ∪ {IntVal(t, x) | IntVal(t, x) defined} ∪ {FloatVal(t, v) | FloatVal(t, v) defined} ∪ {PtrVal(s, addr) | PtrVal(s, addr) defined} ∪ {RawPtr(q, addr)} ∪ TupleVal ∪ ArrayVal ∪ {RecordValue(tr, io)} ∪ {EnumValue(path, payload)} ∪ RangeVal ∪ {SliceValue(v, r) | SliceValue(v, r) defined} ∪ {ModalVal(S, v)} ∪ {Dyn(Cl, RawPtr(`imm`, addr), T)} ∪ `string@Managed` ∪ `string@View` ∪ `bytes@Managed` ∪ `bytes@View` ∪ {FuncVal(sym)} ∪ {ClosureVal(env_ptr, code_ptr)}

TupleValue((v_0, …, v_{n-1}), i) = v_i    (0 ≤ i < n)
TupleUpdate((v_0, …, v_{n-1}), i, v') = (v_0, …, v_{i-1}, v', v_{i+1}, …, v_{n-1})    (0 ≤ i < n)

FieldValue(RecordValue(tr, io), f) = v ⇔ ⟨f, v⟩ ∈ io
FieldUpdate(RecordValue(tr, io), f, v') = RecordValue(tr, io')    where io' = [⟨f_i, v_i'⟩ | ⟨f_i, v_i⟩ ∈ io ∧ v_i' = v' if f_i = f otherwise v_i]

IndexUpdate([v_0, …, v_{n-1}], i, v_e) = [v_0, …, v_{i-1}, v_e, v_{i+1}, …, v_{n-1}]    (0 ≤ i < n)
SliceLen([v_0, …, v_{n-1}]) = n
SliceLen(SliceValue(v, r)) = end - start    (SliceBounds(r, Len(v)) = (start, end))
SliceElem(v, i) = IndexValue(v, i)    (IndexValue(v, i) defined)
SliceUpdate(v, start, v_rhs) ⇓ v' ⇔ n = SliceLen(v_rhs) ∧ ∃ v_0, …, v_n. v_0 = v ∧ ∀ i ∈ [0, n-1]. v_{i+1} = IndexUpdate(v_i, start + i, SliceElem(v_rhs, i)) ∧ v' = v_n

summary: Defines primitive runtime address judgement forms.

AddrPrimJudg = {ReadAddr(σ, addr) = v, WriteAddr(σ, addr, v) ⇓ σ', FieldAddr(T, addr, f) = addr', TupleAddr(T, addr, i) = addr', IndexAddr(T_b, addr, i) = addr'}

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ElementType
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, arrays, slices, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines element type extraction for array and slice base types.

ElemType(T_b) = T ⇔ StripPerm(T_b) = TypeArray(T, _) ∨ StripPerm(T_b) = TypeSlice(T)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AggregateAddressCalculation
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, records, tuples, arrays, slices, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines record field, tuple field, and indexed element address calculations.
-->

FieldAddr(T, addr, f) = AddrAdd(addr, FieldOffset(Fields(R), f))    when StripPerm(T) = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R
TupleAddr(T, addr, i) = AddrAdd(addr, FieldOffset(TupleFields([T_1, …, T_n]), i))    when StripPerm(T) = TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_n])
IndexLen(σ, addr) = Len(v)    (ReadAddr(σ, addr) = v ∧ Len(v) defined)
IndexAddr(T_b, addr, i) = AddrAdd(addr, i × sizeof(ElemType(T_b)))    (ElemType(T_b) defined)
IndexAddr(T_b, addr, v_i) = addr' ⇔ IndexNum(v_i) = i ∧ IndexAddr(T_b, addr, i) = addr'
SliceLenFromAddr(σ, addr) = n ⇔ ReadAddr(σ, addr) = v ∧ SliceLen(v) = n

id: def.PointerStateAndAddress

owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, pointers, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines pointer states, raw pointer qualifiers, and pointer address extraction.
-->

PtrStateSet = {`Valid`, `Null`, `Expired`}
RawQual = {`imm`, `mut`}
PtrAddr(Ptr@Valid(addr)) = addr
PtrAddr(Ptr@Null(addr)) = addr
PtrAddr(Ptr@Expired(addr)) = addr
PtrAddr(RawPtr(q, addr)) = addr

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BindingAddresses
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, bindings, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime binding addresses and address lookup for binding identities and names.
-->

BindAddr(⟨sid, bind_id, x⟩) ∈ Addr
AddrOfBind(b) =
  { addr         if BindingValue(σ, b) = Alias(addr)
    BindAddr(b)  if BindingValue(σ, b) ≠ Alias(_) }
AddrOfBind(x) = addr ⇔ ∃ b. LookupBind(σ, x) = b ∧ AddrOfBind(b) = addr

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RuntimeAddressTagLookup
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, bindings, regions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime address tag lookup from binding addresses and region address tags.
-->

AddrTag(σ, addr) =
  { ScopeTag(sid)    if addr = BindAddr(⟨sid, bind_id, x⟩)
    RegionTag(tag)   if AddrTags(σ)(addr) = RegionTag(tag)
    ⊥                otherwise }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RuntimeTagActive
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, scopes, regions, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines liveness of runtime region and scope tags.
-->

TagActive(σ, RegionTag(tag)) ⇔ ∃ e ∈ RegionStack(σ). RegionTagOf(e) = tag
TagActive(σ, ScopeTag(sid)) ⇔ ∃ e ∈ ScopeStack(σ). ScopeId(e) = sid

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.DynamicAddressState
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime.value-model
applies-to: runtime, addresses, pointers, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines dynamic address validity or expiration from address tag liveness.
-->

DynAddrState(σ, addr) =
  { `Valid`    if AddrTag(σ, addr) = ⊥
    `Valid`    if AddrTag(σ, addr) = tag ≠ ⊥ ∧ TagActive(σ, tag)
    `Expired`  if AddrTag(σ, addr) = tag ≠ ⊥ ∧ ¬ TagActive(σ, tag) }

This section owns binding-state, region/frame, provenance, and unsafe-runtime diagnostics consumed by Chapters 6, 16, and 18.

| Code         | Severity | Detection    | Condition                                                            |
| ------------ | -------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `E-MEM-1206` | Error    | Compile-time | Named region not found for allocation                                |
| `E-MEM-1207` | Error    | Compile-time | `frame` used with no active region in scope                          |
| `E-MEM-1208` | Error    | Compile-time | `r.frame` target is not in `Region@Active` state                     |
| `E-MEM-3001` | Error    | Compile-time | Read or move of a binding in Moved or PartiallyMoved state           |
| `E-MEM-3003` | Error    | Compile-time | Reassignment of immutable binding                                    |
| `E-MEM-3004` | Error    | Compile-time | Partial move from binding without `unique` permission                |
| `E-MEM-3005` | Error    | Compile-time | Explicit call to `drop` method with destructor signature             |
| `E-MEM-3006` | Error    | Compile-time | Attempt to move from immovable binding (`:=`)                        |
| `E-MEM-3007` | Error    | Compile-time | `unique` binding from place expression requires explicit `move`      |
| `E-MEM-3020` | Error    | Compile-time | Value with shorter-lived provenance escapes to longer-lived location |
| `E-MEM-3021` | Error    | Compile-time | Region allocation `^` outside region scope                           |
| `E-MEM-3030` | Error    | Compile-time | Unsafe operation outside block                                       |

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

**Rationale (non-normative).** A binding introduced in an outer scope cannot be reused as the name of a new binding in an inner scope. Users who wish to introduce a new binding under an already-taken name must choose a different name, or introduce their new binding in a separate sibling scope where the outer name is not visible. Users who wish to create a compile-time alternate name for an existing binding should use `using source as alias` (§11.2, §18.3).

id: def.UsingAlias
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, using-aliases, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines UsingAlias as a compile-time alias to an existing entity without storage or copy.
-->

#### UsingAlias

`UsingAlias(source_name, alias_name)` binds `alias_name` in the current scope to the same `Entity` that `source_name` resolves to. It introduces no new storage and does not copy the bound entity; the alias and the source are interchangeable references to the same compile-time entity.

Reuse of a universe-scope name (primitive, special, or async type) at module scope is not a `ValidateModuleNames` concern — it is handled by `(Intro-Outer-Err)` when the module's bindings are introduced, because `UniverseBindings` is always in the outer scope chain at module scope.

UsingImportConflict(B, N) ⇔ ∃ n. n ∈ Names(B) ∩ dom(N) ∧ (NameSource(B, n) ∈ {Using, Import} ∨ NameSource(N, n) ∈ {Using, Import})

kind: formal-definition

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: Names-Start
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, modules, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Starts deterministic name collection by entering scan state over the module item list.
labels: Names-Start
-->

**(Names-Start)**
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
⟨NamesStart(M)⟩ → ⟨NamesScan(M.items, M.path, ∅)⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: Names-Step
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, modules, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Advances deterministic name collection when item bindings are disjoint and duplicate-free.
labels: Names-Step
-->

**(Names-Step)**
Γ ⊢ ItemBindings(it, p) ⇓ B    DisjointNames(B, N)    NoDup(B)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
⟨NamesScan(it :: rest, p, N)⟩ → ⟨NamesScan(rest, p, N ∪ B)⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: Names-Step-Using-Import-Dup
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, modules, imports, using, diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Transitions deterministic name collection to the import/using conflict error state for import/using duplicate conflicts.
labels: Names-Step-Using-Import-Dup
-->

**(Names-Step-Using-Import-Dup)**
Γ ⊢ ItemBindings(it, p) ⇓ B    (¬ DisjointNames(B, N) ∨ ¬ NoDup(B))    UsingImportConflict(B, N)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
⟨NamesScan(it :: rest, p, N)⟩ → ⟨Error(Code(Import-Using-Name-Conflict))⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: Names-Step-Dup
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, modules, diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Transitions deterministic name collection to the duplicate-name error state for non-import/using duplicate conflicts.
labels: Names-Step-Dup
-->

**(Names-Step-Dup)**
Γ ⊢ ItemBindings(it, p) ⇓ B    (¬ DisjointNames(B, N) ∨ ¬ NoDup(B))    ¬ UsingImportConflict(B, N)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
⟨NamesScan(it :: rest, p, N)⟩ → ⟨Error(Code(Names-Step-Dup))⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: Names-Step-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution

summary: Transitions deterministic name collection to an item-binding error state when item binding fails.
labels: Names-Step-Err
-->

**(Names-Step-Err)**
Γ ⊢ ItemBindings(it, p) ⇑ c
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
⟨NamesScan(it :: rest, p, N)⟩ → ⟨Error(c)⟩

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ResolveModalRef
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, generics, predicates, contracts, types, modal-types, parameters, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines modal-reference resolution for type paths and applied type paths.
-->

ResolveModalRef(modal_ref) ⇓ modal_ref' ⇔
 (modal_ref = TypePath(path) ∧ Γ ⊢ ResolveTypePath(path) ⇓ path' ∧ modal_ref' = TypePath(path')) ∨
 (modal_ref = TypeApply(path, args) ∧ Γ ⊢ ResolveTypePath(path) ⇓ path' ∧ Γ ⊢ ResolveTypeList(args) ⇓ args' ∧ modal_ref' = TypeApply(path', args'))

### 7.8 Name Resolution and Reserved Name Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diagnostics.NameResolutionAndReservedNames
kind: diagnostics
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: diagnostics.name-resolution
applies-to: semantic-analysis, name-resolution, visibility, reserved-names, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines name-resolution, visibility, using/import alias, duplicate declaration, reserved-name, and ambiguous method diagnostic code table.
-->

This section owns name-resolution, visibility, and reserved-name diagnostics.

| Code         | Severity | Detection    | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------ | -------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `E-CNF-0406` | Error    | Compile-time | User declaration uses `gen_` prefix                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `E-MOD-1203` | Error    | Compile-time | Name introduced by `using` or `import as` conflicts with existing                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `E-MOD-1207` | Error    | Compile-time | Cannot access a non-public item from this scope                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `E-MOD-1301` | Error    | Compile-time | Unresolved name: identifier not found in any accessible scope                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `E-MOD-1302` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate declaration in module scope                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `E-MOD-1304` | Error    | Compile-time | Name reuse: identifier already bound in an enclosing scope; choose a different name or use `using source as alias` for a compile-time alias (`Intro-Outer-Err`). When the outer binding is a universe name (primitive, special, or async type), the message SHOULD identify the category. |
| `E-MOD-1307` | Error    | Compile-time | Ambiguous name or method resolution; disambiguation required                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `E-MOD-1308` | Error    | Compile-time | `using source as alias`: `source` does not resolve in any accessible scope (`Using-Alias-Unresolved`)                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `E-MOD-1309` | Error    | Compile-time | `using source as alias`: `alias` conflicts with an existing binding in this or an enclosing scope (`Using-Alias-Dup`)                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `E-MOD-1310` | Error    | Compile-time | `using source as alias`: `alias` is a reserved identifier (`Using-Alias-Reserved`)                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.VarianceSatisfied
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: semantic-analysis, type-system, subtyping, generics, variance, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines when generic arguments satisfy covariant, contravariant, invariant, or bivariant variance.
-->

VarianceSatisfied(v, T, U) ⇔
  (v = `+` ∧ Γ ⊢ T <: U) ∨
  (v = `-` ∧ Γ ⊢ U <: T) ∨
  (v = `=` ∧ Γ ⊢ T ≡ U) ∨
  (v = `±`)

id: def.IdentitySubstitution

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SubstitutionApplication
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: semantic-analysis, type-system, inference, checking, unification, substitution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines how substitutions apply to primitive, variable, aggregate, function, pointer, permission, applied, and remaining type constructors.
-->

θ(TypePrim(p)) = TypePrim(p)
θ(TVar(α)) = θ(α) if α ∈ Dom(θ), else TVar(α)
θ(TypeTuple(Ts)) = TypeTuple([θ(T) | T ∈ Ts])
θ(TypeArray(T, n)) = TypeArray(θ(T), n)
θ(TypeSlice(T)) = TypeSlice(θ(T))
θ(TypeUnion(Ts)) = TypeUnion([θ(T) | T ∈ Ts])
θ(TypeFunc(ps, R)) = TypeFunc([(m, θ(T)) | (m, T) ∈ ps], θ(R))
θ(TypePtr(T, s)) = TypePtr(θ(T), s)
θ(TypePerm(p, T)) = TypePerm(p, θ(T))
θ(TypeApply(path, args)) = TypeApply(path, [θ(T) | T ∈ args])
θ distributes over all remaining type constructors.
