### 12.5 Ranges

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.RangeSyntax
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: parser.types
applies-to: parsing, semantic-analysis, runtime, lowering, ranges, slices, diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines range expression syntax and range type names.
-->

#### 12.5.1 Syntax

```ebnf
range_expr      ::= ".."
                  | ".." expr
                  | "..=" expr
                  | expr ".."
                  | expr ".." expr
                  | expr "..=" expr
range_type_name ::= "Range" | "RangeInclusive" | "RangeFrom" | "RangeTo" | "RangeToInclusive" | "RangeFull"
```

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.RangeTypeParserOwnership
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: parser.types
applies-to: parsing, ranges, generic-types, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires named range surface types to use ordinary generic type or nominal type-path parsing with no range-specific type parser.
-->

`Range<T>`, `RangeInclusive<T>`, `RangeFrom<T>`, `RangeTo<T>`, and `RangeToInclusive<T>` use the ordinary `generic_type_use` syntax of §14.2.1. `RangeFull` uses the ordinary nominal type-path syntax. No range-specific type parser is introduced.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Range surface types are parsed by the ordinary type parser:

- `Range<T>` elaborates to `TypeRange(T)`
- `RangeInclusive<T>` elaborates to `TypeRangeInclusive(T)`
- `RangeFrom<T>` elaborates to `TypeRangeFrom(T)`
- `RangeTo<T>` elaborates to `TypeRangeTo(T)`
- `RangeToInclusive<T>` elaborates to `TypeRangeToInclusive(T)`
- `RangeFull` elaborates to `TypeRangeFull`

#### 12.5.5 Dynamic Semantics

ValueType(RangeVal(`Exclusive`, lo, hi)) = TypeRange(T) ⇔ ValueType(lo) = T ∧ ValueType(hi) = T
ValueType(RangeVal(`Inclusive`, lo, hi)) = TypeRangeInclusive(T) ⇔ ValueType(lo) = T ∧ ValueType(hi) = T
ValueType(RangeVal(`From`, lo, ⊥)) = TypeRangeFrom(T) ⇔ ValueType(lo) = T
ValueType(RangeVal(`To`, ⊥, hi)) = TypeRangeTo(T) ⇔ ValueType(hi) = T
ValueType(RangeVal(`ToInclusive`, ⊥, hi)) = TypeRangeToInclusive(T) ⇔ ValueType(hi) = T
ValueType(RangeVal(`Full`, ⊥, ⊥)) = TypeRangeFull

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RangeInc
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types.ranges
applies-to: parsing, semantic-analysis, runtime, lowering, ranges, slices, diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines integer range increment for inclusive bounds.
-->

Inc(v) = v' ⇔ v = IntVal(t, x) ∧ x' = x + 1 ∧ InRange(x', t) ∧ v' = IntVal(t, x')

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SliceBoundsRaw
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime
applies-to: runtime, ranges, slices, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines raw slice bounds for each runtime range value form.
-->

SliceBoundsRaw(RangeVal(`Exclusive`, s, e), L) = (start, end) ⇔ IndexNum(s) = start ∧ IndexNum(e) = end
SliceBoundsRaw(RangeVal(`Inclusive`, s, e), L) = (start, end) ⇔ IndexNum(s) = start ∧ Inc(e) = e' ∧ IndexNum(e') = end
SliceBoundsRaw(RangeVal(`From`, s, ⊥), L) = (start, L) ⇔ IndexNum(s) = start
SliceBoundsRaw(RangeVal(`To`, ⊥, e), L) = (0, end) ⇔ IndexNum(e) = end
SliceBoundsRaw(RangeVal(`ToInclusive`, ⊥, e), L) = (0, end) ⇔ Inc(e) = e' ∧ IndexNum(e') = end
SliceBoundsRaw(RangeVal(`Full`, ⊥, ⊥), L) = (0, L)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SliceBounds
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime
applies-to: runtime, ranges, slices, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines validated slice bounds and undefined slice bounds for runtime slicing.
-->

SliceBounds(r, L) = (start, end) ⇔ SliceBoundsRaw(r, L) = (start, end) ∧ 0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ L
SliceBounds(r, L) = ⊥ ⇔ SliceBoundsRaw(r, L) = ⊥ ∨ (∃ start, end. SliceBoundsRaw(r, L) = (start, end) ∧ ¬ (0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ L))

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.RangeValueBits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: lowering, ranges, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lowering bit encodings for range values.
-->

ValueBits(TypeRange(T), r) = bits ⇔ r = RangeVal(`Exclusive`, v_lo, v_hi) ∧ TupleLayout([T, T]) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ StructBits([T, T], [v_lo, v_hi], offsets, size) = bits
ValueBits(TypeRangeInclusive(T), r) = bits ⇔ r = RangeVal(`Inclusive`, v_lo, v_hi) ∧ TupleLayout([T, T]) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ StructBits([T, T], [v_lo, v_hi], offsets, size) = bits
ValueBits(TypeRangeFrom(T), r) = bits ⇔ r = RangeVal(`From`, v_lo, ⊥) ∧ TupleLayout([T]) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ StructBits([T], [v_lo], offsets, size) = bits
ValueBits(TypeRangeTo(T), r) = bits ⇔ r = RangeVal(`To`, ⊥, v_hi) ∧ TupleLayout([T]) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ StructBits([T], [v_hi], offsets, size) = bits
ValueBits(TypeRangeToInclusive(T), r) = bits ⇔ r = RangeVal(`ToInclusive`, ⊥, v_hi) ∧ TupleLayout([T]) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ StructBits([T], [v_hi], offsets, size) = bits
ValueBits(TypeRangeFull, r) = bits ⇔ r = RangeVal(`Full`, ⊥, ⊥) ∧ bits = []

#### 12.5.7 Diagnostics

Diagnostics are defined for non-constant and empty range patterns in §17.4. Slice-bounds failures induced by ranges panic at runtime when `SliceBounds` is undefined.

### 12.6 Records

#### 12.6.1 Syntax

```ebnf
record_decl     ::= attribute_list? visibility? "record" identifier generic_params? implements_clause? predicate_clause? record_body invariant_clause?
record_body     ::= "{" record_member* "}"
record_field    ::= attribute_list? visibility? key_boundary? identifier ":" type record_field_init_opt
record_literal  ::= identifier "{" field_init_list "}"
default_record  ::= identifier "(" ")"
```

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Offsets(fields) = [offset_1, …, offset_n] ⇔ fields = [⟨f_1, T_1⟩, …, ⟨f_n, T_n⟩] ∧ n ≥ 1 ∧ offset_1 = 0 ∧ ∀ i ∈ {2, …, n}. offset_i = AlignUp(offset_{i-1} + sizeof(T_{i-1}), alignof(T_i))
RecordAlign([]) = 1
RecordAlign(fields) = max_{i ∈ {1, …, n}}(alignof(T_i)) ⇔ fields = [⟨f_1, T_1⟩, …, ⟨f_n, T_n⟩] ∧ n ≥ 1
RecordSize([]) = 0
RecordSize(fields) = AlignUp(offset_n + sizeof(T_n), RecordAlign(fields)) ⇔ fields = [⟨f_1, T_1⟩, …, ⟨f_n, T_n⟩] ∧ n ≥ 1 ∧ Offsets(fields) = [offset_1, …, offset_n]
RecordLayoutJudg = {RecordLayout}

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

kind: formal-definition

strength: required
owner: codegen

summary: Defines structured value bit layout from field types, values, offsets, and size.

StructBits([T_1, …, T_n], [v_1, …, v_n], [o_1, …, o_n], size) = bits ⇔ |bits| = size ∧ ∀ i. ValueBits(T_i, v_i) = b_i ∧ bits[o_i..o_i+|b_i|) = b_i ∧ ∀ j. (∀ i. j ∉ [o_i, o_i+|b_i|)) ⇒ bits[j] = 0x00

#### 12.6.7 Diagnostics

| Code         | Severity | Detection    | Condition                                                                |
| ------------ | -------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `E-TYP-1901` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate field name in record declaration                               |
| `E-TYP-1902` | Error    | Compile-time | Missing field initializer in record literal                              |
| `E-TYP-1903` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate field initializer in record literal                            |
| `E-TYP-1904` | Error    | Compile-time | Access to nonexistent field                                              |
| `E-TYP-1905` | Error    | Compile-time | Access to field not visible in current scope                             |
| `E-TYP-1906` | Error    | Compile-time | Field visibility exceeds record visibility                               |
| `E-TYP-1907` | Error    | Compile-time | Non-`Bitcopy` field requires move source expression                      |
| `E-TYP-1911` | Error    | Compile-time | Default record construction requires default initializer for every field |

id: grammar.EnumSyntax
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: parser.types
applies-to: enum declarations, variants, discriminants, enum literals, enum layout
summary: Defines enum declaration, variant member, variant payload, and variant literal grammar.
-->

### 12.7 Enums

#### 12.7.1 Syntax

```ebnf
enum_decl        ::= attribute_list? visibility? "enum" identifier generic_params? implements_clause? predicate_clause? enum_body invariant_clause?
enum_body        ::= "{" variant_members? "}"
variant_members  ::= variant (terminator variant)* terminator?
variant          ::= identifier variant_payload_opt variant_discriminant_opt
variant_payload  ::= "(" type_list? ")" | "{" field_decl_list? "}"
variant_literal  ::= qualified_variant | qualified_variant "(" arg_exprs? ")" | qualified_variant "{" field_init_list "}"
```

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.EnumVariantSeparatorSyntax
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: parser.types
applies-to: enum declarations, variants, parsing, diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires top-level enum cases to be separated only by statement terminators and forbids comma separators.
-->

Top-level enum cases are item-separated members. Between top-level enum cases, the implementation MUST accept only statement terminators (`newline` or `;`). A comma MUST NOT be accepted as an enum-case separator.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

-->

VariantDecl = ⟨name, payload_opt, discriminant_opt, span, doc_opt⟩

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.EnumVariantHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: enum declarations, variants, discriminants, enum literals, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines enum variant selectors, builtin enum paths, path splitting, and variant indexing.
-->

Variants(E) = E.variants
BuiltinEnum = {`FileKind`, `IoError`, `AllocationError`, `Priority`}
EnumPathOf(E) = [E.name]    if E.name ∈ BuiltinEnum
EnumPathOf(E) = FullPath(ModuleOf(E), E.name)    otherwise
EnumPath(path) = p ⇔ SplitLast(path) = (p, n)
VariantName(path) = n ⇔ SplitLast(path) = (p, n)
VariantIndex(E, name) = i ⇔ Variants(E) = [v_0, …, v_k] ∧ v_i.name = name

id: def.EnumDiscriminantSequence

strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: enum declarations, variants, discriminants, enum literals, enum layout
summary: Defines enum discriminant extraction, sequencing, variant names, and discriminant validation.
-->

DiscOf(v, n) =
 n    if disc_opt(v) = ⊥
 DiscValue(tok)    if disc_opt(v) = tok
DiscValue(tok) = IntValue(tok)
DiscSeq([], n) = []
DiscSeq(v::vs, n) = [DiscOf(v, n)] ++ DiscSeq(vs, DiscOf(v, n) + 1)
EnumVariantNames(E) = [v.name | v ∈ Variants(E)]

EnumDiscriminants(E) ⇓ ds ⇔ ds = DiscSeq(Variants(E), 0) ∧ Distinct(ds) ∧ ∀ d ∈ ds. d ≥ 0

id: def.EnumLayoutHelpers

#### 12.7.6 Lowering

EnumDisc(E, name) = d ⇔ EnumDiscriminants(E) ⇓ ds ∧ VariantIndex(E, name) = i ∧ ds[i] = d
VariantPayloadOpt(v) = payload_opt ⇔ v = ⟨name, payload_opt, disc_opt, span, doc_opt⟩
VariantSize(v) = 0 ⇔ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = ⊥
VariantAlign(v) = 1 ⇔ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = ⊥
VariantSize(v) = s ⇔ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = TuplePayload([T_1, …, T_k]) ∧ TupleLayout([T_1, …, T_k]) ⇓ ⟨s, a, _⟩
VariantAlign(v) = a ⇔ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = TuplePayload([T_1, …, T_k]) ∧ TupleLayout([T_1, …, T_k]) ⇓ ⟨s, a, _⟩
VariantSize(v) = s ⇔ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = RecordPayload(fields) ∧ RecordLayout(fields) ⇓ ⟨s, a, _⟩
VariantAlign(v) = a ⇔ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = RecordPayload(fields) ∧ RecordLayout(fields) ⇓ ⟨s, a, _⟩
PayloadSize(E) = max_{v ∈ Variants(E)}(VariantSize(v))
PayloadAlign(E) = max_{v ∈ Variants(E)}(VariantAlign(v))
EnumDiscType(E) = DiscType(E)
EnumAlign(E) = max(alignof(EnumDiscType(E)), PayloadAlign(E))
EnumSize(E) = AlignUp(sizeof(EnumDiscType(E)) + PayloadSize(E), EnumAlign(E))
EnumLayoutJudg = {EnumLayout}

summary: Defines enum payload bit encoding for unit, tuple, and record payload variants.
-->

EnumPayloadBits(E, name, ⊥) = bits ⇔ (∃ v ∈ Variants(E). v.name = name ∧ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = ⊥) ∧ PadBytes([], PayloadSize(E)) = bits
EnumPayloadBits(E, name, TuplePayload([v_1, …, v_k])) = bits ⇔ (∃ v ∈ Variants(E). v.name = name ∧ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = TuplePayload([T_1, …, T_k])) ∧ ValueBits(TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_k]), (v_1, …, v_k)) = b ∧ PadBytes(b, PayloadSize(E)) = bits
EnumPayloadBits(E, name, RecordPayload(io)) = bits ⇔ (∃ v ∈ Variants(E). v.name = name ∧ VariantPayloadOpt(v) = RecordPayload(fields)) ∧ RecordLayout(fields) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ fields = [⟨f_1, T_1⟩, …, ⟨f_n, T_n⟩] ∧ (∀ i. FieldValueList(io, f_i) = v_i) ∧ StructBits([T_1, …, T_n], [v_1, …, v_n], offsets, size) = b ∧ PadBytes(b, PayloadSize(E)) = bits

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TypeKey
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union layout, type-ordering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines canonical ordering keys for type forms.
-->

TypeKey(TypePrim(name)) = ⟨TagKey(`prim`), name⟩
TypeKey(TypeRange(T)) = ⟨TagKey(`range`), 0, TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeRangeInclusive(T)) = ⟨TagKey(`range`), 1, TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeRangeFrom(T)) = ⟨TagKey(`range`), 2, TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeRangeTo(T)) = ⟨TagKey(`range`), 3, TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeRangeToInclusive(T)) = ⟨TagKey(`range`), 4, TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeRangeFull) = ⟨TagKey(`range`), 5⟩
TypeKey(TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_n])) = ⟨TagKey(`tuple`), n, TypeKey(T_1), …, TypeKey(T_n)⟩
TypeKey(TypeArray(T, e)) = ⟨TagKey(`array`), TypeKey(T), ArrayLen(e)⟩
TypeKey(TypeSlice(T)) = ⟨TagKey(`slice`), TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeFunc([⟨m_1, T_1⟩, …, ⟨m_n, T_n⟩], R)) = ⟨TagKey(`func`), n, ModeKey(m_1), TypeKey(T_1), …, ModeKey(m_n), TypeKey(T_n), TypeKey(R)⟩
TypeKey(TypePath(p)) = ⟨TagKey(`path`), PathOrderKey(p)⟩
TypeKey(TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)) = ⟨TagKey(`modal_state`), PathOrderKey(ModalRefPath(modal_ref)), S⟩
TypeKey(TypeString(st)) = ⟨TagKey(`string`), StateKey(st)⟩
TypeKey(TypeBytes(st)) = ⟨TagKey(`bytes`), StateKey(st)⟩
TypeKey(TypeDynamic(p)) = ⟨TagKey(`dynamic`), PathOrderKey(p)⟩
TypeKey(TypePtr(T, s)) = ⟨TagKey(`ptr`), PtrStateKey(s), TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeRawPtr(q, T)) = ⟨TagKey(`rawptr`), QualKey(q), TypeKey(T)⟩
TypeKey(TypeUnion([T_1, …, T_n])) = ⟨TagKey(`union`), Sort([TypeKey(T_1), …, TypeKey(T_n)])⟩
TypeKey(TypePerm(p, T)) = ⟨TagKey(`perm`), PermKey(p), TypeKey(T)⟩

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TypeKeyOrdering
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union layout, type-ordering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines canonical ordering relations and sorting over type keys.
-->

Key = { TypeKey(T) | T ∈ Type }
KeyList = { [k_1, …, k_n] | ∀ i. k_i ∈ Key }
a ≺_{atom} b ⇔ (a, b ∈ ℕ ∧ a < b) ∨ (a, b ∈ String ∧ Utf8LexLess(a, b)) ∨ (a, b ∈ Key ∧ a ≺_{key} b) ∨ (a, b ∈ KeyList ∧ a ≺_{keylist} b)
LexLess_{≺}(L_1, L_2) ⇔ (∃ k. 0 ≤ k < |L_1| ∧ 0 ≤ k < |L_2| ∧ (∀ i. 0 ≤ i < k ⇒ L_1[i] = L_2[i]) ∧ L_1[k] ≺ L_2[k]) ∨ (|L_1| < |L_2| ∧ ∀ i. 0 ≤ i < |L_1| ⇒ L_1[i] = L_2[i])
k_1 ≺_{key} k_2 ⇔ LexLess_{≺_{atom}}(k_1, k_2)
L_1 ≺_{keylist} L_2 ⇔ LexLess_{≺_{key}}(L_1, L_2)
Sorted_{≺}(L) ⇔ ∀ i, j. 0 ≤ i < j < |L| ⇒ ¬(L[j] ≺ L[i])
Sort(L) = L' ⇔ Permutation(L', L) ∧ Sorted_{≺_{key}}(L')
T_1 ≺_{type} T_2 ⇔ TypeKey(T_1) ≺_{key} TypeKey(T_2)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UnionMemberLayoutSelection
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union layout, niches, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines sorted union member lists, member indices, discriminant values, empty members, payload member selection, and niche applicability.
-->

MemberList(U) = Sort(Members(U))
MemberIndex(U, T) = i ⇔ MemberList(U)[i] ≡ T
UnionDiscValue(U, T) = i ⇔ MemberIndex(U, T) = i
EmptyMember(T) ⇔ T ≡ TypePrim("()")
EmptyList(U) = [MemberList(U)[i] | 0 ≤ i < |MemberList(U)| ∧ EmptyMember(MemberList(U)[i])]
PayloadMember(U) = T_p ⇔ ∃ j. MemberList(U)[j] ≡ T_p ∧ NicheCount(T_p) > 0 ∧ (∀ i. 0 ≤ i < |MemberList(U)| ∧ i ≠ j ⇒ EmptyMember(MemberList(U)[i])) ∧ NicheCount(T_p) ≥ |MemberList(U)| - 1
NicheApplies(U) ⇔ ∃ T_p. PayloadMember(U) = T_p

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UnionLayoutHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union layout, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines union discriminant type, payload size/alignment, union size/alignment, and union layout judgement set.
-->

UnionDiscType(U) = DiscType(k)    where k = |MemberList(U)| - 1
PayloadSize(U) = max_{T ∈ MemberList(U)}(sizeof(T))
PayloadAlign(U) = max_{T ∈ MemberList(U)}(alignof(T))
UnionAlign(U) = max(alignof(UnionDiscType(U)), PayloadAlign(U))
UnionSize(U) = AlignUp(sizeof(UnionDiscType(U)) + PayloadSize(U), UnionAlign(U))
UnionLayoutJudg = {UnionLayout}

summary: Defines payload bit padding for union members.
-->

PayloadBits(U, T, v) = bits ⇔ ValueBits(T, v) = b ∧ |bits| = PayloadSize(U) ∧ bits[0..|b|) = b

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TaggedBits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, enum declarations, tagged-layout, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines tagged discriminant-plus-payload bit layout.
-->

TaggedBits(disc_bits, payload_bits, disc_size, payload_size, payload_align, size) = bits ⇔ |bits| = size ∧ payload_off = AlignUp(disc_size, payload_align) ∧ bits[0..disc_size) = disc_bits ∧ bits[payload_off..payload_off + payload_size) = payload_bits

**Informative.** TaggedBits constrains only the discriminant and payload ranges; bytes outside those ranges are unconstrained.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UnionTaggedBits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union values, union layout, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines tagged union bit encoding.
-->

UnionTaggedBits(U, T, v) = bits ⇔ ¬ NicheApplies(U) ∧ UnionDiscType(U) = D ∧ UnionDiscValue(U, T) = d ∧ ValueBits(D, d) = disc_bits ∧ PayloadBits(U, T, v) = payload_bits ∧ TaggedBits(disc_bits, payload_bits, sizeof(D), PayloadSize(U), PayloadAlign(U), UnionSize(U)) = bits

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UnionBits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union values, union layout, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines union bit encoding as niche or tagged encoding.
-->

UnionBits(U, T, v) = bits ⇔ UnionNicheBits(U, T, v) = bits ∨ UnionTaggedBits(U, T, v) = bits

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UnionValueBits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: codegen
applies-to: union types, union values, union layout, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lowering bit encoding for union values.
-->

ValueBits(TypeUnion(U), v) = bits ⇔ ∃ T. Member(T, TypeUnion(U)) ∧ UnionBits(U, T, v) = bits

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.UnionValueType
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: runtime
applies-to: union types, union values, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime ValueType for union values.
-->

ValueType(v) = U ⇔ ∃ T. ValueType(v) = T ∧ Member(T, U)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

phase: diagnostics

summary: Defines union diagnostic ownership and delegates union case exhaustiveness diagnostics to §17.6.

#### 12.8.7 Diagnostics

Diagnostics are defined for unions with fewer than two member types and for direct field access on union values without prior refinement or pattern matching. Exhaustiveness diagnostics for union `if ... is { ... }` case analysis are defined by §17.6.

### 12.9 Type Aliases

```ebnf
type_alias_decl ::= attribute_list? visibility? "type" identifier generic_params? predicate_clause? "=" type
```

Γ ⊢ ParseAttrListOpt(P) ⇓ (P_0, attrs_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseVis(P_0) ⇓ (P_1, vis)    IsKw(Tok(P_1), `type`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, name)    Γ ⊢ ParseGenericParamsOpt(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, gen_params_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateClauseOpt(P_3) ⇓ (P_4, predicate_clause_opt)    IsOp(Tok(P_4), "=")    Γ ⊢ ParseType(Advance(P_4)) ⇓ (P_5, ty)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseItem(P) ⇓ (P_5, ⟨TypeAliasDecl, attrs_opt, vis, name, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, ty, SpanBetween(P, P_5), []⟩)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TypeAliasAccessors

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ResolveItem(TypeAliasDecl(attrs_opt, vis, name, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, ty, span, doc)) ⇓ TypeAliasDecl(attrs_opt, vis, name, gen_params_opt', predicate_clause_opt', ty', span, doc)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AliasNormalization
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: type aliases, alias normalization, alias cycles, alias layout
summary: Defines alias stepping and recursive alias normalization for all type forms.
-->

AliasStep(TypePath(p)) = AliasBody(p) if defined; otherwise TypePath(p)
AliasStep(T) = T if T ∉ {TypePath(p)}
AliasNorm(T) =
 TypePerm(perm, AliasNorm(base))  if T = TypePerm(perm, base)
 TypeTuple([AliasNorm(t) | t ∈ elems])  if T = TypeTuple(elems)
 TypeArray(AliasNorm(elem), size_expr)  if T = TypeArray(elem, size_expr)
 TypeSlice(AliasNorm(elem))  if T = TypeSlice(elem)
 TypeUnion([AliasNorm(t) | t ∈ members])  if T = TypeUnion(members)
 TypeFunc([⟨m, AliasNorm(t)⟩ | ⟨m, t⟩ ∈ params], AliasNorm(ret))  if T = TypeFunc(params, ret)
 TypeApply(AliasPath(path), [AliasNorm(t) | t ∈ args])  if T = TypeApply(path, args)
 TypeDynamic(AliasPath(path))  if T = TypeDynamic(path)
 TypeOpaque(AliasPath(path))  if T = TypeOpaque(path)
 TypeModalState(AliasModalRef(modal_ref), state)  if T = TypeModalState(modal_ref, state)
 TypePtr(AliasNorm(elem), ptr_state_opt)  if T = TypePtr(elem, ptr_state_opt)
 TypeRawPtr(qual, AliasNorm(elem))  if T = TypeRawPtr(qual, elem)
 TypeRange(AliasNorm(base))  if T = TypeRange(base)
 TypeRangeInclusive(AliasNorm(base))  if T = TypeRangeInclusive(base)
 TypeRangeFrom(AliasNorm(base))  if T = TypeRangeFrom(base)
 TypeRangeTo(AliasNorm(base))  if T = TypeRangeTo(base)
 TypeRangeToInclusive(AliasNorm(base))  if T = TypeRangeToInclusive(base)
 TypeRefine(AliasNorm(base), pred)  if T = TypeRefine(base, pred)
 AliasNorm(AliasStep(T))  if T = TypePath(p)
 T  otherwise

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AliasPathNormalization
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: type aliases, alias normalization, modal types, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines alias path and modal-reference normalization.
-->

AliasPath(p) = p if AliasBody(p) undefined
AliasPath(p) = AliasPath(p') if AliasBody(p) = TypePath(p')
AliasModalRef(TypePath(p)) = TypePath(AliasPath(p))
AliasModalRef(TypeApply(p, args)) = TypeApply(AliasPath(p), [AliasNorm(t) | t ∈ args])

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AliasTransparent

strength: required

applies-to: type aliases, alias normalization, type-equivalence, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines transparent alias equivalence by normalized type equality.
-->

AliasTransparent(T, U) ⇔ AliasNorm(T) = AliasNorm(U)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AliasGraph
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: type aliases, alias cycles, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the alias dependency graph from alias bodies to referenced type paths.
-->

AliasGraph = { ⟨p, q⟩ | AliasBody(p) = T ∧ q ∈ TypePaths(T) }

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TypePaths
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: type aliases, alias cycles, type-path-extraction, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines referenced type-path extraction for all type forms.
-->

TypePaths(TypePrim(_)) = ∅
TypePaths(TypeRange(base)) = TypePaths(base)
TypePaths(TypeRangeInclusive(base)) = TypePaths(base)
TypePaths(TypeRangeFrom(base)) = TypePaths(base)
TypePaths(TypeRangeTo(base)) = TypePaths(base)
TypePaths(TypeRangeToInclusive(base)) = TypePaths(base)
TypePaths(TypeRangeFull) = ∅
TypePaths(TypePerm(_, T)) = TypePaths(T)
TypePaths(TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_n])) = ⋃_{i=1}^n TypePaths(T_i)
TypePaths(TypeArray(T, _)) = TypePaths(T)
TypePaths(TypeSlice(T)) = TypePaths(T)
TypePaths(TypeUnion([T_1, …, T_n])) = ⋃_{i=1}^n TypePaths(T_i)
TypePaths(TypeFunc([⟨_, T_1⟩, …, ⟨_, T_n⟩], R)) = (⋃_{i=1}^n TypePaths(T_i)) ∪ TypePaths(R)
TypePaths(TypeApply(p, args)) = {p} ∪ (⋃_{t ∈ args} TypePaths(t))
TypePaths(TypePtr(T, _)) = TypePaths(T)
TypePaths(TypeRawPtr(_, T)) = TypePaths(T)
TypePaths(TypeString(_)) = ∅
TypePaths(TypeBytes(_)) = ∅
TypePaths(TypeDynamic(p)) = {p}
TypePaths(TypeOpaque(p)) = {p}
TypePaths(TypeModalState(modal_ref, _)) = TypePathsOfModalRef(modal_ref)
TypePaths(TypePath(p)) = {p}
TypePaths(TypeRefine(base, _)) = TypePaths(base)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.TypePathsOfModalRef
kind: formal-definition

strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: type aliases, alias cycles, modal types, type-path-extraction, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines referenced type-path extraction for modal references.
-->

TypePathsOfModalRef(TypePath(p)) = {p}
TypePathsOfModalRef(TypeApply(p, args)) = {p} ∪ (⋃_{t ∈ args} TypePaths(t))

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.AliasCycle
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: checker.types
applies-to: type aliases, alias cycles, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines alias cycle detection through positive reachability in the alias graph.

AliasCycle(p) ⇔ p ∈ Reach^+(AliasGraph, p)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: TypeAlias-Ok
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis

applies-to: type aliases, alias normalization, alias cycles, alias layout

Σ.Types[p] = TypeAliasDecl(_, _, _, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, ty, _, _)    params_gen = TypeParamsOpt(gen_params_opt)    params_gen = [P_1, …, P_n]    Γ ⊢ ⟨P_1; …; P_n⟩ wf    Γ_g = BindTypeParams(Γ, params_gen)    Γ_g; params_gen ⊢ predicate_clause_opt wf    Γ_g ⊢ ty wf    ¬ AliasCycle(p)

**Region Arena Requirements.**

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.RegionAllocProvenance
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires Region::alloc to preserve the receiver's region-provenance tag and alias relation.
-->
1. `Region::alloc` MUST yield a value with provenance `π_Region(tag)`, where `tag` is the region-provenance tag carried by the receiver handle in the current provenance environment. Fresh region tags are introduced by fresh region-creating constructs, including `region` statements and bindings of freshly created `Region@Active` values such as `Region::new_scoped(...)`. Rebinding a `Region@Active` handle MUST preserve the existing region tag and MUST introduce the new binding name as a target alias in the region-target relation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.RegionInactiveDereferenceSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires pointer dereferences through inactive region addresses to behave as expired.
-->
2. After `Region::reset_unchecked` or `Region::free_unchecked`, any dereference through a `Ptr<T>@Valid` whose address has an inactive `RegionTag` MUST behave as `Expired` per `PtrState` and `ReadPtrSigma`. Uses of non-pointer values with provenance `π_Region(r)` after reset/free are `OutsideConformance`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.RegionFreeAtScopeExit
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires each active or frozen Region to be freed exactly once at scope exit.
-->
3. `Region::free_unchecked` MUST be invoked exactly once on any `Region` that remains in `@Active` or `@Frozen` at scope exit. Implementations MAY invoke `Region::free_unchecked` implicitly during `RegionStmt` cleanup.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.13.Region-Unchecked-Unsafe-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines formal rule Region-Unchecked-Unsafe-Err from Chapter 13 modal and special types.
labels: Region-Unchecked-Unsafe-Err
-->
**(Region-Unchecked-Unsafe-Err)**
Γ; R; L ⊢ base : T    StripPerm(T) = TypeModalState(["Region"], S)    S ∈ {`Active`, `Frozen`}    name ∈ {"reset_unchecked", "free_unchecked"}    ¬ UnsafeSpan(span(MethodCall(base, name, args)))    c = Code(Region-Unchecked-Unsafe-Err)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ MethodCall(base, name, args) ⇑ c
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 13.1.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.coverage

-->
Diagnostics are defined for modal declarations with zero states, duplicate state names, state names equal to the modal name, duplicate payload field names, state-member visibility that exceeds modal visibility, bad generic-argument count on modal-state references, and direct record construction of built-in modal states. Match exhaustiveness for general modal values is defined in Chapter 17.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 13.2.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.StateFieldDynamic
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks Chapter 13 semantic requirement req.StateFieldDynamic for oracle extraction.
-->
State-field access on `TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)` reuses ordinary record-field evaluation over the concrete runtime value `RecordValue(ModalStateRef(modal_ref, S), io)`. No additional abstract-machine rule is introduced for successful access beyond the shared `FieldAccess` rules.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 13.2.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.StateFieldLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.codegen, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks Chapter 13 semantic requirement req.StateFieldLowering for oracle extraction.
-->
State-field reads and writes lower exactly as record-payload field accesses over the current state's payload layout. No modal-specific field-access lowering is introduced beyond the general place and field lowering rules.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 13.2.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks Chapter 13 diagnostic requirement diag.StateFields for oracle extraction.
-->
Diagnostics are defined for missing state fields, field access on a general modal value without first refining to a state, and access to a state field outside the declaring modal's module. Duplicate field names within a single state payload are defined by §13.1.4.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Transitions lower as direct modal-method bodies with a moved `self` receiver. Lowering does not mutate an in-place state tag; it lowers the transition body that constructs and returns a fresh `RecordValue(ModalStateRef(modal_ref, S_tgt), ...)`.

 ⟨`string::append`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeString(`@Managed`))⟩, ⟨⊥, `data`, TypeString(`@View`)⟩, ⟨⊥, `heap`, TypeDynamic(`HeapAllocator`)⟩], TypeUnion([TypePrim("()"), TypePath(["AllocationError"])])⟩,
 ⟨`string::length`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeString(`@View`))⟩], TypePrim("usize")⟩,

}

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.StringLiteralStorage
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks Chapter 13 semantic requirement req.StringLiteralStorage for oracle extraction.
-->
**String Literal Storage.**
For any string literal `lit`, evaluation MUST allocate `StringBytes(lit)` in static, read-only storage. The resulting `string@View` value MUST reference that storage and MUST have length `|StringBytes(lit)|`. The backing storage MUST have static duration and MUST NOT be deallocated.
<!-- Source: "Literal content is allocated in static, read-only memory at compilation ... A string@View value is constructed with pointer to static memory and byte length ... String literals have static storage duration; backing memory is never deallocated." -->
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.BytesBuiltinTable
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the built-in bytes operation signature table.
-->
BytesBuiltinTable =
{
 ⟨`bytes::with_capacity`, [⟨⊥, `cap`, TypePrim("usize")⟩, ⟨⊥, `heap`, TypeDynamic(`HeapAllocator`)⟩], TypeApply(["Outcome"], [TypePerm(`unique`, TypeBytes(`@Managed`)), TypePath(["AllocationError"])])⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::from_slice`, [⟨⊥, `data`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeSlice(TypePrim("u8")))⟩, ⟨⊥, `heap`, TypeDynamic(`HeapAllocator`)⟩], TypeApply(["Outcome"], [TypePerm(`unique`, TypeBytes(`@Managed`)), TypePath(["AllocationError"])])⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::as_view`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeBytes(`@Managed`))⟩], TypeBytes(`@View`)⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::as_slice`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeBytes(`@View`))⟩], TypePerm(`const`, TypeSlice(TypePrim("u8")))⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::to_managed`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeBytes(`@View`))⟩, ⟨⊥, `heap`, TypeDynamic(`HeapAllocator`)⟩], TypeApply(["Outcome"], [TypePerm(`unique`, TypeBytes(`@Managed`)), TypePath(["AllocationError"])])⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::view`, [⟨⊥, `data`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeSlice(TypePrim("u8")))⟩], TypeBytes(`@View`)⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::view_string`, [⟨⊥, `data`, TypeString(`@View`)⟩], TypeBytes(`@View`)⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::append`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeBytes(`@Managed`))⟩, ⟨⊥, `data`, TypeBytes(`@View`)⟩, ⟨⊥, `heap`, TypeDynamic(`HeapAllocator`)⟩], TypeUnion([TypePrim("()"), TypePath(["AllocationError"])])⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::length`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeBytes(`@View`))⟩], TypePrim("usize")⟩,
 ⟨`bytes::is_empty`, [⟨⊥, `self`, TypePerm(`const`, TypeBytes(`@View`))⟩], TypePrim("bool")⟩
}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

 BytesToManaged(SB, self, heap) ⇓ (r, SB'),
 BytesView(SB, data) ⇓ v,
 BytesViewString(SB, data) ⇓ v,
 BytesAsSlice(SB, self) ⇓ s,
 BytesAppend(SB, self, data, heap) ⇓ (r, SB'),
 BytesLength(SB, self) ⇓ n,
 BytesIsEmpty(SB, self) ⇓ b
}

summary: Defines runtime constructors for safe-pointer values by state.
-->
Ptr@Valid(addr) = PtrVal(`Valid`, addr)
Ptr@Null(addr) = PtrVal(`Null`, addr)
Ptr@Expired(addr) = PtrVal(`Expired`, addr)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SafePointerValueType
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines value typing for safe-pointer runtime values.
-->
ValueType(PtrVal(s, addr)) = TypePtr(T, s) ⇔ T ∈ Type
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PtrStateImmediate
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines immediate pointer-state results for null and expired pointer values.
-->
PtrState(σ, Ptr@Null(_)) = `Null`
PtrState(σ, Ptr@Expired(_)) = `Expired`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.PtrStateValid
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines dynamic state classification for valid pointer values with optional address tags.
-->
PtrState(σ, Ptr@Valid(addr)) =
 `Valid`    if AddrTag(σ, addr) = ⊥
 `Valid`    if AddrTag(σ, addr) = tag ≠ ⊥ ∧ TagActive(σ, tag)
 `Expired`  if AddrTag(σ, addr) = tag ≠ ⊥ ∧ ¬ TagActive(σ, tag)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

PtrAddrJudg = {Γ ⊢ ReadPtrSigma(v_ptr, σ) ⇓ (out, σ'), Γ ⊢ WritePtrSigma(v_ptr, v, σ) ⇓ (sout, σ'), Γ ⊢ AddrOfSigma(p, σ) ⇓ (out, σ')}

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SafePointerNicheSet
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.codegen, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines niche-set availability for valid safe pointers.
-->
NicheSet(T) = {LEBytes(0, PtrSize)} ⇔ ∃ U. T = TypePtr(U, `Valid`)
NicheSet(T) = ∅ ⇔ ¬ ∃ U. T = TypePtr(U, `Valid`)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SafePointerValidValue
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.codegen, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines valid bit patterns for safe pointer states and general safe pointers.
-->
ValidValue(TypePtr(T, `Valid`), bits) ⇔ |bits| = PtrSize ∧ bits ≠ LEBytes(0, PtrSize)
ValidValue(TypePtr(T, `Null`), bits) ⇔ bits = LEBytes(0, PtrSize)
ValidValue(TypePtr(T, `Expired`), bits) ⇔ |bits| = PtrSize
ValidValue(TypePtr(T, ⊥), bits) ⇔ |bits| = PtrSize
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SafePointerValueBits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.codegen, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines value-bit encodings for safe pointer states and general safe pointers.
-->
ValueBits(TypePtr(T, `Valid`), v) = bits ⇔ v = PtrVal(`Valid`, addr) ∧ addr ≠ 0x0 ∧ bits = LEBytes(addr, PtrSize)
ValueBits(TypePtr(T, `Null`), v) = bits ⇔ v = PtrVal(`Null`, addr) ∧ addr = 0x0 ∧ bits = LEBytes(addr, PtrSize)
ValueBits(TypePtr(T, `Expired`), v) = bits ⇔ v = PtrVal(`Expired`, addr) ∧ bits = LEBytes(addr, PtrSize)
ValueBits(TypePtr(T, ⊥), v) = bits ⇔ ∃ s. s ∈ PtrStateSet ∧ ValueBits(TypePtr(T, s), v) = bits
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 13.10 Function Types

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

```ebnf
func_type       ::= "(" param_type_list? ")" "->" type

param_type      ::= "move" type | type
```

Trailing commas in `param_type_list` are permitted only when `TrailingCommaAllowed` (§5.5). A trailing comma does not denote an additional parameter type.

### 13.11 Closure Types

#### 13.11.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.ClosureTypes.Syntax
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.parse, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks Chapter 13 grammar grammar.ClosureTypes.Syntax for oracle extraction.
-->
```ebnf
closure_type      ::= "|" param_type_list? "|" "->" type closure_deps_opt
closure_deps_opt  ::= ε | "[" "shared" ":" "{" shared_dep_list? "}" "]"
shared_dep_list   ::= shared_dep ("," shared_dep)*
shared_dep        ::= identifier ":" type
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.ClosureParamUnionParentheses
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.modal-special
applies-to: compiler.parse, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks Chapter 13 semantic requirement req.ClosureParamUnionParentheses for oracle extraction.
-->
Within `closure_type`, if a parameter type has a top-level `union_type`, it MUST be parenthesized as `("(" type ")")`. This grouped form is permitted only to disambiguate closure parameter types and does not introduce a distinct type constructor.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

**(WF-Closure)**
T = TypeClosure(params, R, deps_opt)    ∀ ⟨m, T_i⟩ ∈ params, Γ ⊢ T_i wf    Γ ⊢ R wf    (deps_opt = ⊥ ∨ ∀ d ∈ deps_opt, Γ ⊢ TypeOf(d) wf)

-->
**(T-Equiv-Closure)**
T = TypeClosure([⟨m_1, T_1⟩, …, ⟨m_n, T_n⟩], R, D)    U = TypeClosure([⟨m_1, U_1⟩, …, ⟨m_n, U_n⟩], S, D)    ∀ i, Γ ⊢ T_i ≡ U_i    Γ ⊢ R ≡ S
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ T ≡ U
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

| `E-TYP-2051` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate state name within modal type                                                                                   |
| `E-TYP-2052` | Error    | Compile-time | Field access for field not present in current state's payload                                                            |
| `E-TYP-2053` | Error    | Compile-time | Method invocation for method not available in current state                                                              |
| `E-TYP-2054` | Error    | Compile-time | State name collides with modal type name                                                                                 |
| `E-TYP-2055` | Error    | Compile-time | Transition body returns value not matching declared target state                                                         |
| `E-TYP-2056` | Error    | Compile-time | Transition invoked on value not of declared source state                                                                 |
| `E-TYP-2057` | Error    | Compile-time | Direct field access on general modal type without pattern matching                                                       |
| `E-TYP-2058` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate field name in modal state payload                                                                              |
| `E-TYP-2059` | Error    | Compile-time | Transition target state not declared in modal type                                                                       |
| `E-TYP-2060` | Error    | Compile-time | Non-exhaustive `if ... is { ... }` on general modal type                                                                 |
| `E-TYP-2061` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate method name in modal state                                                                                     |
| `E-TYP-2062` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate transition name in modal state                                                                                 |
| `E-TYP-2063` | Error    | Compile-time | State member visibility exceeds modal visibility                                                                         |
| `E-TYP-2064` | Error    | Compile-time | State member not visible in current scope                                                                                |
| `E-TYP-2065` | Error    | Compile-time | State method name conflicts with transition name in the same modal state                                                 |
| `E-TYP-2070` | Error    | Compile-time | Implicit widening on non-niche-layout-compatible type                                                                    |
| `E-TYP-2071` | Error    | Compile-time | `widen` applied to non-modal type                                                                                        |
| `E-TYP-2072` | Error    | Compile-time | `widen` applied to already-general modal type                                                                            |
| `E-TYP-2073` | Error    | Compile-time | Record literal whose type is `File@S`, `DirIter@S`, or `CancelToken@S` for any state `S` in the corresponding modal type |

## 14. Abstraction and Polymorphism

### 14.1 Generic Parameters and Arguments

#### 14.1.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.GenericParamsAndArgsSyntax
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parse, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar for generic parameters, generic arguments, predicate clauses, and predicate requirements.
-->
```ebnf
generic_params       ::= "<" generic_param (";" generic_param)* ">"
generic_param        ::= identifier ("<:" class_bound ("," class_bound)*)? ("=" type)?
generic_args         ::= "<" type ("," type)* ","? ">"
predicate_clause     ::= "|:" predicate_req (terminator predicate_req)* terminator?
predicate_req        ::= ("Bitcopy" | "Clone" | "Drop" | "FfiSafe") "(" type ")"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.GenericArgsTrailingComma
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parse, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Restricts trailing commas in generic argument lists to the shared trailing-comma rule.
-->
Trailing commas in `generic_args` are permitted only when `TrailingCommaAllowed` (§5.5). A trailing comma does not denote an additional type argument.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.GenericParamInlineBoundsClassOnly
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parse, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires inline generic bounds to be class bounds and predicate requirements to use predicate clauses.
-->
Inline bounds introduced by `<:` are class bounds only. Predicate requirements belong to `predicate_clause`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.1.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: conformance.GenericParamsNoRuntimeSemantics
kind: conformance-statement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: States that generic parameter and predicate forms have no runtime semantics.

Generic parameter declarations, generic argument lists, class-bound lists, and predicate clauses have no runtime semantics. They are eliminated before abstract-machine evaluation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

These forms do not lower directly. Lowering consumes their elaborated substitutions and instantiated declarations as defined in §14.2.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.1.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.GenericParametersAndArguments

phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines diagnostic coverage required for generic parameters, defaults, predicate requirements, and instantiation constraints.
-->
Diagnostics are defined for duplicate type-parameter names, malformed predicate requirements, invalid class bounds, defaults that refer to later parameters, non-suffix defaults, missing default arguments during instantiation, and type arguments that fail required class or predicate constraints.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.GenericCalleeProc
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines resolution of generic procedure callees from identifiers and qualified paths.
-->
GenericCalleeProc(Identifier(f)) = proc ⇔ Γ ⊢ ResolveValueName(f) ⇓ ent ∧ ent.origin_opt = mp ∧ f' = (ent.target_opt if present, else f) ∧ DeclOf(mp, f') = proc ∧ proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, gen_params_opt, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ TypeParamsOpt(gen_params_opt) ≠ []
GenericCalleeProc(Path(path, name)) = proc ⇔ Γ ⊢ ResolveQualified(path, name, ValueKind) ⇓ ent ∧ ent.origin_opt = mp ∧ name' = (ent.target_opt if present, else name) ∧ DeclOf(mp, name') = proc ∧ proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, gen_params_opt, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ TypeParamsOpt(gen_params_opt) ≠ []
GenericCalleeProc(callee) undefined otherwise
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.GenericInferenceFreshArgs
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines fresh type-argument variables and solved-type predicate for generic call inference.
-->
FreshTypeArgs([P_1, …, P_n]) = [TVar(α_1), …, TVar(α_n)]    where α_1, …, α_n are pairwise distinct and fresh
SolvedType(T) ⇔ TVars(T) = ∅
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.InferTypeArgs
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines inferred generic type arguments and failure when inference/defaulting cannot produce solved arguments.
-->
InferTypeArgs(params_gen, raw_args) = args' ⇔ params_gen = [P_1, …, P_n] ∧ raw_args = [R_1, …, R_n] ∧
  (∀ i ∈ 1..n.
    ((SolvedType(R_i) ∧ A_i = R_i) ∨
     (¬SolvedType(R_i) ∧ P_i.default_opt = D_i ∧ A_i = TypeSubst([A_1/P_1.name, …, A_{i-1}/P_{i-1}.name], D_i)))) ∧
  args' = [A_1, …, A_n]

InferTypeArgs(params_gen, raw_args) = ⊥ ⇔ ¬ ∃ args'. InferTypeArgs(params_gen, raw_args) = args'
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.14.GenericCallInference
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines formal rule GenericCallInference.
labels: GenericCallInference
-->
**(GenericCallInference)**
GenericCalleeProc(callee) = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, params, ret_opt, _, _, _, _)
params_gen = TypeParamsOpt(gen_params_opt)    params_gen = [P_1, …, P_n]
FreshTypeArgs(params_gen) = [X_1, …, X_n]
θ_var = [X_1/P_1.name, …, X_n/P_n.name]
params_i = [⟨mode_j, TypeSubst(θ_var, T_j)⟩ | ⟨mode_j, x_j, T_j⟩ ∈ params]
R_i = TypeSubst(θ_var, ProcReturn(ret_opt))
|params_i| = |args|
C_args = {(ArgType(params_i[j], args[j]), ParamType(params_i[j])) | j ∈ 1..|args|}
C_ret = {(R_i, T_exp)}    if T_exp_opt = T_exp
      ∅                   otherwise
Γ ⊢ Solve(C_args ∪ C_ret) ⇓ θ_s
raw_args = [θ_s(X_1), …, θ_s(X_n)]
InferTypeArgs(params_gen, raw_args) = [A_1, …, A_n]
θ = [A_1/P_1.name, …, A_n/P_n.name]
∀ i ∈ 1..n. Γ ⊢ A_i satisfies Bounds(P_i)
Γ ⊢ predicate_clause_opt[θ] ok
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ GenericCallInference(callee, args, T_exp_opt) ⇓ [A_1, …, A_n]

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.GenericCallInferenceElaboration
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires omitted type arguments to succeed by GenericCallInference and elaborate to explicit CallTypeArgs.
-->
Type arguments MAY be omitted at generic procedure call sites only when `GenericCallInference` succeeds. A well-typed omitted-type-argument call is elaborated to `CallTypeArgs(callee, inferred_args, args)` before the §14.2.5 monomorphic-call elaboration. Class methods with generic parameter lists are not vtable-eligible and therefore MUST NOT be invoked through dynamic class objects.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.2.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: States the runtime elaboration of generic calls and type applications to monomorphic specialized forms.

`CallTypeArgs` is elaborated to a monomorphic `Call` after substitution. `TypeApply(path, args)` denotes the specialized declaration obtained by applying the elaborated substitution to the generic declaration named by `path`.

#### 14.2.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines diagnostic coverage required for generic procedures, generic type uses, substitutions, constraints, and monomorphization recursion.

Diagnostics are defined for missing or excess type arguments, omitted-type-argument inference failures, use of a generic nominal declaration without required arguments, generic-call substitution failures, unsatisfied bounds or predicate clauses after substitution, and infinite monomorphization recursion.

### 14.3 Classes

#### 14.3.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.ClassesSyntax
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parse, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar for class declarations, class items, abstract states, and abstract fields.
-->
```ebnf
class_decl   ::= attribute_list? visibility? "modal"? "class" identifier generic_params? ("<:" superclass_bounds)? predicate_clause? "{" class_body? "}"
class_item   ::= class_method | associated_type | abstract_field | abstract_state
abstract_state ::= "@" identifier "{" abstract_field* "}"
abstract_field ::= attribute_list? visibility? key_boundary? identifier ":" type
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Associated type item syntax is defined canonically in §14.5.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ClassMethodAbstractConcretePredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines predicates distinguishing abstract and concrete class methods.
-->
AbstractClassMethod(m) ⇔ ∃ attrs, vis, name, gen_params, recv, params, ret, contract, span, doc. m = ClassMethodDecl(attrs, vis, name, gen_params, recv, params, ret, contract, ⊥, span, doc)
ConcreteClassMethod(m) ⇔ ∃ attrs, vis, name, gen_params, recv, params, ret, contract, body, span, doc. m = ClassMethodDecl(attrs, vis, name, gen_params, recv, params, ret, contract, body, span, doc) ∧ body ≠ ⊥
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ClassMemberCollections
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines class item, method, field, and name collection helpers.
-->
ClassItems(Cl) = Cl.items
ClassMethods(Cl) = [ m | m ∈ ClassItems(Cl) ∧ m is ClassMethodDecl ]
ClassFields(Cl) = [ f | f ∈ ClassItems(Cl) ∧ f is ClassFieldDecl ]
MethodNames(Cl) = [ m.name | m ∈ ClassMethods(Cl) ]
FieldNames(Cl) = [ f.name | f ∈ ClassFields(Cl) ]

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.SubstSelf
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines substitution of Self through type forms used in class signatures.
-->
SubstSelf(T, TypePath([`Self`])) = T
SubstSelf(T, TypePerm(p, ty)) = TypePerm(p, SubstSelf(T, ty))
SubstSelf(T, TypeTuple([t_1, …, t_n])) = TypeTuple([SubstSelf(T, t_1), …, SubstSelf(T, t_n)])
SubstSelf(T, TypeArray(ty, e)) = TypeArray(SubstSelf(T, ty), e)
SubstSelf(T, TypeSlice(ty)) = TypeSlice(SubstSelf(T, ty))
SubstSelf(T, TypeUnion([t_1, …, t_n])) = TypeUnion([SubstSelf(T, t_1), …, SubstSelf(T, t_n)])
SubstSelf(T, TypeFunc([⟨m_1, t_1⟩, …, ⟨m_n, t_n⟩], r)) = TypeFunc([⟨m_1, SubstSelf(T, t_1)⟩, …, ⟨m_n, SubstSelf(T, t_n)⟩], SubstSelf(T, r))
SubstSelf(T, TypePtr(ty, s)) = TypePtr(SubstSelf(T, ty), s)
SubstSelf(T, TypeRawPtr(q, ty)) = TypeRawPtr(q, SubstSelf(T, ty))
SubstSelf(T, TypeString(state_opt)) = TypeString(state_opt)
SubstSelf(T, TypeBytes(state_opt)) = TypeBytes(state_opt)
SubstSelf(T, TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)) = TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)
SubstSelf(T, TypeDynamic(p)) = TypeDynamic(p)
SubstSelf(T, TypePrim(n)) = TypePrim(n)
SubstSelf(T, TypePath(p)) = TypePath(p)    if p ≠ [`Self`]
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ReceiverTypeHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines receiver type, receiver mode, permission, parameter, return, and signature helpers for class methods.
-->
RecvType(T, ReceiverShorthand(`const`)) = TypePerm(`const`, T)
RecvType(T, ReceiverShorthand(`unique`)) = TypePerm(`unique`, T)
RecvType(T, ReceiverShorthand(`shared`)) = TypePerm(`shared`, T)
RecvType(T, ReceiverExplicit(mode, ty)) = SubstSelf(T, ty)

RecvMode(ReceiverShorthand(_)) = ⊥
RecvMode(ReceiverExplicit(mode, _)) = mode

PermOf(TypePerm(p, _)) = p
PermOf(ty) = `const`    otherwise
RecvPerm(T, r) = PermOf(RecvType(T, r))

ParamSig_T(T, params) = [⟨mode, SubstSelf(T, ty)⟩ | ⟨mode, name, ty⟩ ∈ params]
ParamBinds_T(T, params) = [⟨x_1, SubstSelf(T, T_1)⟩, …, ⟨x_n, SubstSelf(T, T_n)⟩]
ReturnType_T(T, m) = SubstSelf(T, ReturnType(m))
Sig_T(T, m) = ⟨RecvType(T, m.receiver), ParamSig_T(T, m.params), SubstSelf(T, ReturnType(m))⟩
SigSelf(m) = Sig_T(SelfVar, m)
SigMatch(T, m_impl, m_decl) ⇔ Sig_T(T, m_impl) = ⟨recv_i, params_i, ret_i⟩ ∧ Sig_T(T, m_decl) = ⟨recv_d, params_d, ret_d⟩ ∧ recv_i = recv_d ∧ params_i = params_d ∧ Γ ⊢ ret_i <: ret_d
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ClassLinearizationMergeHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines list head, tail, head-selection, and pop helpers for class linearization merge.
-->
Head(h :: t) = h
Tail([]) = []
Tail(h :: t) = t
HeadOk(h, Ls) ⇔ ∃ L ∈ Ls. L = h :: t ∧ ∀ L' ∈ Ls. h ∉ Tail(L')
SelectHead(Ls) = h ⇔ Ls = [L_1, …, L_n] ∧ L_i = h :: t ∧ HeadOk(h, Ls) ∧ ∀ j < i. ¬ HeadOk(Head(L_j), Ls)
SelectHead(Ls) = ⊥ ⇔ ¬ ∃ h. HeadOk(h, Ls)
PopHead(h, L) = t ⇔ L = h :: t
PopHead(h, L) = L ⇔ ¬(L = h :: t)
PopAll(h, Ls) = [PopHead(h, L) | L ∈ Ls]
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.3.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: conformance.ClassDeclarationsNoRuntimeActions
kind: conformance-statement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: States that class declarations introduce no runtime actions by themselves.
-->
Class declarations do not introduce runtime actions by themselves. Observable behavior arises only when concrete method bodies are invoked or when a class participates in dynamic dispatch as defined in §14.6.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.3.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.ClassMethodLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.codegen, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires concrete class methods to lower as procedures and abstract class members not to lower directly.
-->
Concrete class methods lower as procedures. Abstract methods, abstract fields, abstract states, and superclass lists do not lower to executable code directly.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.codegen, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage

-->
Default-method reuse and vtable construction are defined in §14.4 and §14.6.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.3.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.Classes
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines diagnostic coverage required for class declarations and inheritance.
-->
Diagnostics are defined for duplicate method names, duplicate abstract-field names, class item name conflicts, invalid `Self` receiver forms, undefined superclass paths, superclass linearization cycles, and effective-method or effective-field conflicts introduced by inheritance.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 14.4 Implementations

#### 14.4.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: Defines grammar for implementation clauses and override methods.

```ebnf
implements_clause ::= "<:" class_path ("," class_path)*
override_method   ::= visibility? "override"? "procedure" identifier signature contract_clause? block
```

Class implementation occurs at the defining record, enum, or modal declaration. Standalone extension implementation blocks are not part of the language.

labels: Parse-ClassListTail-End
-->

¬ IsPunc(Tok(P), ",")
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseClassListTail(P, cs) ⇓ (P, cs)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.14.Parse-ClassListTail-Comma
kind: formal-rule

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#### 14.4.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ImplementsAccessor
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines implemented-class list extraction from concrete implementer declarations.
-->
Implements(T) = impls ⇔ T = RecordDecl(_, _, _, _, _, impls, _, _, _, _) ∨ T = EnumDecl(_, _, _, _, _, impls, _, _, _, _) ∨ T = ModalDecl(_, _, _, _, _, impls, _, _, _, _)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.SubtypeOperatorImplementationMeaning
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the two surface meanings of the <: operator for implementers versus class superclasses.
-->
The surface operator `<:` is overloaded.

1. For records, enums, and modals, `<:` is represented by membership in `Implements(T)`.
2. For classes, `<:` is represented by `Supers(Cl)` together with the superclass rules of §14.3.4.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.ImplementationsConcreteOwnerOnly
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Restricts this section's implementation relation to concrete implementers and excludes class superclass clauses.
-->
This section owns only the concrete-implementer relation for records, enums, and modals. Class superclass clauses are not re-encoded as implementation lists here.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ImplementerFields
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines implementer field sets for records, enums, and modals.
-->
Fields(T) = Fields(R) ⇔ T = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R
Fields(T) = [] ⇔ (T = TypePath(p) ∧ EnumDecl(p) = E) ∨ (T = ModalRefType(modal_ref))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ImplementerMethods
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines implementer method sets for records, enums, and modals.
-->
Methods(T) = Methods(R) ⇔ T = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R
Methods(T) = [] ⇔ (T = TypePath(p) ∧ EnumDecl(p) = E) ∨ (T = ModalRefType(modal_ref))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.MethodByName
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines successful and failed method lookup by name for implementer methods.
-->
MethodByName(T, name) = m' ⇔ m' ∈ Methods(T) ∧ m'.name = name
MethodByName(T, name) = ⊥ ⇔ ¬ ∃ m' ∈ Methods(T). m'.name = name
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ClassEffectiveTables
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines class method and field tables from effective class members.
-->
ClassMethodTable(Cl) = EffMethods(Cl)
ClassFieldTable(Cl) = EffFields(Cl)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.ImplementationOrphanRule
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines module and assembly conditions for implementation orphan checking.
-->
ImplModule(T) = ModuleOf(T)
ClassModule(Cl) = ModuleOf(Σ.Classes[Cl])    if Cl ∈ dom(Σ.Classes)
ImplOrphanOk(T, Cl) ⇔ SameAssembly(ImplModule(T), CurrentModule(Γ)) ∨ (Cl ∈ dom(Σ.Classes) ∧ SameAssembly(ClassModule(Cl), CurrentModule(Γ)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines default-method absence and abstract-method implementation predicates.

NoDefaultMethods(Cl) ⇔ ∀ m ∈ ClassMethods(Cl). m.body = ⊥
AbstractsImplemented(T) ⇔ ∀ Cl ∈ Implements(T). ∀ m ∈ ClassMethodTable(Cl). (m.body = ⊥ ⇒ MethodByName(T, m.name) ≠ ⊥)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.ModalClassImplementationRequiresModalType
kind: normative-requirement

labels: DuplicateClassImplementationForbidden
-->

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.ImplementationOrphanRequirement
kind: normative-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires every implementation to define either the implementing type or referenced class in the current assembly.
labels: ImplementationOrphanRequirement
-->
For every implementation `T <: Cl`, at least one of the implementing declaration `T` or the referenced class `Cl` MUST be defined in the current assembly.
Source-level implementation evidence is owned by the implementing record, enum, or
modal declaration. Accepted source evidence for imported classes uses local
implementing types. If imported project metadata presents an implementation relation
owned by an assembly where both `T` and `Cl` are foreign to the current assembly,
the implementation is rejected with `Impl-Orphan-Err`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.ImplementationsNoAdditionalRuntimeState
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires implementations to add no runtime state beyond methods and fields already present on the implementing type.
labels: ImplementationsNoAdditionalRuntimeState
-->
Implementations do not add new runtime state beyond the concrete methods and fields already present on the implementing type. Default-method selection and dynamic dispatch are defined in §14.6.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.4.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.ImplementationBodyLowering
kind: lowering-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires implementation-specific bodies to lower as concrete methods on the implementing type and default methods to be reused as dispatch targets.
labels: ImplementationBodyLowering
-->
Implementation-specific bodies lower exactly as concrete methods on the implementing type. When a required method is satisfied by a class default, lowering reuses the default implementation body as the dispatch target for that `(type, class, method)` triple.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.4.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.14.Implementations
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines required diagnostics for implementation declarations.
labels: ImplementationDiagnostics
-->
Diagnostics are defined for duplicate implemented classes on a declaration, missing required methods, incompatible method signatures, missing associated-type bindings, misuse of `override`, missing required fields, incompatible field types, and non-modal types attempting to implement modal classes.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 14.5 Associated Types

#### 14.5.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.14.AssociatedType
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines associated type declaration grammar.
labels: AssociatedTypeGrammar
-->
```ebnf
associated_type ::= "type" identifier ("=" type)?
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.AssociatedTypeEqualsMeaning
kind: normative-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, compiler.typecheck, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the meaning of optional associated type bodies in class declarations and implementing record bodies.
labels: AssociatedTypeEqualsMeaning
-->
In class declarations, the optional `= type` introduces a default. In implementing record bodies, the optional `= type` is the bound associated type body.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.5.2 Parsing

id: rule.14.Parse-ClassItem-AssociatedType

Γ ⊢ ParseClassItem(P) ⇓ (P_4, ⟨AssociatedTypeDecl, attrs_opt, vis, name, type_opt, SpanBetween(P, P_4), []⟩)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(Parse-RecordMember-AssociatedType)**
Γ ⊢ ParseAttrListOpt(P) ⇓ (P_0, attrs_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseVis(P_0) ⇓ (P_1, vis)    IsKw(Tok(P_1), `type`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, name)    Γ ⊢ ParseAssocTypeDefaultOpt(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, default_type_opt)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseRecordMember(P) ⇓ (P_3, ⟨AssociatedTypeDecl, attrs_opt, vis, name, default_type_opt, SpanBetween(P, P_3), []⟩)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.5.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-definition
phase: ast

owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism

AssociatedTypeDecl = ⟨attrs_opt, vis, name, type_opt_or_default_opt, span, doc_opt⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssociatedTypeAstMembership
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast

ClassItem ::= … | AssociatedTypeDecl
RecordMember ::= … | AssociatedTypeDecl
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssociatedTypeClassAbstractDefaulted
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines abstract and concrete-defaulted associated types in class items.
labels: AssociatedTypeClassAbstractDefaulted
-->
An associated type in a class item is abstract when `type_opt = ⊥` and concrete-defaulted when `type_opt ≠ ⊥`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssocTypeItemsAndNames
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines associated type item and name extraction from classes.
labels: AssocTypeItemsAndNames
-->
AssocTypeItems(Cl) = [a | a ∈ ClassItems(Cl) ∧ a is AssociatedTypeDecl]
AssocTypeNames(Cl) = [a.name | a ∈ AssocTypeItems(Cl)]
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssocTypeDefault
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lookup of class-associated type defaults.
labels: AssocTypeDefault
-->
AssocTypeDefault(Cl, name) = ty ⇔ ∃ a ∈ AssocTypeItems(Cl). a.name = name ∧ a.type_opt_or_default_opt = ty ∧ ty ≠ ⊥
AssocTypeDefault(Cl, name) = ⊥ ⇔ ¬ ∃ ty. AssocTypeDefault(Cl, name) = ty
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.ImplAssocType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lookup of associated type bindings from implementing record declarations.
labels: ImplAssocType
-->
ImplAssocType(TypePath(p), name) = ty ⇔ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ ∃ a ∈ R.members. a is AssociatedTypeDecl ∧ a.name = name ∧ a.type_opt_or_default_opt = ty ∧ ty ≠ ⊥
ImplAssocType(T, name) = ⊥ ⇔ ¬ ∃ ty. ImplAssocType(T, name) = ty
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AbstractAssociatedTypeNames
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the set of abstract associated type names for a class.
labels: AbstractAssociatedTypeNames
-->
A_abs(Cl) = { name | name ∈ AssocTypeNames(Cl) ∧ AssocTypeDefault(Cl, name) = ⊥ }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssocTypeBinding
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines associated type binding resolution from implementation binding, class default, or missing binding.
labels: AssocTypeBinding
-->
AssocTypeBinding(T, Cl, name) = ty ⇔ ImplAssocType(T, name) = ty
AssocTypeBinding(T, Cl, name) = ty ⇔ ImplAssocType(T, name) = ⊥ ∧ AssocTypeDefault(Σ.Classes[Cl], name) = ty
AssocTypeBinding(T, Cl, name) = ⊥ ⇔ ImplAssocType(T, name) = ⊥ ∧ AssocTypeDefault(Σ.Classes[Cl], name) = ⊥
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssocTypeBindsPredicate
kind: formal-definition

owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines when an implementation binds an associated type name for a class.
labels: AssocTypeBindsPredicate
-->
T binds name for Cl ⇔ AssocTypeBinding(T, Cl, name) ≠ ⊥
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.AssociatedTypeAbstractAndDefaultBinding
kind: semantic-requirement

An abstract associated type in a class must be bound by every implementation of that class. A default associated type in a class may be used when the implementing type does not provide an overriding binding.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.ImplementationAssociatedTypeBoundForm

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.AssociatedTypeLookupOrder

strength: required

applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines associated type lookup order.
labels: AssociatedTypeLookupOrder
-->
Associated-type lookup order is:

1. implementation binding from the implementing declaration body;
2. class default from the referenced class;
3. missing binding.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.SelfOccurs
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines structural occurrence of Self within types for vtable eligibility checks.
labels: SelfOccurs
-->
SelfOccurs(TypePath([`Self`])) = true
SelfOccurs(TypePerm(p, ty)) = SelfOccurs(ty)
SelfOccurs(TypeTuple([t_1, …, t_n])) = ∨_i SelfOccurs(t_i)
SelfOccurs(TypeArray(ty, e)) = SelfOccurs(ty)
SelfOccurs(TypeSlice(ty)) = SelfOccurs(ty)
SelfOccurs(TypeUnion([t_1, …, t_n])) = ∨_i SelfOccurs(t_i)
SelfOccurs(TypeFunc([⟨m_1, t_1⟩, …, ⟨m_n, t_n⟩], r)) = (∨_i SelfOccurs(t_i)) ∨ SelfOccurs(r)
SelfOccurs(TypePtr(_, _)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypeRawPtr(_, _)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypeString(_)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypeBytes(_)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypeModalState(_, _)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypeDynamic(_)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypePrim(_)) = false
SelfOccurs(TypePath(p)) = false    if p ≠ [`Self`]
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.DynamicDispatchEligibility
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines receiver, generic-parameter, vtable-eligibility, and dispatchability predicates for dynamic class objects.
labels: DynamicDispatchEligibility
-->
HasReceiver(m) ⇔ m.receiver ≠ ⊥
HasGenericParams(m) ⇔ TypeParamsOpt(m.gen_params_opt) ≠ []
vtable_eligible(m) ⇔ HasReceiver(m) ∧ ¬ HasGenericParams(m) ∧ ¬ SelfOccurs(m)
dispatchable(Cl) ⇔ ∀ m ∈ EffMethods(Cl). vtable_eligible(m)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.DynamicValueBits

ValueBits(TypeDynamic(Cl), v) = bits ⇔ v = Dyn(Cl, RawPtr(`imm`, addr), T) ∧ sym = ScopedSym(VTableDecl(T, Cl)) ∧ addr_vt = AddrOfSym(sym) ∧ RecordLayout(DynFields(Cl)) ⇓ ⟨size, _, offsets⟩ ∧ StructBits([TypeRawPtr(`imm`, TypePrim("()")), TypeRawPtr(`imm`, TypePath(["VTable"]))], [RawPtr(`imm`, addr), RawPtr(`imm`, addr_vt)], offsets, size) = bits

-->

-->
**(DispatchSym-Impl)**
LookupClassMethod(Cl, name) = m    MethodByName(T, name) = m'    SigMatch(T, m', m)    Γ ⊢ Mangle(m') ⇓ sym
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ DispatchSym(T, Cl, name) ⇓ sym

LookupClassMethod(Cl, name) = m    MethodByName(T, name) = ⊥    m.body_opt ≠ ⊥    Γ ⊢ Mangle(DefaultImpl(T, m)) ⇓ sym
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ DispatchSym(T, Cl, name) ⇓ sym

**(DispatchSym-Default-Mismatch)**

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ DispatchSym(T, Cl, name) ⇓ sym
