labels: VTable-Order
-->
**(VTable-Order)**
VTableEligible(Cl) = [m_1, …, m_k]    ∀ i, DispatchSym(T, Cl, m_i.name) = sym_i

### 14.7 Opaque Types

```ebnf
opaque_type ::= "opaque" class_path
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: Requires opaque types to be equivalent only by class path and expose only the named class interface.
labels: OpaqueEquivalenceAndInterfaceExposure
-->
Two opaque types are equivalent exactly when they name the same class path. Opaque values expose only the class interface named by that path.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.7.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.OpaqueTypesNoRuntimeWrapper
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires opaque types to add no runtime wrapper while statically restricting caller observation to the opaque interface.
labels: OpaqueTypesNoRuntimeWrapper
-->
Opaque types add no runtime wrapper. The callee returns a concrete value implementing the named class, and the caller observes that value only through the statically-restricted opaque interface.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.7.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.OpaqueTypesLowerAsConcrete
kind: lowering-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.abi, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires opaque types to use the underlying concrete type's representation and ABI form during lowering.
labels: OpaqueTypesLowerAsConcrete
-->
Opaque types incur no distinct runtime representation or ABI form. Lowering uses the underlying concrete type chosen by the defining body.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.7.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.14.OpaqueTypes
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines required diagnostics for opaque types.
labels: OpaqueTypeDiagnostics
-->
Diagnostics are defined for opaque types naming undefined classes, member access outside the named class interface, and assignment or matching between opaque types with incompatible class paths.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 14.8 Refinement Types

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
Γ ⊢ P ⇒ Q
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ (T |: {P}) <: (T |: {Q})
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.RefinementDecidablePredicateFragment
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires implementations to support the specified decidable predicate fragment for refinement proofs.
labels: RefinementDecidablePredicateFragment
-->
Implementations MUST support the following decidable predicate fragment: literal comparisons, bound propagation from control flow, syntactic equality up to alpha-renaming, transitive integer inequalities, and boolean combinations thereof.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.RefinementStaticDefaultDynamicFallback
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires refinement predicates to be statically verified by default and dynamically checked only inside dynamic scopes when proof fails.
labels: RefinementStaticDefaultDynamicFallback
-->
Refinement predicates are statically verified by default. If proof fails outside `#dynamic`, the program is ill-formed. If proof fails inside `#dynamic`, lowering inserts a runtime check.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.8.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.RefinementRuntimeRepresentationAndPanic
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires refinement types to preserve value representation and failed dynamic refinement checks to panic.
labels: RefinementRuntimeRepresentationAndPanic
-->
Refinement types do not alter the underlying value representation. Failed dynamically-inserted refinement checks panic.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.8.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.14.LLVMTy-Refine
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers refinement types to the LLVM type of their base type.
labels: LLVMTy-Refine
-->
**(LLVMTy-Refine)**
Γ ⊢ LLVMTy(T) ⇓ τ
───────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LLVMTy(TypeRefine(T, P)) ⇓ τ
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.RefinementRuntimeCheckLowering
kind: lowering-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Restricts feature-local refinement lowering to optional runtime predicate checks for failed static verification inside dynamic scopes.
labels: RefinementRuntimeCheckLowering
-->
Feature-local lowering consists only of optional runtime predicate checks when static verification is not discharged inside `#dynamic` scopes.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.8.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.14.RefinementTypes
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines required diagnostics for refinement types.
labels: RefinementTypeDiagnostics
-->
Diagnostics are defined for ill-formed or impure refinement predicates, failed static proof obligations for refinement introduction, and failing dynamic refinement checks.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 14.9 Capability Classes

#### 14.9.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.CapabilityClassSyntaxUsesOrdinaryClassAndDynamicSyntax
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires capability classes to use ordinary class syntax and dynamic class type syntax without distinct surface grammar.
labels: CapabilityClassSyntaxUsesOrdinaryClassAndDynamicSyntax
-->
Capability classes use the ordinary class syntax from §14.3 and dynamic class type syntax from §14.6. No distinct surface grammar is introduced.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.9.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.CapabilityClassNoFeatureSpecificParser
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing

applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires capability classes to have no parser beyond ordinary class parsing and dynamic class type parsing.
labels: CapabilityClassNoFeatureSpecificParser
-->
Capability classes have no feature-specific parser beyond ordinary class parsing and `$Class` type parsing.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

-->
ReactorMethodParams = [⟨`T`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩, ⟨`E`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩]
ReactorMethods = [
  ClassMethodDecl(⊥, `public`, "run", ReactorMethodParams, ReceiverShorthand(`const`), [⟨⊥, `future`, TypeApply(["Future"], [TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["E"])])⟩], TypeUnion([TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["E"])]), ⊥, ⊥, ⊥, ⊥),
  ClassMethodDecl(⊥, `public`, "register", ReactorMethodParams, ReceiverShorthand(`const`), [⟨⊥, `future`, TypeApply(["Future"], [TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["E"])])⟩], TypeApply(["Tracked"], [TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["E"])]), ⊥, ⊥, ⊥, ⊥)
]
ReactorMethodNames = { m.name | m ∈ ReactorMethods }
ReactorDecl = ClassDecl(⊥, `public`, false, `Reactor`, ⊥, ⊥, [], ReactorMethods, ⊥, ⊥)
Σ.Classes["Reactor"] = ReactorDecl
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.CapMethodSig
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.builtins, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines capability method signature lookup.
labels: CapMethodSig
-->
CapMethodSig(`IO`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ IOInterface
CapMethodSig(`Network`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ NetworkInterface
CapMethodSig(`HeapAllocator`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ HeapAllocatorInterface
CapMethodSig(`System`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ SystemInterface
CapMethodSig(`Reactor`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ LookupClassMethod(`Reactor`, name) = m ∧ Sig_T(SelfVar, m) = ⟨_, params, ret⟩
CapMethodSig(`Time`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ TimeInterface
CapMethodSig(`MonotonicTime`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ MonotonicTimeInterface
CapMethodSig(`WallTime`, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ WallTimeInterface
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.CapRecv
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.builtins, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines receiver permission lookup for capability methods.
labels: CapRecv
-->
CapRecv(`IO`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ IOInterface
CapRecv(`Network`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ NetworkInterface
CapRecv(`HeapAllocator`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ HeapAllocatorInterface
CapRecv(`System`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ SystemInterface
CapRecv(`Reactor`, name) = recv ⇔ LookupClassMethod(`Reactor`, name) = m ∧ RecvPerm(SelfVar, m.receiver) = recv
CapRecv(`Time`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ TimeInterface
CapRecv(`MonotonicTime`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ MonotonicTimeInterface
CapRecv(`WallTime`, name) = recv ⇔ ⟨name, recv, params, ret⟩ ∈ WallTimeInterface
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.CapabilityLoweringSupport

LowerCallJudg = {MethodSymbol, BuiltinMethodSym, LowerMethodCall, LowerArgs, LowerRecvArg}
ModalStateOf(T) = TypeModalState(modal_ref, S) ⇔ StripPerm(T) = TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)
BuiltinCapClass = {`IO`, `Network`, `HeapAllocator`, `ExecutionDomain`, `System`, `Reactor`, `Time`, `MonotonicTime`, `WallTime`}

#### 14.9.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.CapabilityClassesOrdinaryClasses
kind: semantic-requirement

Capability classes are ordinary classes in the type system. A parameter of type `$Class` accepts any concrete type implementing `Class`.

The built-in capability class names `IO`, `Network`, `HeapAllocator`, `ExecutionDomain`, `System`, `Reactor`, `Time`, `MonotonicTime`, and `WallTime` are reserved. Type-system use of those names is via `CapType(Cl) = TypeDynamic(Cl)`.

#### 14.9.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.CapabilityClassesUseDynamicDispatchModel
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires capability classes to use the same dynamic-class-object dispatch machinery while built-in operations have primitive implementations.
labels: CapabilityClassesUseDynamicDispatchModel
-->
Capability classes introduce no separate dispatch model. Built-in capability operations have primitive implementations, but capability values are still expressed through the same dynamic-class-object machinery as other dispatchable classes.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.9.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.CapabilityBuiltinMethodLowering
kind: lowering-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires built-in capability class calls to lower to built-in method symbols and other capability classes to lower through ordinary dynamic dispatch.
labels: CapabilityBuiltinMethodLowering
-->
Calls on dynamic receivers of builtin capability classes `IO`, `Network`, `HeapAllocator`, `ExecutionDomain`, `System`, `Reactor`, `Time`, `MonotonicTime`, and `WallTime` lower to builtin method symbols rather than emitted vtable-call sequences. Other capability classes lower through the ordinary dynamic-dispatch path of §14.6.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Diagnostics are defined for capability operations that require `unsafe`, including raw allocation and deallocation through `HeapAllocator`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 14.10 Foundational Classes and Predicates

#### 14.10.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.FoundationalClassesSyntaxAndReservedNames
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism

summary: Requires foundational classes to use ordinary class syntax and reserves foundational class names.
labels: FoundationalClassesSyntaxAndReservedNames
-->
Foundational classes use ordinary class syntax from §14.3. The foundational names `Bitcopy`, `Clone`, `Drop`, `FfiSafe`, `Eq`, `Hasher`, `Hash`, `Iterator`, and `Discrete` are reserved.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

summary: Requires foundational classes and predicates to use ordinary class and predicate-requirement parsing.
labels: FoundationalClassesNoFeatureSpecificParser
-->
Foundational classes and predicates have no feature-specific parse form beyond ordinary class parsing and predicate-requirement parsing from §14.1.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.10.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.FoundationalClassName
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.builtins, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the set of foundational class names.
labels: FoundationalClassName
-->
FoundationalClassName = {`Bitcopy`, `Clone`, `Drop`, `FfiSafe`, `Eq`, `Hasher`, `Hash`, `Iterator`, `Discrete`}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

labels: FoundationalJudgements
-->
BitcopyDropJudg = {Γ ⊢ T : BitcopyDropOk}
BitcopyJudg = {BitcopyType}
CloneJudg = {CloneType}
DropJudg = {DropType}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.HasCloneDropMethod
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines recognition of user-provided clone and drop methods.
labels: HasCloneDropMethod
-->
HasCloneMethod(T) ⇔ ∃ p, R, m. T = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ m ∈ Methods(R) ∧ MethodName(m) = `clone` ∧ Sig_T(T, m) = ⟨TypePerm(`const`, T), [], T⟩
HasDropMethod(T) ⇔ ∃ p, R, m. T = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ m ∈ Methods(R) ∧ MethodName(m) = `drop` ∧ Sig_T(T, m) = ⟨TypePerm(`unique`, T), [], TypePrim("()")⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.CloneDropTypePredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines CloneType and DropType predicates.
labels: CloneDropTypePredicates
-->
CloneType(T) ⇔ BuiltinCloneType(T) ∨ HasCloneMethod(StripPerm(T)) ∨ BitcopyType(T)
DropType(T) ⇔ BuiltinDropType(T) ∨ HasDropMethod(StripPerm(T))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.FoundationalImplementationPredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines intrinsic and implementation-based foundational class satisfaction predicates.
labels: FoundationalImplementationPredicates
-->
BuiltinDiscreteType(T) ⇔ StripPerm(T) = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ IntTypes ∪ UnsignedIntTypes ∪ {`char`}
ImplementsEq(T) ⇔ EqType(T) ∨ `Eq` ∈ Implements(T)
ImplementsHash(T) ⇔ `Hash` ∈ Implements(T)
ImplementsIterator(T) ⇔ `Iterator` ∈ Implements(T)
ImplementsDiscrete(T) ⇔ BuiltinDiscreteType(T) ∨ `Discrete` ∈ Implements(T)
ImplementsHasher(T) ⇔ `Hasher` ∈ Implements(T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.10.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.FoundationalBoundsIntrinsicSatisfaction
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines which foundational class bounds use intrinsic satisfaction and which use ordinary class implementation lookup.
labels: FoundationalBoundsIntrinsicSatisfaction
-->
Foundational class bounds for `Bitcopy`, `Clone`, `Drop`, and `FfiSafe` are interpreted by intrinsic satisfaction judgments, not by user-defined class implementation lookup. `Eq` is satisfied intrinsically when `EqType(T)` holds. `Discrete` is satisfied intrinsically when `BuiltinDiscreteType(T)` holds. Other `Eq` and `Discrete` obligations are discharged through ordinary class implementation lookup.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.14.BitcopyDrop-Ok

applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Accepts types that do not satisfy both BitcopyType and DropType.
labels: BitcopyDrop-Ok
-->
**(BitcopyDrop-Ok)**
¬(BitcopyType(T) ∧ DropType(T))
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ T : BitcopyDropOk
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

**(BitcopyDrop-Conflict)**
BitcopyType(T) ∧ DropType(T)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ T : BitcopyDropOk ⇑
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.BitcopyTypeCore
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines structural bitcopy eligibility for permissions, tuples, arrays, unions, records, enums, modal states, and modal references.
labels: BitcopyTypeCore
-->
BitcopyTypeCore(T) ⇔
 false    if T = TypePerm(`unique`, _)
 BitcopyTypeCore(T_0)    if T = TypePerm(p, T_0) ∧ p ≠ `unique`
 BuiltinBitcopyType(T) ∨
 (T = TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_n]) ∧ ∀ i ∈ 1..n, BitcopyType(T_i)) ∨
 (T = TypeArray(T_0, e) ∧ Γ ⊢ ConstLen(e) ⇓ _ ∧ BitcopyType(T_0)) ∨
 (T = TypeUnion([T_1, …, T_n]) ∧ ∀ i ∈ 1..n, BitcopyType(T_i)) ∨
 (T = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ ∀ f : T_f ∈ Fields(R). BitcopyType(T_f)) ∨
 (T = TypePath(p) ∧ EnumDecl(p) = E ∧ ∀ v ∈ Variants(E). ∀ T_f ∈ PayloadTypes(v). BitcopyType(T_f)) ∨
 (T = TypeModalState(modal_ref, S) ∧ ModalDeclOf(modal_ref) = M ∧ ∀ T_f ∈ ModalPayload(modal_ref, S). BitcopyType(T_f)) ∨
 (T = ModalRefType(modal_ref) ∧ ModalDeclOf(modal_ref) = M ∧ ∀ S ∈ States(M). ∀ T_f ∈ ModalPayload(modal_ref, S). BitcopyType(T_f))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.BuiltinBitcopyType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines built-in bitcopy types.
labels: BuiltinBitcopyType
-->
BuiltinBitcopyType(T) ⇔
 T = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ PrimTypeNames ∨
 T = TypePtr(U, s) ∨
 T = TypeRawPtr(q, U) ∨
 T = TypeSlice(U) ∨
 T = TypeFunc(ps, R) ∨
 T = TypeDynamic(Cl) ∨
 (T = TypeRange(U) ∧ BitcopyType(U)) ∨
 (T = TypeRangeInclusive(U) ∧ BitcopyType(U)) ∨
 (T = TypeRangeFrom(U) ∧ BitcopyType(U)) ∨
 (T = TypeRangeTo(U) ∧ BitcopyType(U)) ∨
 (T = TypeRangeToInclusive(U) ∧ BitcopyType(U)) ∨
 T = TypeRangeFull ∨
 T = TypeString(`@View`) ∨
 T = TypeBytes(`@View`) ∨
 T = TypePath(["FileKind"]) ∨
 T = TypePath(["IoError"]) ∨
 T = TypePath(["Context"])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.BuiltinDropCloneType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines built-in drop and clone type predicates.
labels: BuiltinDropCloneType
-->
BuiltinDropType(T) ⇔ T = TypeString(`@Managed`) ∨ T = TypeBytes(`@Managed`)
BuiltinCloneType(T) ⇔ BuiltinBitcopyType(T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.14.BuiltinFoundationalClassSignatures
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.builtins, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines built-in foundational class signatures for Eq, Hasher, Hash, Iterator, and Discrete.
labels: BuiltinFoundationalClassSignatures
-->
The built-in class signatures are:

- `Eq`: `eq(~, other: const Self) -> bool`
- `Hasher`: `write(~!, data: bytes@View) -> ()`; `finish(~) -> u64`
- `Hash`: `hash(~, hasher: unique Hasher) -> ()`
- `Iterator`: associated type `Item`; `next(~!) -> Self::Item | ()`
- `Discrete`: `successor(~) -> Self | ()`; `predecessor(~) -> Self | ()`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.EqLaws
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires Eq::eq to be reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.
labels: EqLaws
-->
`Eq::eq` MUST be reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.HashRequiresEqAndEqualValuesHashEqual
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires Hash implementations to also implement Eq and equal values to hash equally from identical initial hasher states.
labels: HashRequiresEqAndEqualValuesHashEqual
-->
`Hash` implementations MUST also implement `Eq`, and equal values MUST produce equal hash results when hashed from identical initial hasher states.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.IteratorNextContract
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines Iterator::next return behavior.
labels: IteratorNextContract
-->
`Iterator::next` returns `Self::Item` while iteration remains, or `()` when exhausted.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.DiscretePartialInverseContract
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires Discrete successor and predecessor to define a discrete stepping relation and partial inverses when both are defined.
labels: DiscretePartialInverseContract
-->
`Discrete::successor` and `Discrete::predecessor` define a discrete stepping relation and are partial inverses when both are defined.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.10.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.DropCloneDynamicSemantics
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines implicit drop invocation and clone behavior for bitcopy values.
labels: DropCloneDynamicSemantics
-->
Scope exit runs the cleanup actions for bindings that still own their provenance/allocation domain. A moved-out binding has transferred that domain and is skipped at its original scope exit. At the final owning scope exit, `drop` is invoked when `DropType(T)` holds, owned children are cleaned in reverse construction order, and the provenance/allocation domain is released. For types without `drop`, no type-specific destructor is invoked; domain release still occurs, and cleanup is a no-op when the value has no owned children and no domain storage to release.

`copy e` is the explicit object-duplication operation. It requires `BitcopyType(ExprType(e))`, duplicates the object bits, and materializes a fresh provenance/allocation domain for the duplicate. The original value and its cleanup responsibility remain with the original owner.

`clone` on a `BitcopyType` value is equivalent to `copy` for the value-level duplication it performs.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.HasherDynamicSemantics
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines built-in Hasher state, write, and finish behavior using FNV-1a 64-bit hashing.
labels: HasherDynamicSemantics
-->
`Hasher` maintains an internal `u64` state. `write` appends bytes to the input stream. `finish` returns the FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the concatenated byte stream using `FNVOffset64` and `FNVPrime64`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.IntegerDiscreteDynamicSemantics
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines successor and predecessor behavior for built-in integer Discrete types.
labels: IntegerDiscreteDynamicSemantics
-->
For `BuiltinDiscreteType(T)` with `StripPerm(T) = TypePrim(t)` and `t ∈ IntTypes ∪ UnsignedIntTypes`, `Discrete::successor` returns the least representable value greater than the receiver when one exists, or `()` otherwise; `Discrete::predecessor` returns the greatest representable value smaller than the receiver when one exists, or `()` otherwise.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.CharDiscreteDynamicSemantics
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines successor and predecessor behavior for built-in char Discrete types over Unicode scalar values.
labels: CharDiscreteDynamicSemantics
-->
For `BuiltinDiscreteType(T)` with `StripPerm(T) = TypePrim(`char`)`, `Discrete::successor` returns `CharVal(u')` where `u' = min { v ∈ UnicodeScalar | v > u }` for receiver `CharVal(u)` when such `u'` exists, or `()` otherwise; `Discrete::predecessor` returns `CharVal(u')` where `u' = max { v ∈ UnicodeScalar | v < u }` when such `u'` exists, or `()` otherwise.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.10.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.FoundationalIntrinsicCallLowering
kind: lowering-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines intrinsic lowering for built-in Eq and Discrete calls and ordinary method-call lowering for other Eq and Discrete calls.
labels: FoundationalIntrinsicCallLowering
-->
`Eq::eq` on `EqType(T)` lowers intrinsically to the built-in equality relation for `T`. `Discrete::successor` and `Discrete::predecessor` on `BuiltinDiscreteType(T)` lower intrinsically to the built-in stepping relation for `T`. Other `Eq` and `Discrete` calls lower through ordinary method-call lowering.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.14.FoundationalPredicatesNoSeparateRepresentation
kind: lowering-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.abstraction-polymorphism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.layout, oracle.lowering-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires foundational predicates and built-in classes not to introduce separate representation and to influence lowering through specified semantic hooks.
labels: FoundationalPredicatesNoSeparateRepresentation
-->
These predicates and built-in classes do not introduce a separate representation. They influence lowering indirectly through copy semantics, drop-glue generation, built-in `Eq`/`Discrete` call selection, and whether a dynamic-class-object vtable header carries a non-null drop entry.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 14.10.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: Defines required diagnostics for foundational classes and predicates.

Diagnostics are defined for types that simultaneously satisfy `BitcopyType` and `DropType`, and for direct user calls to the implicit `drop` protocol on types where destruction is reserved to the language runtime.

## 15. Procedures and Contracts

### 15.1 Procedure Declarations

#### 15.1.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.15.ProcedureDeclarations
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines procedure declaration, signature, parameter list, and parameter grammar.
labels: ProcedureDeclarationsGrammar
-->
```ebnf
procedure_decl ::= attribute_list? visibility? "procedure" identifier generic_params? signature predicate_clause? contract_clause? block_expr
signature      ::= "(" param_list? ")" ("->" type)?
param_list      ::= param ("," param)*
param           ::= "move"? identifier ":" type
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ExternProcedureDeclarationsOwnedByFFI
kind: normative-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Assigns extern procedure declaration ownership to the FFI section.
labels: ExternProcedureDeclarationsOwnedByFFI
-->
`extern` procedure declarations are owned by §23.2.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.1.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-Procedure
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses procedure declarations into ProcedureDecl AST nodes.

-->
**(Parse-Procedure)**
Γ ⊢ ParseAttrListOpt(P) ⇓ (P_0, attrs_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseVis(P_0) ⇓ (P_1, vis)    IsKw(Tok(P_1), `procedure`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, name)    Γ ⊢ ParseGenericParamsOpt(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, gen_params_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseSignature(P_3) ⇓ (P_4, params, ret_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateClauseOpt(P_4) ⇓ (P_5, predicate_clause_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseContractClauseOpt(P_5) ⇓ (P_6, contract_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseBlock(P_6) ⇓ (P_7, body)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseItem(P) ⇓ (P_7, ⟨ProcedureDecl, attrs_opt, vis, name, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, params, ret_opt, contract_opt, body, SpanBetween(P, P_7), []⟩)

IsPunc(Tok(P), "(")    Γ ⊢ ParseParamList(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, params)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), ")")    Γ ⊢ ParseReturnOpt(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, ret_opt)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseSignature(P) ⇓ (P_2, params, ret_opt)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

item = ProcedureDecl(_, vis, _, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, params, ret_opt, _, body, _, _)    params_gen = TypeParamsOpt(gen_params_opt)    params_gen = [P_1, …, P_n]    Γ ⊢ ⟨P_1; …; P_n⟩ wf    Γ_g = BindTypeParams(Γ, params_gen)    Γ_g; params_gen ⊢ predicate_clause_opt wf    Distinct(ParamNames(params))    ReturnAnnOk(ret_opt)    R = ProcReturn(ret_opt)    R_b = BodyReturnType(R)    ∀ ⟨_, x_i, T_i⟩ ∈ params, Γ_g ⊢ T_i wf    Γ_0 = PushScope(Γ_g)    IntroAll(Γ_0, ParamBinds(params)) ⇓ Γ_1    Γ_1; R; ⊥ ⊢ body : T_b    Γ_g ⊢ T_b <: R_b    (R_b ≠ TypePrim("()") ⇒ ExplicitReturn(body))

**DeclTyping.**
DeclTyping(Ms) ⇓ ok ⇔ ∀ M ∈ Ms. Γ ⊢ DeclTypingMod(M) ⇓ ok
DeclTypingMod(M) ⇓ ok ⇔ ∀ it ∈ M.items. Γ ⊢ DeclTypingItem(M.path, it) ⇓ ok

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.DeclTypingItem
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.provenance, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines declaration typing for each module item kind, including binding and provenance checks.
labels: DeclTypingItem
-->
DeclTypingItem(m, ImportDecl(_)) ⇓ ok
DeclTypingItem(m, UsingDecl(_)) ⇓ ok
DeclTypingItem(m, ExternBlock(_, _, _, items, _, _)) ⇓ ok ⇔ Γ ⊢ ExternBlock : ok ∧ ∀ it ∈ items. Γ ⊢ it : ok
DeclTypingItem(m, StaticDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _)) ⇓ ok ⇔ Γ ⊢ StaticDecl : ok
DeclTypingItem(m, TypeAliasDecl(_, name, _, _, _, _, _, _)) ⇓ ok ⇔ Γ ⊢ FullPath(m, name) : TypeAliasOk
DeclTypingItem(m, ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, params, _, _, body, _, _) = item) ⇓ ok ⇔ Γ ⊢ ProcedureDecl : ok ∧ ProcBindCheck(m, item) ⇓ ok ∧ ProvBindCheck(params, body) ⇓ ok
DeclTypingItem(m, R) ⇓ ok ⇔ R = RecordDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ Γ ⊢ R record : ok ∧ ∀ md ∈ Methods(R). MethodBindCheck(m, TypePath(RecordPath(R)), md) ⇓ ok ∧ ProvBindCheck(MethodParamsDecl(TypePath(RecordPath(R)), md), md.body) ⇓ ok
DeclTypingItem(m, E) ⇓ ok ⇔ E = EnumDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ Γ ⊢ E enum : ok
DeclTypingItem(m, M) ⇓ ok ⇔ M = ModalDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ Γ ⊢ M modal : ok ∧ ∀ S ∈ States(M), ∀ md ∈ Methods(M, S). StateMethodBindCheck(m, M, S, md) ⇓ ok ∧ ProvBindCheck(StateMethodParams(M, S, md), md.body) ⇓ ok ∧ ∀ tr ∈ Transitions(M, S). TransitionBindCheck(m, M, S, tr) ⇓ ok ∧ ProvBindCheck(TransitionParams(M, S, tr), tr.body) ⇓ ok
DeclTypingItem(m, Cl) ⇓ ok ⇔ Cl = ClassDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ Γ ⊢ Cl : ok ∧ ∀ md ∈ ClassMethods(Cl). (md.body_opt = ⊥ ∨ (ClassMethodBindCheck(m, Cl, md) ⇓ ok ∧ ProvBindCheck(ClassMethodParams(Cl, md), md.body_opt) ⇓ ok))

MethodTarget(RecordValue(TypePath(p), io), name) = m ⇔ LookupMethod(TypePath(p), name) = m

id: def.15.CalleeProc
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines procedure callee resolution for identifiers and qualified paths.
labels: CalleeProc
-->
CalleeProc(Identifier(x)) = proc ⇔ Γ ⊢ ResolveValueName(x) ⇓ ent ∧ ent.origin_opt = mp ∧ name = (ent.target_opt if present, else x) ∧ DeclOf(mp, name) = proc ∧ (proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∨ proc = ExternProcDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _))
CalleeProc(Path(path, name)) = proc ⇔ Γ ⊢ ResolveQualified(path, name, ValueKind) ⇓ ent ∧ ent.origin_opt = mp ∧ name' = (ent.target_opt if present, else name) ∧ DeclOf(mp, name') = proc ∧ (proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∨ proc = ExternProcDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _))

id: def.15.CallParams

owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines call parameter discovery from procedure callees or function-typed callees.
labels: CallParams
-->
Params(Call(callee, args)) =
  { proc.params            if CalleeProc(callee) = proc
    SynthParams(params)    if ExprType(callee) = TypeFunc(params, _)
    ⊥                      otherwise }

ReturnOut(Val(v)) = Val(v)
ReturnOut(Ctrl(Return(v))) = Val(v)
ReturnOut(Ctrl(Panic)) = Ctrl(Panic)
ReturnOut(Ctrl(Abort)) = Ctrl(Abort)
ReturnOut(Ctrl(Break(v_opt))) = ⊥
ReturnOut(Ctrl(Continue)) = ⊥
ReturnOut(out) = ⊥ ⇒ IllFormed(ReturnOut(out))

pass = `ref`    ¬ HasSourceProvenance(e)    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)    MaterializeCallTemp(v, σ_1) ⇓ (addr, σ_2)    Γ ⊢ EvalArgsSigma(ps, as, σ_2) ⇓ (Val(vec_v), σ_3)

### 15.2 Methods and Receivers

#### 15.2.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.15.MethodsAndReceivers
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines method definition, receiver, and state-method signature grammar.
labels: MethodsAndReceiversGrammar
-->
```ebnf
method_def              ::= visibility? "override"? "procedure" identifier generic_params? "(" receiver ("," param_list)? ")" ("->" type)? contract_clause? block_expr
receiver                ::= "~" | "~!" | "~%" | ("move"? "self" ":" type)
state_method_signature  ::= "(" receiver ("," param_list)? ")" ("->" type)?
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ClassAndStateMethodsReuseReceiverForms
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires class methods and state-specific methods to reuse common receiver and parameter forms, with owner-specific additions defined elsewhere.
labels: ClassAndStateMethodsReuseReceiverForms
-->
Class methods and state-specific methods reuse the same receiver and parameter forms. Class-owned additions are in §14.3; modal-state additions are in §13.3.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

phase: ast
strength: required

applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the method declaration AST tuple.
labels: MethodDeclAst
-->
MethodDecl = ⟨attrs_opt, vis, override, name, gen_params_opt, receiver, params, return_type_opt, contract_opt, body, span, doc_opt⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.ReceiverAst
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines receiver AST forms, receiver permissions, and explicit receiver mode options.
labels: ReceiverAst
-->
Receiver ∈ {ReceiverShorthand(perm), ReceiverExplicit(mode, type)}
perm ∈ {`const`, `unique`, `shared`}
mode ∈ {`move`, ⊥}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.RecordFieldsMethodsAndSelf
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines field and method extraction for records and the record Self type.
labels: RecordFieldsMethodsAndSelf
-->
Fields(R) = [ f | f ∈ R.members ∧ f is FieldDecl ]
Methods(R) = [ m | m ∈ R.members ∧ m is MethodDecl ]
Self_R = TypePath(RecordPath(R))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.SelfType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines valid explicit receiver Self types for records.
labels: SelfType
-->
SelfType(R, ty) ⇔ ty = Self_R ∨ ∃ p. ty = TypePerm(p, Self_R)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.RecvType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines receiver type interpretation for shorthand and explicit receivers.
labels: RecvType
-->
RecvType(T, ReceiverShorthand(`const`)) = TypePerm(`const`, T)
RecvType(T, ReceiverShorthand(`unique`)) = TypePerm(`unique`, T)
RecvType(T, ReceiverShorthand(`shared`)) = TypePerm(`shared`, T)
RecvType(T, ReceiverExplicit(mode, ty)) = SubstSelf(T, ty)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.15.MethodSignaturesAndParams

MethodOf(base, name) = tr ⇔ StripPerm(ExprType(base)) = TypeModalState(modal_ref, S) ∧ ModalDeclOf(modal_ref) = M ∧ LookupTransition(M, S, name) = tr

#### 15.3.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.ClassDefaults
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines inherited class default methods available to a type by method name.
labels: ClassDefaults
-->
ClassDefaults(T, name) = { m | ∃ Cl ∈ Implements(T). m ∈ ClassMethodTable(Cl) ∧ m.name = name ∧ m.body ≠ ⊥ }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.LookupMethod
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines method lookup from direct methods or a unique inherited class default.
labels: LookupMethod
-->
LookupMethod(T, name) = m ⇔ MethodByName(T, name) = m
LookupMethod(T, name) = m ⇔ MethodByName(T, name) = ⊥ ∧ |ClassDefaults(T, name)| = 1 ∧ m ∈ ClassDefaults(T, name)
LookupMethod(T, name) = ⊥ ⇔ MethodByName(T, name) = ⊥ ∧ (|ClassDefaults(T, name)| = 0 ∨ |ClassDefaults(T, name)| > 1)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

kind: formal-rule

labels: LookupMethod-NotFound
-->
**(LookupMethod-NotFound)**
Γ; R; L ⊢ base : T_b    MethodByName(StripPerm(T_b), name) = ⊥    ClassDefaults(StripPerm(T_b), name) = ∅
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.FreeProcedureOverloadResolutionBeforeCallTyping
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires free-procedure overload resolution to complete before ordinary Call typing.
labels: FreeProcedureOverloadResolutionBeforeCallTyping
-->
Free-procedure overload resolution is complete before ordinary `Call` typing.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.FreeCallOverloadResolutionAlgorithm
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the candidate selection, filtering, preference, success, and error algorithm for free-call overload resolution.
labels: FreeCallOverloadResolutionAlgorithm
-->
For a free call whose callee names an overload set `O`:

1. Candidate selection: retain procedures in `O` whose parameter count equals the argument count.
2. Type filtering: eliminate candidates for which any argument is incompatible with the corresponding parameter under the call-argument compatibility rules of §16.3.4.
3. Exact-match preference: if multiple candidates remain, retain those with the maximal number of exact argument-type matches.
4. Genericity preference: if both generic and non-generic candidates remain, retain only the non-generic candidates.
5. Constraint specificity: if multiple generic candidates remain, retain only those whose bounds and predicate requirements are pointwise at least as specific as every remaining alternative, with at least one strict improvement.
6. If exactly one candidate remains, that candidate is selected.
7. If no candidate remains, the call is ill-formed with `E-SEM-3031`.
8. If multiple candidates remain after all preference stages, the call is ill-formed with `E-SEM-3030`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.DuplicateErasedOverloadSignaturesForbidden
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Forbids visible overloads with identical parameter-mode/type signatures after generic-parameter erasure.
labels: DuplicateErasedOverloadSignaturesForbidden
-->
Two visible overloads with the same name MUST NOT have identical parameter-mode/type signatures after generic-parameter erasure. Such a declaration set is ill-formed with `E-SEM-3032`.

`ResolvedCallee(call)` is the declaration id selected by overload resolution,
including the selected generic substitution when the selected declaration is generic.
Lowering receives that declaration id and calls `Mangle(selected_decl)` or the
export-specific link-name rules for that declaration. ABI-facing names are outputs of
the selected declaration and are not inputs to overload resolution.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: req.15.NoRuntimeOverloadSearch
kind: dynamic-semantics

applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires runtime method execution to use the unique statically selected method body without runtime overload search.

When `LookupMethod(T, name) = m`, execution uses that unique method body. No runtime overload search is performed.

### 15.4 Contract Clauses

#### 15.4.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.15.ContractClauses
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines contract clause, precondition, and postcondition grammar.
labels: ContractClausesGrammar
-->
```ebnf
contract_clause    ::= "|:" contract_body
contract_body      ::= precondition_expr "|=" postcondition_expr
                     | "|=" postcondition_expr
                     | precondition_expr
precondition_expr  ::= predicate_expr
postcondition_expr ::= predicate_expr
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.4.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ForeignContractStartDisambiguatesContracts
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Uses ForeignContractStart only to disambiguate ordinary contract clauses from foreign contract clauses.
labels: ForeignContractStartDisambiguatesContracts
-->
`ForeignContractStart` is defined by §23.6.2 and is used here only to disambiguate ordinary contract clauses from foreign contract clauses.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-ContractClauseOpt-None
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing

owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses absent ordinary contract clauses, including when a foreign contract starts.
labels: Parse-ContractClauseOpt-None
-->
**(Parse-ContractClauseOpt-None)**
¬ IsOp(Tok(P), "|:") ∨ ForeignContractStart(P)
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseContractClauseOpt(P) ⇓ (P, ⊥)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-ContractClauseOpt-Yes
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses present ordinary contract clauses.
labels: Parse-ContractClauseOpt-Yes
-->
**(Parse-ContractClauseOpt-Yes)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "|:")    Γ ⊢ ParseContractBody(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, clause)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseContractClauseOpt(P) ⇓ (P_1, clause)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: Parses postcondition-only contract bodies.
labels: Parse-ContractBody-PostOnly
-->
**(Parse-ContractBody-PostOnly)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "|=")    Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateExpr(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, post)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseContractBody(P) ⇓ (P_1, ⟨⊤, post⟩)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-ContractBody-PrePost

-->
**(Parse-ContractBody-PrePost)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateExpr(P) ⇓ (P_1, pre)    IsOp(Tok(P_1), "|=")    Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateExpr(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, post)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseContractBody(P) ⇓ (P_2, ⟨pre, post⟩)

summary: Marks array expressions pure when all element expressions are pure.
labels: Pure-Array
-->
**(Pure-Array)**
∀ i. Γ ⊢ e_i pure
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ArrayExpr([e_1, …, e_n]) pure
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Pure-Record
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks record expressions pure when all field expressions are pure.
labels: Pure-Record
-->
**(Pure-Record)**
∀ (f, e) ∈ fields. Γ ⊢ e pure
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RecordExpr(T, fields) pure
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Pure-Call-Builtin
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks built-in calls pure when all arguments are pure and the built-in is pure.
labels: Pure-Call-Builtin
-->
**(Pure-Call-Builtin)**
Γ ⊢ e_1 pure    …    Γ ⊢ e_n pure    BuiltinPure(f)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ CallExpr(f, [e_1, …, e_n]) pure
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Pure-Call-Procedure
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks procedure calls pure when arguments are pure, the procedure has no capability parameters, and the procedure is pure.
labels: Pure-Call-Procedure
-->
**(Pure-Call-Procedure)**
Γ ⊢ e_1 pure    …    Γ ⊢ e_n pure    ProcDecl(f) = P    ¬HasCapabilityParams(P)    IsPureProc(P)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ CallExpr(f, [e_1, …, e_n]) pure
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Pure-Method-Const
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks const method calls pure when receiver and arguments are pure, no capability parameters are present, and the method body is pure.
labels: Pure-Method-Const
-->
**(Pure-Method-Const)**
Γ ⊢ e pure    Γ ⊢ e_1 pure    …    Γ ⊢ e_n pure    ReceiverPerm(m) = `const`    ¬HasCapabilityParams(m)    IsPureProc(m)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ MethodCallExpr(e, m, [e_1, …, e_n]) pure
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Pure-Comptime
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Marks compile-time procedure calls pure when all arguments are pure.
labels: Pure-Comptime
-->
**(Pure-Comptime)**
ComptimeProc(f)    Γ ⊢ e_1 pure    …    Γ ⊢ e_n pure    ∀ T ∈ ArgTypes(f) ∪ {ReturnType(f)}. CtAvail(T)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ CallExpr(f, [e_1, …, e_n]) pure

Contract predicate checking is a static verification context. Pure compile-time
procedures may be evaluated in contract predicates when their argument and result
types are valid for compile-time evaluation and the final predicate has type `bool`.
Such calls are absent from runtime item lowering.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.ContractPurityHelperPredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines helper predicates for contract expression purity.
labels: ContractPurityHelperPredicates
-->
**Helper Predicates**

HasCapabilityParams(P) ⇔ ∃ param ∈ Params(P). IsCapabilityType(ParamType(param))
IsCapabilityType(T) ⇔ CapInType(T) ≠ ∅
ContainsCapability(T) ⇔ CapInType(T) ≠ ∅
BuiltinPure(f) ⇔ f ∈ {sizeof, alignof, type_name, …}
IsPureProc(P) ⇔ ∀ stmt ∈ Body(P). Γ ⊢ stmt pure_stmt ∧ ¬WritesGlobalState(P)
ComptimeProc(f) ⇔ HasAttribute(ProcDecl(f), `comptime`)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ContractNeverPureForms
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines expression forms that are never pure in contract expressions.
labels: ContractNeverPureForms
-->
The following forms are never pure: assignment expressions, mutable method calls, allocation expressions, spawn/dispatch/parallel expressions, yield/wait expressions, procedure calls with capability parameters, and unsafe blocks.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PreconditionEvaluationContext
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the bindings included and excluded in precondition evaluation context.
labels: PreconditionEvaluationContext
-->
**Precondition Evaluation Context (Γ_pre)** includes the receiver binding (if present) and all procedure parameters at entry state. It excludes `@result`, `@entry`, module-scope bindings, enclosing locals, and body-local bindings.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PostconditionEvaluationContext
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the bindings and post-state/entry-state interpretation in postcondition evaluation context.
labels: PostconditionEvaluationContext
-->
**Postcondition Evaluation Context (Γ_post)** includes the receiver, all procedure parameters, `@result`, and `@entry`. Mutable parameters and mutable receivers denote post-state values on the right of `|=`, while `@entry(...)` denotes entry-state values.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ContractClausesNoIndependentRuntimeEffect
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime

applies-to: runtime, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires contract clauses to have no independent runtime effect beyond verification and inserted ContractCheck forms.
labels: ContractClausesNoIndependentRuntimeEffect
-->
Contract clauses themselves have no independent runtime effect. Their operational impact is through verification and inserted `ContractCheck` forms defined in §15.8.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

summary: Requires contract clause lowering to be indirect through verification results and checks defined in the verification section.
labels: ContractClauseLoweringViaVerificationResults
-->
No lowering is defined directly for a contract clause. Lowering consumes verification results and, when required, emits checks as defined in §15.8.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 15.5 Preconditions

#### 15.5.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.PreconditionSyntaxDefinition
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines preconditions as the expression to the left of |= or the entire contract expression when |= is absent.
labels: PreconditionSyntaxDefinition
-->
The precondition is the expression to the left of `|=` in a contract clause, or the entire contract expression when `|=` is absent.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.5.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.PreconditionsParsedByContractBody
kind: syntax-requirement

owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires preconditions to be parsed as part of ParseContractBody.
labels: PreconditionsParsedByContractBody
-->
Preconditions are parsed as part of `ParseContractBody` in §15.4.2.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.5.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PreconditionOf
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines precondition extraction from optional contract clauses.
labels: PreconditionOf
-->
PreconditionOf(contract_opt) = `true`             if contract_opt = ⊥
PreconditionOf(⟨pre, post⟩) = `true`              if pre = ⊤
PreconditionOf(⟨pre, post⟩) = pre                 if pre ≠ ⊤
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.5.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PreconditionProofContext
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines precondition checking program point and proof context after actual-parameter substitution.
labels: PreconditionProofContext
-->
Let `S_call` be the call-site program point for the invocation being checked.
In this section, the proof context symbol `Gamma_S` denotes the active
`ProofContextAt(S_call)` defined in SS15.8.4 after actual-parameter
substitution into the callee precondition.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Pre-Satisfied
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Validates calls whose callee precondition is statically proven at the call site.
labels: Pre-Satisfied
-->
**(Pre-Satisfied)**
Γ ⊢ f : (T_1, …, T_n) → R    precondition(f) = P_pre    StaticProofAt(S_call, Γ_S, P_pre)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ f(a_1, …, a_n) @ S : valid
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PreconditionElisionRules
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines precondition extraction/elision rules for contract forms.
labels: PreconditionElisionRules
-->
Elision rules:

| Contract Form      | Precondition |
| ------------------ | ------------ |
| `                  | : P`         | `P`    |
| `                  | : P |= Q`    | `P`    |
| `                  | : |= Q`      | `true` |
| no contract clause | `true`       |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

labels: CallerResponsibleForPrecondition

The caller is responsible for satisfying the precondition.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 15.6 Postconditions

#### 15.6.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.15.Postconditions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines postcondition expression and contract intrinsic grammar.
labels: PostconditionsGrammar
-->
```ebnf
postcondition_expr ::= predicate_expr
contract_intrinsic ::= "@result" | "@entry" "(" expression ")"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.6.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-Contract-Result
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses @result contract intrinsic expressions.
labels: Parse-Contract-Result
-->
**(Parse-Contract-Result)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "@")    IsIdent(Tok(Advance(P)))    Lexeme(Tok(Advance(P))) = `result`
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (Advance(Advance(P)), ContractResult)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-Contract-Entry
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required

labels: Parse-Contract-Entry
-->
**(Parse-Contract-Entry)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "@")    IsIdent(Tok(Advance(P)))    Lexeme(Tok(Advance(P))) = `entry`    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(P))), "(")    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(Advance(Advance(Advance(P)))) ⇓ (P_1, e)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), ")")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), ContractEntry(e))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.ContractIntrinsicAst
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-checks, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines @result and @entry contract intrinsic AST expression forms.
labels: ContractIntrinsicAst
-->
Expr = … | ContractResult | ContractEntry(expr) | …
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PostconditionOf
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines postcondition extraction from optional contract clauses.
labels: PostconditionOf
-->
PostconditionOf(contract_opt) = `true`           if contract_opt = ⊥
PostconditionOf(⟨pre, post⟩) = `true`            if post = ⊥
PostconditionOf(⟨pre, post⟩) = post              if post ≠ ⊥
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.6.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PostconditionProofContext
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines postcondition proof context at return points after binding @result.
labels: PostconditionProofContext
-->
Let `ProofContextAt(r)` denote the active proof context at return point `r` as
defined in SS15.8.4. Postcondition verification at `r` is performed after
binding `@result` to the returned value and uses that proof context.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Post-Valid
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Validates functions whose postcondition is satisfied at every return point.
labels: Post-Valid
-->
**(Post-Valid)**
postcondition(f) = P_post    ∀ r ∈ ReturnPoints(f). Γ_r ⊢ P_post : satisfied
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f : postcondition-valid
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.PostconditionElisionRules
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines postcondition extraction/elision rules for contract forms.
labels: PostconditionElisionRules
-->
Elision rules:

| Contract Form      | Postcondition |
| ------------------ | ------------- |
| `                  | : P`          | `true` |
| `                  | : P |= Q`     | `Q`    |
| `                  | : |= Q`       | `Q`    |
| no contract clause | `true`        |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ContractResultProperties
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines availability and type properties for @result.
labels: ContractResultProperties
-->
Properties of `@result`:

1. It is available only in postcondition expressions.
2. Its type is the declared return type of the enclosing procedure.
3. For unit-returning procedures, `@result` has type `()`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Result-Union-Type
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Types @result as the declared union return type.
labels: Result-Union-Type
-->
**(Result-Union-Type)**
ReturnType(f) = T_1 | T_2 | ... | T_n
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ_post ⊢ @result : T_1 | T_2 | ... | T_n
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Result-Is-Predicate
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Types @result variant tests over union return types.
labels: Result-Is-Predicate
-->
**(Result-Is-Predicate)**
Γ_post ⊢ @result : T_union    T_variant ∈ Variants(T_union)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ_post ⊢ (@result is T_variant) : bool
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Narrows @result after a successful variant predicate.
labels: Result-Narrowing
-->
**(Result-Narrowing)**
(@result is T_variant) = true    Γ_post ⊢ @result : T_union
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ_post ⊢ @result as T_variant : T_variant
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(Propagate-Postcondition)**
e? propagates error e_err at program point p    ReturnType(f) = T_success | T_error
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Postconditions are evaluated for the propagation return at p with @result bound to e_err
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Result-Modal
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts

-->
**(Result-Modal)**
ReturnType(f) = M@S
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ_post ⊢ @result : M@S
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Result-Generic
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage

-->
**(Result-Generic)**
ReturnType(f) = T    T is a type parameter
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ_post ⊢ @result : T
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Result-Generic-Constraint
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires generic return type parameters used with class-requiring operations in postconditions to carry the required class bound.
labels: Result-Generic-Constraint
-->
**(Result-Generic-Constraint)**
@result op e in postcondition    op requires class C    T is return type parameter
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
T <: C required in procedure signature
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ContractEntryConstraints
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines @entry availability, purity, reference, and BitcopyType constraints.
labels: ContractEntryConstraints
-->
`@entry(expr)` constraints:

1. It is available only in postcondition expressions.
2. `expr` MUST be pure.
3. `expr` MUST reference only parameters and the receiver.
4. The result type of `expr` MUST satisfy `BitcopyType`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Entry-Type
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis

owner: spec.procedures-contracts

summary: Types @entry expressions whose captured expression type satisfies BitcopyType.
labels: Entry-Type
-->
**(Entry-Type)**
Γ_post ⊢ e : T    BitcopyType(T)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ_post ⊢ @entry(e) : T
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.6.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.PostconditionResultRuntimeBinding
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires postconditions to evaluate with @result bound to each returned value.
labels: PostconditionResultRuntimeBinding
-->
At each return point `r` with returned value `v_r`, postconditions are evaluated with `@result` bound to `v_r`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.ContractEntryRuntimeCapture
kind: dynamic-semantics
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime capture behavior for @entry expressions in postconditions.
labels: ContractEntryRuntimeCapture
-->
When `@entry(expr)` appears in a postcondition:

1. `expr` is evaluated immediately after parameter binding and successful precondition checking.
2. The result is captured by bitwise copy.
3. Every postcondition check for the invocation reuses the captured value.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.EntryCaptureTiming
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the runtime phase order for entry capture.
labels: EntryCaptureTiming
-->
Entry-capture timing:

1. Parameter Binding
2. Precondition Check
3. `@entry` Capture
4. Body Execution
5. Postcondition Check
6. Return
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.EntryCapturePhase
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Captures @entry expressions after precondition checking without mutating entry state.
labels: EntryCapturePhase
-->
**(EntryCapturePhase)**
entries = CollectEntryExprs(postcondition(f))    ∀ e_i ∈ entries. Γ_pre ⊢ EvalSigma(e_i, σ_entry) ⇓ (Val(v_i), σ_entry)
captures = { e_i ↦ Capture(v_i, T_i) | e_i ∈ entries }
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EntryCapturePhase(f, σ_entry) = (captures, σ_entry)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.EntryCaptureValue
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines @entry capture values for BitcopyType values.
labels: EntryCaptureValue
-->
Capture(v, T) = v    if BitcopyType(T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses absent invariant clauses.
labels: Parse-InvariantOpt-None
-->
**(Parse-InvariantOpt-None)**
¬ (IsOp(Tok(P), "|:") ∧ IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P)), "{"))
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseInvariantOpt(P) ⇓ (P, ⊥)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Parse-InvariantOpt-Yes
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts

summary: Parses present invariant clauses with braced predicate expressions.
labels: Parse-InvariantOpt-Yes
-->
**(Parse-InvariantOpt-Yes)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "|:")    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P)), "{")    Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateExpr(Advance(Advance(P))) ⇓ (P_1, pred)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), "}")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseInvariantOpt(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), pred)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

summary: Parses loop invariant options by delegating to invariant parsing.

-->
ParseLoopInvariantOpt(P) ⇓ (P_1, inv_opt) ⇔ Γ ⊢ ParseInvariantOpt(P) ⇓ (P_1, inv_opt)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Type invariant context:

1. `self` denotes an instance of the type being defined.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

Type invariant enforcement points:

1. Post-construction.

3. Before any mutating receiver-taking procedure returns.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

Private procedures are exempt from the pre-call enforcement point; the invariant is rechecked when control returns to a public caller.

#### 15.8.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.DynamicScopeAndContext
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines dynamic verification scope and dynamic context detection.
labels: DynamicScopeAndContext
-->
DynamicScope(s) ⇔ (∃ d. DynamicDecl(d) ∧ s ⊆ d.span) ∨ (∃ e. DynamicExpr(e) ∧ s ⊆ ExprSpan(e))
InDynamicContext ⇔ DynamicScope(s) where `s` is the span of the syntactic form currently being verified or type-checked.

ComputeDynamicContext(s, ancestors) =
  let enclosing_dynamic = FindInnermostDynamic(s, ancestors)
  match enclosing_dynamic {
    ⊥       → false
    Some(_) → true
  }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

──────────────────────────────────────────────
program is ill-formed

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

────────────────────────────────────────────────────
