<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.MandatoryProofTechniques
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires the listed proof techniques for verification.
labels: MandatoryProofTechniques
-->
Mandatory proof techniques:

1. Constant propagation
2. Linear integer reasoning
3. Boolean algebra
4. Control flow analysis
5. Type-derived bounds
6. Verification facts
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.ProofContextAt
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines active proof context at a program point from flow facts and contract facts.
labels: ProofContextAt
-->
For this section, `Gamma_S` denotes the active proof context at program point
`S`, written `ProofContextAt(S)`.

Let `FlowFactsAt(S) = { P | F(P, L) ∈ Facts ∧ L dom S }`.

Let `ContractFactsAt(S)` be the set of conjuncts imported from the enclosing
procedure contract precondition that remain in scope at `S`.

Let `ProofContextAt(S) = FlowFactsAt(S) ∪ ContractFactsAt(S)`.

**(Fact-Call-Postcondition)**
StaticallyResolvedCall(c, f)    f.postcondition = P_post    CallReturnsNormally(c)    StableSubst(c.args, f.params, θ)    ResultSubst(c, @result, θ) = θ'
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ProofContextAfter(c) = ProofContextBefore(c) ∪ Facts(P_post[θ'])

Dynamic contract checks establish runtime behavior on the checked execution path.
They create compile-time facts for later proof only through
`Fact-Call-Postcondition`, which requires static callee identity, stable
substitutions, and normal return.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.DecidablePredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the decidable predicate fragment for verification.
labels: DecidablePredicates
-->
`Decidable(P)` is the smallest set closed under:

1. `true`, `false`
2. Comparisons of linear integer expressions over literals and variables
3. Syntactic equality up to alpha-renaming between identifiers and literal constants
4. Boolean combinations using `!`, `&&`, `||`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Entailment:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Ent-True
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Entails true predicates.
labels: Ent-True
-->
**(Ent-True)**
P ≡ `true`
──────────────────────────────
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Ent-Fact
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Entails predicates present in the active proof context.
labels: Ent-Fact
-->
**(Ent-Fact)**
P ∈ ProofContextAt(S)
──────────────────────────────
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Ent-And
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Entails conjunctions from entailed conjuncts.
labels: Ent-And
-->
**(Ent-And)**
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P    ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ Q
────────────────────────────────────────
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P ∧ Q
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Ent-Or-L
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Entails disjunctions from a proven left disjunct.
labels: Ent-Or-L
-->
**(Ent-Or-L)**
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P
────────────────────────
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P ∨ Q
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Ent-Or-R
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Entails disjunctions from a proven right disjunct.
labels: Ent-Or-R
-->
**(Ent-Or-R)**
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ Q
────────────────────────
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P ∨ Q
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Ent-Linear
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Entails predicates proven by linear integer entailment.
labels: Ent-Linear
-->
**(Ent-Linear)**
LinearEntails(ProofContextAt(S), P)
─────────────────────────────
ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.LinearIntegerEntailment
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines linear integer expressions, predicates, facts, and entailment.
labels: LinearIntegerEntailment
-->
**Linear Integer Entailment**

Let `LinExpr` be expressions of the form `∑_i a_i x_i + c` where `a_i, c ∈ ℤ` and each `x_i` is an integer-typed variable.

Let `LinPred` be predicates comparing two `LinExpr` with `==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, or `>=`.

Define `LinFactsAt(S) = { P ∈ ProofContextAt(S) | P ∈ LinPred }`.

Then:

LinearEntails(ProofContextAt(S), P) ⇔ P ∈ LinPred ∧ ⋀ LinFactsAt(S) ⊨_ℤ P
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.LinearEntailmentSoundAndComplete
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Allows any sound decision procedure and requires completeness for LinPred entailment.
labels: LinearEntailmentSoundAndComplete
-->
Implementations MAY use any sound decision procedure; they MUST be complete for `LinPred` entailment.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.StaticProofAt
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines static proof as decidability plus proof-context entailment.
labels: StaticProofAt
-->
StaticProofAt(S, ProofContextAt(S), P) ⇔ Decidable(P) ∧ ProofContextAt(S) ⊢ P
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.NegFact
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines negated fact generation for simple decidable predicates.
labels: NegFact
-->
Define `NegFact(P)` on simple decidable predicates by:

1. `NegFact(!P) = P`
2. `NegFact(a < b) = (a >= b)`
3. `NegFact(a <= b) = (a > b)`
4. `NegFact(a > b) = (a <= b)`
5. `NegFact(a >= b) = (a < b)`
6. `NegFact(a == b) = (a != b)`
7. `NegFact(a != b) = (a == b)`
8. `NegFact(P)` is undefined otherwise
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.VerificationFactsNoRuntimeRepresentation
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires verification facts to have no runtime size or representation and forbids storing, passing, or returning them.
labels: VerificationFactsNoRuntimeRepresentation
-->
Verification facts:

1. Have zero runtime size.
2. Have no runtime representation.
3. MUST NOT be stored, passed, or returned.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Fact-Dominate
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Applies verification facts at dominated program points other than the origin.
labels: Fact-Dominate
-->
**(Fact-Dominate)**
F(P, L) ∈ Facts    L dom S    L ≠ S
────────────────────────────────────
P satisfied at S
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.FactGeneration
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines generation of verification facts from conditionals, pattern tests, runtime checks, and verified loop invariants.
labels: FactGeneration
-->
Fact generation:

1. `if P { ... }` generates `F(P, _)` on then-branch entry.
2. `if P { ... } else { ... }` generates `F(NegFact(P), _)` on else-branch
   entry whenever `NegFact(P)` is defined.
3. `if P { return ... }`, `if P { break ... }`, and `if P { continue ... }`
   generate `F(NegFact(P), _)` on the subsequent fallthrough path whenever
   `NegFact(P)` is defined.
4. A satisfied `if ... is` pattern generates pattern facts on selected-body entry.
5. A runtime check for `P` generates `F(P, _)` after the check.
6. A verified loop invariant generates `F(Inv, _)` after the loop.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.TypeNarrowingFromFacts
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires active facts to refine variable types with refinement predicates.
labels: TypeNarrowingFromFacts
-->
Type narrowing under an active fact `F(P, L)` refines `typeof(x)` to `typeof(x) |: {P}`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 15.8.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.15.ContractEnvironments
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: runtime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime contract environments for empty, postcondition, and foreign postcondition checks.
labels: ContractEnvironments
-->
Contract environments:

1. `ρ_emptyset = ∅`
2. `ρ_post = EntryCapture(f, σ_entry) ∪ { @result ↦ v_r }`
3. `ρ_foreign_post = { @result ↦ v_r }`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(P[ρ], σ) ⇓ (Val(true), σ')

Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(P[ρ], σ) ⇓ (Val(false), σ')

⟨CheckStart(P, k, s, ρ, σ)⟩ →* ⟨CheckDone(σ')⟩
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ContractCheck(P, k, s, ρ, σ) ⇓ σ'

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.15.Insert-Precondition-Check
kind: formal-rule

**(Insert-Precondition-Check)**
f has contract |: P    InDynamicContext(f)    ¬ StaticProof(Γ_entry, P)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(Insert-Postcondition-Check)**
f has contract |: P_pre |= P_post    InDynamicContext(f)    ¬ StaticProof(Γ_exit, P_post)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Before each return from f with value v, insert: ContractCheck(P_post, Post, span(contract), ρ_post)

T has invariant |: {P}    InDynamicContext(construction_site)    ¬ StaticProof(Γ, P[v/self])

T has invariant |: {P}    m is public method with receiver ~    InDynamicContext(call_site)    ¬ StaticProof(Γ, P[self/self])
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Before call to self~>m(...), insert: ContractCheck(P, TypeInv, span(invariant), ρ_emptyset)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#### 15.9.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.BehavioralSubtypingLiskovRequirement
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires implementations to satisfy Liskov substitution with respect to class-defined contracts.
labels: BehavioralSubtypingLiskovRequirement
-->
When a type implements a class, its procedure implementations MUST satisfy the Liskov substitution principle with respect to the class-defined contracts.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.BehavioralSubtypingPreconditionRule
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Allows implementation preconditions to weaken class preconditions and forbids strengthening them.
labels: BehavioralSubtypingPreconditionRule
-->
Precondition rule:

1. An implementation MAY weaken the class precondition.
2. An implementation MUST NOT strengthen the class precondition.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.BehavioralSubtypingPostconditionRule
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts

summary: Allows implementation postconditions to strengthen class postconditions and forbids weakening them.
labels: BehavioralSubtypingPostconditionRule
-->
Postcondition rule:

1. An implementation MAY strengthen the class postcondition.
2. An implementation MUST NOT weaken the class postcondition.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.BehavioralSubtypingVerificationStrategy
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines static verification strategy for behavioral subtyping contract implication obligations.
labels: BehavioralSubtypingVerificationStrategy
-->
Verification strategy:

1. Statically verify that the class precondition implies the implementation precondition.
2. Statically verify that the implementation postcondition implies the class postcondition.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.15.BehavioralSubtypingNoRuntimeChecks
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.procedures-contracts
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires behavioral-subtyping obligations to generate no runtime checks.
labels: BehavioralSubtypingNoRuntimeChecks
-->
No runtime checks are generated for behavioral-subtyping obligations.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

## 16. Expressions

### 16.1 Literal and Name Expressions

#### 16.1.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.LiteralAndNameExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines literal, null pointer, identifier, and qualified name expression grammar.
labels: LiteralAndNameExpressionsGrammar
-->
```ebnf
literal_expr        ::= literal
null_ptr_expr       ::= "Ptr" "::" "null" "(" ")"
identifier_expr     ::= identifier
qualified_name_expr ::= path "::" identifier
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.QualifiedApplicationOwnership
kind: syntax-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Assigns qualified parenthesized and braced applications to their owning expression sections.
labels: QualifiedApplicationOwnership
-->
Qualified applications with `(` ... `)` are owned by §16.3. Qualified applications with `{` ... `}` are owned by §16.6.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.1.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-Literal-Expr
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses literal tokens as literal expressions.
labels: Parse-Literal-Expr
-->
**(Parse-Literal-Expr)**
Tok(P).kind ∈ {IntLiteral, FloatLiteral, StringLiteral, CharLiteral, BoolLiteral, NullLiteral}
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (Advance(P), Literal(Tok(P)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-Null-Ptr
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.syntax-cases, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses Ptr::null() as PtrNullExpr.
labels: Parse-Null-Ptr
-->
**(Parse-Null-Ptr)**
IsIdent(Tok(P))    Lexeme(Tok(P)) = `Ptr`    IsOp(Tok(Advance(P)), "::")    Tok(Advance(Advance(P))).kind = NullLiteral    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(Advance(P)))), "(")    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(Advance(Advance(P))))), ")")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (Advance(Advance(Advance(Advance(Advance(P))))), PtrNullExpr)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

-->
**(Parse-Identifier-Expr)**
IsIdent(Tok(P))    ¬ IsOp(Tok(Advance(P)), "::")    ¬ IsOp(Tok(Advance(P)), "@")    ¬ IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P)), "{")
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-definition

kind: formal-definition

labels: LiteralNameExprAst
-->
Expr = Literal(lit) | PtrNullExpr | Identifier(name) | QualifiedName(path, name) | Path(path, name) | ErrorExpr(span) | …
ExprSpan : Expr → Span
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.QualifiedNameResolution
kind: formal-definition
phase: name-resolution
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.name-resolution, compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines qualified names as pre-resolution expressions and their resolution targets.
labels: QualifiedNameResolution
-->
`QualifiedName(path, name)` is a pre-resolution expression form. Resolution rewrites it to one of:

- `Path(path', name')` for resolved value names
- `EnumLiteral(FullPath(p, name), ⊥)` for resolved unit enum variants

If neither form resolves, the name-resolution pass rejects the expression.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ValuePathType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines value path typing for statics, built-in modal static procedures, ordinary procedures, extern procedures, and unresolved paths.
labels: ValuePathType
-->
ValuePathType : Path × Ident ⇀ Type
BuiltinModalStaticSig(path, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩ ⇔
 (path = ["Region"] ∧ name = `new_scoped` ∧ RegionProcSig(`Region::new_scoped`) = ⟨params, ret⟩) ∨
 (path = ["CancelToken"] ∧ name = `new` ∧ BuiltinModalProcSig(`CancelToken::new`) = ⟨params, ret⟩)
ValuePathType(path, name) = StaticType(path, name) if StaticType(path, name) defined
ValuePathType(path, name) = TypeFunc([⟨mode, T⟩ | ⟨mode, x, T⟩ ∈ params], ret) if BuiltinModalStaticSig(path, name) = ⟨params, ret⟩
ValuePathType(path, name) = TypeFunc([⟨mode, T⟩ | ⟨mode, x, T⟩ ∈ params], ProcReturn(ret_opt)) if DeclOf(path, name) = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, gen_params_opt, _, params, ret_opt, _, _, _, _) ∧ TypeParamsOpt(gen_params_opt) = []
ValuePathType(path, name) = TypeFunc([⟨mode, T⟩ | ⟨mode, x, T⟩ ∈ params], ProcReturn(ret_opt)) if DeclOf(path, name) = ExternProcDecl(_, _, _, _, _, params, ret_opt, _, _, _, _)
ValuePathType(path, name) undefined otherwise
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.1.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.NumericLiteralTypeSets
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines integer and floating literal type sets and default numeric literal types.
labels: NumericLiteralTypeSets
-->
IntTypes = {`i8`, `i16`, `i32`, `i64`, `i128`, `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `u64`, `u128`, `isize`, `usize`}
FloatTypes = {`f16`, `f32`, `f64`}
FloatSuffixKinds = FloatTypes ∪ {`f`}
DefaultInt = `i32`
DefaultFloat = `f32`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.NumericLiteralParsingHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines numeric literal core parsing, suffix stripping, values, and range membership helpers.
labels: NumericLiteralParsingHelpers
-->
IntCore(s) ⇔ s matches (`decimal_integer` | `hex_integer` | `octal_integer` | `binary_integer`)
FloatCore(s) ⇔ s matches (`decimal_integer` "." `decimal_integer`? `exponent`?)
StripIntSuffix(s) = ⟨core, t⟩ ⇔ s = core ++ t ∧ t ∈ IntSuffixSet ∧ IntCore(core)
StripIntSuffix(s) = ⟨s, ⊥⟩ ⇔ ¬ ∃ t. s = core ++ t ∧ t ∈ IntSuffixSet ∧ IntCore(core)
StripFloatSuffix(s) = ⟨core, t⟩ ⇔ s = core ++ t ∧ t ∈ FloatSuffixSet ∧ FloatCore(core)
StripFloatSuffix(s) = ⟨s, ⊥⟩ ⇔ FloatCore(s) ∧ ¬ ∃ t. s = core ++ t ∧ t ∈ FloatSuffixSet ∧ FloatCore(core)
IntSuffix(lit) = t ⇔ lit.kind = IntLiteral ∧ StripIntSuffix(Lexeme(lit)) = ⟨_, t⟩
FloatSuffix(lit) = t ⇔ lit.kind = FloatLiteral ∧ StripFloatSuffix(Lexeme(lit)) = ⟨_, t⟩
NoFloatSuffix(lit) ⇔ lit.kind = FloatLiteral ∧ StripFloatSuffix(Lexeme(lit)) = ⟨_, ⊥⟩
IntValueCore(s) = v ⇔ (s = "0x" ++ h ∧ v = HexValue(Digits(h))) ∨ (s = "0o" ++ o ∧ v = OctValue(Digits(o))) ∨ (s = "0b" ++ b ∧ v = BinValue(Digits(b))) ∨ (s matches `decimal_integer` ∧ v = DecValue(Digits(s)))
IntValue(lit) = v ⇔ lit.kind = IntLiteral ∧ StripIntSuffix(Lexeme(lit)) = ⟨core, _⟩ ∧ IntValueCore(core) = v
FloatParts(s) = ⟨a, b, e⟩ ⇔ s = a ++ "." ++ b ++ exp ∧ (exp = "" ⇒ e = 0) ∧ (exp ≠ "" ⇒ exp = "e" ++ sign ++ d ∨ exp = "E" ++ sign ++ d) ∧ (sign = "" ⇒ e = DecValue(Digits(d))) ∧ (sign = "+" ⇒ e = DecValue(Digits(d))) ∧ (sign = "-" ⇒ e = -DecValue(Digits(d)))
FloatValueCore(s) = v ⇔ FloatParts(s) = ⟨a, b, e⟩ ∧ v = (DecValue(Digits(a)) · 10^{|Digits(b)|} + DecValue(Digits(b))) · 10^{e - |Digits(b)|}
FloatValue(lit) = v ⇔ lit.kind = FloatLiteral ∧ StripFloatSuffix(Lexeme(lit)) = ⟨core, _⟩ ∧ FloatValueCore(core) = v
InRange(v, T) ⇔ v ∈ RangeOf(T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

-->
EvalJudg = {Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (out, σ')}

id: def.16.LiteralRuntimeValues
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.constant-evaluation, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime values produced by boolean, character, string, integer, float, and null literals.
labels: BoolValue, CharValue, LiteralValue
-->
BoolValue(lit) = true ⇔ lit.kind = BoolLiteral ∧ Lexeme(lit) = "true"
BoolValue(lit) = false ⇔ lit.kind = BoolLiteral ∧ Lexeme(lit) = "false"
CharValue(lit) = u ⇔ lit.kind = CharLiteral ∧ T = Lexeme(lit) ∧ StringBytesFrom(T, 1, |T|-1) = bytes ∧ DecodeUTF8(bytes) = [u]
LiteralValue(ℓ, TypePrim("bool")) = BoolVal(b) ⇔ ℓ.kind = BoolLiteral ∧ BoolValue(ℓ) = b
LiteralValue(ℓ, TypePrim("char")) = CharVal(c) ⇔ ℓ.kind = CharLiteral ∧ CharValue(ℓ) = c
LiteralValue(ℓ, TypeString(`@View`)) = v ⇔ ℓ.kind = StringLiteral ∧ ViewBytes(v) = StringBytes(ℓ)
LiteralValue(ℓ, TypePrim(t)) = IntVal(t, x) ⇔ ℓ.kind = IntLiteral ∧ t ∈ IntTypes ∧ x = IntValue(ℓ)
LiteralValue(ℓ, TypePrim(t)) = FloatVal(t, v) ⇔ ℓ.kind = FloatLiteral ∧ t ∈ FloatTypes ∧ v = FloatValue(ℓ)
LiteralValue(ℓ, TypeRawPtr(q, U)) = RawPtr(q, 0x0) ⇔ ℓ.kind = NullLiteral
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 16.2 Access and Place Expressions

#### 16.2.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.AccessAndPlaceExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines access suffix and place-expression grammar.
labels: access_suffix, place_expr
-->
```ebnf
access_suffix ::= "." identifier | "." decimal_literal | "[" expression "]"
place_expr    ::= "*" place_expr | postfix_expr
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.AccessPostfixOwnership
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Assigns access and place-specific postfix suffix ownership to this section and excludes call, method-call, and propagation postfix forms.
labels: AccessPostfixOwnership
-->
`postfix_expr` is the shared postfix-expression carrier. This section owns the access and place-specific suffix cases only. Call, method-call, and propagation postfix forms are owned by §§16.3 and 16.8.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.2.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Postfix-Field
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses dot-identifier postfix suffixes as field access expressions.
labels: Postfix-Field
-->
**(Postfix-Field)**
IsPunc(Tok(P), ".")    IsIdent(Tok(Advance(P)))    name = Lexeme(Tok(Advance(P)))
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ PostfixStep(P, e) ⇓ (Advance(Advance(P)), FieldAccess(e, name))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Postfix-TupleIndex
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses dot-integer postfix suffixes as tuple access expressions.
labels: Postfix-TupleIndex
-->
**(Postfix-TupleIndex)**
IsPunc(Tok(P), ".")    t = Tok(Advance(P))    t.kind = IntLiteral    idx = IntValue(t)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ PostfixStep(P, e) ⇓ (Advance(Advance(P)), TupleAccess(e, idx))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Postfix-Index
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses bracket postfix suffixes as index access expressions.
labels: Postfix-Index
-->
**(Postfix-Index)**
IsPunc(Tok(P), "[")    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, idx)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), "]")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ PostfixStep(P, e) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), IndexAccess(e, idx))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.IsPlace
kind: formal-definition
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines syntactic place expressions for identifiers, accesses, indexes, and recursive dereferences.
labels: IsPlace
-->
IsPlace(e) ⇔ e ∈ {Identifier(_), FieldAccess(_, _), TupleAccess(_, _), IndexAccess(_, _)} ∨ (∃ p. e = Deref(p) ∧ IsPlace(p))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-Place-Deref
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses leading star place expressions as dereference places.
labels: Parse-Place-Deref
-->
**(Parse-Place-Deref)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "*")    Γ ⊢ ParsePlace(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, p)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePlace(P) ⇓ (P_1, Deref(p))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-Place-Postfix
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses postfix expressions as places when they satisfy IsPlace.
labels: Parse-Place-Postfix
-->
**(Parse-Place-Postfix)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePostfix(P) ⇓ (P_1, e)    IsPlace(e)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePlace(P) ⇓ (P_1, e)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-Place-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Emits a syntax diagnostic and recovers when a parsed postfix expression is not a place.
labels: Parse-Place-Err, Parse-Syntax-Err
-->
**(Parse-Place-Err)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePostfix(P) ⇓ (P_1, e)    ¬ IsPlace(e)    c = Code(Parse-Syntax-Err)    Γ ⊢ Emit(c, Tok(P).span)    Γ ⊢ SyncStmt(P_1) ⇓ P_2
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePlace(P) ⇓ (P_2, ErrorExpr(SpanBetween(P, P_2)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.2.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.AccessPlaceAst
kind: formal-definition

summary: Extends expression AST forms with field access, tuple access, index access, and dereference expressions.

Expr = FieldAccess(base, name) | TupleAccess(base, index) | IndexAccess(base, index_expr) | Deref(expr) | …
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.FieldVisibility
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.visibility, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines record field visibility lookup and module-relative field visibility.
labels: FieldVis, FieldVisible
-->
FieldVis(R, f) = vis ⇔ ⟨vis, f, T_f, _⟩ ∈ Fields(R)
FieldVisible(m, R, f) ⇔ FieldVis(R, f) ∈ {`public`, `internal`} ∨ (FieldVis(R, f) = `private` ∧ ModuleOfPath(RecordPath(R)) = m)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.IndexClassification
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.constant-evaluation, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines constant tuple indexes, constant indexes, contextual usize index expressions, and admissible range index expressions.
labels: ConstTupleIndex, ConstIndex, IndexUsizeExpr, RangeIndexType, RangeIndexExpr
-->
ConstTupleIndex(i) ⇔ ∃ n ∈ ℤ. i = n
ConstIndex(e) ⇔ ∃ n. Γ ⊢ ConstLen(e) ⇓ n
IndexUsizeExpr(e) ⇔ (Γ ⊢ e : TypePrim(`usize`)) ∨ (e = Literal(lit) ∧ lit.kind = IntLiteral ∧ IntSuffix(lit) = ⊥ ∧ InRange(IntValue(lit), `usize`))
RangeIndexType(T_r) ⇔ T_r = TypeRange(TypePrim(`usize`)) ∨ T_r = TypeRangeInclusive(TypePrim(`usize`)) ∨ T_r = TypeRangeFrom(TypePrim(`usize`)) ∨ T_r = TypeRangeTo(TypePrim(`usize`)) ∨ T_r = TypeRangeToInclusive(TypePrim(`usize`)) ∨ T_r = TypeRangeFull
RangeIndexExpr(r) ⇔ (Γ; R; L ⊢ r : Range ∧ RangeIndexType(ExprType(r))) ∨ r = Range(`Full`, ⊥, ⊥) ∨ (r = Range(`To`, ⊥, e) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e)) ∨ (r = Range(`ToInclusive`, ⊥, e) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e)) ∨ (r = Range(`From`, e, ⊥) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e)) ∨ (r = Range(`Exclusive`, e_1, e_2) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e_1) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e_2)) ∨ (r = Range(`Inclusive`, e_1, e_2) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e_1) ∧ IndexUsizeExpr(e_2))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

ValueCopyContext(e) holds when the enclosing operation must duplicate the value represented by `e`. It includes explicit `copy e`, by-value materialization for Bitcopy-only operations, and array-repeat/value-spread contexts. It does not include `move e`, ownership-return destinations, address formation, or by-reference argument passing.

#### 16.2.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.16.AccessAndPlaceExpressions
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines diagnostic coverage for field, tuple, array, slice, indexability, union-access, and non-Bitcopy place value-use failures.
labels: Union-DirectAccess-Err, ValueUse-NonBitcopyPlace
-->
Diagnostics are defined for unknown or inaccessible record fields, tuple indexing on non-tuples, non-constant tuple indices, tuple index out of bounds, non-`usize` array indices, non-constant array indices outside dynamic-checking contexts, out-of-bounds array and slice access, indexing non-indexable values, direct field access on unions, and value use of non-`Bitcopy` places.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.ArraySliceIndexDiagnosticsAndPanicBehavior
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.lowering, runtime.evaluator, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Binds array and slice scalar/range indexing to contextual usize diagnostics and requires out-of-bounds scalar/range access to lower to panic.
labels: IndexUsizeExpr, RangeIndexExpr, Index-Array-NonUsize, Index-Slice-NonUsize, EvalSigma-Index-OOB, EvalSigma-Index-Range-OOB
-->
Scalar indexing of arrays and slices is governed by `IndexUsizeExpr` from §12.3.4, which contextually checks direct unsuffixed integer literals as `usize` while requiring non-literal expressions to already type as `usize`. Array/slice range indexing is governed by `RangeIndexExpr` from §12.4.4. The corresponding non-`usize` diagnostics are `Index-Array-NonUsize` and `Index-Slice-NonUsize`. Scalar out-of-bounds access and range out-of-bounds slicing lower to panic through `EvalSigma-Index-OOB` and `EvalSigma-Index-Range-OOB`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 16.3 Call Expressions

#### 16.3.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.CallExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines call, generic call, method call, argument list, and argument grammar.
labels: call_expr, generic_call_expr, method_call_expr, argument_list, argument
-->
```ebnf
call_expr         ::= postfix_expr "(" argument_list? ")"
generic_call_expr ::= postfix_expr generic_args "(" argument_list? ")"
method_call_expr  ::= postfix_expr "~>" identifier "(" argument_list? ")"
argument_list     ::= argument ("," argument)*
argument          ::= ("move" | "copy")? expression
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

labels: QualifiedApply
-->
Qualified applications with parenthesized arguments parse before name resolution as `QualifiedApply(path, name, Paren(args))`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.QualifiedParenthesizedApplicationResolution
kind: semantic-requirement

summary: Requires qualified parenthesized applications to be rewritten to call or enum-literal forms according to resolved target kind.
labels: QualifiedApply
-->
Qualified parenthesized applications are pre-resolution forms. Name resolution rewrites them to:

- `Call(Path(path', name'), args')` for value and built-in paths
- `Call(Path(mp, name'), args')` for record default-constructor references
- `EnumLiteral(FullPath(p, name), Paren(ArgsExprs(args')))` for tuple enum constructors
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.16.CallStaticJudgementsAndArgumentTyping
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines unresolved call expression forms, expression and argument judgements, parameter accessors, provenance, call temporaries, argument adaptation, and argument type computation.
labels: UnresolvedExpr, ExprJudg, ArgsOkTJudg, ParamMode, ParamType, PlaceType, HasSourceProvenance, CallTemp, RefArgExpr, ConsumeArgExpr, ArgType
-->
UnresolvedExpr = {QualifiedName(_, _), QualifiedApply(_, _, _)}
ExprJudg = {Γ; R; L ⊢ e : T, Γ; R; L ⊢ e ⇐ T ⊣ C, Γ; R; L ⊢ p :place T, Γ; R; L ⊢ p ⇐_place T, Γ; R; L ⊢ r : Range}
ArgsOkTJudg = {ArgsOk_T}
ParamMode(⟨mode, T⟩) = mode
ParamType(⟨mode, T⟩) = T
PlaceType(p) = T ⇔ Γ; R; L ⊢ p :place T
HasSourceProvenance(e) ⇔ (∃ π. Γ; Ω ⊢ e ⇓ π ∧ π ≠ ⊥)
CallTemp(e) = p_tmp where ¬ HasSourceProvenance(e) ∧ Lifetime(p_tmp) = CallExtent ∧ ValueOf(p_tmp) = e
RefArgExpr(e) = { e if HasSourceProvenance(e) ; CallTemp(e) otherwise }
ConsumeArgExpr(mode, pass, e) =
  { MoveArgExpr(e)          if mode = `move` ∧ pass = `move`
    CopyArgExpr(e)          if pass = `copy`
    MoveArgExpr(CallTemp(e)) if mode = `move` ∧ pass = `ref` ∧ ¬ HasSourceProvenance(e)
    e                       otherwise }
RefArgOk(pass, e, T_p) ⇔
  (pass = `ref` ∧ Γ; R; L ⊢ RefArgExpr(e) ⇐_place T_p ∧ AddrOfOk(RefArgExpr(e))) ∨
  (pass = `copy` ∧ Γ; R; L ⊢ CopyArgExpr(e) ⇐ T_p ⊣ ∅)
ArgType(p, a) =
  { ExprType(ConsumeArgExpr(ParamMode(p), ArgPass(a), ArgExpr(a)))    if ParamMode(p) = `move`
    ExprType(CopyArgExpr(ArgExpr(a)))                                  if ParamMode(p) = ⊥ ∧ ArgPass(a) = `copy`
    PlaceType(RefArgExpr(ArgExpr(a)))                                  if ParamMode(p) = ⊥ ∧ ArgPass(a) = `ref` }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.ArgsT-Empty
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Accepts an empty argument list for an empty parameter list.

-->
**(ArgsT-Empty)**
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ ArgsOk_T([], [])

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.ArgsT-Cons
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Checks consuming move-parameter arguments using ConsumeArgExpr and recursively checks the remaining arguments.
labels: ArgsT-Cons
-->
**(ArgsT-Cons)**
Γ; R; L ⊢ ConsumeArgExpr(`move`, pass, e) ⇐ T_p ⊣ ∅    (pass ∈ {`move`, `copy`} ∨ (pass = `ref` ∧ ¬ HasSourceProvenance(e)))    Γ; R; L ⊢ ArgsOk_T(ps, as)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ ArgsOk_T([⟨`move`, T_p⟩] ++ ps, [⟨pass, e, _⟩] ++ as)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.ArgsT-Cons-Ref
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Checks by-reference arguments by checking RefArgExpr as a place, requiring address-of validity, and rejecting moved reference arguments.
labels: ArgsT-Cons-Ref
-->
**(ArgsT-Cons-Ref)**
RefArgOk(pass, e, T_p)    Γ; R; L ⊢ ArgsOk_T(ps, as)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ ArgsOk_T([⟨⊥, T_p⟩] ++ ps, [⟨pass, e, _⟩] ++ as)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.CallTypeArgsStaticOwnership
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ast, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Assigns explicit and inferred type-argument call bound checking, default completion, omitted-argument inference, and monomorphic call elaboration to section 14.2.4.
labels: CallTypeArgs
-->
Explicit and inferred type-argument calls use `CallTypeArgs`. Their bound checking, defaulted argument completion, omitted-argument inference, and elaboration to monomorphic `Call` are defined in §14.2.4.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.MethodRecordClosureCallStaticOwnership
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Assigns method-call typing, record-default construction calls, and closure-typed calls to their owning specification sections.
labels: MethodCall, RecordCallee, TypeClosure
-->
Method-call typing is defined in §15.2.4 for concrete receivers and in §14.6.4 for dynamic `$Class` receivers. Record-default construction via `Call(callee, [])` is defined in §16.6.4. Calls whose callee has closure type are defined in §16.9.4.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Calls to `extern` procedures outside `unsafe` are rejected by the FFI boundary rule in §23.2.4.

-->

### 16.4 Operator Expressions

#### 16.4.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.OperatorExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines range, logical, comparison, bitwise, shift, additive, multiplicative, power, and unary-operator expression grammar.
labels: range_expression, logical_or_expr, logical_and_expr, comparison_expr, bitwise_or_expr, bitwise_xor_expr, bitwise_and_expr, shift_expr, additive_expr, multiplicative_expr, power_expr, unary_operator
-->
```ebnf
range_expression    ::= logical_or_expr ".." logical_or_expr
                      | logical_or_expr "..=" logical_or_expr
                      | logical_or_expr ".."
                      | ".." logical_or_expr
                      | "..=" logical_or_expr
                      | ".."
logical_or_expr     ::= logical_and_expr ("||" logical_and_expr)*
logical_and_expr    ::= comparison_expr ("&&" comparison_expr)*
comparison_expr     ::= bitwise_or_expr (("==" | "!=" | "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=") bitwise_or_expr)*
bitwise_or_expr     ::= bitwise_xor_expr ("|" bitwise_xor_expr)*
bitwise_xor_expr    ::= bitwise_and_expr ("^" bitwise_and_expr)*
bitwise_and_expr    ::= shift_expr ("&" shift_expr)*
shift_expr          ::= additive_expr (("<<" | ">>") additive_expr)*
additive_expr       ::= multiplicative_expr (("+" | "-") multiplicative_expr)*
multiplicative_expr ::= power_expr (("*" | "/" | "%") power_expr)*
power_expr          ::= unary_expr ("**" power_expr)?
unary_operator      ::= "!" | "-"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.16.OperatorRuntimeJudgementsAndValuePredicates

-->
RetType(Γ) ∈ Type
OpJudg = {UnOp(op, v) ⇓ v', BinOp(op, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v}
NumericValue(v, t) ⇔ ValueType(v) = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ NumericTypes
IntValue(v, t) ⇔ ValueType(v) = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ IntTypes
FloatValue(v, t) ⇔ ValueType(v) = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ FloatTypes
SignedIntValue(v) ⇔ ∃ t. t ∈ SignedIntTypes ∧ ValueType(v) = TypePrim(t)
SignedTypeOf(v) = t ⇔ t ∈ SignedIntTypes ∧ ValueType(v) = TypePrim(t)
U32Value(v) ⇔ ValueType(v) = TypePrim("u32")
EqValue(v_1, v_2) ⇔ ∃ T. ValueType(v_1) = T ∧ ValueType(v_2) = T ∧ EqType(T)
OrdValue(v_1, v_2) ⇔ ∃ T. ValueType(v_1) = T ∧ ValueType(v_2) = T ∧ OrdType(T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.OperatorComparisonRuntime
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines NaN detection, scalar ordering projection, and equality/ordering comparison results.
labels: IsNaN, OrdScalar, Cmp
-->
IsNaN(t, v) ⇔ t ∈ FloatTypes ∧ v = FloatVal(t, x) ∧ IEEE754Encode(t, x) = CanonicalNaNBits(t)
OrdScalar(v) = x ⇔ (∃ t. v = IntVal(t, x) ∧ t ∈ IntTypes) ∨ (∃ u. v = CharVal(u) ∧ x = u)
Cmp("==", v_1, v_2) = b ⇔ EqValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ ((∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = false) ∨ (¬ ∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = (v_1 = v_2)))
Cmp("!=", v_1, v_2) = b ⇔ EqValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ ((∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = true) ∨ (¬ ∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = (v_1 ≠ v_2)))
Cmp("<", v_1, v_2) = b ⇔ OrdValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ ((∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ ((IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = false) ∨ (¬ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ x_1 = FloatValValue(v_1) ∧ x_2 = FloatValValue(v_2) ∧ b = (x_1 < x_2))) ∨ (∃ x_1, x_2. OrdScalar(v_1) = x_1 ∧ OrdScalar(v_2) = x_2 ∧ b = (x_1 < x_2)))
Cmp("<=", v_1, v_2) = b ⇔ OrdValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ ((∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ ((IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = false) ∨ (¬ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ x_1 = FloatValValue(v_1) ∧ x_2 = FloatValValue(v_2) ∧ b = (x_1 ≤ x_2))) ∨ (∃ x_1, x_2. OrdScalar(v_1) = x_1 ∧ OrdScalar(v_2) = x_2 ∧ b = (x_1 ≤ x_2)))
Cmp(">", v_1, v_2) = b ⇔ OrdValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ ((∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ ((IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = false) ∨ (¬ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ x_1 = FloatValValue(v_1) ∧ x_2 = FloatValValue(v_2) ∧ b = (x_1 > x_2))) ∨ (∃ x_1, x_2. OrdScalar(v_1) = x_1 ∧ OrdScalar(v_2) = x_2 ∧ b = (x_1 > x_2)))
Cmp(">=", v_1, v_2) = b ⇔ OrdValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ ((∃ t. FloatValue(v_1, t) ∧ FloatValue(v_2, t) ∧ ((IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ b = false) ∨ (¬ (IsNaN(t, v_1) ∨ IsNaN(t, v_2)) ∧ x_1 = FloatValValue(v_1) ∧ x_2 = FloatValValue(v_2) ∧ b = (x_1 ≥ x_2))) ∨ (∃ x_1, x_2. OrdScalar(v_1) = x_1 ∧ OrdScalar(v_2) = x_2 ∧ b = (x_1 ≥ x_2)))

For `UnitEnumType(T)`, equality compares the enum discriminant values. Enum declarations reject duplicate discriminants, so this is equivalent to variant identity.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.OperatorBitShiftArithmeticRuntime
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines bit extraction, bitwise operations, shift operations, integer and float exponentiation, and IEEE arithmetic totality.
labels: BitAt, BitNot, BitOp, ShiftOp, PowInt, PowFloat, IEEEArith
-->
BitAt(u, i) = b ⇔ b ∈ {0, 1} ∧ ∃ q, r. u = q · 2^{i + 1} + b · 2^i + r ∧ 0 ≤ r < 2^i
BitNot(v) = v' ⇔ ∃ t, x, w, u, u'. v = IntVal(t, x) ∧ w = IntWidth(t) ∧ u = ToUnsigned(w, x) ∧ u' = (2^w - 1) - u ∧ ((t ∈ SignedIntTypes ∧ v' = IntVal(t, ToSigned(w, u'))) ∨ (t ∈ UnsignedIntTypes ∧ v' = IntVal(t, u')))
BitOp(op, t, v_1, v_2) = v ⇔ v_1 = IntVal(t, x_1) ∧ v_2 = IntVal(t, x_2) ∧ w = IntWidth(t) ∧ u_1 = ToUnsigned(w, x_1) ∧ u_2 = ToUnsigned(w, x_2) ∧ u = ∑_{i=0}^{w-1} b_i 2^i ∧ ∀ i. 0 ≤ i < w ⇒ ((op = "&" ∧ b_i = BitAt(u_1, i) · BitAt(u_2, i)) ∨ (op = "|" ∧ b_i = max(BitAt(u_1, i), BitAt(u_2, i))) ∨ (op = "^" ∧ b_i = (BitAt(u_1, i) + BitAt(u_2, i)) mod 2)) ∧ ((t ∈ SignedIntTypes ∧ v = IntVal(t, ToSigned(w, u))) ∨ (t ∈ UnsignedIntTypes ∧ v = IntVal(t, u)))
ShiftOp(op, t, v_1, v_2) = v ⇔ v_1 = IntVal(t, x_1) ∧ v_2 = IntVal("u32", n) ∧ w = IntWidth(t) ∧ 0 ≤ n < w ∧ u_1 = ToUnsigned(w, x_1) ∧ ((op = "<<" ∧ u = (u_1 · 2^n) mod 2^w) ∨ (op = ">>" ∧ u = ⌊u_1 / 2^n⌋)) ∧ ((t ∈ SignedIntTypes ∧ v = IntVal(t, ToSigned(w, u))) ∨ (t ∈ UnsignedIntTypes ∧ v = IntVal(t, u)))
PowInt(x, n) = y ⇔ n ∈ ℕ ∧ ((n = 0 ∧ y = 1) ∨ (n > 0 ∧ y = x · PowInt(x, n - 1)))
PowFloat(t, x_1, x_2) = x ⇔ t ∈ FloatTypes ∧ x_1 ∈ FloatValueSet(t) ∧ x_2 ∈ FloatValueSet(t) ∧ x is the IEEE 754-2019 pow result of x_1, x_2 in format FloatFormat(t)
IEEEArith(op, t, v_1, v_2) = v ⇔ v_1 = FloatVal(t, x_1) ∧ v_2 = FloatVal(t, x_2) ∧ op ∈ ArithOps ∧ ((op ∈ {"+", "-", "*", "/"} ∧ x is the IEEE 754-2019 result of applying op to x_1, x_2 in format FloatFormat(t)) ∨ (op = "%" ∧ x is the IEEE 754-2019 remainder of x_1, x_2 in format FloatFormat(t)) ∨ (op = "**" ∧ PowFloat(t, x_1, x_2) = x)) ∧ v = FloatVal(t, x)
∀ t ∈ FloatTypes, v_1, v_2, op ∈ ArithOps. ∃ v. IEEEArith(op, t, v_1, v_2) = v
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.UnaryOperatorRuntime
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime unary operator results for boolean not, integer bit-not, integer and float negation, and widen.
labels: UnOp
-->
UnOp("!", false) ⇓ true
UnOp("!", true) ⇓ false
UnOp("!", v) ⇓ v' ⇔ IntValue(v, t) ∧ v' = BitNot(v)
UnOp("-", v) ⇓ v' ⇔ v = IntVal(t, x) ∧ t ∈ SignedIntTypes ∧ x' = -x ∧ InRange(x', t) ∧ v' = IntVal(t, x')
UnOp("-", v) ⇓ v' ⇔ v = FloatVal(t, x) ∧ v' = FloatVal(t, -x)
UnOp("widen", v) ⇓ ModalVal(S, v) ⇔ v = RecordValue(ModalStateRef(modal_ref, S), io)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.FloatUnaryNegationTotality
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires floating-point unary negation to be total, width-preserving, and implemented as IEEE-754 sign negation without overflow panic.
labels: UnOp
-->
For floating-point operands, unary `-` is total (no overflow panic) and MUST preserve width (`f16`/`f32`/`f64`) while applying IEEE-754 sign negation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.BinaryOperatorRuntime
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines binary operator evaluation and delegates arithmetic, bitwise, and shift evaluation to their helper relations.
labels: BinOp, ArithEval, BitEval, ShiftEval
-->
BinOp(op, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ op ∈ ArithOps ∧ NumericValue(v_1, t) ∧ NumericValue(v_2, t) ∧ ArithEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v
BinOp(op, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ op ∈ BitOps ∧ IntValue(v_1, t) ∧ IntValue(v_2, t) ∧ BitEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v
BinOp(op, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ op ∈ ShiftOps ∧ IntValue(v_1, t) ∧ U32Value(v_2) ∧ ShiftEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v
BinOp(op, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ op ∈ {"==", "!="} ∧ EqValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ v = Cmp(op, v_1, v_2)
BinOp(op, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ op ∈ {"<", "<=", ">", ">="} ∧ OrdValue(v_1, v_2) ∧ v = Cmp(op, v_1, v_2)
ArithEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ t ∈ IntTypes ∧ v_1 = IntVal(t, x_1) ∧ v_2 = IntVal(t, x_2) ∧ ((op ∈ {"+", "-", "*"} ∧ x = x_1 op x_2) ∨ (op ∈ {"/", "%"} ∧ x_2 ≠ 0 ∧ x = x_1 op x_2) ∨ (op = "**" ∧ x_2 ≥ 0 ∧ PowInt(x_1, x_2) = x)) ∧ InRange(x, t) ∧ v = IntVal(t, x)
ArithEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ t ∈ FloatTypes ∧ v = IEEEArith(op, t, v_1, v_2)
BitEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ t ∈ IntTypes ∧ v = BitOp(op, t, v_1, v_2)
ShiftEval(op, t, v_1, v_2) ⇓ v ⇔ t ∈ IntTypes ∧ v = ShiftOp(op, t, v_1, v_2)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

**(EvalSigma-Bin-And-True)**

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.OperatorUndefinedAndNaNBehavior
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires undefined unary or binary operations to panic and defines NaN-sensitive comparison outcomes through Cmp.
labels: UnOp, BinOp, Cmp
-->
If `UnOp` or `BinOp` is undefined, evaluation produces `Ctrl(Panic)`. The old draft defines NaN-sensitive comparison behavior through `Cmp`; ordered float comparisons with NaN yield `false`, `==` yields `false`, and `!=` yields `true`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.16.UnaryOperatorLoweringPanicCheck
kind: formal-definition

labels: OpPanicReason, NeedsUnOpPanicCheck

OpPanicReason("-") = Overflow
NeedsUnOpPanicCheck(op, T) ⇔ op = "-" ∧ StripPerm(T) = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ SignedIntTypes

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerUnOp(op, e) ⇓ ⟨SeqIR(IR_e, UnOpIR(op, v, v_r)), v_r⟩

**(Lower-UnOp-Panic)**

kind: semantic-requirement

labels: NeedsUnOpPanicCheck, Lower-UnOp-Ok, Lower-UnOp-Panic

For unary `-`, overflow checks MUST be emitted only when `NeedsUnOpPanicCheck` holds. Unary `-` on floating operands MUST NOT lower an overflow check.

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.CastValidity
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines stripped source/target types and the valid cast relation.
labels: CastValid
-->
S' = StripPerm(S)
T' = StripPerm(T)
CastValid(S, T) ⇔ (S' = TypePrim(s) ∧ T' = TypePrim(t) ∧ s, t ∈ NumericTypes) ∨ (S' = TypePrim(`bool`) ∧ T' = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ IntTypes) ∨ (S' = TypePrim(t) ∧ t ∈ IntTypes ∧ T' = TypePrim(`bool`)) ∨ (S' = TypePrim(`char`) ∧ T' = TypePrim(`u32`)) ∨ (S' = TypePrim(`u32`) ∧ T' = TypePrim(`char`))

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.CastRuntimeConversionHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines cast value judgement, integer widths, signed/unsigned conversion helpers, character scalar conversion, float conversion, and truncation helpers.
labels: CastValJudg, UnsignedIntTypes, IntWidth, Mod_w, ToSigned, ToUnsigned, CodePoint, IsScalar, IntToFloat, FloatToFloat, Trunc, CharOf, IEEE754Bits
-->
CastValJudg = {CastVal(S, T, v) ⇓ v'}
UnsignedIntTypes = {`u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `u64`, `u128`, `usize`}
IntWidth(`i8`) = 8    IntWidth(`i16`) = 16    IntWidth(`i32`) = 32    IntWidth(`i64`) = 64    IntWidth(`i128`) = 128
IntWidth(`u8`) = 8    IntWidth(`u16`) = 16    IntWidth(`u32`) = 32    IntWidth(`u64`) = 64    IntWidth(`u128`) = 128
IntWidth(`isize`) = 8 × PointerSize    IntWidth(`usize`) = 8 × PointerSize
Mod_w(x) = x mod 2^w
ToSigned(w, x) = y ⇔ y ∈ [-2^{w-1}, 2^{w-1}-1] ∧ y ≡ x mod 2^w
ToUnsigned(w, x) = y ⇔ y ∈ [0, 2^w-1] ∧ y ≡ x mod 2^w
CodePoint : `char` → ℕ
IsScalar(u) ⇔ u ∈ CharValueRange
IntToFloat(t, x) function
FloatToFloat(s, t, v) function
Trunc(v) function
CharOf(u) = u ⇔ IsScalar(u)
CodePoint(CharOf(u)) = u    (IsScalar(u))
IEEE754Bits(t, v) = bits ⇔ v ∈ FloatValueSet(t) ∧ IEEE754Encode(t, v) = bits
IntToFloat(t, x) = v ⇔ v ∈ NonNaNValueSet(t) ∧ ∀ v' ∈ NonNaNValueSet(t). |v - x| < |v' - x| ∨ (|v - x| = |v' - x| ∧ EvenSignificandLSB(t, v))
FloatToFloat(s, t, v) = v' ⇔ IEEE754Encode(s, v) = CanonicalNaNBits(s) ∧ v' = CanonicalNaN(t)
FloatToFloat(s, t, v) = v' ⇔ IEEE754Encode(s, v) ≠ CanonicalNaNBits(s) ∧ v' ∈ NonNaNValueSet(t) ∧ ∀ u ∈ NonNaNValueSet(t). |v' - v| < |u - v| ∨ (|v' - v| = |u - v| ∧ EvenSignificandLSB(t, v'))
Trunc(v) =
 ⌊v⌋    if v ≥ 0
 ⌈v⌉    if v < 0
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 16.6 Construction Expressions

#### 16.6.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.ConstructionExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines tuple, array, record, array-segment, field-initializer, and field-initializer-list construction expression grammar.
labels: tuple_literal, tuple_expr_elements, array_literal, array_segment_list, array_segment, record_literal, field_init_list, field_init
-->
```ebnf
tuple_literal       ::= "(" tuple_expr_elements? ")"
tuple_expr_elements ::= expression ";" | expression ("," expression)+
array_literal       ::= "[" array_segment_list? "]"
array_segment_list  ::= array_segment ("," array_segment)*
array_segment       ::= expression | expression ";" expression
record_literal      ::= identifier "{" field_init_list "}" | state_specific_type "{" field_init_list? "}"
field_init_list     ::= field_init ("," field_init)*
field_init          ::= identifier ":" expression | identifier
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 16.7 Control Expressions

#### 16.7.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.ControlExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines if, if-is, if-case, loop, loop condition, loop invariant, and block expression grammar.
labels: if_expr, if_tail, if_case, if_case_else, loop_expr, loop_condition, loop_invariant, block_expr
-->
```ebnf
if_expr        ::= "if" expression if_tail
if_tail        ::= block_expr ("else" (block_expr | if_expr))?
                 | "is" if_case_pattern block_expr ("else" (block_expr | if_expr))?
                 | "is" "{" if_case+ if_case_else? "}"
if_case        ::= if_case_pattern block_expr
if_case_pattern ::= pattern | ":" type
if_case_else   ::= "else" block_expr
loop_expr      ::= "loop" loop_condition? loop_invariant? block_expr
loop_condition ::= expression | pattern (":" type)? "in" expression
loop_invariant ::= "|:" "{" predicate_expr "}"
block_expr     ::= "{" statement* expression? "}"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.ControlExpressionOwnership
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Assigns pattern forms, case parsing, exhaustiveness, loop invariants, and block structure/typing to their owning chapters and sections.
labels: ControlExpressionOwnership
-->
Pattern forms, case-clause parsing, and exhaustiveness notions are owned by Chapter 17. In an `if ... is` case position, `: T` is a type-test pattern shorthand and elaborates to the discard typed pattern `_: T`; it is not general pattern syntax outside `if_case_pattern`. Loop-invariant obligations are owned by §15.7.
Block structure, statement sequencing, terminator handling, and block-local typing are owned by §18.1.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.7.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ControlExprAst
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required

summary: Extends expression AST forms with if, if-is, if-case, loop, iterative loop, and block expression forms.
labels: Expr, IfExpr, IfIsExpr, IfCaseExpr, LoopInfinite, LoopConditional, LoopIter, BlockExpr
-->
Expr = IfExpr(cond, then_block, else_opt) | IfIsExpr(scrutinee, pattern, then_block, else_opt) | IfCaseExpr(scrutinee, cases, else_opt) | LoopInfinite(inv_opt, body) | LoopConditional(cond, inv_opt, body) | LoopIter(pattern, type_opt, iter, inv_opt, body) | BlockExpr(stmts, tail_opt) | …
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ControlAstHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.typecheck, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines loop invariant optionality and if-case AST tuples.
labels: LoopInvariantOpt, IfCase
-->
LoopInvariantOpt ∈ {⊥} ∪ Expr
IfCase = ⟨pattern, body⟩

`if_case_pattern` does not add a distinct AST node. `: T` MUST be represented as `TypedPattern("_", T)` before semantic analysis.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.LoopTypeInference
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines infinite and finite loop result type inference from break collections and bare-break state.
labels: LoopTypeInf, LoopTypeFin
-->
LoopTypeInf(Brk, BrkVoid) =
  { TypePrim(`!`)    if Brk = [] ∧ BrkVoid = false
    TypePrim(`()`)   if Brk = [] ∧ BrkVoid = true
    T                if BrkVoid = false ∧ ResType(Brk) = T
    ⊥                otherwise }

LoopTypeFin(Brk, BrkVoid) =
  { TypePrim(`()`)   if Brk = []
    T                if BrkVoid = false ∧ ResType(Brk) = T
    ⊥                otherwise }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

**(T-Loop-Iter-Async)** and **(Loop-Async-Err)** define the async-iterator case and its rejection when the enclosing return type is not compatible. Async-specific composition semantics remain in Chapter 21.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.16.LoopIterableTypePredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines iterable loop types, range loop types, and bounded range loop types including permission-qualified forms.
labels: LoopIterableType, RangeLoopType, BoundedRangeLoopType
-->
LoopIterableType(T_iter, T) ⇔ T_iter = TypeSlice(T) ∨ T_iter = TypeArray(T, n) ∨ T_iter = TypeRange(T) ∨ T_iter = TypeRangeInclusive(T) ∨ T_iter = TypeRangeFrom(T)
LoopIterableType(TypePerm(p, T_iter), T) ⇔ LoopIterableType(T_iter, T)
RangeLoopType(T_iter, T) ⇔ T_iter = TypeRange(T) ∨ T_iter = TypeRangeInclusive(T) ∨ T_iter = TypeRangeFrom(T)
RangeLoopType(TypePerm(p, T_iter), T) ⇔ RangeLoopType(T_iter, T)
BoundedRangeLoopType(T_iter, T) ⇔ T_iter = TypeRange(T) ∨ T_iter = TypeRangeInclusive(T)
BoundedRangeLoopType(TypePerm(p, T_iter), T) ⇔ BoundedRangeLoopType(T_iter, T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.LoopIteratorRuntime
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines iterator judgements, iterator states, successor and equality helpers, iterator initialization, and iterator next behavior.
labels: IterJudg, Iter, Successor, EqHolds, IterInit, IterNext
-->
IterJudg = {IterInit(v) ⇓ it, IterNext(it) ⇓ (opt(v), it')}
Iter = {SeqIter(v, i) | Len(v) defined ∧ i ∈ ℕ} ∪ {RangeIterExclusive(cur, hi)} ∪ {RangeIterInclusive(cur, hi)} ∪ {RangeIterFrom(cur)} ∪ {IterDone}
Successor(v) ⇓ v' ⇔ `Discrete::successor` applied to v returns v'
EqHolds(v_1, v_2) ⇔ `Eq::eq` applied to ⟨v_1, v_2⟩ returns `true`

IterInit(v) ⇓ SeqIter(v, 0) ⇔ Len(v) defined
IterInit(RangeVal(`Exclusive`, lo, hi)) ⇓ RangeIterExclusive(lo, hi)
IterInit(RangeVal(`Inclusive`, lo, hi)) ⇓ RangeIterInclusive(lo, hi)
IterInit(RangeVal(`From`, lo, ⊥)) ⇓ RangeIterFrom(lo)

IterNext(SeqIter(v, i)) ⇓ (⊥, IterDone) ⇔ ¬ (0 ≤ i < Len(v))
IterNext(SeqIter(v, i)) ⇓ (v_i, SeqIter(v, i + 1)) ⇔ 0 ≤ i < Len(v) ∧ IndexValue(v, i) = v_i
IterNext(RangeIterExclusive(cur, hi)) ⇓ (⊥, IterDone) ⇔ EqHolds(cur, hi)
IterNext(RangeIterExclusive(cur, hi)) ⇓ (cur, RangeIterExclusive(cur', hi)) ⇔ ¬ EqHolds(cur, hi) ∧ Successor(cur) ⇓ cur'
IterNext(RangeIterExclusive(cur, hi)) ⇓ (cur, IterDone) ⇔ ¬ EqHolds(cur, hi) ∧ ¬ ∃ cur'. Successor(cur) ⇓ cur'
IterNext(RangeIterInclusive(cur, hi)) ⇓ (cur, IterDone) ⇔ EqHolds(cur, hi)
IterNext(RangeIterInclusive(cur, hi)) ⇓ (cur, RangeIterInclusive(cur', hi)) ⇔ ¬ EqHolds(cur, hi) ∧ Successor(cur) ⇓ cur'
IterNext(RangeIterInclusive(cur, hi)) ⇓ (cur, IterDone) ⇔ ¬ EqHolds(cur, hi) ∧ ¬ ∃ cur'. Successor(cur) ⇓ cur'
IterNext(RangeIterFrom(cur)) ⇓ (cur, RangeIterFrom(cur')) ⇔ Successor(cur) ⇓ cur'
IterNext(RangeIterFrom(cur)) ⇓ (cur, IterDone) ⇔ ¬ ∃ cur'. Successor(cur) ⇓ cur'
IterNext(IterDone) ⇓ (⊥, IterDone)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.7.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-Expr-If
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers if expressions by lowering condition and branches and emitting IfIR.

Diagnostics are defined for non-`bool` `if` and conditional-loop conditions, ill-typed `if ... is` case bodies, ill-typed loop iterators, and async iterator loops that violate the enclosing async return/error constraints.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

labels: PatternExhaustivenessDiagnostics, LoopInvariantDiagnostics, BlockExpressionDiagnostics
-->
Pattern exhaustiveness and reachability diagnostics for `if ... is { ... }` are owned by §17.6. Loop-invariant diagnostics are owned by §15.7.
Block-expression parse, terminator, and result-join diagnostics are owned by §18.1.7.

### 16.8 Effectful Core Expressions

#### 16.8.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.EffectfulCoreExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines unsafe block, address-of, move, copy, dereference, allocation, and propagation expression grammar.
labels: unsafe_expr, address_of_expr, move_expr, copy_expr, deref_expr, alloc_expr, propagate_expr
-->
```ebnf
unsafe_expr     ::= "unsafe" block_expr
address_of_expr ::= "&" place_expr
move_expr       ::= "move" place_expr
copy_expr       ::= "copy" unary_expr
deref_expr      ::= "*" unary_expr
alloc_expr      ::= "^" expression
propagate_expr  ::= postfix_expr "?"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.RegionAliasAllocRewrite
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: name-resolution
strength: allowed
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.name-resolution, compiler.ast, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Allows Binary(\"^\", Identifier(r), e) to be rewritten to explicit AllocExpr when r resolves to a region alias.
labels: ResolveExpr-Alloc-Explicit-ByAlias
-->
After name resolution, `Binary("^", Identifier(r), e)` MAY be rewritten to `AllocExpr(r, e)` when `r` is a region alias.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.16.AddressOfStaticHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.layout, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines packed layout detection, packed field detection, and address-of admissibility.
labels: HasLayoutPacked, PackedField, AddrOfOk
-->
HasLayoutPacked(D) ⇔ `layout(packed)` appears in D.attrs_opt
PackedField(p) ⇔ p = FieldAccess(base, f) ∧ StripPerm(ExprType(base)) = TypePath(path) ∧ RecordDecl(path) = R ∧ HasLayoutPacked(R)
AddrOfOk(p) ⇔ IsPlace(p) ∧ (p = IndexAccess(_, idx) ⇒ Γ; R; L ⊢ idx : T_i ∧ StripPerm(T_i) = TypePrim(`usize`)) ∧ (PackedField(p) ⇒ UnsafeSpan(span(p)))

#### 16.8.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.16.EffectfulCoreExpressions
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines diagnostic coverage for invalid address-of, packed-field address-of, address-of index type, invalid dereference, raw dereference safety, allocation region, implicit allocation region, and async propagation failures.
labels: E-CON-0230
-->
Diagnostics are defined for address-of on non-places, address-of of packed fields outside `unsafe`, non-`usize` indexing in address-of contexts, dereference of null or expired safe pointers, raw-pointer dereference outside `unsafe`, explicit allocation through a non-region binding, implicit allocation without an active region, and propagation inside async procedures whose error type is `!`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 16.9 Closure and Pipeline Expressions

#### 16.9.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.16.ClosureAndPipelineExpressions
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar productions for pipeline expressions, closure expressions, closure parameters, and closure bodies.
labels: pipeline_expr, closure_expr, closure_param_list, closure_param, closure_body
-->
```ebnf
pipeline_expr      ::= base_postfix_expr ("=>" base_postfix_expr)*
closure_expr       ::= "|" closure_param_list? "|" ("->" type)? closure_body
closure_param_list ::= closure_param ("," closure_param)* ","?
closure_param      ::= "move"? identifier (":" type)?
closure_body       ::= expression | block_expr
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.ClosureParamTrailingComma
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires closure parameter trailing commas to obey TrailingCommaAllowed and not create additional parameters.
labels: TrailingCommaAllowed, closure_param_list
-->
Trailing commas in `closure_param_list` are permitted only when `TrailingCommaAllowed` (§5.5). A trailing comma does not denote an additional parameter.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.ClosureUnionParamParentheses
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires top-level union type annotations in closure parameters to be parenthesized and treats the grouping as syntax-only disambiguation.
labels: closure_expr, union_type
-->
Within `closure_expr`, if a typed parameter annotation has a top-level `union_type`, it MUST be parenthesized as `("(" type ")")`. This grouped form is permitted only to disambiguate closure parameter annotations and does not introduce a distinct type constructor.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.ClosureInvocationOrdinaryCallSyntax
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.semantic-analysis, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires closure invocation to use ordinary call syntax while assigning closure-specific call rules to this section.
labels: closure_expr, call syntax
-->
Closure invocation uses ordinary call syntax; the closure-specific rules for that call form are owned by this section.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.9.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-Pipeline
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a pipeline by parsing the base postfix expression and then the pipeline tail.
labels: Parse-Pipeline
-->
**(Parse-Pipeline)**
Γ ⊢ ParseBasePostfix(P) ⇓ (P_1, e_0)    Γ ⊢ ParsePipelineTail(P_1, e_0) ⇓ (P_2, e)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePipeline(P) ⇓ (P_2, e)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Parse-PipelineTail-Stop
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Stops pipeline-tail parsing when the next token is not the pipeline operator.
labels: Parse-PipelineTail-Stop
-->
**(Parse-PipelineTail-Stop)**

Expr = PipelineExpr(left, right) | ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body) | …

ClosureParam = ⟨move_opt, name, type_opt⟩    move_opt ∈ {true, false}    type_opt ∈ {⊥} ∪ Type

#### 16.9.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureCaptureSets
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.captures, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines free variables and closure capture sets by move, reference, and permission category.
labels: FreeVars, CaptureSet, MoveCaptureSet, RefCaptureSet, SharedCaptures, ConstCaptures, UniqueCaptures
-->
FreeVars(e) = { x | x ∈ Identifier ∧ Bound(x, e) ∧ ¬ LocallyBound(x, e) }
CaptureSet(C) = FreeVars(C.body) ∖ { p.name | p ∈ C.params }
MoveCaptureSet(C) = { x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ (∃ p ∈ C.params. p = ⟨true, x, _⟩) }
                  ∪ { x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ MoveExpr(e) ∈ C.body ∧ PlaceRoot(e) = x }
RefCaptureSet(C) = CaptureSet(C) \ MoveCaptureSet(C)
SharedCaptures(C) = { x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ Γ(x) = TypePerm(`shared`, _) }
ConstCaptures(C) = { x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ Γ(x) = TypePerm(`const`, _) }
UniqueCaptures(C) = { x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ Γ(x) = TypePerm(`unique`, _) }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureEscapeClassification
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.captures, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines escaping and local closure classification from expected type and generic locality.
labels: IsEscaping, CanEscape, IsLocalClosure
-->
IsEscaping(C) ⇔ ExpectedType(C) ≠ ⊥ ∧ CanEscape(ExpectedType(C))
CanEscape(T) ⇔ T = TypeClosure(_, _, _) ∨ (IsGenericType(T) ∧ ¬ LocalBound(T))
IsLocalClosure(C) ⇔ ¬ IsEscaping(C)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureCaptureBindingAccessors
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.captures, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines capture binding accessors and validity predicates used by closure capture analysis.
labels: ClosureMoveCaptures, ClosureRefCaptures, MoveCaptureValid, MoveCaptureErr, RefCaptureValid, ApplyMoveCapture, ApplyMoveCaptures
-->
ClosureMoveCaptures(C) = MoveCaptureSet(C)
ClosureRefCaptures(C) = RefCaptureSet(C)

MoveCaptureValid(𝔅, x) ⇔ Lookup_B(𝔅, x) = ⟨Valid, mov, _, _⟩ ∧ mov = mov
MoveCaptureErr(𝔅, x) ⇔ Lookup_B(𝔅, x) = ⟨s, mv, _, _⟩ ∧ (s ≠ Valid ∨ mv = immov)

RefCaptureValid(𝔅, x) ⇔ Lookup_B(𝔅, x) = ⟨s, _, _, _⟩ ∧ s = Valid

ApplyMoveCapture(𝔅, x) = Update_B(𝔅, x, ⟨Moved, mv, m, r⟩) where Lookup_B(𝔅, x) = ⟨_, mv, m, r⟩

ApplyMoveCaptures(𝔅, []) = 𝔅
ApplyMoveCaptures(𝔅, [x] ++ xs) = ApplyMoveCaptures(ApplyMoveCapture(𝔅, x), xs)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

kind: formal-rule

#### 16.9.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureEnvironmentRuntimeModel
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime closure environment construction, capture values, allocation, binding, loading, captured binding, and environment sizing.
labels: BuildClosureEnv, CaptureVal, AllocEnv, BindEnv, LoadEnv, EnvOffsets, BindCapturedList, BindCaptured, EnvSize
-->
BuildClosureEnv(σ, C) = env ⇔ env = { x ↦ CaptureVal(σ, C, x) | x ∈ CaptureSet(C) }

CaptureVal(σ, C, x) = Ptr@Valid(AddrOfBind(x))    if x ∈ RefCaptureSet(C)
CaptureVal(σ, C, x) = MoveVal(σ, x)      if x ∈ MoveCaptureSet(C)

AllocEnv(σ, env) = (σ', env_ptr) ⇔ env_ptr = Alloc(EnvSize(env)) ∧ σ' = StoreEnv(σ, env_ptr, env)

BindEnv(σ, env_ptr) = σ' ⇔
  C = ClosureOf(env_ptr) ∧
  env = LoadEnv(σ, env_ptr) ∧
  BindCapturedList(σ, C, [⟨x, env[x]⟩ | x ∈ CaptureList(C)]) ⇓ (σ', bs)

LoadEnv(σ, env_ptr) = env ⇔
  ∀ (x, offset) ∈ EnvOffsets(env_ptr). env[x] = ReadAddr(σ, GEP(env_ptr, offset))

EnvOffsets(env_ptr) = [(x_i, offset_i) | C = ClosureOf(env_ptr) ∧ Γ ⊢ ClosureEnvLayout(C) ⇓ ⟨_, _, offsets⟩ ∧ CaptureSet(C) = [x_1, …, x_n] ∧ offsets = [offset_1, …, offset_n]]

BindCapturedList(σ, C, []) ⇓ (σ, [])
BindCapturedList(σ, C, [⟨x, v⟩] ++ xs) ⇓ (σ_2, b :: bs) ⇔ BindCaptured(σ, C, x, v) ⇓ (σ_1, b) ∧ BindCapturedList(σ_1, C, xs) ⇓ (σ_2, bs)

BindCaptured(σ, C, x, Ptr@Valid(addr)) ⇓ (σ', b) ⇔ x ∈ RefCaptureSet(C) ∧ BindVal(σ, x, Alias(addr)) ⇓ (σ', b)
BindCaptured(σ, C, x, v) ⇓ (σ', b) ⇔ x ∈ MoveCaptureSet(C) ∧ BindVal(σ, x, v) ⇓ (σ', b)

EnvSize(env) = size    ⇔ ClosureEnvLayout(ClosureOf(env)) ⇓ ⟨size, _, _⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.EvalSigma-Closure-Capturing
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates a capturing closure by building and allocating an environment, marking move captures, and returning a closure value.

-->

C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    CaptureSet(C) ≠ ∅    Γ ⊢ Mangle(C) ⇓ sym
BuildClosureEnv(σ, C) = env    AllocEnv(σ, env) = (σ_1, env_ptr)
MarkMoved(σ_1, MoveCaptureSet(C)) = σ_2
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(C, σ) ⇓ (Val(ClosureVal(env_ptr, sym)), σ_2)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-definition

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.EvalSigma-ClosureCall
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates a closure call by evaluating the callee, evaluating arguments, and applying the closure.
labels: EvalSigma-ClosureCall
-->
**(EvalSigma-ClosureCall)**
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e_c, σ) ⇓ (Val(ClosureVal(env_ptr, code_ptr)), σ_1)
Γ ⊢ EvalArgsSigma(ClosureParams(ExprType(e_c)), args, σ_1) ⇓ (Val(vec_v), σ_2)
Γ ⊢ ApplyClosureSigma(env_ptr, code_ptr, vec_v, σ_2) ⇓ (out, σ_3)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(ClosureCall(e_c, args), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_3)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureCallRuntimeHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines closure parameter extraction and closure application semantics.
labels: ClosureParams, ApplyClosureSigma
-->
ClosureParams(TypeClosure(params, R, deps_opt)) = params
ClosureParams(TypeFunc(params, R)) = params

ApplyClosureSigma(env_ptr, code_ptr, vec_v, σ) = (out, σ') ⇔
  body = CodeBody(code_ptr) ∧
  params = CodeParams(code_ptr) ∧
  σ_1 = BindParams(σ, params, vec_v) ∧
  (env_ptr ≠ null ⇒ σ_2 = BindEnv(σ_1, env_ptr)) ∧
  (env_ptr = null ⇒ σ_2 = σ_1) ∧
  Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(body, σ_2) ⇓ (out, σ')
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.PipelineDesugaring
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines pipeline expressions as left-first application through the right-hand callable.
labels: pipeline_expr
-->
Pipeline expressions are a distinct left-first application form. `PipelineExpr(e_1, e_2)` evaluates `e_1` before `e_2`; after both produce values, the resulting function or closure value from `e_2` is applied to `[v_1]`. This is call-like lowering, not a source-level equivalence to `e_2(e_1)`.
