#### 16.9.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureLoweringCaptureTypes
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines closure environment fields, reference-capture pointer storage, and move-capture value storage for lowering.
labels: ClosureEnvFields, CaptureType, RefCaptureSet, MoveCaptureSet
-->
ClosureEnvFields(C) = [(x_i, T_i) | x_i ∈ CaptureSet(C) ∧ CaptureType(C, x_i) = T_i]

CaptureType(C, x) = Ptr<T_x>@Valid ⇔ x ∈ RefCaptureSet(C) ∧ Γ(x) = T_x
CaptureType(C, x) = T_x ⇔ x ∈ MoveCaptureSet(C) ∧ Γ(x) = T_x

ConstCaptures(C) ⊆ RefCaptureSet(C) and SharedCaptures(C) ⊆ RefCaptureSet(C). Const and shared captures therefore use the reference-capture environment representation; their additional permission and key-acquisition constraints are defined by §16.9.4 and Chapter 19.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

labels: Layout-ClosureEnv
-->
**(Layout-ClosureEnv)**
C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    ClosureEnvFields(C) = fields    RecordLayout(fields) ⇓ ⟨size, align, offsets⟩
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ClosureEnvLayout(C) ⇓ ⟨size, align, offsets⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    CaptureSet(C) = ∅
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ClosureEnvLayout(C) ⇓ ⟨0, 1, []⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-Expr-Closure-NonCapturing
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a non-capturing closure to an empty IR closure value with null environment and closure code symbol.
labels: Lower-Expr-Closure-NonCapturing
-->
**(Lower-Expr-Closure-NonCapturing)**
C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    CaptureSet(C) = ∅    Γ ⊢ ClosureCodeSym(C) ⇓ sym
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(C) ⇓ ⟨EmptyIR, ClosureVal(null, sym)⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-Expr-Closure-Capturing
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a capturing closure by computing code symbol, environment layout, and capture environment IR.
labels: Lower-Expr-Closure-Capturing
-->
**(Lower-Expr-Closure-Capturing)**
C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    CaptureSet(C) ≠ ∅
Γ ⊢ ClosureCodeSym(C) ⇓ sym    Γ ⊢ ClosureEnvLayout(C) ⇓ ⟨size, align, offsets⟩
Γ ⊢ LowerCaptureEnv(C, offsets) ⇓ ⟨IR_env, env_ptr⟩
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(C) ⇓ ⟨IR_env, ClosureVal(env_ptr, sym)⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.LowerCaptureEnv
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines closure environment allocation and capture storage IR for lowering.
labels: LowerCaptureEnv, StoreCapture, AddrOfBind
-->
LowerCaptureEnv(C, offsets) ⇓ ⟨IR, env_ptr⟩ ⇔
  captures = CaptureSet(C) ∧
  Γ ⊢ ClosureEnvLayout(C) ⇓ ⟨size, align, _⟩ ∧
  env_ptr = Alloc(size, align) ∧
  IR = SeqIR(AllocIR(size, align), [StoreCapture(env_ptr, offsets[i], x_i) | x_i ∈ captures, i ∈ 1..|captures|])

StoreCapture(env_ptr, offset, x) = StoreIR(GEP(env_ptr, offset), Ptr@Valid(AddrOfBind(x)))    if x ∈ RefCaptureSet(C)
StoreCapture(env_ptr, offset, x) = MoveIR(GEP(env_ptr, offset), x)    if x ∈ MoveCaptureSet(C)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.CapturedIdentifierLoweringHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines captured identifier predicates, offsets, and deterministic capture-list ordering for lowering.
labels: IsCaptured, CaptureOffset, CaptureList
-->
IsCaptured(C, x) ⇔ x ∈ CaptureSet(C)
CaptureOffset(C, x) = offset_i ⇔ Γ ⊢ ClosureEnvLayout(C) ⇓ ⟨_, _, offsets⟩ ∧ CaptureList(C) = [x_1, …, x_n] ∧ x = x_i ∧ offsets = [offset_1, …, offset_n]
CaptureList(C) = [x | x ∈ CaptureSet(C)]    (deterministic ordering by lexicographic name)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-CapturedIdent-Ref
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a reference-captured identifier by loading the captured pointer and then the pointed-to value.
labels: Lower-CapturedIdent-Ref
-->
**(Lower-CapturedIdent-Ref)**
InClosureBody(C)    IsCaptured(C, x)    x ∈ RefCaptureSet(C)    CaptureOffset(C, x) = offset
env_param = ClosureEnvParam    Γ(x) = T_x
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(Identifier(x)) ⇓ ⟨SeqIR(LoadIR(GEP(env_param, offset), Ptr<T_x>@Valid), LoadIR(p_capture, T_x)), v_capture⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.LowerCapturedIdentRefTemporaries
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the temporary meanings for p_capture and v_capture in reference-captured identifier lowering.
labels: p_capture, v_capture
-->
where `p_capture` is the result of the first load and `v_capture` is the result of the second load.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-CapturedIdent-Move
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a move-captured identifier by loading the stored capture value from the closure environment.
labels: Lower-CapturedIdent-Move
-->
**(Lower-CapturedIdent-Move)**
InClosureBody(C)    IsCaptured(C, x)    x ∈ MoveCaptureSet(C)    CaptureOffset(C, x) = offset
env_param = ClosureEnvParam    Γ(x) = T_x
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(Identifier(x)) ⇓ ⟨LoadIR(GEP(env_param, offset), T_x), v_capture⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureEnvParam
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the closure environment parameter position in generated closure code.
labels: ClosureEnvParam
-->
ClosureEnvParam = first parameter of closure code function (the environment pointer)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.ClosureCodeSig
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines generated closure code signatures, including the leading environment pointer parameter.
labels: ClosureCodeSig
-->
ClosureCodeSig(C) = (params', R) ⇔
  C.params = params ∧
  C.ret_type_opt = R_opt ∧
  R = (R_opt if R_opt ≠ ⊥ else InferRetType(C.body)) ∧
  params' = CodegenParams([⟨⊥, `__env`, TypeRawPtr(`imm`, TypePrim("u8"))⟩] ++ params)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-Closure-Call
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a resolved closure call to an indirect call with environment pointer prepended to lowered arguments.
labels: Lower-Closure-Call
-->
**(Lower-Closure-Call)**
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(e_closure) ⇓ ⟨IR_c, v_closure⟩
v_closure = ClosureVal(env_ptr, code_ptr)
Γ ⊢ LowerArgs(args) ⇓ ⟨IR_args, vs⟩
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerClosureCall(e_closure, args) ⇓ ⟨SeqIR(IR_c, IR_args), IndirectCall(code_ptr, [env_ptr] ++ vs)⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.16.LowerClosureCallResolvedInternalForm
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.semantic-analysis, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines LowerClosureCall as the resolved internal lowering form for ordinary calls whose callee has closure type.
labels: LowerClosureCall
-->
`LowerClosureCall(e_closure, args)` is the resolved internal lowering form for an ordinary source call `Call(callee, args)` whose callee has closure type. §16.3.6 bridges the source call form to this internal lowering form.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.16.Lower-Expr-Pipeline
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers pipeline expressions by lowering both sides and emitting direct or indirect call IR based on the right-hand side type.
labels: Lower-Expr-Pipeline
-->
**(Lower-Expr-Pipeline)**
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(e_1) ⇓ ⟨IR_1, v_1⟩    Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(e_2) ⇓ ⟨IR_2, v_2⟩
IsFunc(ExprType(e_2)) ⇒ IR_call = CallIR(v_2, [v_1])
IsClosure(ExprType(e_2)) ⇒ v_2 = ClosureVal(env, code) ∧ IR_call = IndirectCall(code, [env, v_1])
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(PipelineExpr(e_1, e_2)) ⇓ ⟨SeqIR(IR_1, IR_2, IR_call), v_result⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.16.LowerPipelineCallablePredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lowering predicates for function and closure callable types.
labels: IsFunc, IsClosure
-->
IsFunc(TypeFunc(_, _)) ⇔ true
IsFunc(_) ⇔ false
IsClosure(TypeClosure(_, _, _)) ⇔ true
IsClosure(_) ⇔ false
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 16.9.7 Diagnostics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.16.ClosureAndPipelineExpressions
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines diagnostic coverage for closure capture, closure inference, and pipeline callable/type/count failures.
labels: E-CON-0120, E-CON-0121, E-MEM-3006, E-MEM-3001, E-SEM-2538, E-SEM-2539, E-SEM-2591
-->
Diagnostics are defined for unique captures, closure parameters whose types cannot be inferred, move-capturing a moved binding, move-capturing an immovable binding, reference-capturing a moved binding, pipeline right-hand sides that are not callable, pipeline type mismatch, and pipeline targets that do not accept exactly one argument.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 16.10 Expression Diagnostics Supplement

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.16.ExpressionDiagnosticsSupplement
kind: diagnostic-table
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.expressions
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines general expression diagnostic codes, severities, detection phase, and trigger conditions.
labels: E-SEM-2525, E-SEM-2526, E-SEM-2527, E-SEM-2528, E-SEM-2531, E-SEM-2532, E-SEM-2533, E-SEM-2534, E-SEM-2535, E-SEM-2536, E-SEM-2538, E-SEM-2539, E-SEM-2591, E-MEM-3031, E-UNS-0102, E-UNS-0103, E-UNS-0104, E-UNS-0107, W-SAFE-0100
-->
This section owns diagnostics for general expression typing, calls, indexing restrictions, and `transmute`.

| Code          | Severity | Detection    | Condition                                                                           |
| ------------- | -------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `E-SEM-2525`  | Error    | Compile-time | Operator operands are not compatible with the operator's type requirements          |
| `E-SEM-2526`  | Error    | Compile-time | Expression type incompatible with expected type                                     |
| `E-SEM-2527`  | Error    | Compile-time | Indexing applied to non-indexable type                                              |
| `E-SEM-2528`  | Error    | Compile-time | Invalid cast                                                                        |
| `E-SEM-2531`  | Error    | Compile-time | Callee expression is not of FUNCTION type                                           |
| `E-SEM-2532`  | Error    | Compile-time | Argument count mismatch                                                             |
| `E-SEM-2533`  | Error    | Compile-time | Argument type incompatible with parameter type                                      |
| `E-SEM-2534`  | Error    | Compile-time | Consuming parameter requires ownership transfer with `move` or an explicit duplicate with `copy` |
| `E-SEM-2535`  | Error    | Compile-time | `move` argument provided for non-consuming parameter                                |
| `E-SEM-2536`  | Error    | Compile-time | Method not found for receiver type                                                  |
| `E-SEM-2538`  | Error    | Compile-time | Pipeline RHS is not callable                                                        |
| `E-SEM-2539`  | Error    | Compile-time | Pipeline argument type mismatch                                                     |
| `E-SEM-2591`  | Error    | Compile-time | Closure parameter type cannot be inferred                                           |
| `E-MEM-3031`  | Error    | Compile-time | `transmute` source and target sizes differ                                          |
| `E-UNS-0102`  | Error    | Compile-time | Fixed-size array index must be a compile-time constant outside `#dynamic` scope  |
| `E-UNS-0103`  | Error    | Compile-time | Array index out of bounds                                                           |
| `E-UNS-0104`  | Error    | Compile-time | `transmute` source and target alignments differ                                     |
| `E-UNS-0107`  | Error    | Compile-time | Explicit `copy` requires a `Bitcopy` value                                          |
| `W-SAFE-0100` | Warning  | Compile-time | `transmute` target type is known to admit invalid bit patterns                      |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

## 17. Patterns

### 17.1 Basic Patterns

**(Pat-Typed-Union-R)**

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ TypedPattern(x, T_a) ◁ T ⊣ B

#### 17.1.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.PatternBindingEnvironment
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines pattern binding environments, domain extraction, and disjoint environment union.
labels: BindEnv, Dom, ⊎
-->
BindEnv = Ident ⇀ Value
Dom(B) = {x | x ∈ Ident ∧ B[x] defined}
B_1 ⊎ B_2 = B ⇔ Dom(B_1) ∩ Dom(B_2) = ∅ ∧ ∀ x. (x ∈ Dom(B_1) ⇒ B[x] = B_1[x]) ∧ (x ∈ Dom(B_2) ⇒ B[x] = B_2[x])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.PatternMatchingJudgementAndLiteralTypes
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the MatchPattern judgement and literal pattern type mapping.
labels: MatchPatJudg, PatType
-->
MatchPatJudg = {MatchPattern(p, v) ⇓ B}
PatType(LiteralPattern(lit)) =
 TypePrim(t)         if lit.kind = IntLiteral ∧ IntSuffix(lit) = t
 TypePrim("i32")     if lit.kind = IntLiteral ∧ IntSuffix(lit) = ⊥
 TypePrim(t)         if lit.kind = FloatLiteral ∧ FloatSuffix(lit) = t ∧ t ∈ {"f16", "f32", "f64"}
 TypePrim("f32")     if lit.kind = FloatLiteral ∧ (FloatSuffix(lit) = "f" ∨ NoFloatSuffix(lit))
 TypePrim("bool")    if lit.kind = BoolLiteral
 TypePrim("char")    if lit.kind = CharLiteral
 TypeString(`@View`) if lit.kind = StringLiteral
 ⊥                   if lit.kind = NullLiteral
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 17.2 Tuple and Record Patterns

#### 17.2.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.17.TupleRecordPatterns
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar productions for tuple patterns, record patterns, and field patterns.
labels: tuple_pattern, tuple_pattern_elements, record_pattern, field_pattern_list, field_pattern
-->
```ebnf
tuple_pattern        ::= "(" tuple_pattern_elements? ")"
tuple_pattern_elements ::= pattern ";" | pattern ("," pattern)+ ","?
record_pattern       ::= type_path "{" field_pattern_list? "}"
field_pattern_list   ::= field_pattern ("," field_pattern)* ","?
field_pattern        ::= identifier (":" pattern)?
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.17.TuplePatternSingleElementSemicolon
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires single-element tuple patterns to use the semicolon spelling.
labels: tuple_pattern
-->
The semicolon form is the only valid single-element tuple-pattern spelling.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

v = (v_1, …, v_n)    ∀ i, Γ ⊢ MatchPattern(p_i, v_i) ⇓ B_i    B = ⊎_i B_i
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ MatchPattern((p_1, …, p_n), v) ⇓ B
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 17.3 Enum and Modal Patterns

#### 17.3.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.17.EnumModalPatterns
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar for enum patterns, enum payload patterns, enum payload elements, and modal patterns.
labels: enum_pattern, enum_payload_pattern, enum_payload_pattern_elements, modal_pattern
-->
```ebnf
enum_pattern                  ::= type_path "::" identifier enum_payload_pattern?
enum_payload_pattern          ::= "(" enum_payload_pattern_elements? ")" | "{" field_pattern_list? "}"
enum_payload_pattern_elements ::= pattern ("," pattern)* ","?
modal_pattern        ::= "@" identifier ("{" field_pattern_list? "}")?
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.17.EnumPayloadSingleElementTuple
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires single-element tuple enum payload patterns to use (p) and forbids the tuple-pattern semicolon marker in enum payloads.
labels: enum_payload_pattern
-->
A single-element tuple enum payload pattern is written as `(p)`. It MUST NOT use the tuple single-element marker `;`, which remains specific to `tuple_pattern`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 17.3.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-Pattern-Enum
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses an enum pattern from a type path, variant separator, variant name, and optional payload.
labels: Parse-Pattern-Enum
-->
**(Parse-Pattern-Enum)**
Γ ⊢ ParseTypePath(P) ⇓ (P_1, path)    IsOp(Tok(P_1), "::")    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, name)    Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPatternPayloadOpt(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, payload_opt)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternAtom(P) ⇓ (P_3, EnumPattern(path, name, payload_opt))

Resolution classifies `A::B { ... }` by the resolved declarations. If `A::B`
resolves as a record type path, the pattern is a `RecordPattern`. If `A` resolves
as an enum type and `B` resolves as a record-payload variant, the pattern is an
`EnumPattern` with record payload. If both are available in the same namespace
relation, resolution emits `E-MOD-1307`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-Pattern-Modal
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a modal pattern from @, state name, and optional record payload.
labels: Parse-Pattern-Modal
-->
**(Parse-Pattern-Modal)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "@")    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, name)    Γ ⊢ ParseModalPatternPayloadOpt(P_1) ⇓ (P_2, fields_opt)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternAtom(P) ⇓ (P_2, ModalPattern(name, fields_opt))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-None
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses absence of enum payload when neither tuple nor record payload starts.
labels: Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-None
-->
**(Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-None)**
Tok(P) ∉ {Punctuator("("), Punctuator("{")}
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPatternPayloadOpt(P) ⇓ (P, ⊥)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-Empty
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses an empty enum tuple payload element list.
labels: Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-Empty
-->
**(Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-Empty)**
IsPunc(Tok(P), ")")
────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPayloadPatternElems(P) ⇓ (P, [])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-One
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a single enum tuple payload pattern element when no comma follows.
labels: Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-One
-->
**(Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-One)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(P) ⇓ (P_1, p)    ¬ IsPunc(Tok(P_1), ",")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPayloadPatternElems(P) ⇓ (P_1, [p])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-TrailingComma
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a single enum tuple payload pattern element with a permitted trailing comma.
labels: Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-TrailingComma, TrailingCommaAllowed
-->
**(Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-TrailingComma)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(P) ⇓ (P_1, p)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), ",")    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P_1)), ")")    TrailingCommaAllowed(P_0, P_1, {Punctuator(")")})
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPayloadPatternElems(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), [p])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-Many
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses multiple comma-separated enum tuple payload pattern elements.
labels: Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-Many
-->
**(Parse-EnumPayloadPatternElems-Many)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(P) ⇓ (P_1, p_1)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), ",")    Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, p_2)    Γ ⊢ ParsePatternListTail(P_2, [p_2]) ⇓ (P_3, ps)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPayloadPatternElems(P) ⇓ (P_3, [p_1] ++ ps)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-Tuple
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a parenthesized enum tuple payload pattern.
labels: Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-Tuple
-->
**(Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-Tuple)**
IsPunc(Tok(P), "(")    Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPayloadPatternElems(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, ps)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), ")")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPatternPayloadOpt(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), TuplePayloadPattern(ps))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-EnumPatternPayloadOpt-Record

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseEnumPatternPayloadOpt(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), RecordPayloadPattern(io))

-->

StripPerm(T) = TypePath(p)    EnumDecl(p) = E    VariantPayload(E, v) = TuplePayload([T_1, …, T_n])    ∀ i, Γ ⊢ p_i ◁ T_i ⊣ B_i    B = ⊎_i B_i
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

id: rule.17.Pat-Enum-Record-R

applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines range pattern grammar for exclusive and inclusive range operators.
labels: range_pattern
-->
```ebnf
range_pattern ::= pattern (".." | "..=") pattern
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 17.4.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-Pattern
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a pattern through ParsePatternRange.
labels: Parse-Pattern
-->
**(Parse-Pattern)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternRange(P) ⇓ (P_1, pat)
───────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(P) ⇓ (P_1, pat)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-Pattern-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns

summary: Emits a syntax diagnostic for pattern parse errors and recovers with a wildcard pattern.
labels: Parse-Pattern-Err, Parse-Syntax-Err
-->
**(Parse-Pattern-Err)**
c = Code(Parse-Syntax-Err)    Γ ⊢ Emit(c, Tok(P).span)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(P) ⇓ (P, WildcardPattern)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-Pattern-Range-None
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a pattern atom as a non-range pattern when no range operator follows.
labels: Parse-Pattern-Range-None
-->
**(Parse-Pattern-Range-None)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternAtom(P) ⇓ (P_1, p)    ¬ (IsOp(Tok(P_1), "..") ∨ IsOp(Tok(P_1), "..="))
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternRange(P) ⇓ (P_1, p)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-Pattern-Range
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ast, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses an exclusive or inclusive range pattern from two pattern atoms.
labels: Parse-Pattern-Range
-->
**(Parse-Pattern-Range)**
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternAtom(P) ⇓ (P_1, p_0)    Tok(P_1) = op ∈ {"..", "..="}    Γ ⊢ ParsePatternAtom(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, p_1)    kind = (`Exclusive` if op = ".." else `Inclusive`)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePatternRange(P) ⇓ (P_2, RangePattern(kind, p_0, p_1))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.RangePatternAst
kind: formal-definition

RangePattern(kind, lo, hi)

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 17.4.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Pat-Range-R
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Checks integer range patterns with compile-time integer bounds and non-empty exclusive or inclusive range ordering.
labels: Pat-Range-R
-->
**(Pat-Range-R)**
StripPerm(T) = TypePrim(t)    t ∈ IntTypes    ConstPatInt(p_l) = n_l    ConstPatInt(p_h) = n_h    (kind = ".." ⇒ n_l < n_h)    (kind = "..=" ⇒ n_l ≤ n_h)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RangePattern(kind, p_l, p_h) ◁ T ⊣ ∅
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.RangePattern-NonConst
kind: formal-rule
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Rejects range patterns whose bounds are not compile-time integer constants.
labels: RangePattern-NonConst
-->
**(RangePattern-NonConst)**
(ConstPatInt(p_l) undefined ∨ ConstPatInt(p_h) undefined)    c = Code(RangePattern-NonConst)
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RangePattern(kind, p_l, p_h) ◁ T ⇑ c
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.RangePattern-Empty
kind: formal-rule
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Rejects statically empty exclusive or inclusive range patterns.
labels: RangePattern-Empty
-->
**(RangePattern-Empty)**
ConstPatInt(p_l) = n_l    ConstPatInt(p_h) = n_h    ((kind = "..") ⇒ n_l ≥ n_h)    ((kind = "..=") ⇒ n_l > n_h)    c = Code(RangePattern-Empty)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RangePattern(kind, p_l, p_h) ◁ T ⇑ c
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 17.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.ConstPat
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines constant literal pattern value extraction for range matching.

-->
ConstPat(p) = v ⇔ p = LiteralPattern(ℓ) ∧ v = LiteralValue(ℓ, PatType(p))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Match-Range-Inclusive
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Matches an inclusive range pattern when the value lies between the bounds inclusively.
labels: Match-Range-Inclusive
-->
**(Match-Range)**
ConstPat(p_l) = v_l    ConstPat(p_h) = v_h    v_l ≤ v ≤ v_h
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ MatchPattern(p_l `..=` p_h, v) ⇓ ∅
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Match-Range-Exclusive
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Matches an exclusive range pattern when the value lies between the lower inclusive bound and upper exclusive bound.
labels: Match-Range-Exclusive
-->
ConstPat(p_l) = v_l    ConstPat(p_h) = v_h    v_l ≤ v < v_h
───────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ MatchPattern(p_l `..` p_h, v) ⇓ ∅
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 17.5 Case Clauses

#### 17.5.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.17.CaseClauses
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar for if-case clauses, type-test case patterns, and else case clauses.
labels: if_case, if_case_pattern, if_case_else
-->
```ebnf
if_case      ::= if_case_pattern block_expr
if_case_pattern ::= pattern | ":" type
if_case_else ::= "else" block_expr
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 17.5.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.CaseClauseParsingGroup

phase: parsing

owner: spec.patterns

**Case Clauses.**

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.Parse-IfCases-Cons
kind: formal-rule

**(Parse-IfCases-Cons)**
Γ ⊢ ParseIfCase(P) ⇓ (P_1, c)    Γ ⊢ ParseIfCasesTail(P_1, [c]) ⇓ (P_2, cases, else_opt)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseIfCases(P) ⇓ (P_2, cases, else_opt)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: rule.17.Parse-IfCase

id: rule.17.Parse-IfCase-Pattern

-->
**(Parse-IfCase-Pattern)**
¬ IsPunc(Tok(P), ":")    Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(P) ⇓ (P_1, pat)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseIfCasePattern(P) ⇓ (P_1, pat)

-->

Tok(P) = Punctuator("}")
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

#### 17.5.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.CaseScopeJudgements
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis

labels: CaseScopeJudg, PatternNarrowJudg, PatternRejectNarrowJudg, ElseScope
-->
CaseScopeJudg = {CaseScope(Γ, e, pat, T) ⇓ Γ_case, ElseScope(Γ, e, pat, T) ⇓ Γ_else, CasesElseScope(Γ, e, cases, T) ⇓ Γ_else}
PatternNarrowJudg = {PatternNarrow(Γ, pat, T) ⇓ T_n}

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.ScrutineeBindingAndRefinement
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis

owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines stable scrutinee binding extraction and environment replacement for case-scope narrowing.
labels: ScrutineeBinding, RefineBinding
-->
ScrutineeBinding(Identifier(x)) = x
ScrutineeBinding(e) = ⊥ ⇔ e ≠ Identifier(_)
RefineBinding(Γ, x, T_n) ⇓ Γ' ⇔ LookupNearestValueBinding(Γ, x) = b ∧ Γ' = ReplaceBindingType(Γ, b, T_n)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.UnionOrSingle

summary: Defines single-member collapse for narrowed union member lists.
labels: UnionOrSingle
-->
UnionOrSingle([T]) = T
UnionOrSingle([T_1, …, T_n]) = TypeUnion([T_1, …, T_n]) ⇔ n ≥ 2
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

**(PatternNarrow-Perm)**
PatternNarrow(Γ, pat, T) ⇓ T_n
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PatternNarrow(Γ, pat, TypePerm(p, T)) ⇓ TypePerm(p, T_n)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.17.PatternNarrow-ModalRef

id: rule.17.PatternNarrow-ModalState

StripPerm(T) = TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)    ModalDeclOf(modal_ref) = M

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

#### 17.6.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.ExhaustivenessIrrefutabilityHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines equality, irrefutability, irrefutable-case detection, case labels, and unreachable-case detection.
labels: AllEq_Γ, Irrefutable, HasIrrefutableCase, CaseLabel, CaseUnreachable, TypedPattern
-->
AllEq_Γ([T_1, …, T_n]) ⇔ ∀ i. Γ ⊢ T_i ≡ T_1
Irrefutable(pat, T) ⇔ pat = WildcardPattern ∨ pat = IdentifierPattern(_) ∨ (pat = TypedPattern(_, T_a) ∧ T_a = StripPerm(T)) ∨ (pat = TuplePattern([p_1, …, p_n]) ∧ StripPerm(T) = TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_n]) ∧ ∀ i. Irrefutable(p_i, T_i)) ∨ (pat = RecordPattern(p, io) ∧ StripPerm(T) = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ ∀ fp ∈ io. Irrefutable(PatOf(fp), FieldType(R, FieldName(fp))))
HasIrrefutableCase(cases, T) ⇔ ∃ case ∈ cases. ∃ p, b. case = ⟨p, b⟩ ∧ Irrefutable(p, T)
CaseLabel(EnumPattern(path, v, _)) = ⟨`enum`, path, v⟩
CaseLabel(ModalPattern(s, _)) = ⟨`modal`, s⟩
CaseLabel(TypedPattern(_, T)) = ⟨`union`, T⟩
CaseLabel(_) = ⊥
CaseUnreachable(T, cases, i) ⇔
  (∃ j. 1 ≤ j < i ∧ Irrefutable(cases[j].pat, T)) ∨
  (CaseLabel(cases[i].pat) ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∃ j. 1 ≤ j < i ∧ CaseLabel(cases[j].pat) = CaseLabel(cases[i].pat))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.EnumCaseCoverageHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines enum variant names and variants covered by case clauses.
labels: VariantNames, CaseVariants
-->
VariantNames(E) = [ v.name | v ∈ E.variants ]
CaseVariants(cases) = { v | ∃ p, b. ⟨p, b⟩ ∈ cases ∧ p = EnumPattern(_, v, _) }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.ModalCaseCoverageHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines modal states covered by case clauses.
labels: CaseStates
-->
CaseStates(cases) = { s | ∃ p, b. ⟨p, b⟩ ∈ cases ∧ p = ModalPattern(_, s) }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.17.UnionCaseCoverageHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.patterns
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines union type extraction, union case labels, and union case exhaustiveness.
labels: UnionTypes, CaseUnionTypes, PatternMayMatchType, UnionTypesExhaustive
-->
UnionTypes(U) = [T_1, …, T_n] ⇔ U = TypeUnion([T_1, …, T_n])
CaseUnionTypes(cases) = { T | ∃ p, b. ⟨p, b⟩ ∈ cases ∧ p = TypedPattern(_, T) }
PatternMayMatchType(Γ, p, T) ⇔ ∃ B. Γ ⊢ p ◁ T ⊣ B
UnionTypesExhaustive(cases, types) ⇔ ∀ T ∈ types. ∃ case ∈ cases. ∃ p, b. case = ⟨p, b⟩ ∧ PatternMayMatchType(Γ, p, T)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: diag.17.PatternDiagnosticsSupplement
kind: diagnostic-table

This section owns diagnostics for pattern exhaustiveness, irrefutability, and pattern-shape validity.

**(IfIs-BareTypePattern-Err)**
`if ... is` case position contains IdentifierPattern(x)    ResolveTypeName(Γ, x) defined    c = Code(IfIs-BareTypePattern-Err)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ IfIsCasePattern(IdentifierPattern(x)) ⇑ c

**(IfIs-TypedPattern-Incompatible)**

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

| Code         | Severity | Detection    | Condition                                                          |
| ------------ | -------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `E-SEM-2705` | Error    | Compile-time | `if ... is { ... }` case analysis is not exhaustive for union type |
| `E-SEM-2711` | Error    | Compile-time | Refutable pattern in irrefutable context (`let`)                   |
| `E-SEM-2713` | Error    | Compile-time | Duplicate binding identifier within single pattern                 |
| `E-SEM-2721` | Error    | Compile-time | Range pattern bounds are not compile-time constants                |
| `E-SEM-2722` | Error    | Compile-time | Range pattern start exceeds end (empty range)                      |
| `E-SEM-2731` | Error    | Compile-time | Record pattern references non-existent field                       |
| `E-SEM-2741` | Error    | Compile-time | `if ... is { ... }` case analysis is not exhaustive                |
| `E-SEM-2751` | Error    | Compile-time | Case clause is unreachable                                         |
| `E-SEM-2761` | Error    | Compile-time | Bare type name in `if ... is` pattern; use `: T` or `_: T`         |
| `E-SEM-2762` | Error    | Compile-time | Typed `if ... is` pattern is incompatible with the scrutinee type  |

## 18. Statements and Blocks

### 18.1 Blocks

#### 18.1.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.18.Blocks
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines statement sequence, statement alternatives, and block expression grammar.
labels: statement_seq, statement, block_expr
-->
```ebnf
statement_seq ::= statement* expression?
statement     ::= binding_stmt
                | using_local_stmt
                | assignment_stmt
                | compound_assign
                | expr_stmt
                | defer_stmt
                | region_stmt
                | frame_stmt
                | return_stmt
                | break_stmt
                | continue_stmt
                | unsafe_block
                | key_block_stmt
                | comptime_stmt
block_expr    ::= "{" statement_seq "}"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing

labels: key_block_stmt, comptime_stmt

`key_block_stmt` is defined in Chapter 19.
`comptime_stmt` is defined in §22.1.1.

StmtTerm = {Punctuator(";"), Newline}

id: def.18.ControlAndStatementOutcomes

labels: Ctrl, StmtOut, Outcome, StmtOutOf, BreakVal
-->
Ctrl = {Return(v), Result(v), Break(v_opt), Continue, Panic, Abort}
StmtOut = {ok} ∪ {Ctrl(κ) | κ ∈ Ctrl}
Outcome = {Val(v)} ∪ {Ctrl(κ) | κ ∈ Ctrl}
StmtOutOf(Val(v)) = ok
StmtOutOf(Ctrl(κ)) = Ctrl(κ)
BreakVal(⊥) = ()
BreakVal(v) = v

summary: Defines how cleanup outcomes transform block exit outcomes.
labels: ExitOutcome
-->
ExitOutcome(out, ok) = out
ExitOutcome(Ctrl(Abort), c) = Ctrl(Abort)
ExitOutcome(Ctrl(Panic), panic) = Ctrl(Abort)
ExitOutcome(out, panic) = Ctrl(Panic)    (out ≠ Ctrl(Panic) ∧ out ≠ Ctrl(Abort))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.BlockExit
kind: formal-definition

owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage

labels: BlockExit
-->
BlockExit(σ, scope, out) ⇓ (out', σ') ⇔ Γ ⊢ CleanupScope(scope, σ) ⇓ (c, σ_1) ∧ out' = ExitOutcome(out, c) ∧ ((out' = Ctrl(Abort) ∧ σ' = σ_1) ∨ (out' ≠ Ctrl(Abort) ∧ PopScope_σ(σ_1) ⇓ (σ', scope)))

EvalBlockBodySigma(BlockExpr(stmts, tail_opt), σ) ⇓ (out, σ') ⇔ Γ ⊢ ExecSeqSigma(stmts, σ) ⇓ (sout, σ_1) ∧ (

 (sout = ok ∧ tail_opt = ⊥ ∧ out = Val(()) ∧ σ' = σ_1) ∨
 (sout = Ctrl(Result(v)) ∧ out = Val(v) ∧ σ' = σ_1) ∨
 (sout = Ctrl(κ) ∧ κ ≠ Result(_) ∧ out = Ctrl(κ) ∧ σ' = σ_1)
)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.LowerStatementJudgements
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lowering judgement family for statements, statement lists, blocks, and loops.
labels: LowerStmtJudg
-->
LowerStmtJudg = {LowerStmt, LowerStmtList, LowerBlock, LowerLoop}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Stmt-Correctness
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: States semantic correctness obligation for statement lowering.
labels: Lower-Stmt-Correctness
-->
**(Lower-Stmt-Correctness)**
∀ σ, Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(s, σ) ⇓ (sout, σ') ⇒ ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (sout, σ')
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(s) ⇓ IR
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Block-Correctness
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: States semantic correctness obligation for block lowering including block result value preservation.
labels: Lower-Block-Correctness
-->
**(Lower-Block-Correctness)**
∀ σ, out, σ'. Γ ⊢ EvalBlockSigma(b, σ) ⇓ (out, σ') ⇒ (ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (out, σ') ∧ (out = Val(v') ⇒ v = v'))
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(b) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.StatementLoweringTotality
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines statement forms covered by baseline statement lowering and totality over those forms.
labels: StmtForms0, LowerStmtTotal
-->
StmtForms0 = {LetStmt(_), VarStmt(_), UsingLocalStmt(_, _, _), AssignStmt(_, _), CompoundAssignStmt(_, _, _), ExprStmt(_), DeferStmt(_), RegionStmt(_, _, _), FrameStmt(_, _), ReturnStmt(_), BreakStmt(_), ContinueStmt, UnsafeBlockStmt(_), ErrorStmt(_)}
LowerStmtTotal(Γ) ⇔ ∀ s. s ∈ StmtForms0 ⇒ ∃ IR. Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(s) ⇓ IR
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-StmtList-Empty
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers an empty statement list to empty IR.
labels: Lower-StmtList-Empty
-->
**(Lower-StmtList-Empty)**
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerStmtList([]) ⇓ ε
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-StmtList-Cons
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a statement list by sequencing lowered head and tail IR.
labels: Lower-StmtList-Cons
-->
**(Lower-StmtList-Cons)**
Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(s) ⇓ IR_s    Γ ⊢ LowerStmtList(ss) ⇓ IR_r
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerStmtList(s::ss) ⇓ SeqIR(IR_s, IR_r)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Block-Tail
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers a block with a tail expression by lowering statements and tail expression into BlockIR.
labels: Lower-Block-Tail
-->
**(Lower-Block-Tail)**
tail ≠ ⊥    Γ ⊢ LowerStmtList(stmts) ⇓ IR_s    Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(tail) ⇓ ⟨IR_t, v_t⟩
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(BlockExpr(stmts, tail)) ⇓ ⟨BlockIR(IR_s, IR_t, v_t), v_block⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

-->

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(BlockExpr(stmts, ⊥)) ⇓ ⟨BlockIR(IR_s, ε, ()), v_block⟩

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Stmt-Error
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering

-->
**(Lower-Stmt-Error)**
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: req.18.TemporaryCleanupLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires lowering to emit temporary cleanup in reverse temporary drop order, after ordinary statements and immediately before control transfers.
labels: TempDropOrder, TempCleanupIR
-->
**Temporary Cleanup in Lowering.**

Let `TempDropOrder(s) = [e_1, …, e_k]`. For each `i`, let
`Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(e_i) ⇓ ⟨IR_i, v_i⟩`
denote the unique invocation of `LowerExpr(e_i)` in the derivation of
`Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(s) ⇓ IR_s`, and let `ExprType(e_i) = T_i`.

TempCleanupIR(s) =
  { ε                                                   if k = 0
    SeqIRList([EmitDrop(T_k, v_k), …, EmitDrop(T_1, v_1)])    otherwise }

For `s ∉ {ReturnStmt(_), BreakStmt(_), ContinueStmt}`, the lowering MUST produce
`Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(s) ⇓ SeqIR(IR_s, TempCleanupIR(s))`.

For control-flow statements, the lowering MUST emit temporary cleanup immediately before the control transfer:

`Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(ReturnStmt(e)) ⇓ SeqIR(IR_e, TempCleanupIR(s), ReturnIR(v))`
`Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(BreakStmt(e)) ⇓ SeqIR(IR_e, TempCleanupIR(s), BreakIR(v))`
`Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(BreakStmt(⊥)) ⇓ SeqIR(TempCleanupIR(s), BreakIR(⊥))`
`Γ ⊢ LowerStmt(ContinueStmt) ⇓ SeqIR(TempCleanupIR(s), ContinueIR)`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.BlockLoopLoweringTotality
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines block and loop forms covered by lowering and totality over those forms.
labels: BlockForms0, LoopForms0, LowerBlockTotal, LowerLoopTotal
-->
BlockForms0 = {BlockExpr(_, _)}
LoopForms0 = {LoopInfinite(_, _), LoopConditional(_, _, _), LoopIter(_, _, _, _, _)}
LowerBlockTotal(Γ) ⇔ ∀ b. b ∈ BlockForms0 ⇒ ∃ IR, v. Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(b) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩
LowerLoopTotal(Γ) ⇔ ∀ l. l ∈ LoopForms0 ⇒ ∃ IR, v. Γ ⊢ LowerLoop(l) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Loop-Infinite
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers infinite loops by lowering their body and emitting LoopIR.
labels: Lower-Loop-Infinite
-->
**(Lower-Loop-Infinite)**
Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(body) ⇓ ⟨IR_b, v_b⟩
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerLoop(LoopInfinite(inv_opt, body)) ⇓ ⟨LoopIR(LoopInfinite, inv_opt, IR_b, v_b), v_loop⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Loop-Cond
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers conditional loops by lowering their condition and body into LoopIR.
labels: Lower-Loop-Cond
-->
**(Lower-Loop-Cond)**
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(cond) ⇓ ⟨IR_c, v_c⟩    Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(body) ⇓ ⟨IR_b, v_b⟩
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerLoop(LoopConditional(cond, inv_opt, body)) ⇓ ⟨LoopIR(LoopConditional, inv_opt, IR_c, v_c, IR_b, v_b), v_loop⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.Lower-Loop-Iter
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers iterator loops by lowering the iterator expression and body into LoopIR.
labels: Lower-Loop-Iter
-->
**(Lower-Loop-Iter)**
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(iter) ⇓ ⟨IR_i, v_iter⟩    Γ ⊢ LowerBlock(body) ⇓ ⟨IR_b, v_b⟩
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerLoop(LoopIter(pat, ty_opt, iter, inv_opt, body)) ⇓ ⟨LoopIR(LoopIter, pat, ty_opt, inv_opt, IR_i, v_iter, IR_b, v_b), v_loop⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 18.2 Binding Statements

#### 18.2.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.18.BindingStatements
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage

```ebnf
binding_stmt ::= ("let" | "var") pattern (":" type)? binding_op expression terminator
```

#### 18.2.2 Parsing

kind: formal-rule

**(Parse-Binding-Stmt)**
Tok(P) ∈ {Keyword(`let`), Keyword(`var`)}    Γ ⊢ ParseBindingAfterLetVar(P) ⇓ (P_1, bind)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

Tok(P) = kw ∈ {Keyword(`let`), Keyword(`var`)}    Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, pat)    Γ ⊢ ParseTypeAnnotOpt(P_1) ⇓ (P_2, ty_opt)    Tok(P_2) ∈ {Operator("="), Operator(":=")}    op = Tok(P_2)    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(Advance(P_2)) ⇓ (P_3, init)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseBindingAfterLetVar(P) ⇓ (P_3, ⟨pat, ty_opt, op, init, SpanBetween(P, P_3)⟩)

BindType(⟨attrs_opt, pat, ty_opt, op, init, _⟩) = T ⇔ ty_opt = T

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.SuspendUniqueBind
kind: formal-definition

summary: Defines suspension of unique place paths when binding a const value from a unique place initializer.
labels: SuspendUniqueBind
-->
SuspendUniqueBind(Π, init, T_b) =
  { SuspendUniquePath(Π, ⊥, init)    if IsPlace(init) ∧ PermOf(ExprType(init)) = `unique` ∧ PermOf(T_b) = `const`
    Π                                otherwise }

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.B-LetVar
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Performs binding-state analysis for let and var statements, including initializer analysis, unique suspension, move consumption, pattern checking, and binding introduction.
labels: B-LetVar
-->
**(B-LetVar)**
Γ; 𝔅; Π ⊢ init ⇒ 𝔅_1 ▷ Π_1    T_b = BindType(⟨pat, ty_opt, op, init, _⟩)    Π_2 = SuspendUniqueBind(Π_1, init, T_b)    𝔅_2 = ConsumeOnMove(𝔅_1, init)    Γ ⊢ pat ⇐ T_b ⊣ B    𝔅_3 = IntroAll_B(𝔅_2, BindInfoMap(λ U. RespOfInit(init), B, MovOf(op), mut))
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; 𝔅; Π ⊢ LetOrVarStmt(⟨pat, ty_opt, op, init, _⟩) ⇒ 𝔅_3 ▷ Π_2

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

binding = ⟨pat, _, _, init, _⟩    Γ; Ω ⊢ init ⇓ π_init    Γ ⊢ PatNames(pat) ⇓ N    π_bind = BindProv(Ω, π_init)    π_bind ≠ π_Region(tag) for every tag    Σ_π' = IntroAll_π(Σ_π, N, π_bind)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#### 18.2.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.BindVal
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime binding of a value to a name in the current scope, including fresh binding id, valid state, and cleanup registration for responsible bindings.
labels: BindVal
-->
BindVal(σ, x, v) ⇓ (σ', b) ⇔ ScopeStack(σ) = scope :: ss ∧ scope = ⟨sid, cleanup, names, vals, states⟩ ∧ bind_id = FreshBindId(σ) ∧ names' = names[x ↦ (names[x] if present else []) ++ [bind_id]] ∧ vals' = vals[bind_id ↦ v] ∧ states' = states[bind_id ↦ `Valid`] ∧ scope' = ⟨sid, cleanup, names', vals', states'⟩ ∧ UpdateScopeStack(σ, scope' :: ss) = σ_1 ∧ b = ⟨sid, bind_id, x⟩ ∧ ((BindInfo(b).resp = resp ∧ AppendCleanup(σ_1, DropBinding(b)) ⇓ σ') ∨ (BindInfo(b).resp ≠ resp ∧ σ' = σ_1))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.BindPatternRuntimeHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime pattern binding value extraction and binding order.
labels: BindPatternVal, BindOrder
-->
BindPatternVal(p, v) ⇓ B ⇔ Γ ⊢ MatchPattern(p, v) ⇓ B
BindOrder(p, B) = [⟨x, B[x]⟩ | x ∈ PatNames(p)]
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.BindList-Empty
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Binds an empty runtime binding list without changing state.
labels: BindList-Empty
-->
**(BindList-Empty)**
────────────────────────────────────────────
BindList(σ, []) ⇓ (σ, [])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.BindList-Cons
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Binds a runtime binding list by binding the head and recursing over the tail.
labels: BindList-Cons
-->
**(BindList-Cons)**
BindVal(σ, x, v) ⇓ (σ_1, b)    BindList(σ_1, xs) ⇓ (σ_2, bs)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BindList(σ, [⟨x, v⟩] ++ xs) ⇓ (σ_2, b::bs)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.BindPattern
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime pattern binding by matching the pattern, ordering bindings, and binding the list.
labels: BindPattern
-->
BindPattern(σ, p, v) ⇓ (σ', bs) ⇔ BindPatternVal(p, v) ⇓ B ∧ BindOrder(p, B) = binds ∧ BindList(σ, binds) ⇓ (σ', bs)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(ExecSigma-Let)**
BindingForm(binding) = ⟨attrs_opt, pat, ty_opt, op, init, _⟩    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(init, σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)    BindPattern(σ_1, pat, v) ⇓ (σ_2, bs)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(LetStmt(binding), σ) ⇓ (ok, σ_2)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(LetStmt(binding), σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ_1)

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ AssignStmt(p, e) ⇒ Γ ▷ ⟨[], [], false⟩

Direct mutation of a `shared` place is valid when Chapter 19 can form a valid
`KeyPath(p)` with `RequiredMode(p) = Write` and no key scope, escape, or conflict
rule forbids the access. If no covering write key is already held, the assignment
implicitly acquires a write key through the ordinary access rules in §19.1.6.
`E-TYP-1604` applies only when no valid key-mediated write context can be formed.

#### 18.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.AssignmentRootBinding
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime root binding resolution for assignment targets as local or static roots.
labels: RootBinding
-->
RootBinding(Sigma, p) =
 Local(b)    if LookupBind(Sigma, PlaceRoot(p)) = b
 Static(path, name)    if LookupBind(Sigma, PlaceRoot(p)) undefined ∧ Γ ⊢ ResolveValueName(PlaceRoot(p)) ⇓ ent ∧ ent.origin_opt = mp ∧ name = (ent.target_opt if present, else PlaceRoot(p)) ∧ path = PathOfModule(mp)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.DropOnAssign
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines when assignment to a local or static root must drop an existing responsible immovable value and whether the root is already moved.
labels: DropOnAssign, DropOnAssignStatic, DropOnAssignRoot, RootMoved
-->
DropOnAssign(b) ⇔ BindInfo(b).mov = immov ∧ BindInfo(b).resp = resp
DropOnAssignStatic(path, name) ⇔ StaticBindInfo(path, name).mov = immov ∧ StaticBindInfo(path, name).resp = resp

DropOnAssignRoot(Sigma, p) ⇔ (RootBinding(Sigma, p) = Local(b) ∧ DropOnAssign(b)) ∨ (RootBinding(Sigma, p) = Static(path, name) ∧ DropOnAssignStatic(path, name))
RootMoved(Sigma, p) ⇔ RootBinding(Sigma, p) = Local(b) ∧ BindState(Sigma, b) = Moved
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.DropSubvalueJudgement
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the DropSubvalue judgement for assignment replacement cleanup.
labels: DropSubvalueJudg
-->
DropSubvalueJudg = {Γ ⊢ DropSubvalue(p, T, v, σ) ⇓ σ'}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.DropSubvalue-Do
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Drops an existing subvalue on assignment when the root requires assignment-drop cleanup and has not been moved.
labels: DropSubvalue-Do
-->
**(DropSubvalue-Do)**
DropOnAssignRoot(Sigma, p)    ¬ RootMoved(Sigma, p)    Γ ⊢ DropValue(T, v, ∅) ⇓ Sigma'
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ DropSubvalue(p, T, v, Sigma) ⇓ Sigma'
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.DropSubvalue-Skip
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Skips assignment-drop cleanup when the root does not require it or is already moved.
labels: DropSubvalue-Skip
-->
**(DropSubvalue-Skip)**
¬ DropOnAssignRoot(Sigma, p) ∨ RootMoved(Sigma, p)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ DropSubvalue(p, T, v, Sigma) ⇓ Sigma
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(AssignStmt(p, e), σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ_1)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

### 18.7 Region

#### 18.7.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.18.Region
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region statement grammar, optional options expression, and optional alias.
labels: region_stmt, region_opts, region_alias
-->
```ebnf
region_stmt  ::= "region" region_opts? region_alias? block_expr
region_opts  ::= "(" expression ")"
region_alias ::= "as" identifier
```

¬ IsPunc(Tok(P), "(")

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseRegionOptsOpt(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), e)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

RegionBind(Γ, alias_opt) = Γ_r ⇔ r =
  { alias_opt           if alias_opt ≠ ⊥
    FreshRegion(Γ)      otherwise } ∧ IntroAll(Γ, [⟨r, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState([`Region`], `Active`))⟩]) ⇓ Γ_r

labels: T-RegionStmt

RegionOptsExpr(opts_opt) = opts    Γ; R; L ⊢ opts ⇐ TypePath([`RegionOptions`]) ⊣ ∅    RegionBind(Γ, alias_opt) = Γ_r    Γ_r; R; L ⊢ b : T_b
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

BindRegionAlias(σ, ⊥, r) ⇓ σ
BindRegionAlias(σ, x, r) ⇓ σ' ⇔ BindVal(σ, x, RegionValue(`@Active`, r)) ⇓ (σ', b)

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.ExecSigma-Region
kind: formal-rule

labels: ExecSigma-Region
-->
**(ExecSigma-Region)**
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(opts, σ) ⇓ (Val(v_o), σ_1)    RegionNew(σ_1, v_o) ⇓ (σ_2, r, scope)    BindRegionAlias(σ_2, alias_opt, r) ⇓ σ_3    Γ ⊢ EvalInScopeSigma(b, σ_3, scope) ⇓ (out, σ_4)    RegionRelease(σ_4, r, scope, out) ⇓ (out', σ_5)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(RegionStmt(opts_opt, alias_opt, b), σ) ⇓ (StmtOutOf(out'), σ_5)

-->

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(RegionStmt(opts_opt, alias_opt, b), σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ_1)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.RegionRelease
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines region release by cleaning up scope, converting exit outcome, releasing the arena, and popping scope unless aborted.
labels: RegionRelease
-->
RegionRelease(Σ, r, scope, out) ⇓ (out', Σ') ⇔ Γ ⊢ CleanupScope(scope, Σ) ⇓ (c, Σ_1) ∧ out' = ExitOutcome(out, c) ∧ ((out' = Ctrl(Abort) ∧ Σ' = Σ_1) ∨ (out' ≠ Ctrl(Abort) ∧ ReleaseArena(Σ_1, r) ⇓ Σ_2 ∧ PopScope_σ(Σ_2) ⇓ (Σ', scope)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.InnermostActiveRegion
kind: formal-definition

summary: Defines lookup of the innermost active region in the typechecking scope stack.

InnermostActiveRegion([]) = ⊥
InnermostActiveRegion([σ] ++ Γ') =

    target_opt                  if target_opt ≠ ⊥ ∧ Γ; R; L ⊢ Identifier(target_opt) : T_r ∧ RegionActiveType(T_r) } ∧ F = FreshRegion(Γ) ∧ IntroAll(Γ, [⟨F, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState([`Region`], `Active`))⟩]) ⇓ Γ_f

strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines active and explicit frame target resolution from runtime region stack entries.
labels: ActiveTarget, ResolveTarget
-->
ActiveTarget(σ) = target ⇔ ActiveEntry(σ) = e ∧ RegionTargetOf(e) = target
ResolveTarget(σ, r) = target ⇔ ResolveEntry(RegionStack(σ), r) = e ∧ RegionTargetOf(e) = target
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.FrameEnter
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines frame entry by pushing a scope, creating a fresh frame tag and mark, and updating the region stack.
labels: FrameEnter
-->
FrameEnter(σ, r) ⇓ (σ', F, scope, mark) ⇔ PushScope_σ(σ) ⇓ (σ_1, scope) ∧ F = FreshTag(σ) ∧ mark = FrameMark(σ_1, r) ∧ UpdateRegionStack(σ_1, ⟨F, r, scope, mark⟩ :: RegionStack(σ_1)) = σ'
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.ExecSigma-Frame-Implicit
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Executes implicit frame statements by resolving the active target, entering a frame, evaluating the body, and resetting the frame.
labels: ExecSigma-Frame-Implicit
-->
**(ExecSigma-Frame-Implicit)**
ActiveTarget(σ) = r    FrameEnter(σ, r) ⇓ (σ_1, F, scope, mark)    Γ ⊢ EvalInScopeSigma(b, σ_1, scope) ⇓ (out, σ_2)    FrameReset(σ_2, r, scope, mark, out) ⇓ (out', σ_3)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(FrameStmt(⊥, b), σ) ⇓ (StmtOutOf(out'), σ_3)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.18.ExecSigma-Frame-Explicit
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Executes explicit frame statements by resolving the target handle, entering a frame, evaluating the body, and resetting the frame.
labels: ExecSigma-Frame-Explicit
-->
**(ExecSigma-Frame-Explicit)**
LookupVal(σ, r) = v_r    RegionHandleOf(v_r) = h    ResolveTarget(σ, h) = r_t    FrameEnter(σ, r_t) ⇓ (σ_1, F, scope, mark)    Γ ⊢ EvalInScopeSigma(b, σ_1, scope) ⇓ (out, σ_2)    FrameReset(σ_2, r_t, scope, mark, out) ⇓ (out', σ_3)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(FrameStmt(r, b), σ) ⇓ (StmtOutOf(out'), σ_3)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.18.FrameReset
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.statements
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines frame reset by cleaning up frame scope, converting exit outcome, resetting the arena to the frame mark, and popping scope unless aborted.
labels: FrameReset
-->
FrameReset(Σ, r, scope, mark, out) ⇓ (out', Σ') ⇔ Γ ⊢ CleanupScope(scope, Σ) ⇓ (c, Σ_1) ∧ out' = ExitOutcome(out, c) ∧ ((out' = Ctrl(Abort) ∧ Σ' = Σ_1) ∨ (out' ≠ Ctrl(Abort) ∧ ResetArena(Σ_1, r, scope, mark) ⇓ Σ_2 ∧ PopScope_σ(Σ_2) ⇓ (Σ', scope)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

### 18.9 Control-Transfer Statements

#### 18.9.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

#### 18.9.4 Static Semantics

ReturnDestExpr(e) =
  { CopyExpr(CopyInner(e))    if IsCopyExpr(e)
    MoveExpr(e)               if IsPlace(e)
    e                         otherwise }

`ReturnDestExpr` is the static ownership-destination view of a return expression. `EvalReturnDest` and `LowerReturnDest` implement the same view dynamically and in IR: a returned owned place transfers its provenance/allocation domain to the return destination, a fresh expression materializes directly in that destination, and `copy` first creates a duplicate domain that becomes the returned owner.
