#### 20.6.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.20.CancelTokenForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines CancelToken state, payload, cancellation judgment families, cancellation status, state, and map.
labels: CancelToken, CancelJudg, CancelJudg_chi, CancelStatus, CancelState, CancelMap
-->
States(`CancelToken`) = { `@Active` }

Payload(`CancelToken`, `@Active`) = [⟨`id`, TypePrim("usize")⟩]

CancelJudg = {CancelNew() ⇓ v, CancelChild(v) ⇓ v', CancelIsCancelled(v) ⇓ b, CancelDoCancel(v) ⇓ ok, CancelWaitCancelled(v) ⇓ a}

CancelJudg_χ = {CancelNew(χ) ⇓ (v, χ'), CancelChild(v, χ) ⇓ (v', χ'), CancelIsCancelled(v, χ) ⇓ b, CancelDoCancel(v, χ) ⇓ χ', CancelWaitCancelled(v, χ) ⇓ a}

CancelStatus = {Active, Cancelled}

CancelState = ⟨parent, status⟩

CancelMap = ℕ ⇀ CancelState
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 20.6.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.20.CancelTokenStaticSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines CancelToken as a built-in modal type and specifies the types of new, child, cancel, is_cancelled, and wait_cancelled surfaces.
labels: CancelToken, CancelToken::new, child, cancel, is_cancelled, wait_cancelled, Async
-->
`CancelToken` is a built-in modal type.

`CancelToken::new` returns `CancelToken@Active`.

`CancelToken@Active::child()` returns a descendant `CancelToken@Active`.

`CancelToken@Active::cancel()` returns `()`.

`CancelToken@Active::is_cancelled()` returns `bool`.

`CancelToken@Active::wait_cancelled()` returns an `Async` value whose eventual completion indicates cancellation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 20.6.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.20.CancelTokenParallelAvailability
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires a cancel token attached to a parallel block to be implicitly available within enclosed spawn and dispatch bodies.
labels: cancel-token-parallel-availability
-->
When a cancel token is attached to a parallel block via the `cancel` option, the token is implicitly available within all enclosed `spawn` and `dispatch` bodies.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.20.CancelRuntimeHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines cancellation status, parent lookup, descendants, fresh identifiers, token values, and token id extraction.
labels: CancelStatusOf, CancelParentOf, Descendant, FreshCancelId, CancelVal, CancelId
-->
CancelStatusOf(χ, id) = s ⇔ χ[id] = ⟨_, s⟩

CancelParentOf(χ, id) = p ⇔ χ[id] = ⟨p, _⟩

Descendant(χ, a, b) ⇔ (a = b) ∨ (∃ p. CancelParentOf(χ, b) = p ∧ Descendant(χ, a, p))

FreshCancelId(χ) = n ⇔ n ∉ dom(χ) ∧ ∀ m < n. m ∈ dom(χ)

CancelVal(n) = RecordValue(ModalStateRef(["CancelToken"], `@Active`), [⟨`id`, IntVal("usize", n)⟩])

CancelId(v) = n ⇔ v = RecordValue(ModalStateRef(["CancelToken"], `@Active`), io) ∧ FieldValue(v, `id`) = IntVal("usize", n)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Cancel-New
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Creates a fresh root active cancel token.
labels: Cancel-New
-->
**(Cancel-New)**
FreshCancelId(χ) = n    χ' = χ[n ↦ ⟨⊥, Active⟩]
──────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelNew(χ) ⇓ (CancelVal(n), χ')
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Cancel-Child
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Creates a fresh active child cancel token with the given token as parent.
labels: Cancel-Child
-->
**(Cancel-Child)**
CancelId(v) = p    FreshCancelId(χ) = n    χ' = χ[n ↦ ⟨p, Active⟩]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelChild(v, χ) ⇓ (CancelVal(n), χ')
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Cancel-IsCancelled
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates is_cancelled by comparing the token status to Cancelled.
labels: Cancel-IsCancelled
-->
**(Cancel-IsCancelled)**
CancelId(v) = n    CancelStatusOf(χ, n) = s    b = (s = Cancelled)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelIsCancelled(v, χ) ⇓ b
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Cancel-DoCancel
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Cancels a token and every descendant token.
labels: Cancel-DoCancel
-->
**(Cancel-DoCancel)**
CancelId(v) = n    χ' = χ[ k ↦ ⟨CancelParentOf(χ, k), Cancelled⟩ | k ∈ dom(χ) ∧ Descendant(χ, n, k) ]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelDoCancel(v, χ) ⇓ χ'
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Cancel-WaitCancelled-Completed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates wait_cancelled on a cancelled token to a completed Async carrying unit.
labels: Cancel-WaitCancelled-Completed
-->
**(Cancel-WaitCancelled-Completed)**
CancelId(v) = n    CancelStatusOf(χ, n) = Cancelled
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelWaitCancelled(v, χ) ⇓ RecordValue(ModalStateRef(["Async"], `@Completed`), [⟨`value`, UnitVal⟩])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Cancel-WaitCancelled-Suspended
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates wait_cancelled on an active token to a suspended Async carrying unit output.
labels: Cancel-WaitCancelled-Suspended
-->
**(Cancel-WaitCancelled-Suspended)**
CancelId(v) = n    CancelStatusOf(χ, n) = Active
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelWaitCancelled(v, χ) ⇓ RecordValue(ModalStateRef(["Async"], `@Suspended`), [⟨`output`, UnitVal⟩])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.20.CooperativeCancellationBehavior
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines cooperative cancellation behavior for work that checks, ignores, is queued but not started, or is mid-execution.
labels: cooperative-cancellation
-->
Cancellation is cooperative:

| Scenario                       | Behavior                                             |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Work checks and returns early  | Iteration completes immediately                      |
| Work ignores cancellation      | Iteration runs to completion                         |
| Work is queued but not started | MUST be dequeued, marked cancelled, and not executed |
| Work is mid-execution          | Continues until next check point                     |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.20.ParallelWorkItemPanicSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines panic capture, continued work or cancellation request, and block-boundary propagation for work item panics.
labels: parallel-work-item-panic
-->
When a work item panics within a parallel block:

1. The panic is captured.
2. Other work items continue to completion, or cancellation is requested if a cancel token is attached.
3. After all started work settles, a panic is propagated at the block boundary.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.EvalSigma-Parallel-Spawn-Panic
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Propagates panic from a parallel block after awaiting spawned work when a spawned handle failed.
labels: EvalSigma-Parallel-Spawn-Panic
-->
**(EvalSigma-Parallel-Spawn-Panic)**
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(D, σ) ⇓ (Val(d), σ_1)    ParallelInit(d, opts) ⇓ pstate_0    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(B, σ_1[parallel_context ↦ pstate_0]) ⇓ (out_body, σ_2)    LookupVal(σ_2, parallel_context) = pstate_n    AwaitSpawned(pstate_n, σ_2) ⇓ (panic_opt, σ_3)    panic_opt ≠ ⊥
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(ParallelExpr(D, opts, B), σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(Panic), σ_3)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.20.ParallelPanicCancellationRequest
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires attached cancel tokens to be cancelled exactly once on first captured panic and forbids panic-only cancellation without a token.
labels: parallel-panic-cancellation-request
-->
If a cancel token is attached to the parallel block, the runtime MUST request cancellation on the first captured panic, exactly once. If no cancel token is attached, panic alone MUST NOT request cancellation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.20.FirstCompletedFailure
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines first completed failure as the failed handle with least CompletionSeq.
labels: FirstCompletedFailure, CompletionSeq
-->
FirstCompletedFailure(pstate, σ) = panic_opt ⇔ panic_opt is the failure whose `CompletionSeq` is least among failed handles in `pstate.Handles`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

-->
Dispatch is deterministic when:

1. Key patterns produce identical partitioning across runs.
2. Iterations with the same key execute in index order.
3. Reduction uses deterministic tree combination.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

-->

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 20.8.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.20.NestedParallelRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines runtime nesting rules for inner CPU parallel blocks, heterogeneous CPU/GPU nesting, independent capture rules, and allocation from heap or region within work items.
labels: nested-parallel-runtime
-->
Inner CPU parallel blocks share the worker pool with outer CPU parallel blocks.

CPU and GPU blocks MAY be nested heterogeneously.

Capture rules apply independently at each nesting level.

Work items MAY capture `ctx.heap` and invoke allocation methods.

Work items executing within a `region` block MAY allocate from that region using `^`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.20.ParallelDeterministicOrdering
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines task identifiers, completion sequence identifiers, CPU queue order, dispatch group order, inline execution, abstract GPU work-item order, and ordered dispatch side-effect commit order.
labels: TaskId, CompletionSeq, cpu-queue-order, dispatch-group-order, inline-domain-order, gpu-work-item-order, ordered-dispatch-commit
-->
TaskId(w) = n assigns each created work item a stable creation identifier.
CompletionSeq(w) = n assigns each settled work item a global monotonically increasing completion identifier.

Within each CPU domain queue, ready work items are dequeued in ascending `TaskId`.

Dispatch groups are scheduled in ascending order of their least iteration index.

The inline domain executes work immediately at creation.

GPU work-items execute in lexicographic order of `(workgroup_id, local_id)` for abstract semantics.

Ordered dispatch buffers side effects within each group and commits them in ascending iteration order after group completion.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 20.8.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Lower-Deterministic-Dispatch
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires ordered dispatch lowering to emit buffer and commit IR around group bodies and commit buffered side effects in ascending iteration order.
labels: Lower-Deterministic-Dispatch
-->
**(Lower-Deterministic-Dispatch)**
Ordered ∈ opts
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Dispatch lowering MUST emit OrderedDispatchBufferIR before the group body and OrderedDispatchCommitIR after the group body, committing buffered side effects in ascending iteration order.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.20.Lower-Nested-Parallel
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.structured-parallelism
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires nested CPU parallel lowering to reuse the enclosing pool handle and nested GPU-in-GPU lowering to emit no IR because it is ill-formed.
labels: Lower-Nested-Parallel, E-CON-0152
-->
**(Lower-Nested-Parallel)**
Nested CPU parallel lowering reuses the enclosing pool handle. Nested GPU-in-GPU lowering is ill-formed and therefore emits no IR.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

## 21. Asynchronous Operations

### 21.1 Async Type

#### 21.1.1 Syntax

The following built-in async type constructors and aliases are reserved:

- `Async<Out, In, Result, E>`
- `Sequence<T>`
- `Future<T, E>`
- `Stream<T, E>`
- `Pipe<In, Out>`
- `Exchange<T>`

#### 21.1.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: parse.21.AsyncTypes
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage

labels: Async, Sequence, Future, Stream, Pipe, Exchange, Async@Suspended, Async@Completed, Async@Failed
-->
`Async`, `Sequence`, `Future`, `Stream`, `Pipe`, and `Exchange` use ordinary path and type-application parsing.

`Async@Suspended`, `Async@Completed`, and `Async@Failed` use ordinary modal-state type parsing.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

labels: TypePath, Async
-->
`TypePath(["Async"])` MAY be parsed by the general type parser; rejection of unapplied `Async` is a static-semantic rule of this section.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.1.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.AsyncModalDeclaration
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the built-in Async modal declaration, states, parameters, state payloads, members, and modal declaration form.
labels: Async, AsyncParams, AsyncRef, AsyncSuspendedFields, AsyncCompletedFields, AsyncFailedFields, AsyncStates, AsyncDecl
-->
`Async` is a built-in modal declaration:

```text
States(`Async`) = { `@Suspended`, `@Completed`, `@Failed` }

AsyncParams = [
  ⟨`Out`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩,
  ⟨`In`, [], TypePrim("()"), ⊥⟩,
  ⟨`Result`, [], TypePrim("()"), ⊥⟩,
  ⟨`E`, [], TypePrim("!"), ⊥⟩
]

AsyncRef = TypeApply(["Async"], [TypePath(["Out"]), TypePath(["In"]), TypePath(["Result"]), TypePath(["E"])])

AsyncSuspendedFields = [⟨`output`, TypePath(["Out"])⟩]
AsyncCompletedFields = [⟨`value`, TypePath(["Result"])⟩]
AsyncFailedFields = [⟨`error`, TypePath(["E"])⟩]

Payload(`Async`, `@Suspended`) = AsyncSuspendedFields
Payload(`Async`, `@Completed`) = AsyncCompletedFields
Payload(`Async`, `@Failed`) = AsyncFailedFields

AsyncSuspendedMembers = [
  StateFieldDecl(⊥, `public`, false, `output`, TypePath(["Out"]), ⊥, ⊥),
  StateMethodDecl(
    ⊥,
    `public`,
    "resume",
    ⊥,
    ReceiverShorthand(`unique`),
    [⟨⊥, `input`, TypePath(["In"])⟩],
    TypeUnion([
      TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState(AsyncRef, `@Suspended`)),
      TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState(AsyncRef, `@Completed`)),
      TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState(AsyncRef, `@Failed`))
    ]),
    ⊥,
    ⊥,
    ⊥,
    ⊥
  )
]

AsyncCompletedMembers = [
  StateFieldDecl(⊥, `public`, false, `value`, TypePath(["Result"]), ⊥, ⊥)
]

AsyncFailedMembers = [
  StateFieldDecl(⊥, `public`, false, `error`, TypePath(["E"]), ⊥, ⊥)
]

AsyncStates = [
  StateBlock(`@Suspended`, AsyncSuspendedMembers, ⊥, ⊥),
  StateBlock(`@Completed`, AsyncCompletedMembers, ⊥, ⊥),
  StateBlock(`@Failed`, AsyncFailedMembers, ⊥, ⊥)
]

AsyncDecl = ModalDecl(⊥, `public`, `Async`, AsyncParams, ⊥, [], AsyncStates, ⊥, ⊥, ⊥)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.AsyncAliases
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the built-in async aliases Sequence, Future, Stream, Pipe, and Exchange.
labels: SequenceDecl, FutureDecl, StreamDecl, PipeDecl, ExchangeDecl
-->
The following built-in aliases are defined:

```text
SequenceDecl = TypeAliasDecl(⊥, `public`, `Sequence`, [⟨`T`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩], ⊥, TypeApply(["Async"], [TypePath(["T"]), TypePrim("()"), TypePrim("()"), TypePrim("!")]), ⊥, ⊥)
FutureDecl = TypeAliasDecl(⊥, `public`, `Future`, [⟨`T`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩, ⟨`E`, [], TypePrim("!"), ⊥⟩], ⊥, TypeApply(["Async"], [TypePrim("()"), TypePrim("()"), TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["E"])]), ⊥, ⊥)
StreamDecl = TypeAliasDecl(⊥, `public`, `Stream`, [⟨`T`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩, ⟨`E`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩], ⊥, TypeApply(["Async"], [TypePath(["T"]), TypePrim("()"), TypePrim("()"), TypePath(["E"])]), ⊥, ⊥)
PipeDecl = TypeAliasDecl(⊥, `public`, `Pipe`, [⟨`In`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩, ⟨`Out`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩], ⊥, TypeApply(["Async"], [TypePath(["Out"]), TypePath(["In"]), TypePrim("()"), TypePrim("!")]), ⊥, ⊥)
ExchangeDecl = TypeAliasDecl(⊥, `public`, `Exchange`, [⟨`T`, [], ⊥, ⊥⟩], ⊥, TypeApply(["Async"], [TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["T"]), TypePath(["T"]), TypePrim("!")]), ⊥, ⊥)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.AsyncCombinatorMembers
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines built-in async combinator names and their general modal member predicate.
labels: AsyncCombinatorNames, BuiltinModalGeneralMember, map, filter, take, fold, chain
-->
The built-in async combinator member set is:

```text
AsyncCombinatorNames = {`map`, `filter`, `take`, `fold`, `chain`}
BuiltinModalGeneralMember(modal_ref, name) ⇔ ModalRefPath(modal_ref) = ["Async"] ∧ name ∈ AsyncCombinatorNames
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.1.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncSigAndBodyReturnType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async alias normalization, async signature extraction with defaults, and async body return type projection.
labels: AsyncSig, AliasNorm, DefaultArgs, BodyReturnType
-->
Alias normalization over built-in async aliases is defined by:

```text
AsyncSig(T) = ⟨Out, In, Result, E⟩ ⇔
  AliasNorm(T) = TypeApply(["Async"], args) ∧
  DefaultArgs(AsyncParams, args) = [Out, In, Result, E]

AsyncSig(T) = ⊥    otherwise

BodyReturnType(R) =
  { Result    if AsyncSig(R) = ⟨Out, In, Result, E⟩
    R         otherwise }
```

An async creation expression may be checked against
`TypePerm(p, TypeModalState(TypeApply(["Async"], args), state))` when `p` is
supplied by the expected type and the ordinary permission rules allow introducing a
fresh value at that permission. Manual `resume` consumes a `unique` suspended async
receiver and returns a `unique` async state value.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`Async` subtyping is:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Sub-Async
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines Async subtyping covariance in Out, Result, and E and contravariance in In.
labels: Sub-Async
-->
**(Sub-Async)**
```text
AsyncSig(T) = ⟨Out_1, In_1, Result_1, E_1⟩    AsyncSig(U) = ⟨Out_2, In_2, Result_2, E_2⟩
Γ ⊢ Out_1 <: Out_2    Γ ⊢ In_2 <: In_1    Γ ⊢ Result_1 <: Result_2    Γ ⊢ E_1 <: E_2
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ T <: U
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

```text
Γ ⊢ T wf
```

#### 21.1.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncTypeLoweringForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async type lowering judgment, lowered state sets, and resume result types.
labels: AsyncTypeLowerJudg, LowerAsyncType, AsyncLoweredStates, AsyncResumeType
-->
AsyncTypeLowerJudg = {LowerAsyncType}

```text
AsyncLoweredStates(⟨Out, In, Result, TypePrim("!")⟩) = [`@Suspended`, `@Completed`]
AsyncLoweredStates(⟨Out, In, Result, E⟩) = [`@Suspended`, `@Completed`, `@Failed`]    if E ≠ TypePrim("!")

AsyncResumeType(⟨Out, In, Result, TypePrim("!")⟩) =
  TypeUnion([
    TypeModalState(TypeApply(["Async"], [Out, In, Result, TypePrim("!")]), `@Suspended`),
    TypeModalState(TypeApply(["Async"], [Out, In, Result, TypePrim("!")]), `@Completed`)
  ])

AsyncResumeType(⟨Out, In, Result, E⟩) =
  TypeUnion([
    TypeModalState(TypeApply(["Async"], [Out, In, Result, E]), `@Suspended`),
    TypeModalState(TypeApply(["Async"], [Out, In, Result, E]), `@Completed`),
    TypeModalState(TypeApply(["Async"], [Out, In, Result, E]), `@Failed`)
  ])    if E ≠ TypePrim("!")
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncNeverErrorLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires lowering to omit concrete Async failed-state layout and resume-result tag space when the error type is never.
labels: Async@Failed, never
-->
When `E = !`, lowering MUST omit the `@Failed` state from concrete storage layouts and from the concrete resume-result tag space. The semantic state `@Failed` remains uninhabited and lowering MUST emit no failed-state variant.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Lower-Async-Type
kind: formal-rule

summary: Lowers async types to async state tag IR and async resume signature IR.
labels: Lower-Async-Type
-->
**(Lower-Async-Type)**
```text
AsyncSig(T) = ⟨Out, In, Result, E⟩    sig = ⟨Out, In, Result, E⟩    states = AsyncLoweredStates(sig)    resume_ty = AsyncResumeType(sig)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerAsyncType(T) ⇓ ⟨AsyncStateTagIR(states), AsyncResumeSigIR(In, resume_ty)⟩
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 21.2 Suspension Forms

#### 21.2.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.21.SuspensionForms
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines wait, yield, and yield from expression grammar.
labels: wait_expr, yield_expr, yield_from_expr
-->
```ebnf
wait_expr       ::= "wait" expression
yield_expr      ::= "yield" "release"? expression
yield_from_expr ::= "yield" "release"? "from" expression
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.2.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: parse.21.SuspensionFormsPrimaryExpressions
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires wait, yield, and yield from to parse as primary expressions.
labels: wait, yield, yield-from
-->
`wait`, `yield`, and `yield from` are primary expressions.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`wait` is parsed by:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-Wait-Expr
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses wait primary expressions from the wait identifier followed by an expression.
labels: Parse-Wait-Expr
-->
**(Parse-Wait-Expr)**
```text
IsIdent(Tok(P))    Lexeme(Tok(P)) = `wait`    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, handle)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_1, WaitExpr(handle))
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`yield from` is parsed by:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-Yield-From-Expr
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses yield from primary expressions, including optional release.
labels: Parse-Yield-From-Expr
-->
**(Parse-Yield-From-Expr)**
```text
IsKw(Tok(P), `yield`)    P_1 = Advance(P)
(IsIdent(Tok(P_1)) ∧ Lexeme(Tok(P_1)) = `release` ⇒ release_opt = Release ∧ P_2 = Advance(P_1))
(¬(IsIdent(Tok(P_1)) ∧ Lexeme(Tok(P_1)) = `release`) ⇒ release_opt = ⊥ ∧ P_2 = P_1)
IsKw(Tok(P_2), `from`)    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(Advance(P_2)) ⇓ (P_3, e)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_3, YieldFromExpr(release_opt, e))
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`yield` is parsed by:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-Yield-Expr
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses yield primary expressions, including optional release and excluding yield from.
labels: Parse-Yield-Expr
-->
**(Parse-Yield-Expr)**
```text
IsKw(Tok(P), `yield`)    P_1 = Advance(P)
(IsIdent(Tok(P_1)) ∧ Lexeme(Tok(P_1)) = `release` ⇒ release_opt = Release ∧ P_2 = Advance(P_1))
(¬(IsIdent(Tok(P_1)) ∧ Lexeme(Tok(P_1)) = `release`) ⇒ release_opt = ⊥ ∧ P_2 = P_1)
¬ IsKw(Tok(P_2), `from`)    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, e)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_3, YieldExpr(release_opt, e))
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.2.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.SuspensionForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast

applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines yield release option and AST expression forms for wait, yield, and yield from.

```text
YieldReleaseOpt ∈ {⊥} ∪ {Release}

Expr includes:

  YieldFromExpr(release_opt, expr)
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.SuspensionFormResolution
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires name resolution to preserve wait, yield, and yield from expression forms.
labels: ResolveExpr, WaitExpr, YieldExpr, YieldFromExpr
-->
Name resolution preserves these forms:

```text
Γ ⊢ ResolveExpr(WaitExpr(handle)) ⇓ WaitExpr(handle')
Γ ⊢ ResolveExpr(YieldExpr(release_opt, e)) ⇓ YieldExpr(release_opt, e')
Γ ⊢ ResolveExpr(YieldFromExpr(release_opt, e)) ⇓ YieldFromExpr(release_opt, e')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.SuspensionFormEvaluationOrder
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines left-to-right child evaluation order for wait, yield, and yield from expressions.
labels: Children_LTR, WaitExpr, YieldExpr, YieldFromExpr
-->
Evaluation order is:

```text
Children_LTR(WaitExpr(handle)) = [handle]
Children_LTR(YieldExpr(release_opt, e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(YieldFromExpr(release_opt, e)) = [e]
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.2.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.WaitRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines wait evaluation over Spawned and Tracked handles, including ready retrieval, blocking pending handles, and Spawned panic handling through parallel panic propagation.
labels: wait, Spawned, Tracked
-->
`wait` retrieves results from `Spawned<T>` and `Tracked<T, E>` handles.

`wait` evaluation is:

1. Evaluate `h`.
2. If the handle is ready, return its settled value.
3. If the handle is pending, block the current task until the handle settles.
4. If a `Spawned<T>` handle settles by panic, that failure is consumed by the enclosing `parallel` panic propagation defined by §20.7.5.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal `wait` rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.WaitRuntimeHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines spawn and tracked handle states and blocking until handles settle.
labels: SpawnHandleState, TrackedHandleState, BlockUntilSettledSpawned, BlockUntilSettledTracked
-->
```text
SpawnHandleState(SpawnedVal(@Ready { value }, _)) = Ready(value)
SpawnHandleState(SpawnedVal(@Pending, _)) = Pending
TrackedHandleState(TrackedVal(@Ready { value }, _)) = Ready(value)
TrackedHandleState(TrackedVal(@Pending, _)) = Pending

BlockUntilSettledSpawned(handle, σ) ⇓ (handle', σ') ⇔
  σ' extends σ by abstract scheduler progress until SpawnHandleState(handle') ∈ {Ready(_), Failed(_)}

BlockUntilSettledTracked(handle, σ) ⇓ (handle', σ') ⇔
  σ' extends σ by abstract scheduler progress until TrackedHandleState(handle') = Ready(_)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Wait-Spawned-Ready
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates wait on a ready Spawned handle to its ready value.
labels: EvalSigma-Wait-Spawned-Ready
-->
**(EvalSigma-Wait-Spawned-Ready)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(h, σ) ⇓ (Val(handle), σ_1)    SpawnHandleState(handle) = Ready(v)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(WaitExpr(h), σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Wait-Spawned-Pending
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates wait on a pending Spawned handle by blocking until it settles ready and returning the value.
labels: EvalSigma-Wait-Spawned-Pending
-->
**(EvalSigma-Wait-Spawned-Pending)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(h, σ) ⇓ (Val(handle), σ_1)    SpawnHandleState(handle) = Pending
BlockUntilSettledSpawned(handle, σ_1) ⇓ (handle', σ_2)    SpawnHandleState(handle') = Ready(v)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(WaitExpr(h), σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.FailedSpawnedWaitHandledByParallelPanic
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, compiler.parallelism, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires failed Spawned settlement not to be independently observed by wait and instead be consumed by parallel panic propagation.
labels: Spawned, AwaitSpawned, parallel-panic-propagation
-->
Failed `Spawned<T>` settlement is not independently observed by `wait`; it is consumed by the enclosing `AwaitSpawned(...)` / §20.7.5 parallel panic propagation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Wait-Tracked-Ready
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates wait on a ready Tracked handle to its ready value.
labels: EvalSigma-Wait-Tracked-Ready
-->
**(EvalSigma-Wait-Tracked-Ready)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(h, σ) ⇓ (Val(handle), σ_1)    TrackedHandleState(handle) = Ready(v)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(WaitExpr(h), σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Wait-Tracked-Pending
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates wait on a pending Tracked handle by blocking until it settles ready and returning the value.
labels: EvalSigma-Wait-Tracked-Pending
-->
**(EvalSigma-Wait-Tracked-Pending)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(h, σ) ⇓ (Val(handle), σ_1)    TrackedHandleState(handle) = Pending
BlockUntilSettledTracked(handle, σ_1) ⇓ (handle', σ_2)    TrackedHandleState(handle') = Ready(v)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(WaitExpr(h), σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Wait-Ctrl
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Propagates control produced while evaluating a wait handle expression.
labels: EvalSigma-Wait-Ctrl
-->
**(EvalSigma-Wait-Ctrl)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(h, σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ_1)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(WaitExpr(h), σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.YieldRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines yield suspension, optional key release, suspended state construction, key reacquisition, resume input binding, and continuation.
labels: yield, yield-release, Async@Suspended
-->
`yield` suspends the current async computation:

1. Evaluate `e` to `v`.
2. If `release_opt = Release`, release all held keys and record the key set.
3. Transition to `Async@Suspended { output = v }`.
4. On resumption with input `i`, reacquire any recorded keys in canonical order under Chapter 19, bind `i` as the value of the suspended `yield` expression, and continue.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Resumption helpers are:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.ResumptionHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, compiler.key-system, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines resumption points, held-key release/reacquisition, resumption-point restoration, and key context projection.
labels: ResumptionPoint, ReleaseKeys, ReacquireKeys, RestoreResumptionPoint, Gamma_keys
-->
```text
ResumptionPoint = ⟨scope_stack, region_stack, continuation⟩

ReleaseKeys(σ, keys) ⇓ σ' ⇔
  rev = CanonicalOrder(keys) ∧
  ∀ k ∈ Reverse(rev). ReleaseLock(σ, k) ∧
  σ' = σ[held_keys := σ.held_keys ∖ keys]

ReacquireKeys(σ, keys) ⇓ σ' ⇔
  sorted = CanonicalOrder(keys) ∧
  ∀ k ∈ sorted. AcquireLock(σ, k, ModeOf(k)) ∧
  σ' = σ[held_keys := σ.held_keys ∪ keys]

RestoreResumptionPoint(rp) ⇓ σ ⇔
  rp = ⟨scope_stack, region_stack, continuation⟩ ∧
  σ.scope_stack = scope_stack ∧
  σ.region_stack = region_stack ∧
  σ.continuation = continuation

Γ_keys(σ) = σ.held_keys
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal `yield` rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Yield
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates non-release yield with no held keys to a suspended async state.
labels: EvalSigma-Yield
-->
**(EvalSigma-Yield)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)    release_opt = ⊥    Γ_keys(σ_1) = ∅
async_state = AsyncSuspended(v, σ_1.resumption_point)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(YieldExpr(release_opt, e), σ) ⇓ (Suspend(async_state), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Yield-Release
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, compiler.key-system, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates release yield by releasing held keys, recording them, and suspending.
labels: EvalSigma-Yield-Release
-->
**(EvalSigma-Yield-Release)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)    release_opt = Release    held = Γ_keys(σ_1)    ReleaseKeys(σ_1, held) ⇓ σ_2
async_state = AsyncSuspended(v, σ_2.resumption_point, held)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(YieldExpr(release_opt, e), σ) ⇓ (Suspend(async_state), σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Yield-Resume
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, compiler.key-system, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes a suspended yield by restoring the resumption point, reacquiring recorded keys when present, and producing the resume input value.
labels: EvalSigma-Yield-Resume
-->
**(EvalSigma-Yield-Resume)**
```text
async_state = AsyncSuspended(_, rp, held_opt)    input = i    RestoreResumptionPoint(rp) ⇓ σ_0
σ_1 = (held_opt ≠ ⊥ ∧ ReacquireKeys(σ_0, held_opt) ⇓ σ_1' → σ_1' | σ_0)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(async_state, i), σ) ⇓ (Val(i), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.YieldFromRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines yield from delegation over suspended, completed, and failed inner async states.
labels: yield-from, Async@Suspended, Async@Completed, Async@Failed
-->
`yield from` delegates suspension and completion to another async value:

1. Evaluate the source async value.
2. If it is suspended, re-emit its output through the enclosing async, preserving `release_opt`.
3. If it is completed, produce the completed value.
4. If it is failed, propagate the failure.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal `yield from` rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Suspended
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates yield from of a suspended source by yielding its output through the outer async and recording the inner async.
labels: EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Suspended
-->
**(EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Suspended)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(source, σ) ⇓ (Val(s), σ_1)    ModalState(s) = @Suspended    s.output = v
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(YieldExpr(release_opt, v), σ_1) ⇓ (Suspend(outer_state), σ_2)
outer_state' = outer_state[inner_async ↦ s]
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(YieldFromExpr(release_opt, source), σ) ⇓ (Suspend(outer_state'), σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Completed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates yield from of a completed source to the completed value.
labels: EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Completed
-->
**(EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Completed)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(source, σ) ⇓ (Val(s), σ_1)    ModalState(s) = @Completed    s.value = v
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(YieldFromExpr(release_opt, source), σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates yield from of a failed source by propagating the async error.
labels: EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Failed
-->
**(EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Failed)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(source, σ) ⇓ (Val(s), σ_1)    ModalState(s) = @Failed    s.error = e
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(YieldFromExpr(release_opt, source), σ) ⇓ (Propagate(e), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Resume
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes an outer yield from by resuming the recorded inner async and continuing yield from evaluation.
labels: EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Resume
-->
**(EvalSigma-YieldFrom-Resume)**
```text
outer_state.inner_async = s    input = i    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(s, i), σ) ⇓ (Val(s'), σ_1)
Γ ⊢ EvalYieldFromContinue(release_opt, s', σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(outer_state, i), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-definition

```text
EvalYieldFromContinue : ReleaseOpt × AsyncValue × State → EvalOut × State
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

**(EvalYieldFromContinue-Suspended)**

```text
ModalState(s) = @Suspended    s.output = v

outer_state' = outer_state[inner_async ↦ s]
```

```text
ModalState(s) = @Completed    s.value = v

```

#### 21.2.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.SuspensionLoweringForms
kind: formal-definition

-->
SuspensionIR = {WaitIR, YieldIR, YieldFromEnterIR, YieldFromResumeIR, SnapshotHeldKeysIR, ReleaseHeldKeysIR, ReacquireHeldKeysIR}

```text
CurrentAsyncFrame(Γ) = f
CurrentGenPoint(Γ) = g
ResumeLabel(Γ, g) = L
WaitResult(v_h) = v_r    where v_r is the result value produced by WaitIR(v_h)

```

```text
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```text
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(YieldFromExpr(release_opt, source)) ⇓ ⟨SeqIR(IR_s, YieldFromEnterIR(f, g, release_opt, v_s)), YieldFromResumeIR(f, g)⟩
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.YieldFromEnterLoweringLoop
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires YieldFromEnterIR to lower delegation as a loop over suspended, completed, and failed inner async states.
labels: YieldFromEnterIR, Async@Suspended, Async@Completed, Async@Failed
-->
`YieldFromEnterIR` MUST lower delegation as a loop over the inner async state:
1. `@Suspended { output = v }` re-enters lowering through the `yield` path using the same `release_opt`,
2. `@Completed { value = v }` returns `v`,
3. `@Failed { error = e }` lowers as async error propagation.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 21.3 Composition Forms

#### 21.3.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncIterationSyntax
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires async iteration to use ordinary loop syntax and manual stepping to use modal-state inspection and method-call syntax.
labels: loop-in, manual-stepping
-->
`loop ... in ...` async iteration uses the ordinary loop syntax defined in Chapter 18.

Manual stepping uses ordinary modal-state inspection and method-call syntax.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.21.CompositionForms
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines sync, race, race arm, race handler, and all expression grammar.
labels: sync_expr, race_expr, race_arm, race_handler, all_expr
-->
```ebnf
sync_expr    ::= "sync" expression
race_expr    ::= "race" "{" race_arm ("," race_arm)* "}"
race_arm     ::= expression "->" "|" pattern "|" race_handler
race_handler ::= expression | "yield" expression
all_expr     ::= "all" "{" expression ("," expression)* "}"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncMethodCallSurfaces
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines source method-call surfaces for until and async combinators.
labels: until, map, filter, take, fold, chain
-->
This section defines the following method-call surfaces:

- `shared_value~>until(pred, action)`
- `a~>map(f)`
- `a~>filter(p)`
- `a~>take(n)`
- `a~>fold(init, f)`
- `a~>chain(f)`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.UntilMethodCallSurface
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires until to be a source-specified method-call surface on shared values with type and runtime behavior defined by composition semantics.
labels: until
-->
`until` is a source-specified method-call surface on `shared` values. Its type and runtime behavior are defined by this section's static and dynamic semantics.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`sync` is parsed by:

```text
IsKw(Tok(P), `sync`)    Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, e)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_1, SyncExpr(e))
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`race` is parsed by:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-Race-Expr
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing

labels: Parse-Race-Expr
-->
**(Parse-Race-Expr)**
```text
IsKw(Tok(P), `race`)    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P)), "{")    Γ ⊢ ParseRaceArms(Advance(Advance(P))) ⇓ (P_1, arms)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), "}")
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (Advance(P_1), RaceExpr(arms))
```

Race-arm parsing is:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-RaceArms-Cons
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a non-empty race arm list by parsing the first arm and tail.
labels: Parse-RaceArms-Cons
-->
**(Parse-RaceArms-Cons)**
```text
Γ ⊢ ParseRaceArm(P) ⇓ (P_1, a)    Γ ⊢ ParseRaceArmsTail(P_1, [a]) ⇓ (P_2, arms)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseRaceArms(P) ⇓ (P_2, arms)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-RaceArm
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required

labels: Parse-RaceArm
-->
**(Parse-RaceArm)**
```text
Γ ⊢ ParseExpr(P) ⇓ (P_1, e)    IsOp(Tok(P_1), "->")    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P_1)), "|")
Γ ⊢ ParsePattern(Advance(Advance(P_1))) ⇓ (P_2, pat)    IsPunc(Tok(P_2), "|")
Γ ⊢ ParseRaceHandler(Advance(P_2)) ⇓ (P_3, handler)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseRaceArm(P) ⇓ (P_3, ⟨e, pat, handler⟩)
```

```text
¬ IsPunc(Tok(P), ",")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(Parse-RaceArmsTail-TrailingComma)**
```text
IsPunc(Tok(P), ",")    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P)), "}")
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseRaceArmsTail(P, xs) ⇓ (Advance(P), xs)
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Parse-RaceArmsTail-Comma

```text
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

#### 21.3.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.CompositionForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines race handler, race arm, race arm list, sync expression, race expression, and all expression AST forms.
labels: RaceHandler, RaceReturn, RaceYield, RaceArm, RaceArms, SyncExpr, RaceExpr, AllExpr
-->
```text
RaceHandler = {RaceReturn(expr), RaceYield(expr)}
RaceArm = ⟨expr, pat, handler⟩    handler ∈ RaceHandler
RaceArms = [RaceArm]

Expr includes:
  SyncExpr(expr)
  RaceExpr(arms)
  AllExpr(exprs)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.AsyncIterationLoopForm
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async iteration as use of the existing loop iteration AST form.
labels: LoopIter
-->
Async iteration uses the existing loop form:

```text
LoopIter(pattern, type_opt, iter, inv_opt, body)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.CompositionMethodCallForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires manual stepping, until, and async combinators to use existing if-case, modal-state, and method-call AST forms with no dedicated nodes for until or combinators.
labels: IfCaseExpr, MethodCall, until, async-combinators
-->
Manual stepping, `until`, and async combinators use existing `IfCaseExpr`, modal-state forms, and `MethodCall`.

No dedicated AST nodes are introduced for `until` or for async combinators beyond ordinary method calls.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.CompositionResolution
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines resolution judgments and preservation of sync, race, all, race arm, and race handler forms.
labels: ResolveRaceJudg, ResolveRaceArm, ResolveRaceArms, ResolveRaceHandler, ResolveAllExprListJudg, ResolveAllExprList, ResolveExpr
-->
Resolution is:

```text
ResolveRaceJudg = {ResolveRaceArm, ResolveRaceArms, ResolveRaceHandler}
ResolveAllExprListJudg = {ResolveAllExprList}

Γ ⊢ ResolveRaceHandler(RaceReturn(e)) ⇓ RaceReturn(e')
Γ ⊢ ResolveRaceHandler(RaceYield(e)) ⇓ RaceYield(e')
Γ ⊢ ResolveRaceArm(⟨e, pat, handler⟩) ⇓ ⟨e', pat', handler'⟩
Γ ⊢ ResolveRaceArms([]) ⇓ []
Γ ⊢ ResolveRaceArms(a :: as) ⇓ a' :: as'
Γ ⊢ ResolveAllExprList([]) ⇓ []
Γ ⊢ ResolveAllExprList(e :: es) ⇓ e' :: es'
Γ ⊢ ResolveExpr(SyncExpr(e)) ⇓ SyncExpr(e')
Γ ⊢ ResolveExpr(RaceExpr(arms)) ⇓ RaceExpr(arms')
Γ ⊢ ResolveExpr(AllExpr(es)) ⇓ AllExpr(es')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.21.CompositionEvaluationOrder
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines race arm expression extraction and left-to-right child evaluation order for sync, race, and all.
labels: RaceArmExprs, Children_LTR, SyncExpr, RaceExpr, AllExpr
-->
Evaluation order is:

```text
RaceArmExprs([]) = []
RaceArmExprs(⟨e, _, _⟩ :: as) = [e] ++ RaceArmExprs(as)

Children_LTR(SyncExpr(e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(RaceExpr(arms)) = RaceArmExprs(arms)
Children_LTR(AllExpr(es)) = es
```

Async iteration over `loop pat in e { body }` is:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.T-Loop-Iter-Async
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required

applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Types async iteration over an async iterator with unit input and compatible error type.
labels: T-Loop-Iter-Async
-->

```text
AsyncSig(R) = ⟨Out_r, In_r, Result_r, E_r⟩    Γ; R; L ⊢ iter : T_iter    AsyncSig(T_iter) = ⟨Out_i, In_i, Result_i, E_i⟩    In_i = TypePrim("()")    Γ ⊢ E_i <: E_r
(ty_opt = ⊥ ⇒ T_p = Out_i)    (ty_opt = T_a ⇒ Γ ⊢ Out_i <: T_a ∧ T_p = T_a)
Γ ⊢ pat ⇐ T_p ⊣ B    Distinct(PatNames(pat))    LoopInvOk(inv_opt)

Γ_1; R; `loop` ⊢ BlockInfo(body) ⇓ ⟨T_b, Brk, BrkVoid⟩    LoopTypeFin(Brk, BrkVoid) = T_r
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ LoopIter(pat, ty_opt, iter, inv_opt, body) : T_r
```

`race` typing is:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.RaceMode
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines race mode from all-return handlers, all-yield handlers, or mixed invalid handlers.
labels: RaceMode, RaceReturn, RaceYield
-->
```text
RaceMode(arms) =
  { `return`    if ∀ arm ∈ arms. arm.handler = RaceReturn(_)
    `yield`     if ∀ arm ∈ arms. arm.handler = RaceYield(_)
    ⊥           otherwise }
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.T-Race
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Types return-mode race expressions as a union of common handler result type and operand errors.
labels: T-Race
-->

```text
n = |arms|    n ≥ 2    RaceMode(arms) = `return`
∀ i, arm_i = ⟨e_i, pat_i, RaceReturn(r_i)⟩    Γ; R; L ⊢ e_i : T_i    AsyncSig(T_i) = ⟨Out_i, In_i, Result_i, E_i⟩
Out_i = TypePrim("()")    In_i = TypePrim("()")    Γ ⊢ pat_i ⇐ Result_i ⊣ B_i    Distinct(PatNames(pat_i))
Γ_i = IntroAll(Γ, B_i)    Γ_i; R; L ⊢ r_i : T_i^r    AllEq_Γ([T_1^r, …, T_n^r])    T_r = T_1^r
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ RaceExpr(arms) : TypeUnion([T_r, E_1, …, E_n])
```

id: def.21.AsyncCombinatorTypes
kind: formal-definition

summary: Defines the source typing signatures for async combinators map, filter, take, fold, and chain.
labels: map, filter, take, fold, chain
-->
Async combinator typing is:

```text
map    : Async<Out, In, Result, E> × procedure(Out) -> U -> Async<U, In, Result, E>
filter : Async<T, (), (), E> × procedure(const T) -> bool -> Async<T, (), (), E>
take   : Async<T, (), (), E> × usize -> Async<T, (), (), E>
fold   : Async<T, (), (), E> × A × procedure(A, T) -> A -> Future<A, E>
chain  : Future<T, E> × procedure(T) -> Future<U, E> -> Future<U, E>
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncCombinatorMemberLookup
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires async combinator method calls to be derived through built-in modal member lookup on Async, including aliases normalized via AsyncSig, not ad hoc method-call exceptions.
labels: AsyncCombinatorNames, BuiltinModalGeneralMember, AsyncSig
-->
For `e~>name(args)`, if `StripPerm(ExprType(e)) = ModalRefType(modal_ref)` and `BuiltinModalGeneralMember(modal_ref, name)`, typing MUST be derived by the async combinator rules in this section.

A conforming implementation MUST resolve `AsyncCombinatorNames` through built-in modal member lookup on `Async` (including aliases normalized via `AsyncSig`) and MUST NOT treat these members as non-modal ad hoc method-call exceptions.
