**(T-Async-Fold)**
```text
Γ; R; L ⊢ a : TypeApply(["Async"], [T, TypePrim("()"), TypePrim("()"), E])    Γ; R; L ⊢ init : A    Γ; R; L ⊢ f : (A, T) -> A
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ a~>fold(init, f) : TypeApply(["Future"], [A, E])
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.T-Async-Chain
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Types async chain method calls over futures preserving the error type.
labels: T-Async-Chain
-->
**(T-Async-Chain)**
```text
Γ; R; L ⊢ a : TypeApply(["Future"], [T, E])    Γ; R; L ⊢ f : (T) -> TypeApply(["Future"], [U, E])
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; R; L ⊢ a~>chain(f) : TypeApply(["Future"], [U, E])
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.3.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncIterationRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async iteration runtime behavior over suspended, completed, and failed async states.
labels: async-iteration, LoopIter
-->
Async iteration over `loop pat in e { body }` is:

1. Evaluate `e` to `a`.
2. If `a` is `@Suspended { output }`, bind `output` to `pat`, execute `body`, and resume with `()`.
3. If `a` is `@Completed { value }`, terminate the loop.
4. If `a` is `@Failed { error }`, propagate the error from the enclosing async procedure.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.ManualSteppingRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines manual stepping as inspecting async modal state and invoking resume on suspended async values.
labels: manual-stepping, resume
-->
Manual stepping advances an async value by inspecting its modal state and invoking `~>resume(input)` on `@Suspended`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.SyncRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines sync evaluation by repeatedly resuming unit-output suspended async values, returning completed values, or returning failed error union values.
labels: sync, SyncExpr
-->
`sync` evaluation is:

1. Evaluate `e` to `a`.
2. While `a` is `@Suspended { output = () }`, set `a := a~>resume(())`.
3. If `a` is `@Completed { value }`, produce `value`.
4. If `a` is `@Failed { error }`, produce the union error value.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal `sync` rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.SyncStepSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the SyncStep relation signature.
labels: SyncStep
-->
```text
SyncStep : AsyncValue × State → AsyncValue × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.SyncStep-Suspended
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Steps a suspended unit-output async value by resuming it with unit input.
labels: SyncStep-Suspended
-->
**(SyncStep-Suspended)**
```text
ModalState(a) = @Suspended    a.output = ()    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(a, ()), σ) ⇓ (Val(a'), σ_1)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ SyncStep(a, σ) ⇓ (a', σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Sync-Suspended
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates sync of a suspended async by stepping and recursively evaluating sync on the stepped value.
labels: EvalSigma-Sync-Suspended
-->
**(EvalSigma-Sync-Suspended)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(a), σ_1)    ModalState(a) = @Suspended    Γ ⊢ SyncStep(a, σ_1) ⇓ (a', σ_2)
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(SyncExpr(a'), σ_2) ⇓ (out, σ_3)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(SyncExpr(e), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_3)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Sync-Completed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates sync of a completed async value to its completed value.
labels: EvalSigma-Sync-Completed
-->
**(EvalSigma-Sync-Completed)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(a), σ_1)    ModalState(a) = @Completed    a.value = v
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(SyncExpr(e), σ) ⇓ (Val(v), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Sync-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates sync of a failed async value to its error value.
labels: EvalSigma-Sync-Failed
-->
**(EvalSigma-Sync-Failed)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(a), σ_1)    ModalState(a) = @Failed    a.error = err
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(SyncExpr(e), σ) ⇓ (Val(err), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.RaceReturnRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines return-mode race evaluation by initiating arms concurrently, selecting completion or failure, cancelling remaining arms, and producing handler or error value.
labels: race-return
-->
`race` return-mode evaluation is:

1. Initiate all async expressions concurrently.
2. When any arm completes or fails, handle that arm.
3. Cancel all remaining arms.
4. Produce the selected handler result or propagated error value.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.RaceStreamingRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines streaming race evaluation over yielded arm outputs, completed arms, all-complete stream completion, and failure propagation with cancellation.
labels: race-streaming
-->
`race` streaming-mode evaluation is:

1. Initiate all async expressions concurrently.
2. When an arm yields, execute the corresponding handler and emit its value as the next stream output.
3. When an arm completes, remove it from the race.
4. When all arms complete, the stream completes.
5. If any arm fails, propagate the error and cancel remaining arms.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal `race` rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.RaceSelectionAndState
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines ready-arm selection relations, race state, and race initialization signature.
labels: SelectReady, SelectReadyAny, RaceState, InitRace
-->
```text
SelectReady(asyncs) = (index, async_value) ⇔
  asyncs = [a_1, …, a_n] ∧
  ∃ i ∈ [1..n]. ModalState(a_i) = @Suspended ∧ IsReady(a_i) ∧
  (∀ j < i. ¬IsReady(a_j) ∨ ModalState(a_j) ≠ @Suspended) ∧
  index = i ∧
  async_value = a_i

SelectReadyAny(asyncs) = (index, async_value) ⇔
  asyncs = [a_1, …, a_n] ∧
  ∃ i ∈ [1..n]. (ModalState(a_i) = @Completed ∨ ModalState(a_i) = @Failed ∨ (ModalState(a_i) = @Suspended ∧ IsReady(a_i))) ∧
  (∀ j < i. ModalState(a_j) = @Suspended ∧ ¬IsReady(a_j)) ∧
  index = i ∧
  async_value = a_i

RaceState = { active: [AsyncValue], completed: Option<(Index, AsyncValue)>, mode: `return` | `yield` }
InitRace : [RaceArm] × State → RaceState × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.InitRace
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Initializes race state by evaluating arm expressions left-to-right and storing active async values with the race mode.
labels: InitRace
-->
**(InitRace)**
```text
∀ i, Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(arm_i.expr, σ_i) ⇓ (Val(a_i), σ_{i+1})    mode = RaceMode(arms)
race_state = { active: [a_1, …, a_n], completed: ⊥, mode: mode }
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ InitRace(arms, σ_0) ⇓ (race_state, σ_n)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.RaceStepReturnSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the RaceStepReturn relation signature.
labels: RaceStepReturn
-->
```text
RaceStepReturn : RaceState × [RaceArm] × State → EvalOut × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepReturn-Completed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Handles a completed return-mode race arm by binding its value, evaluating the handler, cancelling remaining arms, and returning the handler value.
labels: RaceStepReturn-Completed
-->
**(RaceStepReturn-Completed)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Completed    a_i = race_state.active[i]    a_i.value = v
arm_i = arms[i]    Γ ⊢ BindPattern(arm_i.pat, v) ⇓ Γ_1    Γ_1 ⊢ EvalSigma(arm_i.handler.expr, σ) ⇓ (Val(r), σ_1)
CancelAll(race_state.active ∖ {a_i}, σ_1) ⇓ σ_2
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepReturn(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (Val(r), σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepReturn-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Handles a failed return-mode race arm by cancelling remaining arms and returning the error value.
labels: RaceStepReturn-Failed
-->
**(RaceStepReturn-Failed)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Failed    a_i = race_state.active[i]    a_i.error = e
CancelAll(race_state.active ∖ {a_i}, σ) ⇓ σ_1
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepReturn(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (Val(e), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepReturn-Continue
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Continues return-mode race execution by resuming the selected ready suspended arm and recursing on updated race state.
labels: RaceStepReturn-Continue
-->
**(RaceStepReturn-Continue)**
```text
∀ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Suspended
SelectReady(race_state.active) = (j, a_j)    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(a_j, ()), σ) ⇓ (Val(a_j'), σ_1)
race_state' = race_state[active[j] ↦ a_j']    Γ ⊢ RaceStepReturn(race_state', arms, σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepReturn(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Race-Return
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates a return-mode race by initializing race state and stepping return-mode race execution.
labels: EvalSigma-Race-Return
-->
**(EvalSigma-Race-Return)**
```text
RaceMode(arms) = `return`    Γ ⊢ InitRace(arms, σ) ⇓ (race_state, σ_1)
Γ ⊢ RaceStepReturn(race_state, arms, σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(RaceExpr(arms), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.RaceStepStreamSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the RaceStepStream relation signature.
labels: RaceStepStream
-->
```text
RaceStepStream : RaceState × [RaceArm] × State → EvalOut × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepStream-Yield-Initial
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Handles a yielded streaming race arm by binding its output, evaluating the yield handler, and suspending the outer async with stream state.
labels: RaceStepStream-Yield
-->
**(RaceStepStream-Yield)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Suspended    a_i = race_state.active[i]    a_i.output = v
arm_i = arms[i]    Γ ⊢ BindPattern(arm_i.pat, v) ⇓ Γ_1    Γ_1 ⊢ EvalSigma(arm_i.handler.expr, σ) ⇓ (Val(u), σ_1)
stream_state = { race_state: race_state, pending_yield: (i, u) }
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepStream(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (Suspend(AsyncSuspended(u, stream_state)), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepStream-AllComplete
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Completes a streaming race when all active arms have completed.
labels: RaceStepStream-AllComplete
-->
**(RaceStepStream-AllComplete)**
```text
∀ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Completed
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepStream(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (Val(AsyncCompleted(())), σ)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepStream-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Handles a failed streaming race arm by cancelling remaining arms and returning a failed async value.
labels: RaceStepStream-Failed
-->
**(RaceStepStream-Failed)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Failed    a_i = race_state.active[i]    a_i.error = e
CancelAll(race_state.active ∖ {a_i}, σ) ⇓ σ_1
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepStream(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (Val(AsyncFailed(e)), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Race-Stream
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates a streaming race by initializing race state and stepping streaming race execution.
labels: EvalSigma-Race-Stream
-->
**(EvalSigma-Race-Stream)**
```text
RaceMode(arms) = `yield`    Γ ⊢ InitRace(arms, σ) ⇓ (race_state, σ_1)
Γ ⊢ RaceStepStream(race_state, arms, σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(RaceExpr(arms), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.CancelAllSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the CancelAll relation signature.
labels: CancelAll
-->
```text
CancelAll : [AsyncValue] × State → State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.CancelAll
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Cancels every async value in a list.
labels: CancelAll
-->
**(CancelAll)**
```text
∀ a ∈ asyncs. Cancel(a) ⇓ ()
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CancelAll(asyncs, σ) ⇓ σ
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Streaming-race suspension state is:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.RaceStreamSuspensionState
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines streaming race suspension state, resume order, and arm resume helper relation.
labels: RaceStreamState, RaceResumeOrder, ResumeRaceArm
-->
```text
RaceStreamState = { race_state: RaceState, yielded_arm: Index }

RaceResumeOrder(state, arms) = [state.yielded_arm] ++ [j | 1 ≤ j ≤ |arms| ∧ j ≠ state.yielded_arm ∧ ModalState(state.race_state.active[j]) ≠ @Completed]

ResumeRaceArm(a, σ) ⇓ (a', σ') ⇔ ModalState(a) = @Suspended ∧ Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(a, ()), σ) ⇓ (Val(a'), σ')
ResumeRaceArm(a, σ) ⇓ (a, σ)  ⇔ ModalState(a) = @Completed
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.RaceStepStream-Yield-Resumable
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Handles a yielded streaming race arm by recording the yielded arm for streaming race resumption order.
labels: RaceStepStream-Yield
-->
**(RaceStepStream-Yield)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(race_state.active[i]) = @Suspended    a_i = race_state.active[i]    a_i.output = v
arm_i = arms[i]    Γ ⊢ BindPattern(arm_i.pat, v) ⇓ Γ_1    Γ_1 ⊢ EvalSigma(arm_i.handler.expr, σ) ⇓ (Val(u), σ_1)
stream_state = { race_state: race_state, yielded_arm: i }
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RaceStepStream(race_state, arms, σ) ⇓ (Suspend(AsyncSuspended(u, stream_state)), σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.ResumeRaceState-Step
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes streaming race arms in the provided order and recurses on the remaining order.
labels: ResumeRaceState-Step
-->
**(ResumeRaceState-Step)**
```text
order = [i] ++ rest    a_i = state.active[i]    ResumeRaceArm(a_i, σ) ⇓ (a_i', σ_1)
state' = state[active[i] ↦ a_i']    Γ ⊢ ResumeRaceState(state', rest, σ_1) ⇓ (state'', σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ResumeRaceState(state, order, σ) ⇓ (state'', σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.ResumeRaceState-Done
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Completes streaming race state resumption when the resume order is empty.
labels: ResumeRaceState-Done
-->
**(ResumeRaceState-Done)**
```text
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ResumeRaceState(state, [], σ) ⇓ (state, σ)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Race-Stream-Resume
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes a suspended streaming race by resuming arms in race resume order and stepping streaming race execution.
labels: EvalSigma-Race-Stream-Resume
-->
**(EvalSigma-Race-Stream-Resume)**
```text
async_state = AsyncSuspended(_, stream_state)    input = ()    order = RaceResumeOrder(stream_state, arms)
Γ ⊢ ResumeRaceState(stream_state.race_state, order, σ) ⇓ (race_state', σ_1)
Γ ⊢ RaceStepStream(race_state', arms, σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(async_state, input), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.StreamingRaceResumptionOrder
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires streaming race resumption to resume the previously yielded arm first, then remaining live arms in declaration order, with first yield or failure selecting the next output or failure.
labels: streaming-race-resumption-order
-->
On resumption of a streaming `race`, the previously yielded arm MUST resume first. Remaining live arms MUST then resume in arm declaration order. The first resumed arm to yield determines the next stream output. The first resumed arm to fail cancels the remaining live arms and determines the failure result.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AllRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines all expression runtime behavior for concurrent initiation, completion, result tuple ordering, first failure, and cancellation of remaining operations.
labels: all
-->
`all` evaluation is:

1. Initiate all async expressions concurrently.
2. Wait for all operations to complete.
3. If all succeed, return the result tuple in expression order.
4. If any fails, cancel remaining operations and return the first recorded error value.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal `all` rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AllStateAndInitSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines all expression state and initialization signature.
labels: AllState, InitAll
-->
```text
AllState = { active: [AsyncValue], results: [Option<Value>], failed: Option<Error> }
InitAll : [Expr] × State → AllState × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.InitAll
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Initializes all expression state by evaluating operand expressions left-to-right and storing active async values.
labels: InitAll
-->
**(InitAll)**
```text
∀ i, Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e_i, σ_i) ⇓ (Val(a_i), σ_{i+1})
all_state = { active: [a_1, …, a_n], results: [⊥, …, ⊥], failed: ⊥ }
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ InitAll([e_1, …, e_n], σ_0) ⇓ (all_state, σ_n)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AllStepSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the AllStep relation signature.
labels: AllStep
-->
```text
AllStep : AllState × State → AllState × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.AllStep-Complete
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Records a completed all operand result.
labels: AllStep-Complete
-->
**(AllStep-Complete)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(all_state.active[i]) = @Completed    a_i = all_state.active[i]    a_i.value = v
all_state' = all_state[results[i] ↦ v]
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ AllStep(all_state, σ) ⇓ (all_state', σ)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.AllStep-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Records the first failed all operand and cancels remaining incomplete operands.
labels: AllStep-Failed
-->
**(AllStep-Failed)**
```text
∃ i. ModalState(all_state.active[i]) = @Failed    a_i = all_state.active[i]    a_i.error = e    all_state.failed = ⊥
remaining = { a_j | j ≠ i ∧ ModalState(a_j) ≠ @Completed }    CancelAll(remaining, σ) ⇓ σ_1
all_state' = all_state[failed ↦ e]
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ AllStep(all_state, σ) ⇓ (all_state', σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.AllStep-Resume
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes a ready suspended all operand when no operand has failed.
labels: AllStep-Resume
-->
**(AllStep-Resume)**
```text
∀ i. ModalState(all_state.active[i]) ≠ @Failed    ∃ j. all_state.results[j] = ⊥ ∧ ModalState(all_state.active[j]) = @Suspended
SelectReady(all_state.active) = (j, a_j)    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(Resume(a_j, ()), σ) ⇓ (Val(a_j'), σ_1)
all_state' = all_state[active[j] ↦ a_j']
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ AllStep(all_state, σ) ⇓ (all_state', σ_1)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AllLoopSignature
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the AllLoop relation signature.
labels: AllLoop
-->
```text
AllLoop : AllState × State → EvalOut × State
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.AllLoop-AllCompleted
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Completes all expression evaluation with result tuple in expression order when all operands completed and none failed.
labels: AllLoop-AllCompleted
-->
**(AllLoop-AllCompleted)**
```text
∀ i. all_state.results[i] ≠ ⊥    all_state.failed = ⊥    tuple = (all_state.results[1], …, all_state.results[n])
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ AllLoop(all_state, σ) ⇓ (Val(tuple), σ)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.AllLoop-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Completes all expression evaluation with the first recorded error when an operand failed.
labels: AllLoop-Failed
-->
**(AllLoop-Failed)**
```text
all_state.failed = e    e ≠ ⊥
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ AllLoop(all_state, σ) ⇓ (Val(e), σ)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.AllLoop-Continue
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Continues all expression evaluation by stepping and recursing until completion or failure.
labels: AllLoop-Continue
-->
**(AllLoop-Continue)**
```text
∃ i. all_state.results[i] = ⊥    all_state.failed = ⊥    Γ ⊢ AllStep(all_state, σ) ⇓ (all_state', σ_1)
Γ ⊢ AllLoop(all_state', σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ AllLoop(all_state, σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-All
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates an all expression by initializing all state and running the all loop.
labels: EvalSigma-All
-->
**(EvalSigma-All)**
```text
Γ ⊢ InitAll(exprs, σ) ⇓ (all_state, σ_1)    Γ ⊢ AllLoop(all_state, σ_1) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(AllExpr(exprs), σ) ⇓ (out, σ_2)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.UntilRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, compiler.key-system, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines until evaluation over shared values, including write-key acquisition, action execution, waiter registration, suspension, and re-evaluation on key release.
labels: until
-->
`until` evaluation is:

1. If `pred(shared_value)` is true, acquire a Write key for the target path, execute `action(shared_value)`, and complete the future with the result.
2. Otherwise register a waiter record and transition to `@Suspended { output = () }`.
3. On key release, re-evaluate registered waiters and schedule those whose predicates become true.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncCombinatorRuntimeWrappers
kind: formal-definition
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines wrapper async values created by map, filter, take, fold, and chain combinators.
labels: MappedAsync, FilteredAsync, TakeAsync, FoldAsync, ChainAsync
-->
Async combinators create wrapper async values:

```text
MappedAsync = ⟨source, f⟩
FilteredAsync = ⟨source, pred, state⟩    state ∈ {Pending, Done}
TakeAsync = ⟨source, remaining⟩
FoldAsync = ⟨source, acc, f⟩
ChainAsync = ⟨source, f, state⟩    state ∈ {WaitingSource, WaitingChained(inner)}
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Formal combinator rules:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Map-Create
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Creates a mapped async wrapper from source and mapping function values.
labels: EvalSigma-Map-Create
-->
**(EvalSigma-Map-Create)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a, σ) ⇓ (Val(src), σ')    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(f, σ') ⇓ (Val(fn), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a~>map(f), σ) ⇓ (Val(MappedAsync(src, fn)), σ'')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Yield
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes mapped async by mapping yielded source output through the mapping function.
labels: EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Yield
-->
**(EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Yield)**
```text
a = MappedAsync(src, f)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, input, σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ')    Γ ⊢ Apply(f, v, σ') ⇓ (Val(v'), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, input, σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v'}, σ'')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Complete
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes mapped async to completed source values unchanged.
labels: EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Complete
-->
**(EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Complete)**
```text
a = MappedAsync(src, f)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, input, σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: v}, σ')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, input, σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: v}, σ')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Failed
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes mapped async to failed source errors unchanged.
labels: EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Failed
-->
**(EvalSigma-Map-Resume-Failed)**
```text
a = MappedAsync(src, f)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, input, σ) ⇓ (@Failed{error: e}, σ')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, input, σ) ⇓ (@Failed{error: e}, σ')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Filter-Create
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Creates a filtered async wrapper from source and predicate values.
labels: EvalSigma-Filter-Create
-->
**(EvalSigma-Filter-Create)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a, σ) ⇓ (Val(src), σ')    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(p, σ') ⇓ (Val(pred), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a~>filter(p), σ) ⇓ (Val(FilteredAsync(src, pred, Pending)), σ'')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Pass
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes filtered async by yielding source output when the predicate returns true.
labels: EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Pass
-->
**(EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Pass)**
```text
a = FilteredAsync(src, pred, Pending)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ')    Γ ⊢ Apply(pred, v, σ') ⇓ (Val(true), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ'')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Skip
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes filtered async by skipping source output when the predicate returns false and continuing.
labels: EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Skip
-->
**(EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Skip)**
```text
a = FilteredAsync(src, pred, Pending)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ')    Γ ⊢ Apply(pred, v, σ') ⇓ (Val(false), σ'')
Γ ⊢ Resume(FilteredAsync(src, pred, Pending), (), σ'') ⇓ (out, σ''')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, (), σ) ⇓ (out, σ''')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Complete
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes filtered async to completed source values unchanged.
labels: EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Complete
-->
**(EvalSigma-Filter-Resume-Complete)**
```text
a = FilteredAsync(src, pred, _)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: v}, σ')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, (), σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: v}, σ')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Take-Create
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Creates a take async wrapper from source and count values.
labels: EvalSigma-Take-Create
-->
**(EvalSigma-Take-Create)**
```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a, σ) ⇓ (Val(src), σ')    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(n, σ') ⇓ (Val(count), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a~>take(n), σ) ⇓ (Val(TakeAsync(src, count)), σ'')
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Take-Resume-Yield
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Resumes take async by yielding source output while remaining count is positive and decrementing the wrapper count.
labels: EvalSigma-Take-Resume-Yield
-->
**(EvalSigma-Take-Resume-Yield)**
```text
a = TakeAsync(src, n)    n > 0    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ')    ∧ a' = TakeAsync(src, n - 1)
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Take-Resume-Done
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Completes take async when the remaining count is zero.

```text
a = TakeAsync(src, 0)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, (), σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: ()}, σ)
```

```text
a = TakeAsync(src, n)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: v}, σ')
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Fold-Create
kind: formal-rule
phase: runtime

-->

```text
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a, σ) ⇓ (Val(src), σ')    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(init, σ') ⇓ (Val(acc), σ'')    Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(f, σ'') ⇓ (Val(fn), σ''')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(a~>fold(init, f), σ) ⇓ (Val(FoldAsync(src, acc, fn)), σ''')
```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.EvalSigma-Fold-Resume-Accumulate
kind: formal-rule

labels: EvalSigma-Fold-Resume-Accumulate
-->

```text
a = FoldAsync(src, acc, f)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: v}, σ')    Γ ⊢ Apply(f, (acc, v), σ') ⇓ (Val(acc'), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ Resume(a, (), σ) ⇓ (@Suspended{output: ()}, σ'')    ∧ a' = FoldAsync(src, acc', f)
```

```text
a = ChainAsync(src, f, WaitingSource)    Γ ⊢ Resume(src, (), σ) ⇓ (@Completed{value: v}, σ')    Γ ⊢ Apply(f, v, σ') ⇓ (Val(inner), σ'')
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

#### 21.3.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncComposeIR
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the async composition lowering IR forms.
labels: AsyncComposeIR, SyncLoopIR, RaceInitIR, RaceSelectIR, RaceResumeIR, AllInitIR, AllJoinIR, UntilWaiterIR, AsyncMapIR, AsyncFilterIR, AsyncTakeIR, AsyncFoldIR, AsyncChainIR
-->
AsyncComposeIR = {SyncLoopIR, RaceInitIR, RaceSelectIR, RaceResumeIR, AllInitIR, AllJoinIR, UntilWaiterIR, AsyncMapIR, AsyncFilterIR, AsyncTakeIR, AsyncFoldIR, AsyncChainIR}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Lower-Expr-Sync
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers sync expressions to expression lowering followed by SyncLoopIR over the operand value.
labels: Lower-Expr-Sync
-->
**(Lower-Expr-Sync)**
```text
Γ ⊢ LowerExpr(e) ⇓ ⟨IR_e, v_e⟩
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

```

### 21.4 Async State Machine

#### 21.4.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncStateMachineSyntaxSurface
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.async, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires async state machines to introduce no syntax beyond ordinary procedure declarations, calls, and resume method calls.
labels: async-state-machine-syntax
-->
This section introduces no additional surface syntax beyond ordinary procedure declarations, calls, and `resume` method calls on `Async@Suspended`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncProcedureDefinition
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async procedures by declared return types whose AsyncSig is not bottom.
labels: async-procedure, AsyncSig
-->
An async procedure is any procedure whose declared return type `R` satisfies `AsyncSig(R) ≠ ⊥`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.4.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncStateMachineParsingSurface
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.async, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires async state-machine parsing to use existing procedure, call, and method-call parsing without additional productions.
labels: async-state-machine-parsing
-->
This section introduces no additional parser productions beyond ordinary procedure, call, and method-call parsing.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.4.3 AST Representation / Form

Async-state-machine analysis uses the following helper forms:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncStateMachineHelperForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.async, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async state-machine helper forms for suspension expressions, async creation expressions, capture arguments, capture size, and large-capture warning condition.
labels: SuspendExpr, AsyncCreateExpr, AsyncCaptureArgs, ASYNC_LARGE_CAPTURE_THRESHOLD_BYTES, AsyncCaptureSize, AsyncCaptureWarnCond
-->
```text
SuspendExpr(e) ⇔ e = YieldExpr(_, _) ∨ e = YieldFromExpr(_, _)

AsyncCreateExpr(Call(_, _)) ⇔ AsyncSig(ExprType(Call(_, _))) ≠ ⊥
AsyncCreateExpr(MethodCall(_, _, _)) ⇔ AsyncSig(ExprType(MethodCall(_, _, _))) ≠ ⊥
AsyncCreateExpr(RaceExpr(_)) ⇔ AsyncSig(ExprType(RaceExpr(_))) ≠ ⊥
AsyncCreateExpr(_) ⇔ false

AsyncCaptureArgs(Call(_, args)) = [e | ⟨_, e, _⟩ ∈ args]
AsyncCaptureArgs(MethodCall(base, _, args)) = [base] ++ [e | ⟨_, e, _⟩ ∈ args]
AsyncCaptureArgs(RaceExpr(arms)) = [e | ⟨e, _, _⟩ ∈ arms]
AsyncCaptureArgs(_) = []

ASYNC_LARGE_CAPTURE_THRESHOLD_BYTES = WIDEN_LARGE_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD_BYTES
AsyncCaptureSize(args) = Σ_{e ∈ args} sizeof(ExprType(e))
AsyncCaptureWarnCond(e) ⇔ AsyncCreateExpr(e) ∧ AsyncCaptureSize(AsyncCaptureArgs(e)) > ASYNC_LARGE_CAPTURE_THRESHOLD_BYTES
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncFrameStoredState
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires async frames to store live-across-suspension bindings, current resumption point, and required runtime implementation fields.
labels: async-frame
-->
The async frame stores:

- every binding live across suspension,
- the current resumption point,
- implementation fields required by the runtime.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.4.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.LiveAcrossSuspension
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.async, compiler.lowering, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines when a binding is live across suspension.
labels: live-across-suspension
-->
A binding is live across suspension iff there exists a control-flow path from a suspension point to a use of the binding on which the binding is not redefined.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Large capture warning and capture/escape provenance rules are:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(Warn-Async-LargeCapture)**
```text
AsyncCaptureWarnCond(e)
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ WarnAsyncCapture(e) ⇓ ok
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

```text
¬ AsyncCaptureWarnCond(e)
───────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ WarnAsyncCapture(e) ⇓ ok
```

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
**(Async-Capture-Err)**
```text
AsyncCreateExpr(e)    AsyncCaptureArgs(e) = args    ∃ e_i ∈ args. Γ; Ω ⊢ e_i ⇓ π_i ∧ π_i < FrameProv(Γ, Ω)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; Ω ⊢ e ⇑
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.P-Async-Create
kind: formal-rule

-->
**(P-Async-Create)**
```text
AsyncCreateExpr(e)    AsyncCaptureArgs(e) = args    ∀ e_i ∈ args, Γ; Ω ⊢ e_i ⇓ π_i
∀ e_i ∈ args, ¬(π_i < FrameProv(Γ, Ω))    Γ ⊢ WarnAsyncCapture(e) ⇓ ok
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; Ω ⊢ e ⇓ FrameProv(Γ, Ω)
```

```text
stmt ∈ {AssignStmt(p, e), CompoundAssignStmt(p, _, e)}    Γ; Ω ⊢ p ⇓ π_x    Γ; Ω ⊢ e ⇓ π_e
π_e < π_x    AsyncSig(ExprType(e)) ≠ ⊥
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; Ω ⊢ stmt ⇑
```

#### 21.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncProcedureCallRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async procedure call evaluation by evaluating arguments, allocating an async frame, executing until settlement, and returning the produced async modal state.
labels: async-procedure-call
-->
Evaluation of a call to an async procedure:

1. Evaluate arguments left-to-right.
2. Allocate a fresh async frame, capturing required arguments and initializing the resumption point to the procedure entry.
3. Execute the body until it suspends, completes, or fails.
4. The call expression evaluates to the produced async modal state.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncSettlementRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines settlement of yield, return, and error propagation into Async suspended, completed, and failed states.
labels: async-settlement, yield, yield-from, return, error-propagation
-->
Settlement rules are:

- `yield` or `yield from` produces `Async@Suspended { output = v }`.
- `return` produces `Async@Completed { value = v }`.
- error propagation via `?` produces `Async@Failed { error = e }`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncResumeRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines resume evaluation for suspended async values by continuing at the stored resumption point with the yielded input and running to the next settlement.
labels: resume, Async@Suspended
-->
Evaluation of `a~>resume(input)` for `a : Async@Suspended`:

1. Resume execution at the stored resumption point with the yielded input value bound to the suspended `yield` expression.
2. Run until the next suspension, completion, or failure, and return the resulting `Async` state.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncFailureRuntimeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async failure handling by capturing the error, running defer blocks, dropping live bindings, and transitioning to failed state.
labels: async-failure, defer, Drop, Async@Failed
-->
When an async computation fails:

1. Capture the error value.
2. Execute `defer` blocks in reverse order.
3. Run `Drop` implementations for live bindings.
4. Transition to `@Failed { error }`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.4.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncStateMachineLoweringJudgements
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async state-machine lowering judgement and IR form sets.
labels: AsyncStateMachineJudg, LowerAsyncProc, LowerAsyncResume, AsyncProcIR, AsyncFrameInitIR, AsyncResumeSwitchIR, AsyncSuspendStateIR, AsyncCompleteStateIR, AsyncFailStateIR
-->
AsyncStateMachineJudg = {LowerAsyncProc, LowerAsyncResume}
AsyncProcIR = {AsyncFrameInitIR, AsyncResumeSwitchIR, AsyncSuspendStateIR, AsyncCompleteStateIR, AsyncFailStateIR}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.21.AsyncStateMachineFrameHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines async state-machine generation points and frame slots.
labels: GenPoints, FrameSlots
-->
```text
GenPoints(proc) = [g_0, …, g_n]    where the suspension expressions of proc are listed in source order
FrameSlots(proc) = CaptureSet(proc) ∪ LiveAcrossSuspend(proc)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Lower-Async-Proc
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers async procedures to procedure IR with async frame initialization containing signature, slots, and generation points.
labels: Lower-Async-Proc
-->
**(Lower-Async-Proc)**
```text
ProcedureDecl(_, _, name, _, _, params, ret_opt, _, body, _, _) = proc    AsyncSig(ProcReturn(ret_opt)) = sig
slots = FrameSlots(proc)    gen_points = GenPoints(proc)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerAsyncProc(proc) ⇓ ProcIR(Mangle(proc), params, ProcReturn(ret_opt), AsyncFrameInitIR(name, sig, slots, gen_points))
```

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncFrameInitIRSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, runtime.evaluator, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires AsyncFrameInitIR to evaluate arguments, allocate the frame, capture frame slots, initialize generation point, and enter the resume switch.
labels: AsyncFrameInitIR
-->
`AsyncFrameInitIR` MUST:
1. evaluate arguments left-to-right,
2. allocate the async frame,
3. copy or move captured values into `FrameSlots(proc)`,
4. initialize `gen_point` to `g_0`,
5. enter `AsyncResumeSwitchIR`.

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Lower-Async-Resume
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Lowers async resume to the async resume switch for the current async frame and procedure generation points.
labels: Lower-Async-Resume
-->
**(Lower-Async-Resume)**
```text
AsyncSig(ExprType(a)) = sig    CurrentAsyncFrame(Γ) = f    CurrentProcedure(Γ) = proc
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ LowerAsyncResume(a) ⇓ AsyncResumeSwitchIR(f, GenPoints(proc))
```

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.5.4 Static Semantics

Async key restrictions are:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncKeyRestrictions
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires wait, yield, and yield-from to be ill-formed at key-holding program points unless the relevant release form is present.
labels: wait, yield, yield-from, release, Γ_keys
-->
- `wait` is ill-formed at program point `p` when `Γ_keys(p) ≠ ∅`.
- `yield` is ill-formed at program point `p` when `release_opt = ⊥` and `Γ_keys(p) ≠ ∅`.
- `yield from` is ill-formed at program point `p` when `release_opt = ⊥` and `Γ_keys(p) ≠ ∅`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Shared-capturing closures that contain `yield` are additionally constrained:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.A-Closure-Yield-Keys-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Rejects shared-capturing closures containing an unreleased yield while keys are held.
labels: A-Closure-Yield-Keys-Err
-->
**(A-Closure-Yield-Keys-Err)**
```text
C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    YieldExpr(_, _) ∈ body    SharedCaptures(C) ≠ ∅
YieldExpr(⊥, _) at program point p within body    Γ_keys(p) ≠ ∅
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ C ⇑
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.SharedCapturingClosureYieldKeys
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires shared-capturing closures with yield expressions not to hold keys across yield points unless release is present.
labels: shared-capturing-closure, yield, release
-->
A closure that captures `shared` bindings and contains `yield` expressions MUST NOT hold keys across the yield point unless the `release` modifier is present.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.YieldReleaseStalenessWarning
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires bindings derived from shared data before yield release to be treated as potentially stale after resumption and warned according to Chapter 19 unless stale_ok suppresses it.
labels: yield-release, stale_ok, staleness-warning
-->
Bindings derived from shared data before a `yield release` are potentially stale after resumption. The staleness warning defined in Chapter 19 applies unless suppressed by `#stale_ok`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

Async capability requirements are:

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirements.21.AsyncCapabilityRequirements
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.capabilities, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines capability requirements for pure sequences, I/O operations, timing, and async runtime operations.
labels: async-capability-requirements, System, Reactor
-->
| Category      | Capability Required                         |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Pure sequence | None                                        |
| I/O operation | Capability providing the invoked I/O method |
| Timing        | `System`                                    |
| Async runtime | `Reactor`                                   |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 21.5.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.21.AsyncSuspensionAccessRights
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage

At suspension, the task releases access rights. Other tasks MAY acquire keys to the same paths during the suspension period.

For `yield release`, key release and reacquisition are defined by §21.2.5.

-->

```text
WaitExpr(h) occurs at program point p    Γ_keys(p) ≠ ∅

```

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Lower-Yield-Release-Keys
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires yield release lowering with held keys to snapshot keys, release held keys, perform ordinary yield lowering, and prepend key reacquisition to the resumption target.
labels: Lower-Yield-Release-Keys
-->
**(Lower-Yield-Release-Keys)**
```text
YieldExpr(Release, e) at program point p    Γ_keys(p) = keys    keys ≠ ∅
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

```

labels: Lower-YieldFrom-Release-Keys
-->
**(Lower-YieldFrom-Release-Keys)**
```text
YieldFromExpr(Release, e) at program point p    Γ_keys(p) = keys    keys ≠ ∅
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Lowering MUST use the same key snapshot, release, and reacquisition sequence as **(Lower-Yield-Release-Keys)** around the delegated async state machine.
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.21.Lower-Closure-Yield-Shared
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.async
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.key-system, compiler.async, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires shared-capturing closure yield-release lowering to attach captured-key snapshots to closure async frames and mark derived bindings stale across suspension.
labels: Lower-Closure-Yield-Shared
-->
**(Lower-Closure-Yield-Shared)**
```text
C = ClosureExpr(params, ret_type_opt, body)    SharedCaptures(C) ≠ ∅    YieldExpr(Release, _) ∈ body ∨ YieldFromExpr(Release, _) ∈ body
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Lowering MUST attach the captured-key snapshot to the generated closure async frame and MUST emit StaleValueMarkIR for bindings derived from shared captures across the suspension boundary.
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

## 22. Compile-Time Execution and Metaprogramming

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.Phase2ExecutionPosition
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.pipeline, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
