### 22.4 Quote, Splice, and Emission

#### 22.4.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.22.QuoteSpliceEmission
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines quote, quote type, quote pattern, quoted content, expression splice, and identifier splice grammar productions.
labels: quote_expr, quote_type, quote_pattern, quoted_content, splice_expr, splice_ident
-->
```ebnf
quote_expr     ::= "quote" "{" quoted_content "}"
quote_type     ::= "quote" "type" "{" type "}"
quote_pattern  ::= "quote" "pattern" "{" pattern "}"
quoted_content ::= expression | statement | top_level_item
splice_expr    ::= "$(" expression ")"
splice_ident   ::= "$" identifier
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.4.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.QuoteParseJudg
kind: formal-definition
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines quote parsing judgement names.
labels: QuoteParseJudg, ParseQuoteExpr, ParseQuoteType, ParseQuotePattern, CaptureQuotedTokens
-->
QuoteParseJudg = {ParseQuoteExpr, ParseQuoteType, ParseQuotePattern, CaptureQuotedTokens}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.CaptureQuotedTokens
kind: formal-definition
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines CaptureQuotedTokens over balanced token sequences and preserved splice markers.
labels: CaptureQuotedTokens
-->
CaptureQuotedTokens(P) ⇓ (P', ts) consumes the balanced token sequence between the opening `{` at `P` and its matching `}` and preserves nested delimiter structure and all splice markers inside that slice.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-Quote-Raw
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses raw quote expressions as QuoteNode with unresolved kind and raw quoted tokens.
labels: Parse-Quote-Raw
-->
**(Parse-Quote-Raw)**
IsIdent(Tok(P))    Lexeme(Tok(P)) = "quote"    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(P)), "{")    CaptureQuotedTokens(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, ts)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_1, QuoteNode(⊥, QuotedRaw(ts), SpanBetween(P, P_1)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-Quote-Type
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses quote type forms as QuoteNode with Type kind and raw quoted tokens.
labels: Parse-Quote-Type
-->
**(Parse-Quote-Type)**
IsIdent(Tok(P))    Lexeme(Tok(P)) = "quote"    IsKw(Tok(Advance(P)), `type`)    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(P))), "{")    CaptureQuotedTokens(Advance(Advance(P))) ⇓ (P_1, ts)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_1, QuoteNode(`Type`, QuotedRaw(ts), SpanBetween(P, P_1)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-Quote-Pattern
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses quote pattern forms as QuoteNode with Pattern kind and raw quoted tokens.
labels: Parse-Quote-Pattern
-->
**(Parse-Quote-Pattern)**
IsIdent(Tok(P))    Lexeme(Tok(P)) = "quote"    FixedIdentTok(Tok(Advance(P)), `pattern`)    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(P))), "{")    CaptureQuotedTokens(Advance(Advance(P))) ⇓ (P_1, ts)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParsePrimary(P) ⇓ (P_1, QuoteNode(`Pattern`, QuotedRaw(ts), SpanBetween(P, P_1)))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.4.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.AstForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.comptime, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines Ast kinds, Ast node structure, accessors, and AstOf constructor.
labels: AstKind, Ast, AstKindOf, AstPayloadOf, AstSpanOf, AstHygieneOf, AstOf
-->
AstKind = {`Expr`, `Stmt`, `Item`, `Type`, `Pattern`}
Ast = {AstNode(kind, payload, span, hygiene)}
AstKindOf(AstNode(kind, payload, span, hygiene)) = kind
AstPayloadOf(AstNode(kind, payload, span, hygiene)) = payload
AstSpanOf(AstNode(kind, payload, span, hygiene)) = span
AstHygieneOf(AstNode(kind, payload, span, hygiene)) = hygiene
AstOf(kind, payload) = AstNode(kind, payload, ⊥, ⊥)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.QuoteSpliceHygieneForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.comptime, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines quote nodes, quoted bodies, splice nodes, hygiene records, quote site, emit site, and hygienization use.
labels: QuoteNode, QuotedBody, SpliceNode, Hygiene, quote_site, emit_site, HygienizeAst
-->
QuoteNode(kind_opt, body, span)
QuotedBody = QuotedRaw(tokens) | QuotedResolved(kind, payload)
SpliceNode = SpliceExprNode(expr, span) | SpliceIdentNode(name_expr, span)
Hygiene = ⟨quote_site, emit_site, mark⟩
`quote_site` is the lexical origin of the quoted fragment. `emit_site` is the insertion site at which the fragment becomes part of the expanded program. `HygienizeAst` is applied when a quoted `Ast` fragment is inserted into the expanded program.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.QuoteJudg
kind: formal-definition
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines quote judgement names.
labels: QuoteJudg, ResolveQuoteKind, ParseQuotedBody, RenderSplice, QuoteBuild, HygienizeAst
-->
QuoteJudg = {ResolveQuoteKind, ParseQuotedBody, RenderSplice, QuoteBuild, HygienizeAst}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.ExpectedAstKind
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines expected AST kind from Ast typed paths.
labels: ExpectedAstKind
-->
ExpectedAstKind(TypePath([`Ast`, `Expr`])) = `Expr`
ExpectedAstKind(TypePath([`Ast`, `Stmt`])) = `Stmt`
ExpectedAstKind(TypePath([`Ast`, `Item`])) = `Item`
ExpectedAstKind(TypePath([`Ast`, `Type`])) = `Type`
ExpectedAstKind(TypePath([`Ast`, `Pattern`])) = `Pattern`
ExpectedAstKind(TypePath([`Ast`])) = ⊥
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.CtLiteralType
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines compile-time literalizable types for splice compatibility.
labels: CtLiteralType
-->
CtLiteralType(TypePrim(t)) ⇔ t ∈ PrimitiveTypeName \ {`!`}
CtLiteralType(TypeString(st)) ⇔ st ∈ {`@View`, `@Managed`}
CtLiteralType(TypeTuple([T_1, …, T_n])) ⇔ ∀ i. CtLiteralType(T_i)
CtLiteralType(TypeArray(T, _)) ⇔ CtLiteralType(T)
CtLiteralType(TypePerm(_, T)) ⇔ CtLiteralType(T)
CtLiteralType(TypeRefine(T, _)) ⇔ CtLiteralType(T)
CtLiteralType(TypePath(p)) ⇔ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ ∀ f ∈ Fields(R). CtLiteralType(FieldType(f))
CtLiteralType(TypePath(p)) ⇔ EnumDecl(p) = E ∧ ∀ v ∈ Variants(E). (Payload(v) = ⊥ ∨ (Payload(v) = TuplePayload([T_1, …, T_n]) ∧ ∀ i. CtLiteralType(T_i)) ∨ (Payload(v) = RecordPayload(io) ∧ ∀ f ∈ io. CtLiteralType(FieldType(f))))
CtLiteralType(TypeApply(p, [T_1, …, T_n])) ⇔ CtLiteralType(TypePath(p)<T_1, …, T_n>)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.SpliceCompat
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines splice compatibility by quote context and splice source type.
labels: SpliceCompat
-->
SpliceCompat(`Expr`, T) ⇔ T = TypePath(["Ast"]) ∨ T = TypePath(["Ast", "Expr"]) ∨ CtLiteralType(T)
SpliceCompat(`Stmt`, T) ⇔ T = TypePath(["Ast", "Stmt"]) ∨ T = TypePath(["Ast", "Expr"])
SpliceCompat(`Item`, T) ⇔ T = TypePath(["Ast", "Item"])
SpliceCompat(`Type`, T) ⇔ T = TypePath(["Ast", "Type"]) ∨ T = TypePath(["Type"])
SpliceCompat(`Pattern`, T) ⇔ T = TypePath(["Ast", "Pattern"])
SpliceCompat(`Identifier`, T) ⇔ T = TypeString(`@Managed`) ∨ T = TypeString(`@View`)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.4.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.QuoteCompileTimeOnly
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires quote forms to be valid only in compile-time contexts.
labels: quote, quote-type, quote-pattern
-->
`quote { ... }`, `quote type { ... }`, and `quote pattern { ... }` are valid only in compile-time contexts.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.ResolveQuoteKind
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines quote kind resolution from explicit kind, expected AST type, or unique parseable raw quote category.
labels: ResolveQuoteKind
-->
ResolveQuoteKind(QuoteNode(kind, body, span), T_exp) = kind    if kind ≠ ⊥
ResolveQuoteKind(QuoteNode(⊥, body, span), T_exp) = kind    if ExpectedAstKind(T_exp) = kind ∧ kind ≠ ⊥
ResolveQuoteKind(QuoteNode(⊥, body, span), T_exp) = kind    if ExpectedAstKind(T_exp) = ⊥ ∧ `kind` is the unique member of {`Expr`, `Stmt`, `Item`} for which `ParseQuotedBody(kind, body)` succeeds
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.QuotedContentValidity
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires quoted content to be syntactically valid in the resolved category and rejects unresolved quote kind.
labels: quoted-content, ResolveQuoteKind
-->
Quoted content MUST be syntactically valid in the resolved category. If `ResolveQuoteKind` is undefined, the quote is ill-formed.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.SpliceContextAndTypeCompatibility
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires expression and identifier splices to appear only inside quoted token slices and have source types compatible with the surrounding quoted position.
labels: splice, SpliceCompat
-->
`$(e)` and `$ident` are valid only inside a quoted token slice. The compile-time type of the splice source MUST satisfy `SpliceCompat` for the surrounding quoted position.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.SpliceIdentifierPositionRestrictions
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Restricts SpliceIdentNode to identifier-position splices, forbids it in structural identifier positions, requires other quoted positions to use expression splice, and preserves ordinary language meaning of dollar syntax in type position.
labels: SpliceIdentNode, splice-ident
-->
`$ident` is an identifier-position splice only. `SpliceIdentNode` MAY occur only in identifier expressions, identifier-pattern bindings, typed-pattern bindings, `using ... as` alias names, `region as` aliases, and procedure or method parameter bindings. `SpliceIdentNode` MUST NOT occur in structural identifier positions, including module or type path segments, field labels, variant names, type-parameter names, item declaration names, or modal state names. In every other quoted position, including quoted type position, splicing MUST use `$(e)`. Ordinary language syntax retains precedence where it already uses `$`; for example, in `quote type { $IO }`, `$IO` is parsed as `TypeDynamic(["IO"])`, not as a splice.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.StringSpliceIdentifierHygiene
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires string-valued identifier-position splices to be intentionally unhygienic and bind in the emission environment.
labels: string-splice, identifier-position, hygiene
-->
If a string-valued splice occupies identifier position, the resulting identifier is intentionally unhygienic and binds in the emission environment.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.EmitterEmitWellFormedness
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires emitter emit calls to have TypeEmitter receiver type and Ast::Item or Ast argument type.
labels: emitter.emit, TypeEmitter, Ast::Item, Ast
-->
`emitter~>emit(ast)` is well-formed only when `emitter` has compile-time type `TypeEmitter` and `ast` has compile-time type `Ast::Item` or `Ast`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.ParseQuotedBody
kind: formal-definition
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.parser, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines parsing of quoted raw token bodies into expression, statement, item, type, and pattern payloads using ordinary parsers extended with splice nodes.
labels: ParseQuotedBody
-->
ParseQuotedBody(`Expr`, QuotedRaw(ts)) ⇓ payload iff the ordinary expression parser, extended with `SpliceExprNode` and `SpliceIdentNode`, parses `ts` as exactly one expression.
ParseQuotedBody(`Stmt`, QuotedRaw(ts)) ⇓ payload iff the ordinary statement parser, extended with `SpliceExprNode` and `SpliceIdentNode`, parses `ts` as exactly one statement.
ParseQuotedBody(`Item`, QuotedRaw(ts)) ⇓ payload iff the ordinary item parser, extended with `SpliceExprNode` and `SpliceIdentNode`, parses `ts` as exactly one top-level item.
ParseQuotedBody(`Type`, QuotedRaw(ts)) ⇓ payload iff the ordinary type parser, extended with `SpliceExprNode` and `SpliceIdentNode`, parses `ts` as exactly one type.
ParseQuotedBody(`Pattern`, QuotedRaw(ts)) ⇓ payload iff the ordinary pattern parser, extended with `SpliceExprNode` and `SpliceIdentNode`, parses `ts` as exactly one pattern.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.RenderSplice
kind: formal-definition
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.ast, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines rendering of compile-time splice values into expression, statement, item, type, pattern, and identifier payloads.
labels: RenderSplice
-->
RenderSplice(`Expr`, cv) ⇓ payload    iff (cv = CtAst(a) ∧ AstKindOf(a) = `Expr` ∧ payload = AstPayloadOf(a)) ∨ (cv ≠ CtAst(_) ∧ Γ ⊢ CtLiteralize(cv) ⇓ payload)
RenderSplice(`Stmt`, cv) ⇓ payload    iff cv = CtAst(a) ∧ AstKindOf(a) ∈ {`Stmt`, `Expr`} ∧ payload = AstPayloadOf(a)
RenderSplice(`Item`, cv) ⇓ payload    iff cv = CtAst(a) ∧ AstKindOf(a) = `Item` ∧ payload = AstPayloadOf(a)
RenderSplice(`Type`, cv) ⇓ payload    iff (cv = CtAst(a) ∧ AstKindOf(a) = `Type` ∧ payload = AstPayloadOf(a)) ∨ (cv = CtType(T) ∧ payload = T)
RenderSplice(`Pattern`, cv) ⇓ payload iff cv = CtAst(a) ∧ AstKindOf(a) = `Pattern` ∧ payload = AstPayloadOf(a)
RenderSplice(`Identifier`, cv) ⇓ payload iff cv = CtString(name) ∧ payload = Identifier(name)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.HygienizeAstProperties
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires HygienizeAst to preserve quote-site captures, prevent hygienic quoted binders from capturing emission-site names except string identifier splices, and derive deterministic fresh marks from quote site, emit site, and input counter.
labels: HygienizeAst, hygiene
-->
HygienizeAst(a, quote_site, emit_site, n) ⇓ (a', n') MUST satisfy all of the following:
1. Any capture from the quote site resolves to the same binding after emission.
2. Any binder introduced by hygienic quoted content, including top-level declaration names in quoted item fragments, MUST NOT capture names from the emission site unless the splice was string-valued in identifier position.
3. Fresh hygienic marks are deterministic functions of `quote_site`, `emit_site`, and the input counter `n`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.HygienicInternalReferences
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires references inside quoted fragments to hygienic binders introduced by the same fragment to resolve to the renamed binding after emission.
labels: hygiene, quoted-fragment
-->
If a reference inside the quoted fragment resolves to a hygienic binder introduced by that same fragment before emission, it MUST resolve to the renamed binding after emission.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.ImportUsingHygiene
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.name-resolution, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires only explicit alias names in using/import to be hygienic binders and preserves unaliased imported names as written.
labels: hygiene, using, import
-->
For `using` and `import`, only explicit alias names are hygienic binders. Unaliased imported names are preserved as written.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.CtEval-Quote
kind: formal-rule
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.ast, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Evaluates a quote node by resolving quote kind, parsing the quoted body, building the quote payload, and returning a CtAst with hygiene initialized to the current compile-time site.
labels: CtEval-Quote
-->
**(CtEval-Quote)**
q = QuoteNode(kind_opt, body, span)    T_q = ExprType(q)    ResolveQuoteKind(q, T_q) = kind    ParseQuotedBody(kind, body) ⇓ payload_0    Γ ⊢ QuoteBuild(Ξ, Φ, kind, payload_0) ⇓ (payload_1, Φ_1)    a = AstNode(kind, payload_1, span, ⟨CtSiteOf(Ξ), CtSiteOf(Ξ), 0⟩)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ CtEval(Ξ, Φ, q) ⇓ (CtAst(a), Ξ, Φ_1)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.QuoteBuildSpliceOrder
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires QuoteBuild to evaluate splice expressions left-to-right, render each splice, substitute into the quoted payload, and return the resulting fragment as Ast payload.
labels: QuoteBuild, RenderSplice
-->
`QuoteBuild` evaluates splice expressions in left-to-right source order. Each splice value is rendered by `RenderSplice`, substituted into the quoted payload, and the resulting fragment becomes the payload of the returned `Ast`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->


<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.EmissionOrder
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines emission order as derive-generated emissions for the current declaration followed by explicit TypeEmitter.emit calls in source order.
labels: emission-order, TypeEmitter.emit
-->
Emission order is:
1. derive-generated emissions required by §22.5 for the current declaration
2. explicit `TypeEmitter.emit` calls in source order
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.4.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.QuoteSpliceEmissionLowering
kind: semantic-requirement

Quoted and spliced AST fragments affect lowering only through the declarations and expressions present after Phase 2 expansion. No runtime representation of `Ast` survives unless explicitly embedded by emitted declarations.

### 22.5 Derive Targets and Contracts

#### 22.5.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.22.DeriveTargetsAndContracts
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines derive attribute, derive target list, derive target declaration, derive contract, and derive clause grammar productions.
labels: derive_attribute, derive_target_list, derive_target_decl, derive_contract_opt, derive_clause
-->
```ebnf
derive_attribute    ::= attr_open "derive" "(" derive_target_list ")" attr_close
derive_target_list  ::= identifier ("," identifier)*
derive_target_decl  ::= "derive" "target" identifier "(" "target" ":" "Type" ")" derive_contract_opt block_expr
derive_contract_opt ::= "|:" derive_clause ("," derive_clause)*
derive_clause       ::= "emits" identifier | "requires" identifier
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.5.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.DeriveParseJudg
kind: formal-definition
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines derive parsing judgement names.
labels: DeriveParseJudg, ParseDeriveAttr, ParseDeriveTargetList, ParseDeriveTargetDecl, ParseDeriveContractOpt, ParseDeriveClauseList, ParseDeriveClauseTail
-->
DeriveParseJudg = {ParseDeriveAttr, ParseDeriveTargetList, ParseDeriveTargetDecl, ParseDeriveContractOpt, ParseDeriveClauseList, ParseDeriveClauseTail}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveAttributeParsingReference
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires derive attributes to be parsed by the Chapter 9 attribute parser and interpreted by this section.
labels: derive-attribute
-->
`#derive(... )` is parsed by the attribute parser in §9.1.2; the `derive` attribute name and its argument list are interpreted by this section.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveTargetDecl
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a derive target declaration with target Type parameter, optional derive contract, and body.
labels: Parse-DeriveTargetDecl
-->
**(Parse-DeriveTargetDecl)**
IsIdent(Tok(P))    Lexeme(Tok(P)) = "derive"    FixedIdentTok(Tok(Advance(P)), `target`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(Advance(P))) ⇓ (P_1, name)    IsPunc(Tok(P_1), "(")    FixedIdentTok(Tok(Advance(P_1)), `target`)    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(P_1))), ":")    IsIdent(Tok(Advance(Advance(Advance(P_1)))))    Lexeme(Tok(Advance(Advance(Advance(P_1))))) = "Type"    IsPunc(Tok(Advance(Advance(Advance(Advance(P_1))))), ")")    Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveContractOpt(Advance(Advance(Advance(Advance(Advance(P_1)))))) ⇓ (P_2, contract_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseBlock(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, body)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseItem(P) ⇓ (P_3, DeriveTargetDecl(name, contract_opt, body, SpanBetween(P, P_3), []))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveContractOpt-None
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses absence of a derive contract option as an empty clause list.
labels: Parse-DeriveContractOpt-None
-->
**(Parse-DeriveContractOpt-None)**
¬ IsOp(Tok(P), "|:")
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveContractOpt(P) ⇓ (P, [])
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveContractOpt-Yes
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a present derive contract option through derive clause list parsing.
labels: Parse-DeriveContractOpt-Yes
-->
**(Parse-DeriveContractOpt-Yes)**
IsOp(Tok(P), "|:")    Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClauseList(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, clauses)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveContractOpt(P) ⇓ (P_1, clauses)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveClauseList-Cons
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a derive clause list from a first clause and its tail.
labels: Parse-DeriveClauseList-Cons
-->
**(Parse-DeriveClauseList-Cons)**
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClause(P) ⇓ (P_1, clause)    Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClauseTail(P_1, [clause]) ⇓ (P_2, clauses)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClauseList(P) ⇓ (P_2, clauses)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveClause-Requires
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a requires derive clause.
labels: Parse-DeriveClause-Requires
-->
**(Parse-DeriveClause-Requires)**
FixedIdentTok(Tok(P), `requires`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, name)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClause(P) ⇓ (P_1, ⟨`requires`, name⟩)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveClause-Emits
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses an emits derive clause.
labels: Parse-DeriveClause-Emits
-->
**(Parse-DeriveClause-Emits)**
FixedIdentTok(Tok(P), `emits`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, name)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClause(P) ⇓ (P_1, ⟨`emits`, name⟩)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveClauseTail-End
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Ends derive clause tail parsing when there is no comma.
labels: Parse-DeriveClauseTail-End
-->
**(Parse-DeriveClauseTail-End)**
¬ IsPunc(Tok(P), ",")
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClauseTail(P, xs) ⇓ (P, xs)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.Parse-DeriveClauseTail-Comma
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.comptime, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Continues derive clause tail parsing after a comma by parsing another clause and recursing.
labels: Parse-DeriveClauseTail-Comma
-->
**(Parse-DeriveClauseTail-Comma)**
IsPunc(Tok(P), ",")    Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClause(Advance(P)) ⇓ (P_1, clause)    Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClauseTail(P_1, xs ++ [clause]) ⇓ (P_2, ys)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseDeriveClauseTail(P, xs) ⇓ (P_2, ys)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.5.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.DeriveTargetDecl
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.comptime, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines derive target declaration AST form and derive requires/emits contract extractors.
labels: DeriveTargetDecl, DeriveReqs, DeriveEmits
-->
DeriveTargetDecl(name, contract_opt, body, span, doc)
DeriveReqs(dt) = { C | `requires` C ∈ contract_opt(dt) }
DeriveEmits(dt) = { C | `emits` C ∈ contract_opt(dt) }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.DeriveGraphAndOrder
kind: formal-definition
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines derive requests, annotated declarations, execution judgement names, graph edges, graph construction, stable topological order, target type, visible target lookup, and declared implementation names.
labels: DeriveRequest, DeriveAnnotated, DeriveExecJudg, DeriveEdge, DeriveGraph, DeriveOrder, StableTopologicalOrder, TargetTypeOf, VisibleDeriveTarget, DeclaredImplNames
-->
DeriveRequest(ty_decl, name) exists when `#derive(name)` is attached to `ty_decl`.
DeriveAnnotated(D) ⇔ ∃ name. DeriveRequest(D, name)
DeriveExecJudg = {DeriveGraph, DeriveOrder, RunDeriveTarget, RunDeriveSet}
DeriveEdge(req_i, req_j) ⇔ DeriveReqs(req_i.target) ∩ DeriveEmits(req_j.target) ≠ ∅
DeriveGraph(D) = ⟨V, E⟩ where V = [req | req = DeriveRequest(D, name)] and E = {⟨v_i, v_j⟩ | DeriveEdge(v_i, v_j)}
DeriveOrder(D) = order iff StableTopologicalOrder(DeriveGraph(D), [name | `#derive(name)` occurs on `D` in source order]) = order
StableTopologicalOrder(⟨V, E⟩, seed) = order iff `order` is a topological ordering of `⟨V, E⟩` and any two incomparable vertices preserve their relative order from `seed`.
TargetTypeOf(D) = TypePath(ItemPath(D))
VisibleDeriveTarget(name, site) = dt iff `dt` is the unique visible `DeriveTargetDecl(name, _, _, _, _)` at `site` under the ordinary item-visibility rules.
DeclaredImplNames(D) = { name | ∃ prefix. prefix ++ [name] ∈ Implements(D) }
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.5.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveAttributeTargetKinds
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires derive attributes to be valid only on record, enum, and modal declarations.
labels: derive-attribute
-->
`#derive(... )` is valid only on `record`, `enum`, and `modal` declarations.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetNameResolution
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.name-resolution, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires each derive target name in a derive attribute to resolve to exactly one visible derive target declaration at the annotated declaration.
labels: derive-target-resolution
-->
Every derive target name in `#derive(... )` MUST resolve to exactly one `derive target` declaration visible at the annotated declaration.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetBodyBindings
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines fixed bindings available inside derive target declaration bodies.
labels: derive-target-bindings, target, emitter, introspect, diagnostics
-->
Within the body of a derive target declaration, the following bindings are available:
- `target : Type`
- `emitter : TypeEmitter`
- `introspect : Introspect`
- `diagnostics : ComptimeDiagnostics`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetBodyRestrictions
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires derive target bodies to execute under the same restrictions as any other compile-time procedure body.
labels: derive-target-body
-->
The body of a derive target declaration executes under the same restrictions as any other compile-time procedure body.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveExecutionOrder
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires derive execution order for one annotated type declaration to be the topological order of derive requests with edges from requires/emits intersections.
labels: DeriveOrder, DeriveGraph, DeriveReqs, DeriveEmits
-->
For one annotated type declaration `D`, derive execution order is the topological order of the graph:
- vertices: all `DeriveRequest(D, name)`
- edge `name_i -> name_j` when `DeriveReqs(name_i) ∩ DeriveEmits(name_j) ≠ ∅`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveOrderTieBreaker
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires incomparable derive targets to preserve source order from the derive attribute as the tie-breaker.
labels: DeriveOrder
-->
If multiple derive targets are incomparable in that graph, source order in `#derive(... )` is the tie-breaker.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveRequiresValidation
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires every class in DeriveReqs(name) to belong to DeclaredImplNames(D) before executing that derive target for D.
labels: DeriveReqs, DeclaredImplNames
-->
Before executing derive target `name` for type `D`, every class in `DeriveReqs(name)` MUST belong to `DeclaredImplNames(D)`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveEmitsValidation
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires every class in DeriveEmits(name) to belong to DeclaredImplNames(D) before executing that derive target for D.
labels: DeriveEmits, DeclaredImplNames
-->
Before executing derive target `name` for type `D`, every class in `DeriveEmits(name)` MUST belong to `DeclaredImplNames(D)`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveRequiresEmitsScope
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires requires and emits clauses to participate only in derive ordering and explicit implements-list validation and not to add or remove class implementations.
labels: requires, emits, implements
-->
`requires` and `emits` participate only in derive ordering and validation against the annotated declaration's explicit `implements` list. They do not add or remove class implementations for `D`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.5.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetDeclPhase2Lifetime
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires DeriveTargetDecl to be compile-time-only, visible to later derive lookup in Phase 2 module order, and absent from the expanded Phase 3 module set.
labels: DeriveTargetDecl
-->
`DeriveTargetDecl` is a compile-time-only item. It is visible to later derive lookup in the same Phase 2 module order and MUST NOT survive into the expanded Phase 3 module set.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.CtExpandItem-DeriveTargetDecl
kind: formal-rule
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Expands a derive target declaration to no runtime items and unchanged compile-time state.
labels: CtExpandItem-DeriveTargetDecl
-->
**(CtExpandItem-DeriveTargetDecl)**
dt = DeriveTargetDecl(_, _, _, _, _)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ CtExpandItem(Ξ, Φ, dt) ⇓ (⟨[], []⟩, Ξ, Φ)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.RunDeriveSet-Empty
kind: formal-rule
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Runs an empty derive target set to no emitted items and unchanged state.
labels: RunDeriveSet-Empty
-->
**(RunDeriveSet-Empty)**
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RunDeriveSet(D, [], Ξ, Φ) ⇓ ([], Ξ, Φ)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.RunDeriveSet-Cons
kind: formal-rule
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Runs a non-empty derive target set by resolving and running the head derive target, then running the rest and concatenating emitted items.
labels: RunDeriveSet-Cons
-->
**(RunDeriveSet-Cons)**
VisibleDeriveTarget(name, CtSiteOf(Ξ)) = dt    Γ ⊢ RunDeriveTarget(D, dt, Ξ, Φ_0) ⇓ (items_0, Ξ_1, Φ_1)    Γ ⊢ RunDeriveSet(D, rest, Ξ_1, Φ_1) ⇓ (items_1, Ξ_2, Φ_2)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RunDeriveSet(D, [name] ++ rest, Ξ, Φ_0) ⇓ (items_0 ++ items_1, Ξ_2, Φ_2)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.RunDeriveTarget
kind: formal-rule
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Runs one derive target by binding derive inputs, executing its body, collecting pending emissions, and clearing the pending-emission queue.
labels: RunDeriveTarget
-->
**(RunDeriveTarget)**
dt = DeriveTargetDecl(name, contract_opt, body, span, doc)    Ξ_0 = BindDeriveTargetInputs(Ξ, D)    Γ ⊢ CtExec(Ξ_0, Φ_0, body) ⇓ (Ξ_1, Φ_1)    items = CtPendingEmits(Φ_1)    Φ_2 = ⟨CtFiles(Φ_1), CtProjectRoot(Φ_1), CtDiags(Φ_1), [], CtFreshSeed(Φ_1)⟩
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ RunDeriveTarget(D, dt, Ξ, Φ_0) ⇓ (items, Ξ_1, Φ_2)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.22.BindDeriveTargetInputs
kind: formal-definition
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines derive target input binding for target type and visible TypeEmitter, Introspect, and ComptimeDiagnostics capabilities.
labels: BindDeriveTargetInputs
-->
BindDeriveTargetInputs(Ξ, D) = Ξ' iff `Ξ'` extends `Ξ` with the fixed compile-time bindings required by §22.5.4 for one derive-target execution over `D`: `target = CtType(TargetTypeOf(D))`, plus the `TypeEmitter`, `Introspect`, and `ComptimeDiagnostics` capability bindings visible in derive-target bodies.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.22.CtExpandItem-DeriveAnnotatedDecl
kind: formal-rule
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Expands a derive-annotated declaration by preserving the declaration, running derive targets in derive order, and returning emitted items.
labels: CtExpandItem-DeriveAnnotatedDecl
-->
**(CtExpandItem-DeriveAnnotatedDecl)**
DeriveAnnotated(D)    DeriveOrder(D) = [name_1, …, name_n]    Γ ⊢ RunDeriveSet(D, [name_1, …, name_n], Ξ, Φ_0) ⇓ (emits, Ξ_1, Φ_1)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ CtExpandItem(Ξ, Φ_0, D) ⇓ (⟨[D], emits⟩, Ξ_1, Φ_1)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetExecutionTiming
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires each derive target to execute exactly once per annotated declaration immediately after introducing that declaration and before later source items in the same module.
labels: derive-target-execution
-->
Each derive target executes exactly once per annotated declaration, immediately after the annotated declaration has been introduced and before any later source item in the same module is executed.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetFailureSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: compile-time-execution
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.comptime, compiler.diagnostics, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires Phase 2 failure and compilation rejection when a derive target emits diagnostics.error, panics, or emits ill-formed declarations.
labels: derive-target-failure
-->
If a derive target signals `diagnostics.error`, panics, or emits ill-formed declarations, Phase 2 fails and compilation is rejected.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 22.5.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.DeriveTargetsLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.comptime, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires derive targets to introduce no runtime dispatch or metadata and affect lowering only through declarations emitted during Phase 2.
labels: derive-target-lowering
-->
Derive targets introduce no runtime dispatch or metadata. Their only lowering consequence is the presence of the declarations emitted during Phase 2.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.22.UserDiagnosticBuiltinEmission
kind: diagnostic-requirement
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.comptime
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, compiler.comptime, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires diagnostics.error, diagnostics.warning, and diagnostics.note to append the specified diagnostic records with the current compile-time site span.
labels: diagnostics.error, diagnostics.warning, diagnostics.note, E-CTE-0070, W-CTE-0071
-->
`diagnostics.error(msg)` MUST append `⟨`E-CTE-0070`, Error, msg, sp⟩`, where `sp` is the current compile-time site span.
`diagnostics.warning(msg)` MUST append `⟨`W-CTE-0071`, Warning, msg, sp⟩`, where `sp` is the current compile-time site span.
`diagnostics.note(msg)` MUST append `⟨⊥, Note, msg, sp⟩`, where `sp` is the current compile-time site span.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

## 23. Foreign Function Interface

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FFIBoundaryDefinition
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ffi, compiler.semantic-analysis, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines extern calls and foreign invocations of exported procedures as foreign-function boundary crossings.
labels: FFI Boundary, extern, export, host_export
-->
**FFI Boundary.** A call to an `extern` procedure or an invocation of a `#export` or `#host_export` procedure from foreign code crosses the foreign-function boundary.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.FFIBoundary
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ffi, compiler.semantic-analysis, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the FFIBoundary predicate for extern procedure declarations and exported procedure declarations.
labels: FFIBoundary, ExternProcDecl, ExportAttr, HostExportAttr
-->
FFIBoundary(proc) ⇔ proc = ExternProcDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∨ (proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ (ExportAttr(proc) defined ∨ HostExportAttr(proc) defined))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 23.1 FfiSafe

#### 23.1.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiSafeSyntaxNoAdditionalForm
kind: grammar
phase: parsing

PayloadTypes(v) = []    if v.payload_opt = ⊥
PayloadTypes(v) = ts    if v.payload_opt = TuplePayload(ts)

AliasParams(p) = gen_params_opt ⇔ Σ.Types[p] = TypeAliasDecl(_, _, _, gen_params_opt, _, _, _, _)
AliasPredicateClause(p) = predicate_clause_opt ⇔ Σ.Types[p] = TypeAliasDecl(_, _, _, _, predicate_clause_opt, _, _, _)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.TypeSubst
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines TypeSubst and ModalRefSubst equations used by generic FfiSafe rules.
labels: TypeSubst, ModalRefSubst
-->
TypeSubst(θ, TypePath([x])) = θ(x)    if x ∈ dom(θ)
TypeSubst(θ, TypePath(p)) = TypePath(p)    if p ≠ [x] ∨ x ∉ dom(θ)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeApply(p, args)) = TypeApply(p, [TypeSubst(θ, a) | a ∈ args])
TypeSubst(θ, TypePerm(p, T)) = TypePerm(p, TypeSubst(θ, T))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeTuple(ts)) = TypeTuple([TypeSubst(θ, t) | t ∈ ts])
TypeSubst(θ, TypeArray(T, e)) = TypeArray(TypeSubst(θ, T), e)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeSlice(T)) = TypeSlice(TypeSubst(θ, T))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeUnion(ts)) = TypeUnion([TypeSubst(θ, t) | t ∈ ts])
TypeSubst(θ, TypeFunc(params, R)) = TypeFunc([⟨m, TypeSubst(θ, T)⟩ | ⟨m, T⟩ ∈ params], TypeSubst(θ, R))
TypeSubst(θ, TypePtr(T, s)) = TypePtr(TypeSubst(θ, T), s)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRawPtr(q, T)) = TypeRawPtr(q, TypeSubst(θ, T))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeString(s)) = TypeString(s)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeBytes(s)) = TypeBytes(s)
ModalRefSubst(θ, TypePath(p)) = TypePath(p)
ModalRefSubst(θ, TypeApply(p, args)) = TypeApply(p, [TypeSubst(θ, a) | a ∈ args])
TypeSubst(θ, TypeModalState(modal_ref, S)) = TypeModalState(ModalRefSubst(θ, modal_ref), S)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeDynamic(p)) = TypeDynamic(p)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeOpaque(p)) = TypeOpaque(p)
TypeSubst(θ, TypePrim(n)) = TypePrim(n)
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRange(base)) = TypeRange(TypeSubst(θ, base))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRangeInclusive(base)) = TypeRangeInclusive(TypeSubst(θ, base))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRangeFrom(base)) = TypeRangeFrom(TypeSubst(θ, base))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRangeTo(base)) = TypeRangeTo(TypeSubst(θ, base))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRangeToInclusive(base)) = TypeRangeToInclusive(TypeSubst(θ, base))
TypeSubst(θ, TypeRangeFull) = TypeRangeFull
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.TypeParamsIn
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines TypeParamsIn and TypeParamsInModalRef equations used by FfiSafe generic-bound analysis.
labels: TypeParamsIn, TypeParamsInModalRef
-->
TypeParamsIn(TypePath([x]), params) = {x}    if x ∈ TypeParamSet(params)
TypeParamsIn(TypePath(p), params) = ∅        if p ≠ [x] ∨ x ∉ TypeParamSet(params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeApply(_, args), params) = ⋃_{a ∈ args} TypeParamsIn(a, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypePerm(_, T), params) = TypeParamsIn(T, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeTuple(ts), params) = ⋃_{t ∈ ts} TypeParamsIn(t, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeArray(T, _), params) = TypeParamsIn(T, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeSlice(T), params) = TypeParamsIn(T, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeUnion(ts), params) = ⋃_{t ∈ ts} TypeParamsIn(t, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeFunc(params_t, R), params) = ⋃_{⟨_, T⟩ ∈ params_t} TypeParamsIn(T, params) ∪ TypeParamsIn(R, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypePtr(T, _), params) = TypeParamsIn(T, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeRawPtr(_, T), params) = TypeParamsIn(T, params)
TypeParamsInModalRef(TypePath(_), params) = ∅
TypeParamsInModalRef(TypeApply(_, args), params) = ⋃_{a ∈ args} TypeParamsIn(a, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeModalState(modal_ref, _), params) = TypeParamsInModalRef(modal_ref, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeString(_), params) = ∅
TypeParamsIn(TypeBytes(_), params) = ∅
TypeParamsIn(TypeModalState(_, _), params) = ∅
TypeParamsIn(TypeDynamic(_), params) = ∅
TypeParamsIn(TypeOpaque(_), params) = ∅
TypeParamsIn(TypePrim(_), params) = ∅
TypeParamsIn(TypeRange(base), params) = TypeParamsIn(base, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeRangeInclusive(base), params) = TypeParamsIn(base, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeRangeFrom(base), params) = TypeParamsIn(base, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeRangeTo(base), params) = TypeParamsIn(base, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeRangeToInclusive(base), params) = TypeParamsIn(base, params)
TypeParamsIn(TypeRangeFull, params) = ∅
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.FfiFieldAndPayloadTypeParamHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines helper functions for finding type parameters in record fields and enum payloads.
labels: TypeParamsInFields, TypeParamsInPayloads
-->
TypeParamsInFields(fields, params) = ⋃_{f ∈ fields} TypeParamsIn(f.type, params)
TypeParamsInPayloads(vars, params) = ⋃_{v ∈ vars} ⋃_{T_f ∈ PayloadTypes(v)} TypeParamsIn(T_f, params)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.FfiSafePredicateClauseHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines helpers for checking that generic parameters used by FfiSafe types have FfiSafe predicate requirements.
labels: HasFfiSafeReq, FfiSafePredicateClauseOk, PredicateReqs, FfiSafe
-->
HasFfiSafeReq(W, x) ⇔ ∃ wp ∈ PredicateReqs(W). wp = PredicateReq(`FfiSafe`, TypePath([x]))
FfiSafePredicateClauseOk(params, W, Xs) ⇔ ∀ x ∈ Xs. HasFfiSafeReq(W, x)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ProhibitedFfiType
kind: formal-definition

labels: ProhibitedFfiType
-->
ProhibitedFfiType(T) ⇔

 T = ModalRefType(modal_ref) ∨
 T = TypeDynamic(_) ∨
 T = TypeOpaque(_) ∨
 T = TypeTuple(_) ∨
 T = TypeUnion(_) ∨
 T = TypeSlice(_) ∨

 T = TypePath(["Context"])

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.FfiByValueHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines helper predicates that determine when DropType by-value FFI use requires ffi_pass_by_value.
labels: FfiByValueType, FfiPassByValueAttr, FfiByValueOk, ffi_pass_by_value
-->
FfiByValueType(T) ⇔ StripPerm(T) ∉ {TypeRawPtr(_, _), TypePtr(_, _), TypeFunc(_, _)} ∧ StripPerm(T) ≠ TypePrim("()")
FfiPassByValueAttr(T) ⇔ (T = TypePath(p) ∧ RecordDecl(p) = R ∧ AttrByName(R, "ffi_pass_by_value") ≠ []) ∨ (T = TypePath(p) ∧ EnumDecl(p) = E ∧ AttrByName(E, "ffi_pass_by_value") ≠ [])
FfiByValueOk(T) ⇔ ¬(DropType(T) ∧ FfiSafeType(T) ⇓ ok ∧ FfiByValueType(T)) ∨ FfiPassByValueAttr(StripPerm(T))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiSafeProhibitedCategories
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires the listed type categories not to satisfy FfiSafeType.
labels: Prohibited Categories, FfiSafeType, bool, Modal types, Ptr, TypeDynamic, Context, Range types
-->
**Prohibited Categories**

The following type categories MUST NOT satisfy `FfiSafeType`:

- `bool`
- Modal types
- Safe pointers `Ptr<T>`
- Dynamic class object types `TypeDynamic(_)`
- Opaque types
- Tuples
- Unions
- Slices
- String and bytes types
- `Context`
- Range types
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiSafeRaiiByValueRule
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires by-value FFI appearances of types satisfying both DropType and FfiSafeType to carry ffi_pass_by_value on the defining type.
labels: RAII by-value rule, DropType, FfiSafeType, ffi_pass_by_value
-->
**RAII by-value rule.** If a type satisfies both `DropType` and `FfiSafeType`, then any by-value appearance of that type in an FFI signature requires the defining type to carry `#ffi_pass_by_value`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiSafeGenericBounds
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires every type parameter used in a field type or variant payload of a FfiSafe type to be bounded by FfiSafe(X) in the declaration predicate clause.
labels: Generic Bounds, FfiSafe, predicate requirement
-->
**Generic Bounds.** Any type parameter that appears in a field type or variant payload of a type satisfying `FfiSafeType` MUST be bounded by a predicate requirement of the form `FfiSafe(X)` in the declaration's `|:` clause.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

This section introduces no additional runtime mechanism. Dynamic boundary behavior is defined by §§23.2, 23.3, and 23.7.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

`FfiSafeType` constrains which values may be lowered across an FFI boundary. This section introduces no additional feature-local lowering beyond the ABI and boundary rules defined in §§23.2, 23.3, and 23.7.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 23.2 Extern Procedures

#### 23.2.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.23.ExternProcedureDecl
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the grammar for extern procedure declarations.
labels: extern_procedure_decl
-->
```ebnf
extern_procedure_decl ::= attribute_list? visibility? "procedure" identifier generic_params? signature predicate_clause? contract_clause? foreign_contract_clause_list? terminator
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.2.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.23.Parse-ExternProcDecl
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses an extern procedure declaration into an ExternProcDecl with attributes, visibility, name, generics, predicate clause, signature, contract, foreign contracts, span, and doc fields.
labels: Parse-ExternProcDecl, ParseExternProcDecl, ExternProcDecl
-->
**(Parse-ExternProcDecl)**
Γ ⊢ ParseAttrListOpt(P) ⇓ (P_0, attrs_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseVis(P_0) ⇓ (P_1, vis)    IsKw(Tok(P_1), `procedure`)    Γ ⊢ ParseIdent(Advance(P_1)) ⇓ (P_2, name)    Γ ⊢ ParseGenericParamsOpt(P_2) ⇓ (P_3, gen_params_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseSignature(P_3) ⇓ (P_4, params, ret_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParsePredicateClauseOpt(P_4) ⇓ (P_5, predicate_clause_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseContractClauseOpt(P_5) ⇓ (P_6, contract_opt)    Γ ⊢ ParseForeignContractClauseListOpt(P_6) ⇓ (P_7, foreign_contracts_opt)    Γ ⊢ ConsumeTerminatorReq(P_7) ⇓ P_8
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseExternProcDecl(P) ⇓ (P_8, ExternProcDecl(attrs_opt, vis, name, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, params, ret_opt, contract_opt, foreign_contracts_opt, SpanBetween(P, P_8), []))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.2.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.23.ExternProcDeclForm
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.ffi, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the ExternProcDecl AST tuple fields.
labels: ExternProcDecl
-->
Extern procedure declarations are represented by:

```text
ExternProcDecl = ⟨attrs_opt, vis, name, gen_params_opt, predicate_clause_opt, params, return_type_opt, contract_opt, foreign_contracts_opt, span, doc⟩
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ExternProcedureDerivedForms
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines ProcName and ExternRawName derived forms for extern procedure declarations.
labels: ProcName, ExternRawName, ExternAbiName, ExternAbiOf
-->
Extern procedure declarations also admit the derived forms:

```text
ProcName(proc) = name ⇔ proc = ExternProcDecl(_, _, name, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _)
ExternRawName(proc) ⇔ proc = ExternProcDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ ExternAbiName(ExternAbiOf(proc)) ∈ {"C", "C-unwind"}
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.2.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ExternProcedureMeaning
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines an extern procedure as a declaration whose implementation is provided by foreign code.
labels: Extern Procedure
-->
**Extern Procedure.** A declaration whose implementation is provided by foreign code.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ExternAbiStrings
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines permitted extern ABI strings, target-profile restrictions, and ExternAbiOk.
labels: ABI Strings, ExternAbiSet, AbiProfileOk, ExternAbiOk
-->
**ABI Strings**

ExternAbiSet = {"C", "C-unwind", "system", "stdcall", "fastcall", "vectorcall"}
AbiProfileOk("C", profile)
AbiProfileOk("C-unwind", profile)
AbiProfileOk("system", profile)
AbiProfileOk("stdcall", profile) ⇔ profile = `x86_64-win64`
AbiProfileOk("fastcall", profile) ⇔ profile = `x86_64-win64`
AbiProfileOk("vectorcall", profile) ⇔ profile = `x86_64-win64`
ExternAbiOk(abi_opt) ⇔ ExternAbiName(abi_opt) ∈ ExternAbiSet ∧ AbiProfileOk(ExternAbiName(abi_opt), SelectedTargetProfile)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ExternSignatureRequirements
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines extern signature admissibility in terms of return and parameter FfiSafeType checks and FfiByValueOk checks.
labels: Signature Requirements, ExternParamTypes, ExternSigOk, SparseFuncType
-->
**Signature Requirements**

ExternParamTypes(params) = [T_i | ⟨_, _, T_i⟩ ∈ params]
ExternSigOk(params, ret_opt) ⇔
 R = ProcReturn(ret_opt) ∧
 (R = TypePrim("()") ∨ Γ ⊢ FfiSafeType(R) ⇓ ok) ∧
 (∀ T ∈ ExternParamTypes(params). Γ ⊢ FfiSafeType(T) ⇓ ok) ∧
 (∀ T ∈ ExternParamTypes(params). FfiByValueOk(T)) ∧
 FfiByValueOk(R)

SparseFuncType(T) ⇔ T = TypeFunc(_, _)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ExternFfiConstraints
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires extern signatures to reject closure types, accept only sparse function pointer types as FFI-safe, and reject generic type parameters in sparse function pointer types.
labels: FFI Constraints, extern, SparseFuncType
-->
**FFI Constraints**

1. Closure types MUST NOT appear in `extern` signatures.
2. Only sparse function pointer types are FFI-safe in `extern` signatures (`SparseFuncType`).
3. Sparse function pointer types in `extern` signatures MUST NOT have generic type parameters.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ExternCallSafety
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires calls to extern procedures to appear within an unsafe block.
labels: Call Safety, extern, unsafe, E-TYP-2106
-->
**Call Safety**

Calls to extern procedures MUST appear within an `unsafe` block.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.2.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ExternDynamicSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires extern calls to transfer control to foreign code and applies catch or abort unwind behavior at the boundary.
labels: extern, UnwindMode, catch, abort
-->
Calls to extern procedures transfer control to foreign code. If `UnwindMode(proc) = "catch"`, foreign unwinds are converted to Ultraviolet panics at the boundary as defined in §23.7. If `UnwindMode(proc) = "abort"`, any unwind that attempts to cross the boundary aborts as defined in §23.7.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.2.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ExternLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires extern lowering to use import-side unwind landing pads from Section 23.7 and adds no other feature-local lowering beyond ABI selection and unsafe-call boundary.
labels: extern, lowering, unwind landing pads
-->
Import-side unwind landing pads are defined in §23.7. This section introduces no additional lowering rules beyond ABI selection and the required unsafe-call boundary.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

| `E-TYP-2306` | Error    | Compile-time | Generic parameter in `extern` procedure signature |

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 23.3 Exported Procedures and Hosted Exports

#### 23.3.1 Raw Exported Procedures

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.RawExportedProcedureClassification
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines a raw exported procedure as a procedure carrying export(abi) and delegates attribute syntax to Section 23.4.1.
labels: raw exported procedure, export
-->
A procedure becomes a raw exported procedure when it carries `#export("abi")`. The attribute syntax is defined in §23.4.1.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.3.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.RawExportParsingUsesOrdinaryProcedureParser
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires raw exported procedures to be parsed by the ordinary procedure-declaration parser.
labels: raw export, procedure parser
-->
Raw exported procedures are parsed by the ordinary procedure-declaration parser from §15.1.2.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.RawExportParsingClassification
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires ordinary ProcedureDecl items to be classified as raw exported procedures when their attributes include export(abi) parsed by Section 23.4.2.
labels: raw export, ProcedureDecl, ExportAttr
-->
An ordinary `ProcedureDecl` is classified as a raw exported procedure when its attached attribute list contains `#export("abi")` as parsed by §23.4.2.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.3.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.23.RawExportProcedureForm
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.ffi, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines raw exported procedures as ordinary ProcedureDecl items with ExportAttr defined and no dedicated AST node.
labels: raw export, ProcedureDecl, ExportAttr
-->
Raw exported procedures are represented by ordinary `ProcedureDecl(...)` items with `ExportAttr(proc)` defined.

This section introduces no dedicated raw-export AST node beyond `ProcedureDecl` plus the attached `export` attribute.

ZeroValue(T) = v ⇔ ValueBits(T, v) = ZeroBits(T) ∧ ∀ v'. (ValueBits(T, v') = ZeroBits(T) ⇒ v' = v)
ZeroableType(T) ⇔ ∃ v. ZeroValue(T) = v

#### 23.3.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.RawExportOrdinaryBodyAndCatchReturn
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires raw exported procedure bodies to follow ordinary procedure semantics, boundary panic handling to follow Section 23.7, and catch mode to return ZeroValue(R).
labels: raw export, UnwindMode, catch, ZeroValue
-->
Execution of the body follows ordinary procedure semantics. Boundary panic handling is defined by §23.7. When `UnwindMode(proc) = "catch"`, the boundary MUST return `ZeroValue(R)` for the raw exported procedure's return type `R`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.RawExportLibraryImageLifecycle
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires raw export calls for RawExportLibrary projects to establish, reuse, and destroy exactly one live loaded library image state according to Section 24.4.4.
labels: RawExportLibrary, LibraryImageInitSigma, LibraryImageDestroySigma, RawLibraryCallSigma
-->
For a raw exported procedure `proc` owned by a project `P` satisfying `RawExportLibrary(P)`, a boundary call occurs only through one live loaded library image `i` owned by `P`. Before the first raw export call through a newly loaded image, the implementation MUST establish that image by `LibraryImageInitSigma(P, i, σ)` as defined in §24.4.4. Later raw export calls through the same live image MUST reuse the same image-owned static state, poison flags, and boundary panic record until unload. On unload of that live image, the implementation MUST execute `LibraryImageDestroySigma(P, i, σ)` exactly once. User-procedure execution within that live image is governed by `RawLibraryCallSigma(P, i, proc, vs, σ)` in §24.4.4.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.SharedLibraryLinkedCallLifecycle
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires ordinary Ultraviolet calls across a shared-library link boundary to establish, reuse, and destroy exactly one live loaded library image state according to Section 24.4.4.
labels: shared-library link boundary, LibraryImageInitSigma, LibraryImageDestroySigma, ApplyProcSigma
-->
For any shared library project `P`, an ordinary Ultraviolet call that crosses a shared-library link boundary into one externally linked procedure owned by `P` likewise occurs only through one live loaded library image `i` owned by `P`. Before the first such linked call through a newly loaded image, the implementation MUST establish that image by `LibraryImageInitSigma(P, i, σ)` as defined in §24.4.4. Later linked calls through the same live image MUST reuse the same image-owned static state, poison flags, and boundary panic record until unload. On unload of that live image, the implementation MUST execute `LibraryImageDestroySigma(P, i, σ)` exactly once. User-procedure execution for that linked call continues to follow ordinary `ApplyProcSigma` under the image-state interpretation defined by §24.4.4.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.3.8 Hosted Exports

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.HostedExportProcedureHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines hosted export classification, context parameter extraction, visible parameter extraction, export sets, hosted-library classification, mixed-mode classification, root capability collection, hosted context bundle constraints, ABI version, session parameter, thunk parameters, foreign parameter types, and thunk signature.
labels: HostExported, HostContextParam, HostVisibleParams, HostVisibleParamTypes, HostExports, RawExports, HostedLibrary, MixedForeignExportModes, HostedRootCaps, HostedContextBundleType, HostAbiVersion, HostSessionAbiParam, HostThunkParams, HostThunkForeignParamTypes, HostThunkSig
-->
HostExported(proc) ⇔ proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ HostExportAttr(proc) defined
HostContextParam(proc) = ⟨mode, name, T_ctx⟩ ⇔ proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, [⟨mode, name, T_ctx⟩] ++ _, _, _, _, _, _)
HostVisibleParams(proc) = params_vis ⇔ proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, [ctx_param] ++ params_vis, _, _, _, _, _)
HostVisibleParamTypes(proc) = [T_i | ⟨_, _, T_i⟩ ∈ params_vis] ⇔ HostVisibleParams(proc) = params_vis
HostExports(P) = [d | m ∈ P.modules, d ∈ ASTModule(P, m).items, HostExported(d)]
RawExports(P) = [d | m ∈ P.modules, d ∈ ASTModule(P, m).items, d = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) ∧ ExportAttr(d) defined]
HostedLibrary(P) ⇔ Library(P) ∧ HostExports(P) ≠ []
MixedForeignExportModes(P) ⇔ HostedLibrary(P) ∧ RawExports(P) ≠ []
HostedRootCaps(P) = ⋃{CapInType(StripPerm(T_ctx)) | d ∈ HostExports(P) ∧ HostContextParam(d) = ⟨_, _, T_ctx⟩}
HostedContextBundleType(T) ⇔ ContextBundleType(T) ∧ AliasNorm(T) ≠ TypePath(["Context"])
HostAbiVersion = 1
HostSessionAbiParam = ⟨`move`, `__ultraviolet_session`, TypePrim("usize")⟩
HostThunkParams(proc) = [HostSessionAbiParam] ++ params_vis ⇔ HostVisibleParams(proc) = params_vis
HostThunkForeignParamTypes(proc) = [TypePrim("usize")] ++ [T_i | ⟨_, _, T_i⟩ ∈ params_vis] ⇔ HostVisibleParams(proc) = params_vis
HostThunkSig(proc) = ⟨HostThunkParams(proc), ProcReturn(ret_opt)⟩ ⇔ proc = ProcedureDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, ret_opt, _, _, _, _)

#### 23.3.12 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportSessionHandleValidity
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required

summary: Requires hosted export calls to use a live idle hosted-library session handle of ABI type usize and reject zero as invalid.
labels: hosted export, session handle, usize
-->
A hosted export call occurs only with a live, idle hosted-library session `h` owned by the library project `P`. Hosted-export foreign-visible session handles use ABI type `usize`; the value `0` MUST be rejected as invalid.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportCapabilityIsolation
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-export boundaries to introduce only the reconstructed first source argument as a capability-bearing value, never expose raw Context, and keep visible roots within HostedRootCaps.
labels: hosted export, capability isolation, HostedRootCaps, Context
-->
A conforming implementation MUST ensure that the only capability-bearing value introduced to Ultraviolet user code by the hosted-export boundary is the reconstructed first source argument. Raw `Context` values MUST NOT be exposed directly to hosted-export user code, and the capability roots that become visible across all hosted exports of `P` MUST be a subset of `HostedRootCaps(P)`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime

owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires successful hosted sessions to grant exactly HostedRootCaps through runtime-owned standard providers and forbids foreign-supplied capability values across the hosted-session ABI.
labels: hosted session, HostedRootCaps, capability adapters
-->
This specification revision defines no foreign-supplied capability adapters or session options. A successful hosted session MUST grant exactly `HostedRootCaps(P)` through runtime-owned standard providers; foreign code does not pass capability values across the hosted-session ABI.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportBoundaryEntrySequence
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-export boundaries to validate the session handle, reject invalid states before user code, recover session context, build the first source argument, and invoke the source procedure under ordinary semantics.
labels: hosted export, boundary, ContextBundleBuild, SessionContext
-->
The boundary MUST:

1. validate the foreign-visible session handle;
2. reject any handle that is invalid, not live, or currently busy before any user code executes;
3. recover the session-owned root context carrier for `h`;
4. construct the first source argument `v_ctx` by `ContextBundleBuild(StripPerm(T_ctx), SessionContext(h))`;
5. pass `v_ctx` plus the foreign-visible arguments to the source procedure under ordinary Ultraviolet semantics.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->
