strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-export invalid, non-live, or busy handles to return ZeroValue(R) in catch mode and otherwise abort.
labels: hosted export, invalid handle, ZeroValue, Abort
-->
If the supplied handle is invalid, not live, or busy, then the hosted-export boundary MUST:

1. return `ZeroValue(R)` when `UnwindMode(proc) = "catch"`;
2. otherwise terminate the boundary call as `Abort`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportCatchFailureReturn
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires any hosted-export boundary failure before or during invocation in catch mode to return ZeroValue(R).
labels: hosted export, catch, boundary failure, ZeroValue
-->
When `UnwindMode(proc) = "catch"`, any boundary failure that occurs before or during hosted-export invocation MUST return `ZeroValue(R)` for the hosted export's return type `R`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.3.13 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportLoweringPreservesRawFfiRules
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-export lowering to preserve raw-FFI rules for the foreign-visible signature while reconstructing the first source parameter internally.
labels: hosted export, lowering, raw FFI
-->
Hosted-export lowering MUST preserve the raw-FFI rules of §§23.1–23.5 for the foreign-visible signature while reconstructing the first source parameter internally.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportThunkAbiDetermination
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-export foreign-visible thunk ABI to be determined by ForeignABICall, ConventionLayout, AssignParamRegs, and the raw-export-equivalent return and stack layout.
labels: hosted export, thunk ABI, ForeignABICall, ConventionLayout, AssignParamRegs
-->
For a hosted export `proc` with `HostExportAttr(proc) = ⟨abi, _⟩` and `HostThunkSig(proc) = ⟨params_thunk, R⟩`, the foreign-visible thunk ABI is determined exactly as follows:

1. `Γ ⊢ ForeignABICall(HostThunkForeignParamTypes(proc), R) ⇓ ⟨[k_1, …, k_n], k_r, sretSigma⟩` determines the complete foreign by-value/by-reference parameter classification and indirect-return decision.
2. `ConventionLayout(SelectedTargetProfile, AbiToConvention(abi))` determines the calling-convention layout used by the thunk.
3. `AssignParamRegs(HostThunkForeignParamTypes(proc), AbiToConvention(abi))` determines the thunk's parameter register assignment and stack-slot assignment.
4. The thunk's return-register assignment, indirect-return slot placement, and stack layout MUST be exactly those implied by the same `ForeignABICall`, `ConventionLayout`, and `AssignParamRegs` results for a raw exported procedure whose source signature is `params_thunk -> R`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.HostThunkCarrierHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines hosted thunk carrier judgement families, thunk parameter and return shape helpers, integer lanes, and aggregate LLVM classification.
labels: HostThunkParamCarrierJudg, HostThunkRetCarrierJudg, HostThunkParamShape, HostThunkRetShape, IntLane, AggLLVM
-->
HostThunkParamCarrierJudg = {HostThunkParamCarrier}
HostThunkRetCarrierJudg = {HostThunkRetCarrier}
HostThunkParamShape(proc) = [⟨k_i, c_i, τ_i⟩] ⇔
  HostThunkForeignParamTypes(proc) = [T_i] ∧
  HostThunkSig(proc) = ⟨_, R⟩ ∧
  Γ ⊢ ForeignABICall([T_i], R) ⇓ ⟨[k_i], k_r, sretSigma_base⟩ ∧
  ∀ i. Γ ⊢ HostThunkParamCarrier(SelectedTargetProfile, k_i, T_i) ⇓ ⟨c_i, τ_i⟩
HostThunkRetShape(proc) = ⟨k_r, c_r, τ_r, sretSigma⟩ ⇔
  HostThunkSig(proc) = ⟨_, R⟩ ∧
  Γ ⊢ ForeignABICall(HostThunkForeignParamTypes(proc), R) ⇓ ⟨[k_i], k_r, sretSigma_base⟩ ∧
  Γ ⊢ HostThunkRetCarrier(SelectedTargetProfile, k_r, R, sretSigma_base) ⇓ ⟨c_r, τ_r, sretSigma⟩
IntLane(1) = `i8`
IntLane(2) = `i16`
IntLane(4) = `i32`
IntLane(8) = `i64`
AggLLVM(T) ⇔ ∃ τ. Γ ⊢ LLVMTy(T) ⇓ τ ∧ (τ is `struct` ∨ τ is `array`)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

labels: x86_64-win64, hosted export, aggregate, scalar ABI parameters
-->
For `SelectedTargetProfile = x86_64-win64`, a conforming implementation MUST NOT split one by-value aggregate source parameter of a hosted export into multiple scalar ABI parameters at the foreign-visible thunk boundary.

labels: hosted export, ABI rewriting, HostSessionAbiParam
-->
No hosted-export-specific ABI rewriting beyond prepending `HostSessionAbiParam` and omitting the first source parameter is permitted.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedThunkModeIndependentForeignClassification
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi

summary: Requires hosted thunk foreign parameter classification to be mode-independent and pointer-typed visible parameters to use canonical C-style pointer carriers.
labels: hosted thunk, foreign parameter classification, pointer carriers
-->
Hosted thunk foreign parameter classification MUST be mode-independent. Pointer-typed visible parameters therefore use canonical C-style pointer carriers at the foreign boundary.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedThunkToSourceCallReconstruction
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires thunk-to-source reconstruction to materialize a temporary storage cell and pass it according to ABIParam when foreign ABI parameter classification differs from source ABI parameter classification.
labels: ForeignABIParam, ABIParam, thunk-to-source call reconstruction
-->
When `ForeignABIParam(T_i) ≠ ABIParam(mode_i, T_i)`, thunk-to-source call reconstruction MUST preserve source semantics by materializing one temporary storage cell of type `T_i`, storing the incoming foreign value into that cell, and passing that temporary according to `ABIParam(mode_i, T_i)` to the source procedure body.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedStateSymbolResolution
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-library thunk and body emission to resolve HostedStateSym loads and stores by full symbol identity and session context and forbids substituting ZeroValue or defaults for failed symbol materialization.
labels: HostedStateSym, HostedStateSym, ZeroValue, symbol materialization
-->
For hosted-library thunk and body emission, loads and stores of `HostedStateSym(Project(Γ), sym)` MUST resolve by full symbol identity `sym` (including cross-module references) and session context, not by module-local global-declaration presence. When `HostedStateSym(Project(Γ), sym)` holds, a conforming implementation MUST NOT substitute `ZeroValue` or any other default value in place of a failed symbol materialization.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedLibraryLifecycleExports
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires every hosted library to emit the specified foreign-callable lifecycle exports with their names, ABIs, return values, session initialization and destruction behavior, failure cleanup, and handle validity behavior.
labels: __ultraviolet_host_abi_version, __ultraviolet_host_session_create, __ultraviolet_host_session_destroy, HostAbiVersion, HostSessionInitSigma, HostSessionDestroySigma
-->
For every hosted library, a conforming implementation MUST emit foreign-callable lifecycle exports with the following names and ABIs:

1. `__ultraviolet_host_abi_version : () -> u32`, which MUST return `HostAbiVersion`.
2. `__ultraviolet_host_session_create : () -> usize`, which MUST return `0` iff it cannot establish a live hosted session by `HostSessionInitSigma`, MUST leave no live hosted session reachable from foreign code on that failure path, MUST reclaim any partially initialized session state for that failed attempt, and MUST otherwise return one nonzero hosted-session handle token.
3. `__ultraviolet_host_session_destroy : (usize) -> u32`, which MUST return `1` iff it destroys one live idle hosted session by `HostSessionDestroySigma`, MUST return `0` for invalid, non-live, or busy handles, and MUST NOT return any value other than `0` or `1`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedLifecycleExportsBackendGenerated
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted lifecycle exports to be backend-generated boundary declarations, not user-declared ProcedureDecl items, and emitted exactly once in each hosted library linked image.
labels: lifecycle exports, backend-generated, ProcedureDecl
-->
These lifecycle exports are backend-generated boundary declarations. They are not user-declared `ProcedureDecl` items. A conforming backend MUST emit them exactly once in the linked image of each hosted library.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedLifecycleExportsPanicAndDestroyFailure
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted lifecycle exports not to propagate Panic and requires session_destroy failure after accepting a live idle handle to return 0, retire the handle, and reclaim remaining session-private runtime state.
labels: lifecycle exports, Panic, __ultraviolet_host_session_destroy, HostSessionDestroySigma
-->
These lifecycle exports MUST NOT propagate `Panic` across the foreign boundary. If hosted-session destruction accepts a live idle handle but user deinitialization panics or session teardown otherwise cannot complete `HostSessionDestroySigma`, `__ultraviolet_host_session_destroy` MUST return `0`, MUST retire the handle so it is no longer live and cannot be reused, and MUST reclaim any remaining session-private runtime state that is not already consumed by the deinitialization steps that completed before the failure.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedSessionHandleNoReissue
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Forbids reissuing a nonzero hosted-session handle token later in the same process lifetime.
labels: hosted-session handle, __ultraviolet_host_session_create
-->
A hosted-session handle token that has been returned nonzero by `__ultraviolet_host_session_create` MUST NOT be reissued again later in the same process lifetime.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportThunkForeignVisibleAbi
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires every hosted export to emit one foreign-callable thunk selected by LinkName whose ABI prepends a session handle, omits the first source parameter, reconstructs that parameter, rejects invalid handles before user code, and applies raw-export unwind boundary rules.
labels: hosted-export thunk, LinkName, session-handle parameter, unwind
-->
For every hosted export `proc`, a conforming implementation MUST emit one foreign-callable thunk whose link name is selected by `LinkName` and whose foreign-visible ABI:

1. prepends one `usize` session-handle parameter;
2. omits the first source parameter from the foreign-visible ABI;
3. reconstructs the first source parameter from the session-owned `Context` value before entering the user procedure;
4. rejects invalid, non-live, and busy handles according to §23.3.12 before any user code executes;
5. applies the same `#unwind` boundary rules as a raw exported procedure with the derived foreign-visible signature.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostedExportThunkEmissionAndEntrypoint
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires hosted-export thunks to be backend-generated boundary declarations emitted exactly once per hosted export, use HostThunkLinkName as the foreign symbol, keep Ultraviolet calls targeting Mangle(proc), and forbid exposing Mangle(proc) as the hosted foreign entrypoint.
labels: hosted-export thunks, HostThunkLinkName, Mangle, HostExports
-->
These hosted-export thunks are backend-generated boundary declarations. They are not the same declarations as the user-authored source procedures. A conforming backend MUST emit exactly one hosted-export thunk per `proc ∈ HostExports(P)` in the linked image of `P`, and that thunk MUST use `HostThunkLinkName(proc)` as its foreign symbol while calls from Ultraviolet code continue to target the source procedure body symbol `Mangle(proc)`. A conforming implementation MUST NOT expose `Mangle(proc)` itself as the hosted foreign entrypoint for `proc`; foreign code enters only through the generated thunk.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 23.4 FFI Attributes

#### 23.4.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.23.FfiAttributes
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar for mangle, library, unwind, export, host_export, and ffi_pass_by_value attributes.
labels: mangle_attribute, library_attribute, unwind_attribute, export_attribute, host_export_attribute, ffi_pass_by_value_attribute
-->
```ebnf
mangle_attribute            ::= "#" "mangle" "(" mangle_mode ")"
mangle_mode                 ::= "none" | string_literal

library_attribute           ::= "#" "library" "(" library_args ")"
library_args                ::= "name" ":" string_literal ("," "kind" ":" string_literal)?

unwind_attribute            ::= "#" "unwind" "(" unwind_mode ")"
unwind_mode                 ::= string_literal

export_attribute            ::= "#" "export" "(" string_literal ")"
host_export_attribute       ::= "#" "host_export" "(" string_literal ")"

ffi_pass_by_value_attribute ::= "#" "ffi_pass_by_value"
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.4.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiAttributesParsing
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires FFI attributes to be parsed by the general attribute parser, with argument classification, target checking, and attribute-specific constraints applied by the referenced chapters and this section.
labels: FFI attributes, attribute parser
-->
FFI attributes are parsed by the general attribute parser in Chapter 5. Argument classification and target checking are defined by Chapter 9 and the attribute-specific constraints below.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

FFI attributes are ordinary attribute-list entries attached to their owning declarations.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

| Attribute           | Target Kinds     |
| :------------------ | :--------------- |

| `unwind`            | `Procedure`      |

| `ffi_pass_by_value` | `Record`, `Enum` |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.4.4 Static Semantics

##### 23.4.4.1 `#mangle`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.MangleAttributeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines mangle attribute validity and link-name selection for none and string modes and rejects non-FFI uses.
labels: mangle, mangle(none), link name
-->
1. Valid only on extern procedure declarations, raw exported procedures, and hosted exports.
2. `#mangle(none)` sets link name to the declaration identifier (unmangled).
3. `#mangle("name")` sets link name to the exact string.
4. String mode MUST be non-empty and valid for the target linker.
5. On non-FFI procedures, `#mangle(...)` is ill-formed.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.4.4.2 `#library`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.LibraryLinkKinds
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines library link-kind names and meanings.
labels: Link Kinds, dylib, static, framework, raw-dylib
-->
**Link Kinds**

| Kind          | Meaning                   |
| :------------ | :------------------------ |
| `"dylib"`     | Dynamic library (default) |
| `"static"`    | Static library            |
| `"framework"` | macOS framework           |
| `"raw-dylib"` | Windows named DLL import  |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.LibraryAttributeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines library attribute validity, name argument interpretation, default kind, manifest independence, and library-resolution obligation.
labels: library, extern block, assembly.link_kind, ResolveLibraryName
-->
1. Valid only on `extern` blocks.
2. The `name` argument specifies the library name without platform prefix or suffix.
3. If `kind` is omitted, `"dylib"` is assumed.
4. This attribute governs foreign-library resolution only. It is independent of the manifest key `assembly.link_kind` defined in §3.2.
5. Library resolution is:
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ResolveLibraryName
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.linker, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines platform-specific library name resolution and library-kind support.
labels: ResolveLibraryName, LibraryKindSupported
-->
```text
ResolveLibraryName(`dylib`, name, `x86_64-sysv`) = "lib" ++ name ++ ".so"
ResolveLibraryName(`dylib`, name, `aarch64-aapcs64`) = "lib" ++ name ++ ".so"
ResolveLibraryName(`dylib`, name, `aarch64-darwin`) = "lib" ++ name ++ ".dylib"
ResolveLibraryName(`dylib`, name, `x86_64-win64`) = name ++ ".dll"

ResolveLibraryName(`static`, name, `x86_64-sysv`) = "lib" ++ name ++ ".a"
ResolveLibraryName(`static`, name, `aarch64-aapcs64`) = "lib" ++ name ++ ".a"
ResolveLibraryName(`static`, name, `aarch64-darwin`) = "lib" ++ name ++ ".a"
ResolveLibraryName(`static`, name, `x86_64-win64`) = name ++ ".lib"

ResolveLibraryName(`raw-dylib`, name, `x86_64-win64`) = name ++ ".dll"

LibraryKindSupported(`framework`, profile) ⇔ false
LibraryKindSupported(`raw-dylib`, profile) ⇔ profile = `x86_64-win64`
LibraryKindSupported(kind, profile) ⇔ kind ∈ {`dylib`, `static`}
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.UnsupportedLibraryKindIllFormed
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires declarations whose library kind is unsupported for the selected target profile to be ill-formed.
labels: LibraryKindSupported, SelectedTargetProfile, E-SYS-3346
-->
If `LibraryKindSupported(kind, SelectedTargetProfile)` does not hold, the declaration is ill-formed.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.RawDylibResolution
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.linker, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires raw-dylib imports to resolve the Windows DLL and foreign symbol by resolved DLL name and declared symbol name, allows implementation-defined lazy resolution, and does not require PE DELAYLOAD.
labels: raw-dylib, Windows DLL, DELAYLOAD
-->
For `raw-dylib` imports, the implementation MUST resolve the named Windows DLL
and foreign symbol using the resolved DLL name and declared foreign symbol
name. Resolution strategy is implementation-defined and MAY be lazy; an
implementation is not required to use PE `/DELAYLOAD`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.4.4.3 `#unwind`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.UnwindModes
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines unwind modes and their boundary behavior.
labels: unwind, abort, catch
-->
**Modes**

| Mode      | Behavior                                                                                            |
| :-------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"abort"` | Any panic or foreign unwind that would cross the boundary aborts.                                   |
| `"catch"` | Unwinding is caught at the boundary. Imported procedures convert foreign unwinds to Ultraviolet panics. |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.UnwindDefaultMode
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires abort to be assumed when unwind is not specified.
labels: unwind, abort
-->
If `#unwind` is not specified, `"abort"` is assumed.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.UnwindAttributeTargetValidity
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires unwind to be valid only on extern procedure declarations, raw exported procedures, and hosted exports.
labels: unwind, E-SYS-3356
-->
`#unwind` is valid only on extern procedure declarations, raw exported procedures, and hosted exports.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.UnwindCatchAbiRequirement
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires catch unwind mode to use C-unwind ABI at extern, raw export, and hosted export boundaries.
labels: Catch ABI Requirement, UnwindMode, C-unwind
-->
**Catch ABI Requirement.**

If `UnwindMode(proc) = "catch"`, the ABI at the boundary MUST be `"C-unwind"`:
1. For extern procedures: `ExternAbiName(ExternAbiOf(proc)) = "C-unwind"`.
2. For raw exported procedures: `ExportAttr(proc) = ⟨"C-unwind", _⟩`.
3. For hosted exports: `HostExportAttr(proc) = ⟨"C-unwind", _⟩`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.4.4.4 `#export`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ExportAttributeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines export attribute target validity, public visibility requirement, ABI selection, external linkage, link-name selection, and FFI safety requirements.
labels: export, public, external linkage, LinkName, FFI safety
-->
1. Valid only on procedure declarations.
2. The procedure MUST be `public`.
3. The ABI string selects the foreign calling convention (see §23.2.4).
4. `#export` implies external linkage.
5. Link name selection is defined by `LinkName` (§24.3) and `#mangle(...)`.
6. Raw export signatures MUST satisfy the FFI safety requirements in §§23.3 and 23.5.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.4.4.5 `#host_export`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.HostExportAttributeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines host_export attribute target validity, public and library requirements, thunk external linkage, ABI selection, link-name selection, hosted-export signature requirements, and prohibition on mixing with export in the same assembly.
labels: host_export, public, library, external linkage, hosted-export thunk, LinkName, export
-->
1. Valid only on procedure declarations.
2. The procedure MUST be `public`.
3. The owning assembly MUST be a library assembly.
4. `#host_export` implies external linkage through the hosted-export thunk defined in §23.3.13. The source procedure body continues to use ordinary visibility-based linkage for Ultraviolet calls; `#host_export` alone does not make the source procedure body symbol the foreign entrypoint.
5. The ABI string selects the foreign calling convention (see §23.2.4).
6. Link name selection is defined by `LinkName` (§24.3) and `#mangle(...)`.
7. Hosted-export signatures MUST satisfy the hosted-export rules of §§23.3 and 23.5.
8. `#host_export` and `#export` MUST NOT appear in the same assembly.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.4.4.6 `#ffi_pass_by_value`

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiPassByValueAttributeSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines ffi_pass_by_value as eligibility for by-value FFI passing of record or enum types satisfying DropType and FfiSafeType, and makes unmarked by-value uses ill-formed.
labels: ffi_pass_by_value, DropType, FfiSafeType, E-TYP-2630
-->
This attribute marks a `record` or `enum` that satisfies both `DropType` and `FfiSafeType` as eligible for by-value passing across the FFI boundary. If a `DropType` + `FfiSafeType` type is passed by value in any FFI signature without this attribute, the program is ill-formed (§23.1.4).
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiAttributeConstraints
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines general FFI attribute constraints, including allowed targets, duplicate symbol diagnostics, unsupported library kinds, redundant-warning cases, host_export library requirement, and host_export/export mixing prohibition.
labels: FFI Attribute Constraints, mangle, library, unwind, host_export, export, E-SYS-3342, W-SYS-3350, W-SYS-3355
-->
**FFI Attribute Constraints**

1. `#mangle` is valid only on extern procedure declarations, raw exported procedures, or hosted exports.
2. Duplicate symbol names within a compilation unit are ill-formed and MUST be diagnosed at compile-time or link-time.
3. `#library` is valid only on `extern` blocks.
4. Unknown library kinds are ill-formed.
5. `#mangle(none)` on a non-FFI procedure is ill-formed.
6. `#mangle(none)` with `#export("C")` is redundant and SHOULD emit a warning.
7. `#unwind` on a non-FFI procedure is ill-formed.
8. `#unwind("abort")` is redundant and SHOULD emit a warning.
9. `#host_export` requires `assembly.kind = "library"`.
10. `#host_export` and `#export` MUST NOT be mixed in the same assembly.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.4.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiAttributesDynamicSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires FFI attributes not to directly evaluate to runtime values and identifies their runtime-relevant effects through unwind behavior, linkage, signature admissibility, hosted-session lowering, and boundary behavior.
labels: FFI attributes, runtime, unwind, linkage
-->
FFI attributes do not directly evaluate to runtime values. `#unwind` selects the boundary behavior defined by §23.7. `#mangle`, `#library`, `#export`, `#host_export`, and `#ffi_pass_by_value` have no direct runtime semantics apart from their effects on linkage, signature admissibility, hosted-session lowering, and boundary behavior.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.4.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.FfiAttributesLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines lowering effects of mangle, library, export, host_export, unwind, and ffi_pass_by_value attributes.
labels: mangle, library, export, host_export, unwind, ffi_pass_by_value, lowering
-->
`#mangle` selects link names. `#library` contributes library-resolution metadata for extern blocks. `#export` implies external linkage at the raw FFI boundary. `#host_export` selects hosted-library thunk emission and the hosted-session lifecycle exports required by §23.3.13. `#unwind` selects the boundary frame strategy in §23.7. `#ffi_pass_by_value` authorizes by-value ABI lowering for eligible `DropType` + `FfiSafeType` records and enums.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.5.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.CapabilityIsolationSemantics
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires foreign code not to receive or return capability-bearing values, rejects raw and hosted FFI signatures containing Context, capability classes, or dynamic class objects, and forbids region-local raw pointers from crossing FFI boundaries.
labels: Capability Isolation, Context, capability class, dynamic class object, region-local raw pointer
-->
**Capability Isolation.** Foreign code MUST NOT receive or return capability-bearing values.

1. Any raw FFI signature or hosted-export visible signature containing `Context`, a capability class, or a dynamic class object is ill-formed.
2. A raw pointer derived from region-local storage MUST NOT cross an FFI boundary.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.CapabilityIsolationHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.typecheck, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines helper predicates for region-local provenance, raw pointer types, and FFI call detection.
labels: RegionLocalProv, RawPtrType, FFICall
-->
```text
RegionLocalProv(π) ⇔ ∃ tag. π = π_Region(tag)
RawPtrType(T) ⇔ T = TypeRawPtr(_, _)
FFICall(Call(callee, args)) ⇔ CalleeProc(callee) = proc ∧ FFIBoundary(proc)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.23.FFI-Arg-RegionLocalRawPtr-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Rejects an FFI call argument whose provenance is region-local and whose expression type is a raw pointer.
labels: FFI-Arg-RegionLocalRawPtr-Err, E-SYS-3360
-->
**(FFI-Arg-RegionLocalRawPtr-Err)**
```text
FFICall(Call(callee, args))    ∃ ⟨_, arg, _⟩ ∈ args. Γ; Ω ⊢ arg ⇓ π ∧ RegionLocalProv(π) ∧ RawPtrType(ExprType(arg))
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; Ω ⊢ Call(callee, args) ⇑
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.23.FFI-Return-RegionLocalRawPtr-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Rejects a return statement from an exported procedure when the returned expression has region-local provenance and raw pointer type.
labels: FFI-Return-RegionLocalRawPtr-Err, E-SYS-3360
-->
**(FFI-Return-RegionLocalRawPtr-Err)**
```text
CurrentProcedure(Γ) = proc    (ExportAttr(proc) defined ∨ HostExportAttr(proc) defined)    Γ; Ω ⊢ e ⇓ π    RegionLocalProv(π)    RawPtrType(ExprType(e))
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ; Ω ⊢ ReturnStmt(e) ⇑
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

### 23.6 Foreign Contracts

#### 23.6.1 Syntax

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: grammar.23.ForeignContracts
kind: grammar
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines grammar for FFI verification attributes, foreign contract clauses, and ensures predicates.
labels: ffi_verification_attr, foreign_contract, foreign_contract_clause_list, ensures_predicate
-->
```ebnf
ffi_verification_attr    ::= "#" ffi_verification_mode
ffi_verification_mode    ::= "static" | "dynamic"

foreign_contract         ::= "|:" "@foreign_assumes" "(" predicate_expr ")"
                           | "|:" "@foreign_ensures" "(" ensures_predicate ")"
foreign_contract_clause_list ::= foreign_contract+
ensures_predicate        ::= predicate_expr
                           | "@error" ":" predicate_expr
                           | "@null_result" ":" predicate_expr
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.6.2 Parsing

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignContractStart
kind: formal-definition
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines the token predicate that starts a foreign contract clause.
labels: ForeignContractStart, foreign_assumes, foreign_ensures
-->
ForeignContractStart(P) ⇔ IsOp(Tok(P), "|:") ∧ IsOp(Tok(Advance(P)), "@") ∧ IsIdent(Tok(Advance(Advance(P)))) ∧ Lexeme(Tok(Advance(Advance(P)))) ∈ {`foreign_assumes`, `foreign_ensures`}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.23.Parse-ForeignContractClauseListOpt-None
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses an absent optional foreign contract clause list when ForeignContractStart does not hold.
labels: Parse-ForeignContractClauseListOpt-None
-->
**(Parse-ForeignContractClauseListOpt-None)**
¬ ForeignContractStart(P)
──────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ ParseForeignContractClauseListOpt(P) ⇓ (P, ⊥)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.23.Parse-ForeignContractClauseListOpt-Yes
kind: formal-rule
phase: parsing
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.parser, compiler.ffi, oracle.parser-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Parses a present optional foreign contract clause list when ForeignContractStart holds.
labels: Parse-ForeignContractClauseListOpt-Yes
-->
**(Parse-ForeignContractClauseListOpt-Yes)**

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

-->
Foreign contracts are attached to extern declarations via `foreign_contracts_opt`.

```text
foreign_contracts_opt ∈ {⊥} ∪ [ForeignContractClause]

ForeignContractKind = {ForeignAssumes, ForeignEnsures, ForeignEnsuresError, ForeignEnsuresNullResult}
EnsuresPredicate = {Ensures(pred), EnsuresError(pred), EnsuresNullResult(pred)}    pred ∈ Expr

ForeignContractClause = ForeignContractClause(kind, preds)
kind ∈ ForeignContractKind    preds ∈ [Expr]
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

labels: Ensures, EnsuresError, EnsuresNullResult
-->
Ensures-predicate forms are:

```text
Ensures(pred)
EnsuresError(pred)
EnsuresNullResult(pred)
```

#### 23.6.4 Static Semantics

##### 23.6.4.1 Foreign Preconditions

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignPreconditions
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines foreign preconditions as caller obligations specified with foreign_assumes.
labels: Foreign Preconditions, foreign_assumes
-->
**Foreign Preconditions.** Conditions that callers must satisfy before invoking foreign procedures, specified using the `@foreign_assumes` clause.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignPredicateContext
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines what foreign contract predicates may and must not reference.
labels: Predicate Context, parameter names, pure functions, global mutable state, effectful operations
-->
**Predicate Context**

Predicates MAY reference:

- Parameter names from the procedure signature
- Literal constants
- Pure functions and operators
- Fields of parameter values (for record types)

Predicates MUST NOT reference:

- Global mutable state
- Values not in scope at the call site
- Effectful operations
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignPreconditionVerificationModes
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines static and dynamic verification-mode behavior for foreign preconditions.
labels: Verification Modes, static, dynamic, ForeignPre
-->
**Verification Modes**

| Mode                   | Behavior                                     |
| :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| `#static` (default) | Caller must prove predicates at compile time |
| `#dynamic`          | Runtime checks inserted before `unsafe` call |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignPreconditionVerificationLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires static foreign preconditions to use StaticProof and dynamic foreign preconditions to insert ContractCheck before the foreign call.
labels: StaticProof, ContractCheck, ForeignPre, dynamic, static
-->
`#static` uses `StaticProof` as defined in §15.8. `#dynamic` inserts `ContractCheck(P, ForeignPre, s, ρ_emptyset)` immediately before the foreign call.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.6.4.2 Foreign Postconditions

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignPostconditions
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines foreign postconditions as successful-return guarantees specified with foreign_ensures.
labels: Foreign Postconditions, foreign_ensures
-->
**Foreign Postconditions.** Conditions that foreign code guarantees upon successful return, specified using the `@foreign_ensures` clause.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignPostconditionPredicateBindings
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines what foreign postcondition predicates may reference.
labels: Predicate Bindings, result, error, null_result
-->
**Predicate Bindings**

Postcondition predicates MAY reference:

- `@result`: The return value of the foreign procedure
- Parameter names (for checking output parameters)
- `@error`: Predicates that hold when the call fails
- `@null_result`: Predicates that hold when result is null
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignPostconditionClassification
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines SuccessCond, ErrCond, NullCond, foreign call error classification, and postcondition implication obligations.
labels: Success, Error, and Null Classification, ErrCond, NullCond, SuccessCond
-->
**Success, Error, and Null Classification**

Let U be the set of unconditional predicates, E the list of `@error` predicates, and N the list of `@null_result` predicates.

Define:

ErrCond =
 ⋀_(P ∈ E) P    if E ≠ ∅
 `false`        otherwise

NullCond = (`@result` == `null`)

SuccessCond = ¬ ErrCond

The foreign call is classified as an error iff `ErrCond` holds; otherwise it is classified as success.

Then the foreign postcondition obligations are:

1. For each P ∈ U, require SuccessCond ⇒ P
2. For each P ∈ E, require ErrCond ⇒ P
3. For each P ∈ N, require NullCond ⇒ P
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.NullResultWellFormedness
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires null_result predicates to appear only when the return type is a nullable pointer type and enumerates nullable pointer forms.
labels: null_result, nullable pointer type, E-SEM-2856
-->
`@null_result` predicates are well-formed only when the return type is a nullable pointer type; otherwise they are invalid. A nullable pointer type is one of:
1. `Ptr<T>@Null`
2. `*imm T`
3. `*mut T`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.NullableFfiResult
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines NullableFfiResult and NullResultEnsures helpers for null_result postcondition validation.
labels: NullableFfiResult, NullResultEnsures
-->
```text
NullableFfiResult(T) ⇔ T = TypePtr(_, `@Null`) ∨ T = TypeRawPtr(`imm`, _) ∨ T = TypeRawPtr(`mut`, _)
NullResultEnsures(proc) = [pred | clause ∈ proc.foreign_contracts_opt ∧ clause.kind = ForeignEnsures ∧ pred ∈ clause.preds ∧ pred = EnsuresNullResult(_)]
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.23.ForeignEnsures-NullResult-Err
kind: formal-rule
phase: diagnostics
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Rejects an extern procedure with null_result ensures predicates when the return type is not a nullable FFI result.
labels: ForeignEnsures-NullResult-Err, E-SEM-2856
-->
**(ForeignEnsures-NullResult-Err)**
```text
proc = ExternProcDecl(_, _, _, _, _, _, ret_opt, _, foreign_contracts_opt, _, _)
NullResultEnsures(proc) ≠ []    R = ProcReturn(ret_opt)    ¬ NullableFfiResult(R)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ proc ⇑
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ErrorPredicateWellFormedness
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.ffi, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires error predicates to appear only on foreign procedures whose return type is not unit.
labels: error, void-returning procedure, E-SEM-2855
-->
`@error` predicates are well-formed only when the return type is not `()`. Using `@error` on a void-returning foreign procedure is ill-formed.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignPostconditionVerificationModes
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines static and dynamic verification-mode behavior for foreign postconditions.
labels: Verification Modes, static, dynamic, ForeignPost
-->
**Verification Modes**

| Mode                   | Behavior                                                      |
| :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `#static` (default) | Postconditions available as assumptions for downstream proofs |
| `#dynamic`          | Runtime assertions after foreign call returns                 |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignPostconditionStaticVerification
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires static foreign postconditions to use StaticProof with SuccessCond and ErrCond gating obligations.
labels: StaticProof, SuccessCond, ErrCond, ForeignPost
-->
`#static` uses `StaticProof` as defined in §15.8 with `SuccessCond` and `ErrCond` gating the obligations.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

##### 23.6.4.3 Verification Summary

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ForeignContractVerificationSummary
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Summarizes static and dynamic foreign-contract verification behavior for preconditions and postconditions.
labels: Verification Summary, static, dynamic, foreign contracts
-->
**Verification Summary.** Foreign-contract verification uses the following mode table:

| Level         | Precondition Check | Postcondition Check      |
| :------------ | :----------------- | :----------------------- |
| `#static`  | Compile-time proof | Available as assumptions |
| `#dynamic` | Runtime assertion  | Runtime assertion        |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.6.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignPreconditionDynamicFailure
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires a failed dynamic ForeignPre check to trigger a panic.
labels: ForeignPre, panic, P-SEM-2860
-->
For foreign preconditions, a failed `ForeignPre` check triggers a panic.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignPostconditionDynamicChecks
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires dynamic foreign postconditions to evaluate ErrCond and NullCond in left-to-right predicate order, insert ContractCheck after the foreign call, and panic with ContractViolation on failure.
labels: ForeignPost, ErrCond, NullCond, ContractCheck, ContractViolation, P-SEM-2861
-->
For foreign postconditions, in `#dynamic` mode, the implementation MUST evaluate `ErrCond` and `NullCond` in left-to-right predicate order and insert runtime checks enforcing the implications above immediately after the foreign call returns. Each inserted check is `ContractCheck(P, ForeignPost, s, ρ_foreign_post)`. A failed runtime check triggers a panic with payload `ContractViolation(ForeignPost, P, s)` at the call site.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.6.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.ForeignContractsLowering
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires dynamic foreign contracts to lower to ContractCheck before the foreign call for ForeignPre and after the foreign call for ForeignPost, while static contracts introduce no runtime checks.
labels: dynamic, static, ForeignPre, ForeignPost, ContractCheck
-->
`#dynamic` lowers foreign contracts by inserting `ContractCheck` before the foreign call for `ForeignPre` and after the foreign call for `ForeignPost`. `#static` introduces no runtime checks.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.7.3 AST Representation / Form

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: ast.23.BoundaryUnwindPolicySource
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.ffi, oracle.ast-fixtures, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines boundary unwind policy as derived from the unwind attribute attached to a procedure declaration.
labels: Boundary unwind policy, unwind attribute
-->
Boundary unwind policy is derived from the `#unwind` attribute attached to a procedure declaration.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.UnwindModeAstHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: ast
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.ast, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines UnwindModeValue, UnwindMode, default abort behavior, and UnwindAttr extraction.
labels: UnwindModeValue, UnwindMode, UnwindAttr
-->
UnwindModeValue = { `abort`, `catch` }

UnwindMode : ProcDecl → UnwindModeValue

UnwindMode(proc) = m ⇔ UnwindAttr(proc) = m
UnwindMode(proc) = `abort` ⇔ UnwindAttr(proc) undefined

UnwindAttr(proc) = m ⇔ ∃ a ∈ AttrByName(proc, "unwind"). a.args = [StringLiteral(m)] ∧ m ∈ UnwindModeValue
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.7.4 Static Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.DetermineUnwindMode
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines DetermineUnwindMode, including default abort mode, parsing a single unwind attribute, and duplicate unwind diagnostic emission.
labels: Formal UnwindMode Determination, DetermineUnwindMode, E-FFI-0350
-->
**Formal UnwindMode Determination**

DetermineUnwindMode : ProcDecl → UnwindModeValue

```text
DetermineUnwindMode(proc) =
  let attrs = AttrByName(proc, "unwind")
  match attrs {
    []        → `abort`
    [a]       → ParseUnwindArg(a)
    _         → Emit(`E-FFI-0350`)
  }
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.ParseUnwindArg
kind: formal-definition
phase: semantic-analysis
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.semantic-analysis, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines ParseUnwindArg for abort and catch string literals and emits E-SYS-3355 for invalid arguments.
labels: ParseUnwindArg, abort, catch, E-SYS-3355
-->
ParseUnwindArg : Attr → UnwindModeValue

```text
ParseUnwindArg(a) =
  match a.args {
    [StringLiteral("abort")] → `abort`
    [StringLiteral("catch")] → `catch`
    _                        → Emit(`E-SYS-3355`)
  }
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

kind: formal-rule

summary: Accepts an unwind mode when the unwind attribute is abort or catch.
labels: UnwindMode-Valid, abort, catch
-->
**(UnwindMode-Valid)**
```
UnwindAttr(proc) = m    m ∈ { "abort", "catch" }
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
UnwindMode(proc) = m
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

**(UnwindMode-Invalid-Err)**

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
UnwindMode(proc) ⇑ c
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.7.5 Dynamic Semantics

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.23.BoundaryUnwindDynamicEffects
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: runtime
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: runtime.evaluator, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Requires abort-mode boundary crossings to abort and catch-mode boundaries to convert imported unwinds to Ultraviolet panics or return ZeroValue for raw and hosted exports.
labels: Boundary Effects, UnwindMode, abort, catch, ZeroValue
-->
**Boundary Effects.**

1. If a Ultraviolet panic or foreign unwind attempts to cross an FFI boundary with `UnwindMode(proc) = abort`, the program MUST abort.
2. If `UnwindMode(proc) = catch`:
   - imported procedures convert foreign unwinds to Ultraviolet panics;
   - raw exported procedures return `ZeroValue(R)` as defined by §23.3.5;
   - hosted exports return `ZeroValue(R)` as defined by §23.3.12.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

summary: Assigns general destruction and unwind cleanup semantics to Section 24.5.
labels: destruction, unwind cleanup
-->
General destruction and unwind cleanup semantics remain defined by §24.5.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 23.7.6 Lowering

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.23.BoundaryUnwindCodeGenerationEffects
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.ffi
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines code generation effects of abort and catch unwind modes for import and export/hosted-export FFI boundaries.
labels: Code Generation Effects, UnwindMode, abort, catch
-->
**Code Generation Effects**

The `UnwindMode` affects generated code at FFI boundaries:

| Mode    | Import (calling extern)                            | Export / Hosted Export (called from foreign)                    |
| :------ | :------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `abort` | Install landing pad that aborts on foreign unwind  | Install frame that aborts if Ultraviolet panic escapes              |
| `catch` | Install landing pad that converts to Ultraviolet panic | Install frame that catches unwind and returns the boundary zero |
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

-->
**(CodeGen-UnwindAbort-Import)**

UnwindMode(extern_proc) = `abort`    CallSite(extern_proc) at location L
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EmitAbortLandingPad(L)
```
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

#### 24.1.1 Codegen Model and Targets

ArtifactsOf(P) = Set(Objs) ∪ Set(IRs) ∪ ({Artifact} if Artifact ≠ ⊥ else ∅) ⇔ Γ ⊢ OutputPipeline(P) ⇓ (Objs, IRs, Artifact)

IRDefined(IR) ⇔ ∀ σ. ∃ out, σ'. ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (out, σ')
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.CodegenCorrectnessPredicates
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines expression, statement, and block codegen correctness predicates relating source semantics to ExecIRSigma behavior.
labels: CodegenExprValCorrect, CodegenExprCtrlCorrect, CodegenStmtCorrect, CodegenBlockValCorrect, CodegenBlockCtrlCorrect
-->
CodegenExprValCorrect ⇔ ∀ e, IR, v, σ, v', σ'. (Γ ⊢ CodegenExpr(e) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩ ∧ Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Val(v'), σ')) ⇒ (ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (Val(v'), σ') ∧ v = v')
CodegenExprCtrlCorrect ⇔ ∀ e, IR, v, σ, κ, σ'. (Γ ⊢ CodegenExpr(e) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩ ∧ Γ ⊢ EvalSigma(e, σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ')) ⇒ ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ')
CodegenStmtCorrect ⇔ ∀ s, IR, σ, sout, σ'. (Γ ⊢ CodegenStmt(s) ⇓ IR ∧ Γ ⊢ ExecSigma(s, σ) ⇓ (sout, σ')) ⇒ ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (sout, σ')
CodegenBlockValCorrect ⇔ ∀ b, IR, v, σ, v', σ'. (Γ ⊢ CodegenBlock(b) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩ ∧ Γ ⊢ EvalBlockSigma(b, σ) ⇓ (Val(v'), σ')) ⇒ (ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (Val(v'), σ') ∧ v = v')
CodegenBlockCtrlCorrect ⇔ ∀ b, IR, v, σ, κ, σ'. (Γ ⊢ CodegenBlock(b) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩ ∧ Γ ⊢ EvalBlockSigma(b, σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ')) ⇒ ExecIRSigma(IR, σ) ⇓ (Ctrl(κ), σ')
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.CodegenCorrectAndUndefined
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines aggregate codegen correctness, undefined codegen, and classifies undefined codegen as outside conformance.
labels: CodegenCorrect, CodegenUndefined, OutsideConformance
-->
CodegenCorrect ⇔ CodegenExprValCorrect ∧ CodegenExprCtrlCorrect ∧ CodegenStmtCorrect ∧ CodegenBlockValCorrect ∧ CodegenBlockCtrlCorrect
CodegenUndefined ⇔ ∃ e, IR, v. Γ ⊢ CodegenExpr(e) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩ ∧ ¬ IRDefined(IR) ∨ ∃ s, IR. Γ ⊢ CodegenStmt(s) ⇓ IR ∧ ¬ IRDefined(IR) ∨ ∃ b, IR, v. Γ ⊢ CodegenBlock(b) ⇓ ⟨IR, v⟩ ∧ ¬ IRDefined(IR)
CodegenUndefined ⇒ OutsideConformance
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.MethodAndTransitionParams
kind: formal-definition

summary: Defines lowered parameter lists for record methods, class methods, substituted class methods, modal state methods, and transitions.
labels: MethodParams, ClassMethodParams, ParamList_T, ClassMethodParams_T, StateMethodParams, TransitionParams
-->
MethodParams(R, m) = [⟨RecvMode(m.receiver), `self`, RecvType(Self_R, m.receiver)⟩] ++ m.params
ClassMethodParams(Cl, m) = [⟨RecvMode(m.receiver), `self`, RecvType(SelfVar, m.receiver)⟩] ++ m.params
ParamList_T(T, params) = [⟨mode_i, name_i, SubstSelf(T, ty_i)⟩ | ⟨mode_i, name_i, ty_i⟩ ∈ params]
ClassMethodParams_T(T, m) = [⟨RecvMode(m.receiver), `self`, RecvType(T, m.receiver)⟩] ++ ParamList_T(T, m.params)
StateMethodParams(M, S, md) = [⟨RecvMode(md.receiver), `self`, RecvType(TypeModalState(ModalPath(M), S), md.receiver)⟩] ++ md.params
TransitionParams(M, S, tr) = [⟨`move`, `self`, TypePerm(`unique`, TypeModalState(ModalPath(M), S))⟩] ++ tr.params
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.ChildExpressionListHelpers
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines helper functions that extract child expressions from argument lists, field initializers, optional expressions, parallel options, spawn options, dispatch options, key paths, key clauses, and race arms.
labels: ArgsExprs, FieldExprs, OptExprs, ParallelOptExprs, SpawnOptExprs, DispatchOptExprs, KeySegExprs, KeyPathExprs, KeyClauseExprs, RaceArmExprs
-->
ArgsExprs([]) = []
ArgsExprs([⟨pass, e, span⟩] ++ rest) = [e] ++ ArgsExprs(rest)

FieldExprs([]) = []
FieldExprs([⟨f, e⟩] ++ rest) = [e] ++ FieldExprs(rest)

OptExprs(⊥, ⊥) = []
OptExprs(e, ⊥) = [e]
OptExprs(⊥, e) = [e]
OptExprs(e_1, e_2) = [e_1, e_2]

ParallelOptExprs([]) = []
ParallelOptExprs(Cancel(e) :: os) = [e] ++ ParallelOptExprs(os)
ParallelOptExprs(Name(_) :: os) = ParallelOptExprs(os)

SpawnOptExprs([]) = []
SpawnOptExprs(Name(_) :: os) = SpawnOptExprs(os)
SpawnOptExprs(Affinity(e) :: os) = [e] ++ SpawnOptExprs(os)
SpawnOptExprs(Priority(e) :: os) = [e] ++ SpawnOptExprs(os)

DispatchOptExprs([]) = []
DispatchOptExprs(Reduce(_) :: os) = DispatchOptExprs(os)
DispatchOptExprs(Ordered :: os) = DispatchOptExprs(os)
DispatchOptExprs(Chunk(e) :: os) = [e] ++ DispatchOptExprs(os)

KeySegExprs([]) = []
KeySegExprs(Field(_, _) :: ss) = KeySegExprs(ss)
KeySegExprs(Index(_, e) :: ss) = [e] ++ KeySegExprs(ss)
KeyPathExprs(⟨root, segs⟩) = KeySegExprs(segs)
KeyClauseExprs(⊥) = []
KeyClauseExprs(⟨path, mode⟩) = KeyPathExprs(path)

RaceArmExprs([]) = []
RaceArmExprs(⟨e, _, _⟩ :: as) = [e] ++ RaceArmExprs(as)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.ChildrenLTRExpressions
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines left-to-right child expression lists for each expression form that participates in lowering evaluation order.
labels: Children_LTR, Literal, PtrNullExpr, Identifier, Path, TupleExpr, ArrayExpr, RecordExpr, EnumLiteral, FieldAccess, TupleAccess, IndexAccess, Call, CallTypeArgs, MethodCall, Unary, Binary, Cast, TransmuteExpr, Propagate, Range, IfExpr, IfIsExpr, IfCaseExpr, LoopInfinite, LoopConditional, LoopIter, BlockExpr, UnsafeBlockExpr, MoveExpr, AddressOf, Deref, AllocExpr, ParallelExpr, SpawnExpr, DispatchExpr
-->
Children_LTR(Literal(ℓ)) = []
Children_LTR(PtrNullExpr) = []
Children_LTR(Identifier(x)) = []
Children_LTR(Path(path, name)) = []
Children_LTR(TupleExpr(es)) = es
Children_LTR(ArrayExpr(es)) = es
Children_LTR(RecordExpr(tr, fields)) = FieldExprs(fields)
Children_LTR(EnumLiteral(path, ⊥)) = []
Children_LTR(EnumLiteral(path, Paren(es))) = es
Children_LTR(EnumLiteral(path, Brace(fields))) = FieldExprs(fields)
Children_LTR(FieldAccess(base, f)) = [base]
Children_LTR(TupleAccess(base, i)) = [base]
Children_LTR(IndexAccess(base, idx)) = [base, idx]
Children_LTR(Call(callee, args)) = [callee] ++ ArgsExprs(args)
Children_LTR(CallTypeArgs(callee, type_args, args)) = [callee] ++ ArgsExprs(args)
Children_LTR(MethodCall(base, name, args)) = [base] ++ ArgsExprs(args)
Children_LTR(Unary(op, e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(Binary(op, e_1, e_2)) = [e_1, e_2]
Children_LTR(Cast(e, T)) = [e]
Children_LTR(TransmuteExpr(T_1, T_2, e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(Propagate(e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(Range(kind, lo_opt, hi_opt)) = OptExprs(lo_opt, hi_opt)
Children_LTR(IfExpr(cond, b1, b2)) = [cond]
Children_LTR(IfIsExpr(scrut, _, _, _)) = [scrut]
Children_LTR(IfCaseExpr(scrut, _, _)) = [scrut]
LoopInvExprs(⊥) = []
LoopInvExprs(inv) = [inv]
Children_LTR(LoopInfinite(inv_opt, body)) = LoopInvExprs(inv_opt) ++ [body]
Children_LTR(LoopConditional(cond, inv_opt, body)) = [cond] ++ LoopInvExprs(inv_opt) ++ [body]
Children_LTR(LoopIter(pat, ty_opt, iter, inv_opt, body)) = [iter] ++ LoopInvExprs(inv_opt) ++ [body]
Children_LTR(BlockExpr(stmts, tail_opt)) = []
Children_LTR(UnsafeBlockExpr(b)) = []
Children_LTR(MoveExpr(p)) = []
Children_LTR(AddressOf(p)) = []
Children_LTR(Deref(e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(AllocExpr(r_opt, e)) = [e]
Children_LTR(ParallelExpr(domain, opts, body)) = [domain] ++ ParallelOptExprs(opts)
Children_LTR(SpawnExpr(opts, body)) = SpawnOptExprs(opts)
Children_LTR(DispatchExpr(pat, range, key_clause_opt, opts, body)) = [range] ++ KeyClauseExprs(key_clause_opt) ++ DispatchOptExprs(opts)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.24.Lower-Expr-Correctness
kind: formal-rule

strength: required

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.RefSyms
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines RefSyms over IR declarations and instruction forms to identify referenced symbols.
labels: RefSyms, RuntimeRefs, LiteralRef, LiteralRefs, VTableRefs
-->
RefSyms : IR → 𝒫(Symbol)
RefSyms([]) = ∅
RefSyms([d] ++ ds) = RefSyms(d) ∪ RefSyms(ds)
RefSyms(ProcIR(_, _, _, IR)) = RefSyms(IR)
RefSyms(GlobalConst(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(GlobalZero(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(GlobalVTable(_, header, slots)) = { s | s ∈ header ∧ s ∈ Symbol } ∪ { s | s ∈ slots ∧ s ∈ Symbol }
RefSyms(EmitVTable(T, Cl)) = RefSyms(d) ⇔ Γ ⊢ EmitVTable(T, Cl) ⇓ d
RefSyms(EmitDropGlue(T)) = RefSyms(IR) ⇔ Γ ⊢ DropGlueIR(T) ⇓ IR
RefSyms(EmitLiteralData(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(ε) = ∅
RefSyms(SeqIR(IR_1, IR_2)) = RefSyms(IR_1) ∪ RefSyms(IR_2)
RefSyms(ReadVarIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(StoreVarIR(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(StoreVarNoDropIR(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(BindVarIR(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(ReadPtrIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(WritePtrIR(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(AllocIR(_, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(MoveStateIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(ReturnIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(ResultIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(BreakIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(ContinueIR) = ∅
RefSyms(DeferIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(ReadPathIR(path, name)) = {PathSym(path, name)} ∪ { sym | StaticSymPath(path, name) = sym }
RefSyms(StoreGlobal(sym, _)) = {sym}
RefSyms(CallIR(callee, _)) = { callee | callee ∈ Symbol }
RefSyms(IfIR(_, IR_t, _, IR_f, _)) = RefSyms(IR_t) ∪ RefSyms(IR_f)
RefSyms(BlockIR(IR_s, IR_t, _)) = RefSyms(IR_s) ∪ RefSyms(IR_t)
RefSyms(IfCaseIR(_, _, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(LoopIR(LoopInfinite, IR_b, _)) = RefSyms(IR_b)
RefSyms(LoopIR(LoopConditional, IR_c, _, IR_b, _)) = RefSyms(IR_c) ∪ RefSyms(IR_b)
RefSyms(LoopIR(LoopIter, _, _, IR_i, _, IR_b, _)) = RefSyms(IR_i) ∪ RefSyms(IR_b)
RefSyms(RegionIR(_, _, IR_b, _)) = RefSyms(IR_b)
RefSyms(FrameIR(_, IR_b, _)) = RefSyms(IR_b)
RefSyms(BranchIR(_)) = ∅
RefSyms(BranchIR(_, _, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(PhiIR(_, _, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(CallVTable(_, _, _)) = ∅
RefSyms(AddrOfIR(p)) = RefSyms(IR_p) ⇔ Γ ⊢ LowerAddrOf(p) ⇓ ⟨IR_p, addr⟩
RefSyms(ClearPanic) = RefSyms(IR) ⇔ Γ ⊢ ClearPanic ⇓ IR
RefSyms(PanicCheck) = RefSyms(IR) ⇔ Γ ⊢ PanicCheck ⇓ IR
RefSyms(CheckPoison(m)) = RefSyms(IR) ⇔ Γ ⊢ CheckPoison(m) ⇓ IR
RefSyms(LowerPanic(r)) = RefSyms(IR) ⇔ Γ ⊢ LowerPanic(r) ⇓ IR

RuntimeRefs(IR) = RefSyms(IR) ∩ RuntimeSyms
LiteralRef(IR, kind, bytes) ⇔ LiteralDataSym(kind, bytes) ∈ RefSyms(IR)
LiteralRefs(IR) = {⟨kind, bytes⟩ | LiteralRef(IR, kind, bytes)}
VTableRefs(IR) = {(T, Cl) | DynPack(T, _) ∈ IR ∨ CallVTable(_, _, _) ∈ IR}
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.ExpandIR
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines IR expansion to include referenced drop glue, vtables, and literal data emissions.
labels: ExpandIR, EmitDropGlue, EmitVTable, EmitLiteralData
-->
ExpandIR(IR) = IR ++ ((++_{(T, Cl) ∈ VTableRefs(IR)} [EmitDropGlue(T), EmitVTable(T, Cl)])) ++ ((++_{⟨kind, bytes⟩ ∈ LiteralRefs(IR)} [EmitLiteralData(kind, bytes)]))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.UniqueEmits
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines emitted artifact keys and the no-duplicate UniqueEmits condition.
labels: EmitKey, EmitKeys, UniqueEmits, NoDup
-->
EmitKey(d) =
 ⟨`vtable`, T, Cl⟩     if d = EmitVTable(T, Cl)
 ⟨`drop`, T⟩           if d = EmitDropGlue(T)
 ⟨`lit`, kind, bytes⟩  if d = EmitLiteralData(kind, bytes)
 ⊥                     otherwise

EmitKeys(IR) = [EmitKey(d) | d ∈ IR ∧ EmitKey(d) ≠ ⊥]
UniqueEmits(IR) ⇔ NoDup(EmitKeys(IR))
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

summary: Fails EmitLLVM when llvm-as resolves and RenderLLVM fails.
labels: EmitLLVM-Err, ResolveTool, RenderLLVM
-->
**(EmitLLVM-Err)**
Γ ⊢ ResolveTool(`llvm-as`) ⇓ a    RenderLLVM(LLVMIR, a) ⇑
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Γ ⊢ EmitLLVM(LLVMIR) ⇑
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: requirement.24.LLVMToolAcceptanceAndResolveOwnership
kind: semantic-requirement
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.diagnostics, compiler.backend, oracle.expected-diagnostics, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines LLVMText_21 and LLVMObj_21 by LLVM 21.1.8 tool acceptance and assigns llvm-as resolution failure to ResolveTool-Err-IR rather than EmitLLVM-Err.
labels: LLVMText_21, LLVMObj_21, LLVM 21.1.8, ResolveTool-Err-IR, EmitLLVM-Err
-->
LLVMText_21 and LLVMObj_21 are defined by LLVM 21.1.8 tool acceptance for textual IR and object emission respectively.
Failure to resolve `llvm-as` is owned by §3.7 `ResolveTool-Err-IR` and the enclosing output rule; it MUST NOT be classified as `EmitLLVM-Err`.
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

LLVMEmitObj_21(LLVMIR) = bytes

Γ ⊢ EmitObj(LLVMIR) ⇓ bytes
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: rule.24.EmitObj-Err
kind: formal-rule

`EmitObj-Err` is reserved for verifier, target-machine, or object-emission failure

#### 24.2.3 Default Calling Convention

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.DefaultCallingConventionAndTargetArtifacts
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, compiler.linker, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines default calling convention, supported calling conventions, object formats/extensions, executable and library naming, runtime library names, linker and archiver tool names, link flags, archive flags, LLVM triples, and LLVM data layouts by target profile.
labels: CallConvDefault, CallingConvention, ObjFormatOf, ObjExt, ExeSuffix, LibraryPrefix, SharedLibSuffix, StaticLibSuffix, ImportLibSuffix, EmitsImportLib, RuntimeLibNameFor, LinkerToolName, LibraryEntrySym, ArchiverToolName, LinkFlagsFor, ArchiveFlagsFor, LLVMTripleOf, LLVMDataLayoutOf
-->
CallConvDefault = `C`

CallingConvention = { `C`, `C-unwind`, `system`, `stdcall`, `fastcall`, `vectorcall` }

ObjFormatOf(`x86_64-sysv`) = "ELF"
ObjFormatOf(`x86_64-win64`) = "COFF"
ObjFormatOf(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = "ELF"
ObjFormatOf(`aarch64-darwin`) = "MachO"

ObjExt(`x86_64-sysv`) = ".o"
ObjExt(`x86_64-win64`) = ".obj"
ObjExt(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = ".o"
ObjExt(`aarch64-darwin`) = ".o"

ExeSuffix(`x86_64-sysv`) = ""
ExeSuffix(`x86_64-win64`) = ".exe"
ExeSuffix(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = ""
ExeSuffix(`aarch64-darwin`) = ""

LibraryPrefix(`x86_64-sysv`) = "lib"
LibraryPrefix(`x86_64-win64`) = ""
LibraryPrefix(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = "lib"
LibraryPrefix(`aarch64-darwin`) = "lib"

SharedLibSuffix(`x86_64-sysv`) = ".so"
SharedLibSuffix(`x86_64-win64`) = ".dll"
SharedLibSuffix(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = ".so"
SharedLibSuffix(`aarch64-darwin`) = ".dylib"

StaticLibSuffix(`x86_64-sysv`) = ".a"
StaticLibSuffix(`x86_64-win64`) = ".lib"
StaticLibSuffix(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = ".a"
StaticLibSuffix(`aarch64-darwin`) = ".a"

ImportLibSuffix(`x86_64-sysv`) = ".so.import"
ImportLibSuffix(`x86_64-win64`) = ".lib"
ImportLibSuffix(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = ".so.import"
ImportLibSuffix(`aarch64-darwin`) = ".dylib.import"

EmitsImportLib(`x86_64-sysv`) ⇔ false
EmitsImportLib(`x86_64-win64`) ⇔ true
EmitsImportLib(`aarch64-aapcs64`) ⇔ false
EmitsImportLib(`aarch64-darwin`) ⇔ false

RuntimeLibNameFor(`x86_64-sysv`) = "UltravioletRT.a"
RuntimeLibNameFor(`x86_64-win64`) = "UltravioletRT.lib"
RuntimeLibNameFor(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = "UltravioletRT.a"
RuntimeLibNameFor(`aarch64-darwin`) = "UltravioletRT.a"

LinkerToolName(`x86_64-sysv`) = `ld.lld`
LinkerToolName(`x86_64-win64`) = `lld-link`
LinkerToolName(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = `ld.lld`
LinkerToolName(`aarch64-darwin`) = `clang++`

LibraryEntrySym(`x86_64-win64`) = "__ultraviolet_library_entry"

ArchiverToolName(`x86_64-sysv`) = `llvm-ar`
ArchiverToolName(`x86_64-win64`) = `llvm-lib`
ArchiverToolName(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = `llvm-ar`
ArchiverToolName(`aarch64-darwin`) = `llvm-ar`

LinkFlagsFor(`x86_64-sysv`, `exe`, out, _) = ["-o", out, "--entry=_start", "--nostdlib", "--dynamic-linker=/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2"]
LinkFlagsFor(`x86_64-sysv`, `shared`, out, _) = ["-o", out, "--shared", "--nostdlib"]
LinkFlagsFor(`x86_64-win64`, `exe`, out, _) = ["/OUT:" ++ out, "/ENTRY:main", "/SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE", "/NODEFAULTLIB"]
LinkFlagsFor(`x86_64-win64`, `shared`, out, import_lib) = ["/OUT:" ++ out, "/DLL", "/ENTRY:" ++ LibraryEntrySym(`x86_64-win64`), "/NODEFAULTLIB", "/IMPLIB:" ++ import_lib]
LinkFlagsFor(`aarch64-aapcs64`, `exe`, out, _) = ["-o", out, "--entry=main", "--nostdlib", "--dynamic-linker=/lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1"]
LinkFlagsFor(`aarch64-aapcs64`, `shared`, out, _) = ["-o", out, "--shared", "--nostdlib"]
LinkFlagsFor(`aarch64-darwin`, `exe`, out, _) =
  ["-target", "arm64-apple-macosx14.0.0", "-mmacosx-version-min=14.0", "-o", out, "-Wl,-rpath,@executable_path", "-Wl,-rpath,@loader_path"]
LinkFlagsFor(`aarch64-darwin`, `shared`, out, _) =
  ["-dynamiclib", "-target", "arm64-apple-macosx14.0.0", "-mmacosx-version-min=14.0", "-install_name", "@rpath/" ++ basename(out), "-o", out, "-Wl,-rpath,@loader_path"]

ArchiveFlagsFor(`x86_64-sysv`, out) = ["rcs", out]
ArchiveFlagsFor(`x86_64-win64`, out) = ["/OUT:" ++ out]
ArchiveFlagsFor(`aarch64-aapcs64`, out) = ["rcs", out]
ArchiveFlagsFor(`aarch64-darwin`, out) = ["rcs", out]

LLVMTripleOf(`x86_64-sysv`) = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
LLVMTripleOf(`x86_64-win64`) = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
LLVMTripleOf(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu"
LLVMTripleOf(`aarch64-darwin`) = "arm64-apple-macosx14.0.0"

LLVMDataLayoutOf(`x86_64-sysv`) = "e-m:e-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i128:128-n8:16:32:64-S128"
LLVMDataLayoutOf(`x86_64-win64`) = "e-m:w-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-f80:128-n8:16:32:64-S128"
LLVMDataLayoutOf(`aarch64-aapcs64`) = "e-m:e-i8:8:32-i16:16:32-i64:64-i128:128-n32:64-S128"
LLVMDataLayoutOf(`aarch64-darwin`) = "e-m:o-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-n32:64-S128-Fn32"
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.ConventionLayout
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines calling-convention layouts by selected target profile and convention, including registers, stack alignment, saved registers, variadic support, unwind support, and panic passing.
labels: ConventionLayout, x86_64-sysv, x86_64-win64, aarch64-aapcs64, aarch64-darwin, C, C-unwind, system, stdcall, fastcall, vectorcall
-->
ConventionLayout(`x86_64-sysv`, `C`) = ⟨
  param_regs: ⟨int = [rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, r9], float = [xmm0, xmm1, xmm2, xmm3, xmm4, xmm5, xmm6, xmm7]⟩,
  return_regs: ⟨int = [rax, rdx], float = [xmm0, xmm1]⟩,
  stack_alignment: 16,
  callee_saved: [rbx, rbp, r12, r13, r14, r15],
  caller_saved: [rax, rcx, rdx, rsi, rdi, r8, r9, r10, r11],
  variadic_support: true,
  unwind_support: false,
  panic_passing: `OutParam`
⟩

ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `C`) = ⟨
  param_regs: ⟨int = [rcx, rdx, r8, r9], float = [xmm0, xmm1, xmm2, xmm3]⟩,
  return_regs: ⟨int = [rax], float = [xmm0]⟩,
  stack_alignment: 16,
  callee_saved: [rbx, rbp, rdi, rsi, r12, r13, r14, r15],
  caller_saved: [rax, rcx, rdx, r8, r9, r10, r11],
  variadic_support: true,
  unwind_support: false,
  panic_passing: `OutParam`
⟩

ConventionLayout(`aarch64-aapcs64`, `C`) = ⟨
  param_regs: ⟨int = [x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7], float = [v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7]⟩,
  return_regs: ⟨int = [x0, x1], float = [v0, v1]⟩,
  stack_alignment: 16,
  callee_saved: [x19, x20, x21, x22, x23, x24, x25, x26, x27, x28, x29, x30],
  caller_saved: [x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, x15, x16, x17, x18],
  variadic_support: true,
  unwind_support: false,
  panic_passing: `OutParam`
⟩

ConventionLayout(`aarch64-darwin`, `C`) = ⟨
  param_regs: ⟨int = [x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7], float = [v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7]⟩,
  return_regs: ⟨int = [x0, x1], float = [v0, v1]⟩,
  stack_alignment: 16,
  callee_saved: [x19, x20, x21, x22, x23, x24, x25, x26, x27, x28, x29, x30],
  caller_saved: [x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, x15, x16, x17],
  variadic_support: true,
  unwind_support: false,
  panic_passing: `OutParam`
⟩

ConventionLayout(profile, `C-unwind`) = ConventionLayout(profile, `C`) with `unwind_support := true`
ConventionLayout(profile, `system`) = ConventionLayout(profile, `C`)
ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `stdcall`) = ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `C`)
ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `fastcall`) = ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `C`)
ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `vectorcall`) = ConventionLayout(`x86_64-win64`, `C`) with `variadic_support := false`
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: def.24.AssignParamRegs
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.ffi, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Defines parameter register and stack assignment for a calling convention.
labels: AssignParamRegs, ConventionLayout, IsFloatType, IsIntOrPtrType, Stack
-->
AssignParamRegs : [ParamType] × CallingConvention → [ParamLocation]

AssignParamRegs(params, conv) =
  let abi = ConventionLayout(SelectedTargetProfile, conv)
  let (int_regs, float_regs) = (abi.param_regs.int, abi.param_regs.float)
  let int_idx = 0, float_idx = 0, stack_offset = 0
  for each (mode, T) in params:
    if IsFloatType(T) ∧ float_idx < |float_regs|:
      assign float_regs[float_idx++]
    else if IsIntOrPtrType(T) ∧ int_idx < |int_regs|:
      assign int_regs[int_idx++]
    else:
      assign Stack(stack_offset)
      stack_offset += Align(sizeof(T), abi.stack_alignment)
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT

summary: Defines the StackFrame tuple fields.
labels: StackFrame
-->
StackFrame = ⟨
  return_address: Offset,
  saved_frame_pointer: Option<Offset>,
  callee_saved_area: [⟨Register, Offset⟩],
  local_variables: [⟨Name, Offset, Size⟩],
  outgoing_args: Option<Offset>,
  alignment_padding: Size
⟩

<!-- ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT
id: rule.24.StackFrame-Layout
kind: formal-rule
phase: lowering
strength: required
owner: spec.lowering
applies-to: compiler.lowering, compiler.backend, oracle.reference-model, oracle.coverage
summary: Computes a procedure stack frame size and offsets from locals, outgoing argument size, callee-saved registers, pointer size, and default convention stack alignment.
labels: StackFrame-Layout, StackFrameOf, CallConvDefault, ConventionLayout
-->
**(StackFrame-Layout)**
procedure f with locals L, max_outgoing_args M
frame_size = Align(|L| + |ConventionLayout(SelectedTargetProfile, CallConvDefault).callee_saved| × PtrSize + M, ConventionLayout(SelectedTargetProfile, CallConvDefault).stack_alignment)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
StackFrameOf(f) = ⟨frame_size, local_offsets, callee_saved_offsets, outgoing_offset⟩
<!-- /ULTRAVIOLET-SPEC-UNIT -->

id: def.24.PanicRecordAndPanicOut
kind: formal-definition
phase: lowering

summary: Defines panic record fields/layout, panic out type/name, the predicate for requiring a panic out parameter, and panic out parameter insertion.
labels: PanicRecordFields, PanicRecordLayout, PanicOutType, PanicOutName, NeedsPanicOut, PanicOutParams
-->
PanicRecordFields = [⟨`panic`, TypePrim("bool")⟩, ⟨`code`, TypePrim("u32")⟩]
PanicRecordLayout = RecordLayout(PanicRecordFields)
PanicRecordFieldsOf(PanicRecord) = PanicRecordFields
PanicRecordLayoutOf(PanicRecord) = PanicRecordLayout

PanicOutType = TypeRawPtr(`mut`, PanicRecord)
PanicOutName = "__panic"

NeedsPanicOut(callee) ⇔ callee ≠ RecordCtor(_) ∧ callee ≠ EntrySym ∧ RuntimeSig(callee) undefined

PanicOutParams(params, callee) =
 params ++ [⟨`move`, PanicOutName, PanicOutType⟩]    if NeedsPanicOut(callee)
 params    otherwise
